nodes.Name: The Head (A)
nodes.Desc:
**District 1 · Nest A** — The Head.

The heart of the City and the residence of **the Head** — the supreme authority standing above all the Wings. The highest level of security; almost nothing is known about the Nest's inner workings: even Feathers of other Wings only ever see it from afar.

Pec.Name: Wing and Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** The Head

Authority. Control over patents, Taboos and taxes. Arbiters.

Pec.Name: Nest
Pec.Desc: The heart of the City and the residence of **the Head** — the supreme authority standing above all the Wings. The highest level of security; almost nothing is known about the Nest's inner workings: even Feathers of other Wings only ever see it from afar.

Pec.Name: Backstreets
Pec.Desc: There is practically no information about the Backstreets of District 1. It is believed that even the slums here are controlled more strictly than the Nests of many other Districts.

Pec.Name: Campaign ideas (non-canon)
Pec.Desc:
- Any deal in which the word "Head" comes up is a reason for paranoia among everyone involved.
- A character may receive a letter bearing the Eye's seal: it contains no threats, only a list of their past deeds.

nodes.Name: The Head's Residence
nodes.Desc: The place where Taboos and patents originate. Visiting uninvited is tantamount to suicide.

nodes.Name: Arbiter Headquarters
nodes.Desc: Arbiters are the Head's elite agents with Singularities of their own (Garion, Zena). They are sent wherever a Taboo has been broken.

nodes.Name: The Eye of the Head (B)
nodes.Desc:
**District 2 · Nest B** — The Eye of the Head.

The Nest of the Head's "Eye" Wing. A spy network devoted to intelligence gathering; the **Beholders** (Luda) belong to it.

Pec.Name: Wing and Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** The Eye

Spy network. Observers (Luda).

Pec.Name: Nest
Pec.Desc: The Nest of the Head's "Eye" Wing. A spy network devoted to intelligence gathering; the **Beholders** (Luda) belong to it.

Pec.Name: Backstreets
Pec.Desc: Nothing is known about the Backstreets of District 2 — which in itself says a lot about the local Wing's work.

Pec.Name: Campaign ideas (non-canon)
Pec.Desc: - Surveillance "out of nowhere": recordings of conversations that nobody could have made.

nodes.Name: The Claw of the Head (C)
nodes.Desc:
**District 3 · Nest C** — The Claw of the Head.

The Nest of the Head's "Fist" Wing. This is where the **Claws** are grown — genetically modified assassin-soldiers (Baral).

Pec.Name: Wing and Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** The Fist

Enforcement by force. Claws (Baral).

Pec.Name: Nest
Pec.Desc: The Nest of the Head's "Fist" Wing. This is where the **Claws** are grown — genetically modified assassin-soldiers (Baral).

Pec.Name: Backstreets
Pec.Desc: Unknown.

Pec.Name: Campaign ideas (non-canon)
Pec.Desc: - A rumor about an unfinished Claw that escaped and is hiding in the Backstreets.

The Nest of E Corp. Its Singularity is unknown.

nodes.Desc:
**District 7 · Nest G** — G Corp.

The Nest of G Corp (gravity, weight-altering spheres). **The old G Corp** fell during **the Smoke War**: its "bug soldiers" with insect prosthetics became the symbol of that slaughter.

Pec.Name: Wing and Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Gravity

Weight-altering spheres. **The old G Corp** (bug soldiers) fell in the Smoke War. Gregor belonged to it.

Pec.Desc: The Nest of G Corp (gravity, weight-altering spheres). **The old G Corp** fell during **the Smoke War**: its "bug soldiers" with insect prosthetics became the symbol of that slaughter.

Pec.Desc: Gregor

nodes.Desc: A Wing war in which the old G Corp and the old L Corp fell. Veterans: Gregor, Outis, Valencina. Future Sinclair speaks of a coming "Second Smoke War".

nodes.Name: Hongyuan (H)
nodes.Desc:
**District 8 · Nest H** — Hongyuan.

**Hongyuan** is a building-city occupying all of District 8. Space is allocated by wealth: on **Restructuring Days** rooms grow or shrink, and the buildings themselves move. It is ruled by the four great families — **Jia, Shi, Xue and Wang** — from **Daguanyuan**.

Pec.Name: Wing and Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Hongyuan (H Corp)

**Boluses** (healing with bodily alteration), brain revival through Life Insurance. Ruled by the four great families (Jia, Shi, Xue, Wang) from Daguanyuan. The Family Hierarch (the head) holds absolute power. The Singularity is also connected to the **Xianhuang Anamnesis Worm** — a parasite that grants immortality by absorbing the host's knowledge and personality. The **Family Hierarch Candidacy Assessment** is held to choose a successor. The building-city of Hongyuan is constantly rebuilt on **Restructuring Days**, allocating space according to wealth (measured in "rooms").

Pec.Name: Nest
Pec.Desc: **Hongyuan** is a building-city occupying all of District 8. Space is allocated by wealth: on **Restructuring Days** rooms grow or shrink, and the buildings themselves move. It is ruled by the four great families — **Jia, Shi, Xue and Wang** — from **Daguanyuan**.

Pec.Name: Backstreets
Pec.Desc: Eastern culture: fabrics, martial arts, timekeeping by the Earthly Branches. The **Heishou** Pack serves as a private army for various powers in Hongyuan.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 985.1.01*
  - "Hongyuan Bioengineering Group". Their Nest is located in District 8.
  - All of it is crammed into one big… Actually, the word "big" doesn't capture the scale of the megastructure that occupies the whole of H Corp's District 8. District 8 as a whole is called Hongyuan.
  - Their Singularity lies in creating the "Bolus", a kind of medicine. I was told these things can be used not only to heal wounds but also for body modification procedures. But something about the way these medicines change your body frightens me.
  - Those who took these boluses or used them in procedures gained body parts of certain creatures, or replaced parts of their own bodies with them.
  - In District 8, depending on your fortune, the size of the room allotted to you can grow or shrink, and the buildings themselves would move accordingly. So here it's "space", huh? Using time in T Corp to measure one's wealth was strange enough.

##### The Heishou Pack
- *Entry #1 · 985.1.02*
  - They are something like a private army for the various powers of Hongyuan.
  - The only branch we've met so far is the Mao Branch, but there are other Heishou branches with the traits of different animals.
  - Jia Xichun told me that they possess the powers of twelve animals from a list called the "Twelve Earthly Branches", and that this most likely carries some ritual significance.
  - I wonder if their loyalty can be traded? Conversations with the Identities revealed that they often change their "masters", or "lords".
  - Considering that R Corp also has "Packs" themed around animals, I can draw some parallels between the Heishou and them.

Pec.Name: Related characters
Pec.Desc: Hong Lu

Pec.Name: Campaign ideas (non-canon)
Pec.Desc:
- A Restructuring Day in the middle of a chase: a corridor vanishes, a room shrinks.
- A Hierarch candidate hires a squad "to prove immortality".

nodes.Name: Daguanyuan
nodes.Desc: A luxurious mansion complex of the four families. The site of the **Family Hierarch Candidacy Assessment** (Canto VIII).

nodes.Name: Tiekan Temple
nodes.Desc: The abode of the **Xianren** — immortal elders who observe the world through Hong Lu's jade eye. The site of the ritual with the Xianhuang Anamnesis Worm.

nodes.Name: Heishou Pack
nodes.Desc: Hongyuan's private army, wielding the powers of the twelve animals (the Earthly Branches). The Mao Branch is well known.

"The District of Music." I Corp took part in the Smoke War.

Pec.Desc:

Took part in the Smoke War.

Pec.Desc: "The District of Music." I Corp took part in the Smoke War.

nodes.Name: J Corp.
nodes.Desc:
**District 10 · Nest J** — J Corp.

The Nest of J Corp — a center of gambling, total surveillance and casinos. Its public Singularity is locking (memories, concepts); its hidden one is extracting **Wish Power** (luck), which can be converted into currency.

Pec.Name: Wing and Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Locking / Luck

Publicly: locking anything (memories, concepts). Secretly: extracting Wish Power (luck). Casinos, pawnshops. In District 10, J Corp's Nest is a center of gambling where luck can be converted into currency.

Pec.Name: Nest
Pec.Desc: The Nest of J Corp — a center of gambling, total surveillance and casinos. Its public Singularity is locking (memories, concepts); its hidden one is extracting **Wish Power** (luck), which can be converted into currency.

Pec.Name: Backstreets
Pec.Desc: The Backstreets are full of pawnshops and underground games. In Canto II the Sinners disguised themselves as the Tingtang Gang.

Pec.Name: Campaign ideas (non-canon)
Pec.Desc:
- A game where the stake is your luck for the coming week.
- A debtor whose name has been "locked".

nodes.Desc: A branch beneath District 10. **Canto II** (Rodion): an underground game for access, Sonya of the Yurodivy, resonance with the Golden Bough.

nodes.Name: J Corp Casino
nodes.Desc: An underground game between Syndicate bosses; Rodion played against Sonya.

nodes.Name: K Corp.
nodes.Desc:
**District 11 · Nest K** — K Corp.

The Nest of K Corp. Its Singularity is **Hemopoiesis / regeneration ampules (HP)**. Officially — nanobots; in reality — processed **tears of "Something Full of Tears"** (the Weeping Beast), which return the body to the form it "remembers" as unharmed.

Pec.Name: Wing and Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Hemopoiesis (HP)

Publicly: regeneration via nanobots. In reality: **the tears of the "Weeping Beast"**, which restore bodies to their original state. The secret was revealed by Dongbaek: the disintegration ampules work on the same principle. Director Alfonso runs the Wing and uses recordings of atrocities to harvest the tears.

Pec.Name: Nest
Pec.Desc: The Nest of K Corp. Its Singularity is **Hemopoiesis / regeneration ampules (HP)**. Officially — nanobots; in reality — processed **tears of "Something Full of Tears"** (the Weeping Beast), which return the body to the form it "remembers" as unharmed.

Pec.Name: Backstreets
Pec.Desc: The prosthetics industry is also here, as was the town of **Kalv**, destroyed by N Corp's Inquisition. The Nest's checkpoint is one of the most dangerous places for those who break procedure.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.22*
  - Located in the Nest of District 11.
  - Judging by that nightmarish fight at the checkpoint... K Corp's Singularity seems to let the user continuously heal—or rather, regenerate—their body.
  Faust called it "Hemopoiesis", but apparently it's easier for City residents to call them HP "bullets" or "ampules".
  Thanks to that, all the Sinners died, and I nearly fainted from the pain of resurrecting 12 people at once...
  But the ampules also helped my melted lower half get back into good shape.
  - K Corp apparently uses this technology in several industries.
- *Entry #2 · 984.4.23*
  - According to Samjo, the employee we saw at Eunbong's, the Wing may also develop food-related technologies using its Singularity.
- *Entry #3 · 984.5.22*
  - I didn't quite understand why they were flying drones around the City filming scenes of death and pain... but it seems there was a reason for all of it.
  - I learned a few things about the Nest and K Corp while carrying out their request... But I'm not sure it's okay for me to keep a record of them.
- *Entry #4 · 984.5.23*
  - All right. Below is some information that I shouldn't be writing down.… But I wanted to write it down anyway. Nothing more comes of it.
  - … Who knows. Someday even I might forget everything.
  - They explained that HP ampules are actually infinitely tiny nanobots that help the body regenerate. Apparently they were so small that a cluster of them just happened to look like some kind of green liquid.
  But all of that was a lie. They weren't anything even remotely like nanobots. The ampules were simply filled with some kind of green liquid.
  - K Corp's HP bullets, also known as regeneration ampules, are nothing like an ointment.
   This...… returns the body of the person it's injected into to the form it remembers as unharmed.
  - Stefanette, the founder of K Corp, went to the Outskirts and brought back this organism, which they call "Something Full of Tears", from which they extract the liquid.
  - I think "Something Full of Tears" was once a person, judging by what I saw during the resonance with the Golden Bough.
  - It seems their wish was that no one would ever suffer pain again. And that wish was granted… in one form or another, anyway. In theory, its tears can heal literally any part of the body, as long as the brain isn't damaged.
  - True to its name, Something Full of Tears sheds tears when it feels sorrow. And by processing or diluting the tears, they create the ampules, K Corp's Singularity.
  - At first, the founder Stefanette drew out the tears by sharing sad or emotional stories. But once she passed away, those who later seized power buried it under a constant stream of brutal, shocking images to draw out tears more efficiently.
  - That's why the drones were filming people's deaths. So they could make Something Full of Tears watch those brutal and shocking tragedies.
  - It seems making her watch the same tragedy over and over isn't as effective. They have to keep feeding it new, different scenes of violence. That's why they import similar footage from other Nests. They planned to use a glass-window technology similar to the Mirror to ensure a constant inflow of video material, but our involvement seems to have prevented that.
  - Considering that "Something Full of Tears" is, after all, an organism, it also seems capable of producing offspring. Alfonso called the one we saw ... a daughter creature.
  - I don't know how… but if I had to venture a guess, I'd say they're trying to improve their production figures by using the children of Something Full of Tears.
- *Entry #5 · 984.5.25*
  - I'm a little curious, but I wonder what would happen if someone with prosthetics were injected with a K Corp Ampule?
  - We learned everything about their Singularity, from its origins to its production methods, but after they put us through a memory-erasure procedure, I'm the only one who remembers it. I decided to lie low and pretend the procedure worked. Even with my limited knowledge of the City, I felt this information was probably fairly important.
  - I don't usually show these notes to the Sinners anyway, but… From now on I'll have to be especially careful.

nodes.Name: L Corp (fallen)
nodes.Desc:
**District 12 · Nest L** — L Corp (fallen).

The **Fallen Nest** of Lobotomy Corporation. After a beam of light burst out of the headquarters, the company sank underground, and in its place appeared **the Library** ("something in the shape of a tower"), which later vanished. The Wing's seat is vacant.

Pec.Name: Wing and Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Lobotomy Corp

**Fallen**. Materialization of the mind (Cogito, E.G.O), Abnormality energy.

Pec.Name: Nest
Pec.Desc: The **Fallen Nest** of Lobotomy Corporation. After a beam of light burst out of the headquarters, the company sank underground, and in its place appeared **the Library** ("something in the shape of a tower"), which later vanished. The Wing's seat is vacant.

Pec.Name: Backstreets
Pec.Desc: After L Corp's fall, the District was gripped by **the Fingers' War** over the empty Nest, and it was shrouded in fog. The epicenter of the "White Nights and Dark Days".

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.28*
  - Full name: Lobotomy Corporation.
  - This Nest was located in District 12. A fallen Wing whose seat is currently vacant.
   It seems it was the epicenter of a City-wide event called the "White Nights and Dark Days", which everyone has heard of. (Except me—or is that because of the amnesia?...)

##### Lobotomy Corporation
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.28*
  - The name of L Corp, which existed in the past. It was an energy supplier.
  - It transported *Abnormalities* (like the ones we've encountered) to its facilities in their egg-like forms and *managed them in containment units* to produce energy in the form of *Enkephalin*.
  - I was told it once supplied energy to many other corporations and Wings—practically all over the City, really—so it must have been quite a substantial enterprise...
  - Then, one fine day, a furious beam of light burst out of the headquarters, and the company vanished underground.
  I even heard that after the company was gone, something appeared in its place... *Something in the shape of a tower*, which vanished after a while. At the time of writing, the Wing's seat is still empty, which has most likely thrown the whole District into chaos.
  - With the disappearance of the headquarters, all branches across the City shut down and were *buried underground*.
- *Entry #2 · 984.5.28*
  - It seems they left behind some of Lobotomy Corporation's E.G.O. The branches once used it to suppress their Abnormalities.
  - I think there are certain conditions and risks to using this E.G.O equipment, such as weapons or armor. It makes sense, since they're derived from the Abnormalities that Lobotomy Corporation used to handle. It seems they also affect the mood or manner of speech of their users.
  - Considering that they're made from Abnormalities… they could become a problem during our future visits to Lobotomy Corporation branches.

Pec.Name: Campaign ideas (non-canon)
Pec.Desc:
- Whoever is first to "declare the Nest destroyed" gets the rights to the land — a race between Syndicates.
- Mothballed containment units with Abnormalities may still lie beneath the ruins.

nodes.Name: L Corp Headquarters
nodes.Desc: The headquarters of Lobotomy Corporation and the Sephirot Tree. The Light burst forth from here.

nodes.Name: The Library (appearance)
nodes.Desc: A building shining "like a mirage in the midst of fog". Later exiled to the Outskirts.

nodes.Name: The Fingers' War
nodes.Desc: The struggle of the Thumb and the Index (among others) for Nest L. The prologue of LoR's "Urban Legend".

nodes.Name: M Corp.
nodes.Desc:
**District 13 · Nest M** — M Corp.

The Nest of M Corp. Its Singularity is **Moonstone**: a material that absorbs psychological damage and lets one focus on a single thing. The **"Abyss"** rehabilitation center (Trauma Rehabilitation Center) is also here.

Pec.Name: Wing and Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Moonstone

A material that absorbs psychological damage. The "Abyss" rehabilitation center.

Pec.Name: Nest
Pec.Desc: The Nest of M Corp. Its Singularity is **Moonstone**: a material that absorbs psychological damage and lets one focus on a single thing. The **"Abyss"** rehabilitation center (Trauma Rehabilitation Center) is also here.

Pec.Name: Backstreets
Pec.Desc: Unknown.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.12.24*
  - Located in the Nest of District 13.
  - It seems they control a Singularity called "Moonstone". They say it lets people focus exclusively on one object or get rid of all distracting thoughts… Given that they have a facility called the "Abyss" Trauma Rehabilitation Center, perhaps they specialize in psychological care or relaxation-related business.
  - Hey, maybe we should buy some of this Moonstone for the Sinners, to prevent E.G.O Corrosion or to help them calm down and relax when their "turn" comes?
  - I shared this seemingly good idea with Faust, but she rejected it immediately. She didn't even explain why — she just said now wasn't the time to discuss it. Considering that practically every technology in the City has these different sides... perhaps it has some side effects too.

Pec.Name: Campaign ideas (non-canon)
Pec.Desc: - Moonstone as a cure for E.G.O Corrosion? Faust refused to discuss it — so there is a price.

nodes.Name: The "Abyss" Center
nodes.Desc: M Corp's trauma rehabilitation center.

nodes.Name: Nagel und Hammer (N)
nodes.Desc:
**District 14 · Nest N** — Nagel und Hammer.

**Nagel und Hammer**. White buildings, a Taboo on video. The hierarchy: "The One Who Holds → Big Hammer → Middle → Small Nail". The Inquisition destroys "heretics" with prosthetics. Director **Hermann** is behind the experiments with the Mirrors and the "dough".

Pec.Name: Wing and Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Nagel und Hammer

Preserving experience. An Inquisition against prosthetics. Hierarchy: The One Who Holds → Big Hammer → Middle → Small. Actively destroys "heretics" with prosthetics (Canto III). Carried out punitive operations in Kalv. Is trying to revive the League of Nine. **Director Hermann** plays a key role in the experiments with the Mirrors and the "dough".

Pec.Name: Nest
Pec.Desc: **Nagel und Hammer**. White buildings, a Taboo on video. The hierarchy: "The One Who Holds → Big Hammer → Middle → Small Nail". The Inquisition destroys "heretics" with prosthetics. Director **Hermann** is behind the experiments with the Mirrors and the "dough".

Pec.Name: Backstreets
Pec.Desc: N Corp's Taboo Hunters are a formidable force. Meursault and Vespa Crabro came from this Wing.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.22*
  — Nägel und Hammer: located in the Nest of District 14. Nägel apparently means "Nail".
  - After talking with Meursault, it turned out there are two factions called "Nail" and "Hammer".
   According to him, the armored "inquisitors" we encountered weren't so common when he worked for the Wing, and there weren't nearly as many of them during his time there.
  - Unlike the group under Kromer's command, N Corp isn't all that different from other corporations, setting aside a certain harshness.
- *Entry #2 · 984.4.24*
  - Not sure what their main business is, but some of the Sinners seem familiar with the Wing.
  ...If only they'd tell me everything too.

Pec.Name: Related characters
Pec.Desc: Meursault

Pec.Name: Campaign ideas (non-canon)
Pec.Desc:
- A character with prosthetics in District 14 is a walking target.
- The board of directors approves the roster of the "Malleus Maleficarum".

nodes.Name: The Inquisition
nodes.Desc: The punitive force of the Nails and Hammers. Burned Kalv (Canto III).

nodes.Name: O Corp.
nodes.Desc:

The Nest of O Corp. All that is known is that it tried to buy Enkephalin.

**Singularity / specialty:** Unknown

Tried to buy Enkephalin.

Pec.Desc: The Nest of O Corp. All that is known is that it tried to buy Enkephalin.

Pec.Desc: Unknown.

nodes.Name: P Corp.
nodes.Desc:
**District 16 · Nest P** — P Corp.

Art Deco skyscrapers and spires. Its Singularity is **the expansion and warping of space**; buildings are elastic, and inside is "the safest place". Publicly known for canned goods. **The Archiving Department** (headed by Cesara) keeps records and funds the destruction of phenomena.

Pec.Name: Wing and Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Spatial expansion

Safe real estate made of elastic material. The goal: "the safest place". **The Archiving Department** (headed by Cesara) keeps records and funds the destruction of phenomena.

Pec.Desc: Art Deco skyscrapers and spires. Its Singularity is **the expansion and warping of space**; buildings are elastic, and inside is "the safest place". Publicly known for canned goods. **The Archiving Department** (headed by Cesara) keeps records and funds the destruction of phenomena.

Pec.Name: Backstreets
Pec.Desc: The station walls are plastered with flyers. The La Manchaland phenomenon bent neighboring buildings like rubber.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.12.20*
  - Located in the Nest of District 16.
  - It's full of incredibly tall skyscrapers and spires, and I have to crane my neck to see how tall they really are.
  - Their specialty is canned goods. Meursault listed every kind of canned food, and I learned there are a great many of them.
  - The walls and pillars of the station were covered from top to bottom with all kinds of flyers. I wonder what's going on here?
- *Entry #2 · 984.12.25*
  - Their motto has something to do with creating a very safe place, and their Singularity can either expand or warp space itself.
  - I was told that all structures built with P Corp's Singularity are very... elastic. That turned out to be surprisingly literal, because when La Manchaland began to manifest, I saw the buildings touching La Manchaland bulge outward like rubber. They said it's perfectly safe inside, even if the outside of the building bends and twists like that, but... I can't imagine how that's possible.
  - Many spatial-expansion technologies in the City make things bigger on the inside, but P Corp's version is focused first and foremost on safety.
  - This is just my guess, but... if I recall our conversation with Cesara, it seems La Manchaland heavily influenced P Corp's Singularity. I wonder whether a Singularity could be developed that's inspired by something else?

Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.7*
  - Located in the Nest of District 18.
  - Judging by what I've heard from the Sinners connected to the corporation, it's a bit different from the other Wings I know.
  While most Wings provide all sorts of conveniences, using their Singularities to improve people's quality of life, R Corp deals mainly in armed force, such as mercenary work.
  - R Corp's might as a Wing depends on the quality of the military services it provides.
  Outis added that however important a unit's size may be, most of its strength in combat will depend on field experience and fortitude of spirit.
  In that sense, she says, R Corp's combatants (soldiers? employees?) are like killing machines with dauntless spirits and excellent health.
  Gregor said that ordinary soldiers often lose the will to fight and then flee the battlefield or panic, and those who don't are the exceptions.
  I wonder if R Corp runs war games and simulators or something like that?
- *Entry #2 · 984.5.9*
  - From what the R Corp Identities say, one can conclude that the Wing has a team called the "4th Pack" with three units: Rabbits, Reindeer and Rhinos.
  - Rabbits are generalists who can be deployed on a wide range of missions.
  - Reindeer have surgically received antlers that convert their mental power into physical power.
  - I haven't personally met the Rhinos yet, but I was told their specialty is sowing chaos.

  - Located in the Nest of District 19.
  - It seems they have a ... "King" ...? And this "King", whatever that means, has "servants".
  - Okay, according to some brief explanations, this appears to be a form of governance. Something like the Nests and Wings... but not quite the same. Don Quixote's eyes were practically shining as she listened, so I'm pretty sure it's far from a standard system of governance.
  - The thing is, every Nest has its own culture and its own way of doing things.
  - I still have no idea what Singularity they use to sustain their Nest.
- *Entry #2 · 984.11.9*

  - The members of the Blade Lineage we ran into recently were also from S Corp. Apparently they left the Nest for a reason similar to Yi Sang's: internal problems and the tyranny of the corrupt.
  - S Corp is in incredible chaos.... I hope that's not where we're headed next.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.26*
  - Located in the "Nest of District 20".
  - It seems they specialize in the use of temporal technologies.
  - I only got to know T Corp through the resonance with the Golden Bough. I've never actually been to T Corp's Nest before, so I'm not sure how true to life that experience was.
  - It seems they value technology and inventions.
   - The entire Nest is literally monochrome. I think having any color at all is a privilege granted only to those with power. Black smoke constantly spewing from countless buildings has darkened the sky.
- *Entry #2 · 984.12.12*
  - Well, I understand that I accidentally manipulated a large amount of time. But out of pure curiosity, I asked Yi Sang how we ended up owing more than ten billion ahn in time tax.
  - Yi Sang explained that each person has their own time tax rate, and that the more "time" you have, the more time tax you have to pay. He went on to explain it with all sorts of mathematical formulas, but I didn't understand even half of what... I mean, not even a quarter of what he said.
  - No matter how much time someone has, they can't use it unless they withdraw the remaining time the day before. With that spare time they can use it right away to make their days longer… or save it to use in another situation. Not that poor people have the financial means to even consider the latter.
  - The CEO of T Corp was a guy named Herbert. I don't think I'd ever met the actual leader of an entire Wing before…
  - Herbert helped the Sinners by pretending to be our "assistant". He used to strive to make the City a better place, or so he says… Honestly, considering the state T Corp is in, I'm not sure I believe it.
  - At first he seemed somewhat depressed. Having let the League of Nine Literati go, having ignored the presence of the Yurodivy in his Nest… But something in me seems to have motivated him again. The question is… why?
  - He also gave me an ominous warning that… turning back time always comes at a steep price.
  -… But how could I not turn back time?

- *Entry #1 · 984.5.26*
  - Located in the Nest of District 21.
  - They use a Singularity called the Resonance Tuning Fork. It can merge two objects of completely different natures into one, as if they had always been part of each other.
  - Somehow the power of the Resonance Tuning Fork merged guns with monstrous crabs called Trash Crabs. They could use these merged firearms as if they had been born with them.
  U Corp is scattered across the Great Lake, and most of its main facilities are located on its surface.
  - Which means we badly need a ship if we want to go anywhere in U Corp. So we turned Mephistopheles into a ship using the Resonance Tuning Fork.
  - It seems to me that this overlaps with another region called the 'Outskirts'… Hm.

"The District of Taste" — there is no Taboo on cannibalism here. The **WARP** Nest: trains that carry you anywhere in "10 seconds". In reality the trip lasts thousands of subjective years; passengers sleep in cryo-sleep, and the Cleanup Crews clean up whatever has become of those who stayed awake.

Pec.Name: Backstreets
Pec.Desc: The childhood of **Kali (the Red Mist)** — orphans in the Backstreets of District 23.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.6*
  - Located in the Nest of District 23
  - I still haven't had the chance to visit this place, but I learned a couple of things from the Wing's Identities.
  W Corp runs a transport service known as the "WARP Train", which carries passengers from one station to another in mere seconds.
  WARP Train tickets are apparently very expensive, and I was told how absurd the first-class prices are.
  -...Shouldn't you cut prices and transport people that way?
- *Entry #2 · 984.5.8*
  - I'll write down some additional details I managed to hear.
  - Although you can get anywhere by car, WARP Trains are preferred because traveling by car can be quite difficult.
  Makes sense, if you recall the procedures we had to go through to enter K Corp's Nest.
  - More specifically, it seems the bad roads are a big problem.
  They are so winding and tangled that traveling between Backstreets by car takes an unreasonably long time.
  - Even if the distance is small, the route will be labyrinthine.
  Supposedly there are wide open roads called highways connecting the Nests, but those also come with a number of conditions and costs.
- *Entry #3 · 984.5.9*
  - I learned a shocking fact while talking with the Sinners in W Corp Identities.
   Even though they don't tell me directly... from other people's point of view the trips take no more than a couple of minutes, but in reality they can take a monstrously long stretch of time, robbing passengers of their sanity and deforming their bodies beyond recognition by the time the trip is over.
  Then, a cleanup agent physically sorts out the mess every time.
  -...Thank god we have the bus.
  - All of this is speculation based on conversations with the Identities, so I plan to keep this information to myself.
- *Entry #4 · 984.12.13*
  - After I'd gotten to know many Identities of W Corp employees and learned quite a lot about the WARP Trains from them, I felt comfortable enough to share this information with the Sinners. Looking back, it was a good move. It would have been a disaster to explain to them what WARP Trains were at that moment.
  - Besides being allowed to enter cryo-sleep during the WARP Train trip, we were also given free snacks as part of the first-class package. The blissful expression on Rodion's face (she also took my portion, since I had no mouth to eat it with) made it clear that it was a real delicacy.
  - It did seem somewhat unusual to me that a train which, as far as the public knows, runs for only ten seconds would bother selling packages or onboard meals. When I asked Faust, she explained that their purpose was less practical and more thematic, so that passengers would get the impression they were setting off on a journey.
  - One more thing: I definitely remember that employee crawling into an emergency escape pod. So where did he go?
  - So why don't WARP Trains specialize in transporting cargo? If they have to deal with such difficulties and labor costs to transport people, wouldn't it be far more efficient if they just carried cargo?
  - Wait, I think I've started a discussion —
  - Heathcliff said it's because transporting people is the whole point of the train. That remark seemed to give Yi Sang an idea.
  - Yi Sang pointed out that because of W Corp's cooperation with T Corp, they probably need "time" to run their trains. Moreover, T Corp's CEO said that emotions don't change with time; on the contrary, time changes along with emotions. Something like that, at least.
  - Based on what everyone said, we reached a fairly plausible conclusion. The state of an emotionally transforming consciousness in an effective infinity of time is what drives or powers the WARP Trains. Either that, or WARP Trains are built precisely to induce such a state of consciousness. Some of the Sinners and I applauded Yi Sang and Heathcliff for this hypothesis.

nodes.Name: Backstreets
nodes.Desc: Slums that occupy most of every District. There are no Wing laws here — only force. Order is kept by **the Fingers** and other Syndicates; protection can be bought from Associations and Offices. The roads are winding and tangled, and everything is damp. The borders between the Nest and the Backstreets are always clearly visible.

Pec.Name: Streets and daily life
Pec.Desc: Restaurants, workshops, schools, academies, housing. Firearms are unpopular because of the Taboos and the strength of Fixers. Cars are nearly useless because of the maze of roads; there are toll highways between the Nests.

nodes.Name: The Night in the Backstreets
nodes.Desc: Daily from **3:13 to 4:34**. Killing is legal and **the Sweepers** walk the streets. Breaking into homes and making recordings is forbidden. Everyone hides.

Pec.Name: Sweepers
Pec.Desc: Post-humans who speak in numbers. They process bodies into fuel. In LoR they are a separate Reception (Urban Nightmare).

nodes.Name: WARP Network
nodes.Desc: W Corp's trains connect the Nests in "10 seconds". For the wealthy, there is first class with cryo-sleep.

nodes.Name: The Nests
nodes.Desc: The centers of the Districts, governed by the Wings. A high standard of living and safety. Entry requires an immigration ticket (an exam or special conditions). Feather residents pay taxes. Breaking procedure at a checkpoint is punishable by death without warning.

nodes.Name: Fashion of the cardinal directions
nodes.Desc: The North is bright and high-tech; the South is businesslike; the East is Asian (fabrics, "Skirmish", time by the Earthly Branches); the West is medieval (knights, orders). Association uniforms differ by region; a transfer to the headquarters' "home" region is considered a promotion.

nodes.Name: Taboos of the Head
nodes.Desc: The code of prohibitions: AI indistinguishable from humans, firearms, cloning for >7 days, complete resurrection, unhumans, taxes and patents (three warnings → death). Details on the "Concepts and Taboos" screen.

nodes.Name: The Great Lake
nodes.Desc: A vast body of water on the edge of the City, divided into separate **Lakes**. Each has its own **Laws**: rules of time, direction of travel, Waves. Breaking the Laws causes catastrophes. Home to Whales, Merfolk and **the Five Calamities**. U Corp's monopoly.

Pec.Name: The Laws of the Lake
Pec.Desc: A set of rules of navigation, time and Waves for each Lake. Writing down or tattooing the laws is Taboo; violators are hunted by U Corp's Taboo Hunters.

Pec.Name: Variable Coordinates
Pec.Desc: Encrypted navigation data based on the Laws of the Lake, without which U Corp's facilities cannot be reached.

Pec.Name: Transport
Pec.Desc: Port-ships assembled by the Resonance Tuning Fork. Mephistopheles was converted into a bus-boat.

nodes.Name: Port Marlin
nodes.Desc: A large port-ship and trade hub. LCB met the agent Pilot here (**Canto V**).

nodes.Name: Port Ray
nodes.Desc: Another U Corp port.

nodes.Name: The Twinhook Pirates
nodes.Desc: Lake pirates who captured Pilot's crew. Behind them stands the Middle Finger's Big Brother **Ricardo**.

nodes.Name: The Five Calamities
nodes.Desc: Colossal whale-like monsters of the Lake (the Pallid Whale and others). The Indigo Elder has destroyed several of them.

nodes.Name: The Pallid Whale
nodes.Desc: One of the Five Calamities. Comes from the Wastes beyond the Outskirts and devours everything, leaving "pallid" ruins. It swallowed a Golden Bough; killed by Ishmael from the inside (**Canto V**).

Pec.Name: Paling
Pec.Desc: People swallowed by the Whale turn into Merfolk. Dante's clock counteracts the paling.

nodes.Name: Pequod Village
nodes.Desc: The surviving crew of the ship "Pequod" inside the Pallid Whale, led by Captain **Ahab**. Ishmael served here.

nodes.Name: Merfolk
nodes.Desc: People swallowed and changed by the Whale. Pallid Merfolk keep their skills and attack every living thing.

nodes.Name: Trash Crabs
nodes.Desc: Monstrous crabs from the shore; the Resonance Tuning Fork fused some of them with rifles. The Trash Crab King — **Intervallo II**.

nodes.Name: The Indigo Elder
nodes.Desc: A Color Fixer and legendary Whale hunter. "I'm just chasing the fish that got off my hook." His boat is made of X Corp alloy.

nodes.Name: The Outskirts
nodes.Desc: Vast wastelands outside the City with ruined settlements and anomalous zones. Compared to them, even the Backstreets seem calm. They arose from the Wing wars before the Head established control; a place of exile for robots, cyborgs, failed experiments and other "filth" of the City.

Pec.Name: History
Pec.Desc:
- They arose from the Wing wars before the Head established control.
- They became a place of exile for robots, cyborgs, failed experiments and other "filth" of the City.
- Key events:
  - Carmen founded a laboratory in the Outskirts. Enoch died here, and Carmen took her own life. The laboratory was destroyed by the Arbiter Garion.
  - In the 980s, a conflict between the Ring and Pinky Fingers took place in the Outskirts.
  - In 982, Angela's Library was exiled there.

Pec.Name: Inhabitants
Pec.Desc:
- **Sweepers:** Cannibalistic post-humans.
- **Outskirts residents:** People exiled or born here, hiding from monsters.
- **Monster hunters:** Defenders of settlements (Domino of Cloud Village).
- **Notable figures:** Lisa and Enoch (rescued by Carmen); Angelica and Argalia (cast out by a Wing, survived).
- **Monsters:**
  - **Clockwork Jaws:** Outwardly resemble Dante.
  - **Gnomes:** Armed plush toys that kidnap people around New Year (exiled from the City). They have a gift factory and make gifts out of people. Led by the giant Santata.
  - **Northern Giants:** Giants that burst into acid when they die (defeated by piercing the belly).
  - **Jiajia-ren (Cuckoo People):** Prolific bird-like monsters.
- **Unhumans:** Sentient monsters exiled under the Taboos.

nodes.Name: Carmen's Laboratory
nodes.Desc: The research complex of the "Seed of Light" project. Enoch died here, Carmen took her own life; the laboratory was destroyed by the Arbiter Garion. Later — a shelter for Outskirts residents, where the Red Mist set up a command post; Argalia visited her there.

nodes.Name: The Library (exiled)
nodes.Desc: After the Head's visit the Library was moved to the Outskirts. Angela and Roland are free, but exiled forever.

nodes.Name: Cloud Village
nodes.Desc: A ruined settlement, Crayon's birthplace. It was protected by the monster hunter Domino.

nodes.Name: Santata's Gift Factory
nodes.Desc: Gnomes kidnap people around New Year and make them into "gifts" for the monsters of the Outskirts. The boss is the giant **Santata** (**Intervallo III**).

nodes.Name: The Black Forest
nodes.Desc: The place where the Deepest River breaks through, from which Abnormalities emerge. In L Corp's fairy tales — the forest of the Three Birds.

nodes.Name: The Outskirts Train
nodes.Desc: Runs between the Outskirts and the City.

nodes.Name: Gnomes
nodes.Desc: Armed plush toys exiled from the City. They kidnap people around New Year.

nodes.Name: Northern Giants
nodes.Desc: Giants that burst into acid when they die. Defeated by piercing the belly.

nodes.Name: Cuckoo People
nodes.Desc: Jiajia-ren — prolific bird-like monsters.

nodes.Name: Clockwork Jaws
nodes.Desc: Monsters that outwardly resemble Dante.

nodes.Name: Unhumans
nodes.Desc: Sentient monsters exiled by the Taboos.

nodes.Name: Monster Hunters
nodes.Desc: Defenders of settlements, such as Domino of Cloud Village.

nodes.Name: Beyond the Outskirts
nodes.Desc: A beautiful and calm territory with a starry sky and unknown flowers. It is believed that **the Pallid Whale** and the other Calamities come from beyond this boundary.

nodes.Name: Star
nodes.Desc: A transcendent being that grants sincere wishes in a distorted form. It created "Something Full of Tears" (K Corp's source) and helped Herbert (T Corp).

nodes.Name: Nebulae
nodes.Desc: Unknown beings. According to Bari, humanity will lose the war against them.

nodes.Name: Ruins
nodes.Desc: The depths beneath the City, where magical rivers flow and surreal creatures dwell. Danger on the level of **ALEPH** or **Star of the City**. Explorers: R Corp teams, the Dieci Association, the Order of the World's Edge, **Bari** (Knight of the White Moon), Tai.

nodes.Name: The Deepest River / The Primordial Sea
nodes.Desc: The source of everything (past, present, future). Abnormalities emerge from its breaches.

nodes.Name: The River of Mirror-World / of the Future
nodes.Desc: Sight of the future, but blindness to the present → madness.

nodes.Name: The River of Oblivion (Lethe)
nodes.Desc: Puts memories to sleep (reversibly). Sancho lived by it for 200 years.

nodes.Name: The River of Immortality
nodes.Desc: Immortality of the mind. Sought by Jia Xichun.

nodes.Name: Bari — Knight of the White Moon
nodes.Desc: A wandering Fixer who showed Sancho the Rivers of the Ruins and led her to Lethe. For centuries she secretly sent her books and letters.

nodes.Name: How to read the map
nodes.Desc:
**A diagram, not exact geography.** Districts 1–26 are arranged in a circle by number (the Wing's letter = the District number). The exact relative positions of the Districts are not revealed in canon.

- Frame = District, large circle = Nest and Wing, squares = important places.
- West: **the Great Lake**. East: **the Outskirts** and what lies **beyond them**. South: **the Ruins** beneath the City.
- Every District has a "Campaign ideas" sub-block — this is not canon, but material for the GM.
- Other screens: Factions, Lobotomy Corp, Abnormalities, Library, Limbus Company, Timeline, Concepts.

nodes.Name: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
nodes.Desc: N Corp's virtual department-store prison: the place where the "Sisyphean punishment" is served and the factory of **Canned Experience**. The setting of **Canto X**; destroyed, and a "Sisyphean rain" fell over District 14.

nodes.Name: The Head
nodes.Desc:
The supreme authority of the City, standing above all the Wings. Consists of the three "first" Wings: **A, B and C**. Sets the **Taboos**, issues patents on technologies, collects taxes and assigns threats the rank of **Impurity** ("Impure City").

Taboo violators can expect a visit from the Arbiters and Claws; to the Backstreets, the Head is more a natural disaster than a government.

Pec.Name: Taboo
Pec.Desc: The full list is on the "Concepts and Taboos" screen. The main ones: the AI Ethics Amendment, firearms, cloning, resurrection, unhumans, taxes and patents.

Pec.Name: The Head's Three Wings
Pec.Desc:
| Wing | Role |
|---|---|
| **A — The Head** | Authority, patents, Taboos, taxes, Arbiters |
| **B — The Eye** | Spy network, Beholders |
| **C — The Fist** | Enforcement by force, Claws |

nodes.Name: A Corp — The Head
nodes.Desc: Controls the Taboos, issues patents, collects taxes. The **Arbiters** answer to it.

nodes.Name: B Corp — The Eye
nodes.Desc: Intelligence gathering and surveillance. Its agents are the **Beholders** (Luda).

nodes.Name: C Corp — The Claw
nodes.Desc: The enforcement arm: genetically modified assassin-soldiers, the **Claws** (Baral).

nodes.Name: Arbiters
nodes.Desc: The Head's elite agents, possessing Singularities. They carry out especially important missions: eliminating Taboo violators.

nodes.Name: Garion
nodes.Desc: The Arbiter who destroyed Carmen's laboratory. Her brain became the basis of the Sephirah **Binah** (see the Lobotomy Corporation screen).

nodes.Name: Zena
nodes.Desc: The Arbiter who came to the Library for its violation of a Taboo (the finale of Library of Ruina).

nodes.Name: Luda
nodes.Desc: The B Corp Beholder who accompanied the Arbiter to the Library.

nodes.Name: Baral
nodes.Desc: The Claw who invaded the Library together with Zena and Luda.

nodes.Name: Wings
nodes.Desc:
26 monopolistic corporations that own **Singularities** — proprietary technologies. With the income from them (and from taxes), a Wing governs the **Nest** of its District. Employees are called **Feathers**.

The fall of a Wing leads to its Nest being assimilated into the Backstreets and to Syndicate wars over the empty seat.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.21*
  - The companies that possess the most advanced and influential technologies in their Districts practically run everything.
   Supposedly they're corporate entities, but the more I hear about them, the more they seem like governing bodies.
   (Come to think of it, Limbus Company doesn't really fit the conventional idea of a company either. For example, we spend all our time on a bus.)
  - Every Wing has its own proprietary technologies called "Singularities", and uses the money earned from them (and ridiculous taxes) to run a high-class district within the District, called a Nest.
  - It seems the people who work for the Wings are called "Feathers".

nodes.Name: H — Hongyuan
nodes.Desc:
**Wing H**, the Nest of District 8.

**Boluses** (healing with bodily alteration), brain revival through Life Insurance. Ruled by the four great families (Jia, Shi, Xue, Wang) from Daguanyuan. The Family Hierarch (the head) holds absolute power. The Singularity is also connected to the **Xianhuang Anamnesis Worm** — a parasite that grants immortality by absorbing the host's knowledge and personality. The **Family Hierarch Candidacy Assessment** is held to choose a successor. The building-city of Hongyuan is constantly rebuilt on **Restructuring Days**, allocating space according to wealth (measured in "rooms").

Pec.Name: Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Hongyuan (H Corp)

**Boluses** (healing with bodily alteration), brain revival through Life Insurance. Ruled by the four great families (Jia, Shi, Xue, Wang) from Daguanyuan. The Family Hierarch (the head) holds absolute power. The Singularity is also connected to the **Xianhuang Anamnesis Worm** — a parasite that grants immortality by absorbing the host's knowledge and personality. The **Family Hierarch Candidacy Assessment** is held to choose a successor. The building-city of Hongyuan is constantly rebuilt on **Restructuring Days**, allocating space according to wealth (measured in "rooms").

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 985.1.01*
  - "Hongyuan Bioengineering Group". Their Nest is located in District 8.
  - All of it is crammed into one big… Actually, the word "big" doesn't capture the scale of the megastructure that occupies the whole of H Corp's District 8. District 8 as a whole is called Hongyuan.
  - Their Singularity lies in creating the "Bolus", a kind of medicine. I was told these things can be used not only to heal wounds but also for body modification procedures. But something about the way these medicines change your body frightens me.
  - Those who took these boluses or used them in procedures gained body parts of certain creatures, or replaced parts of their own bodies with them.
  - In District 8, depending on your fortune, the size of the room allotted to you can grow or shrink, and the buildings themselves would move accordingly. So here it's "space", huh? Using time in T Corp to measure one's wealth was strange enough.

##### The Heishou Pack
- *Entry #1 · 985.1.02*
  - They are something like a private army for the various powers of Hongyuan.
  - The only branch we've met so far is the Mao Branch, but there are other Heishou branches with the traits of different animals.
  - Jia Xichun told me that they possess the powers of twelve animals from a list called the "Twelve Earthly Branches", and that this most likely carries some ritual significance.
  - I wonder if their loyalty can be traded? Conversations with the Identities revealed that they often change their "masters", or "lords".
  - Considering that R Corp also has "Packs" themed around animals, I can draw some parallels between the Heishou and them.

nodes.Name: K Corp
nodes.Desc:
**Wing K**, the Nest of District 11.

Publicly: regeneration via nanobots. In reality: **the tears of the "Weeping Beast"**, which restore bodies to their original state. The secret was revealed by Dongbaek: the disintegration ampules work on the same principle. Director Alfonso runs the Wing and uses recordings of atrocities to harvest the tears.

Pec.Name: Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Hemopoiesis (HP)

Publicly: regeneration via nanobots. In reality: **the tears of the "Weeping Beast"**, which restore bodies to their original state. The secret was revealed by Dongbaek: the disintegration ampules work on the same principle. Director Alfonso runs the Wing and uses recordings of atrocities to harvest the tears.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.22*
  - Located in the Nest of District 11.
  - Judging by that nightmarish fight at the checkpoint... K Corp's Singularity seems to let the user continuously heal—or rather, regenerate—their body.
  Faust called it "Hemopoiesis", but apparently it's easier for City residents to call them HP "bullets" or "ampules".
  Thanks to that, all the Sinners died, and I nearly fainted from the pain of resurrecting 12 people at once...
  But the ampules also helped my melted lower half get back into good shape.
  - K Corp apparently uses this technology in several industries.
- *Entry #2 · 984.4.23*
  - According to Samjo, the employee we saw at Eunbong's, the Wing may also develop food-related technologies using its Singularity.
- *Entry #3 · 984.5.22*
  - I didn't quite understand why they were flying drones around the City filming scenes of death and pain... but it seems there was a reason for all of it.
  - I learned a few things about the Nest and K Corp while carrying out their request... But I'm not sure it's okay for me to keep a record of them.
- *Entry #4 · 984.5.23*
  - All right. Below is some information that I shouldn't be writing down.… But I wanted to write it down anyway. Nothing more comes of it.
  - … Who knows. Someday even I might forget everything.
  - They explained that HP ampules are actually infinitely tiny nanobots that help the body regenerate. Apparently they were so small that a cluster of them just happened to look like some kind of green liquid.
  But all of that was a lie. They weren't anything even remotely like nanobots. The ampules were simply filled with some kind of green liquid.
  - K Corp's HP bullets, also known as regeneration ampules, are nothing like an ointment.
   This...… returns the body of the person it's injected into to the form it remembers as unharmed.
  - Stefanette, the founder of K Corp, went to the Outskirts and brought back this organism, which they call "Something Full of Tears", from which they extract the liquid.
  - I think "Something Full of Tears" was once a person, judging by what I saw during the resonance with the Golden Bough.
  - It seems their wish was that no one would ever suffer pain again. And that wish was granted… in one form or another, anyway. In theory, its tears can heal literally any part of the body, as long as the brain isn't damaged.
  - True to its name, Something Full of Tears sheds tears when it feels sorrow. And by processing or diluting the tears, they create the ampules, K Corp's Singularity.
  - At first, the founder Stefanette drew out the tears by sharing sad or emotional stories. But once she passed away, those who later seized power buried it under a constant stream of brutal, shocking images to draw out tears more efficiently.
  - That's why the drones were filming people's deaths. So they could make Something Full of Tears watch those brutal and shocking tragedies.
  - It seems making her watch the same tragedy over and over isn't as effective. They have to keep feeding it new, different scenes of violence. That's why they import similar footage from other Nests. They planned to use a glass-window technology similar to the Mirror to ensure a constant inflow of video material, but our involvement seems to have prevented that.
  - Considering that "Something Full of Tears" is, after all, an organism, it also seems capable of producing offspring. Alfonso called the one we saw ... a daughter creature.
  - I don't know how… but if I had to venture a guess, I'd say they're trying to improve their production figures by using the children of Something Full of Tears.
- *Entry #5 · 984.5.25*
  - I'm a little curious, but I wonder what would happen if someone with prosthetics were injected with a K Corp Ampule?
  - We learned everything about their Singularity, from its origins to its production methods, but after they put us through a memory-erasure procedure, I'm the only one who remembers it. I decided to lie low and pretend the procedure worked. Even with my limited knowledge of the City, I felt this information was probably fairly important.
  - I don't usually show these notes to the Sinners anyway, but… From now on I'll have to be especially careful.

**Wing L**, the Nest of District 12.

**Fallen**. Materialization of the mind (Cogito, E.G.O), Abnormality energy.

**Fallen**. Materialization of the mind (Cogito, E.G.O), Abnormality energy.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.28*
  - Full name: Lobotomy Corporation.
  - This Nest was located in District 12. A fallen Wing whose seat is currently vacant.
   It seems it was the epicenter of a City-wide event called the "White Nights and Dark Days", which everyone has heard of. (Except me—or is that because of the amnesia?...)

##### Lobotomy Corporation
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.28*
  - The name of L Corp, which existed in the past. It was an energy supplier.
  - It transported *Abnormalities* (like the ones we've encountered) to its facilities in their egg-like forms and *managed them in containment units* to produce energy in the form of *Enkephalin*.
  - I was told it once supplied energy to many other corporations and Wings—practically all over the City, really—so it must have been quite a substantial enterprise...
  - Then, one fine day, a furious beam of light burst out of the headquarters, and the company vanished underground.
  I even heard that after the company was gone, something appeared in its place... *Something in the shape of a tower*, which vanished after a while. At the time of writing, the Wing's seat is still empty, which has most likely thrown the whole District into chaos.
  - With the disappearance of the headquarters, all branches across the City shut down and were *buried underground*.
- *Entry #2 · 984.5.28*
  - It seems they left behind some of Lobotomy Corporation's E.G.O. The branches once used it to suppress their Abnormalities.
  - I think there are certain conditions and risks to using this E.G.O equipment, such as weapons or armor. It makes sense, since they're derived from the Abnormalities that Lobotomy Corporation used to handle. It seems they also affect the mood or manner of speech of their users.
  - Considering that they're made from Abnormalities… they could become a problem during our future visits to Lobotomy Corporation branches.

nodes.Name: M Corp
nodes.Desc:
**Wing M**, the Nest of District 13.

A material that absorbs psychological damage. The "Abyss" rehabilitation center.

Pec.Name: Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Moonstone

A material that absorbs psychological damage. The "Abyss" rehabilitation center.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.12.24*
  - Located in the Nest of District 13.
  - It seems they control a Singularity called "Moonstone". They say it lets people focus exclusively on one object or get rid of all distracting thoughts… Given that they have a facility called the "Abyss" Trauma Rehabilitation Center, perhaps they specialize in psychological care or relaxation-related business.
  - Hey, maybe we should buy some of this Moonstone for the Sinners, to prevent E.G.O Corrosion or to help them calm down and relax when their "turn" comes?
  - I shared this seemingly good idea with Faust, but she rejected it immediately. She didn't even explain why — she just said now wasn't the time to discuss it. Considering that practically every technology in the City has these different sides... perhaps it has some side effects too.

nodes.Name: N — Nagel und Hammer
nodes.Desc:
**Wing N**, the Nest of District 14.

Preserving experience. An Inquisition against prosthetics. Hierarchy: The One Who Holds → Big Hammer → Middle → Small. Actively destroys "heretics" with prosthetics (Canto III). Carried out punitive operations in Kalv. Is trying to revive the League of Nine. **Director Hermann** plays a key role in the experiments with the Mirrors and the "dough".

Pec.Name: Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Nagel und Hammer

Preserving experience. An Inquisition against prosthetics. Hierarchy: The One Who Holds → Big Hammer → Middle → Small. Actively destroys "heretics" with prosthetics (Canto III). Carried out punitive operations in Kalv. Is trying to revive the League of Nine. **Director Hermann** plays a key role in the experiments with the Mirrors and the "dough".

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.22*
  — Nägel und Hammer: located in the Nest of District 14. Nägel apparently means "Nail".
  - After talking with Meursault, it turned out there are two factions called "Nail" and "Hammer".
   According to him, the armored "inquisitors" we encountered weren't so common when he worked for the Wing, and there weren't nearly as many of them during his time there.
  - Unlike the group under Kromer's command, N Corp isn't all that different from other corporations, setting aside a certain harshness.
- *Entry #2 · 984.4.24*
  - Not sure what their main business is, but some of the Sinners seem familiar with the Wing.
  ...If only they'd tell me everything too.

Pec.Name: ＋ Sisyphe and Canned Experience
Pec.Desc: N Corp owns **Grand Magasin Sisyphe** — a virtual prison where convicts are held through execution (the "Sisyphean punishment") and **Canned Experience** is produced. Sisyphe collapsed in Canto X; after that, the board of directors decides to extract experience directly from brains. Details on the "Limbus Company" screen.

**Wing P**, the Nest of District 16.

Safe real estate made of elastic material. The goal: "the safest place". **The Archiving Department** (headed by Cesara) keeps records and funds the destruction of phenomena.

Pec.Name: Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Spatial expansion

Safe real estate made of elastic material. The goal: "the safest place". **The Archiving Department** (headed by Cesara) keeps records and funds the destruction of phenomena.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.12.20*
  - Located in the Nest of District 16.
  - It's full of incredibly tall skyscrapers and spires, and I have to crane my neck to see how tall they really are.
  - Their specialty is canned goods. Meursault listed every kind of canned food, and I learned there are a great many of them.
  - The walls and pillars of the station were covered from top to bottom with all kinds of flyers. I wonder what's going on here?
- *Entry #2 · 984.12.25*
  - Their motto has something to do with creating a very safe place, and their Singularity can either expand or warp space itself.
  - I was told that all structures built with P Corp's Singularity are very... elastic. That turned out to be surprisingly literal, because when La Manchaland began to manifest, I saw the buildings touching La Manchaland bulge outward like rubber. They said it's perfectly safe inside, even if the outside of the building bends and twists like that, but... I can't imagine how that's possible.
  - Many spatial-expansion technologies in the City make things bigger on the inside, but P Corp's version is focused first and foremost on safety.
  - This is just my guess, but... if I recall our conversation with Cesara, it seems La Manchaland heavily influenced P Corp's Singularity. I wonder whether a Singularity could be developed that's inspired by something else?

nodes.Name: R Corp
nodes.Desc:
**Wing R**, the Nest of District 18.

PMC. 4 Packs (Rabbits, Rhinos, Reindeer, Ravens). Bypassing Taboos via T Corp.

Pec.Name: Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Cloning

PMC. 4 Packs (Rabbits, Rhinos, Reindeer, Ravens). Bypassing Taboos via T Corp.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.7*
  - Located in the Nest of District 18.
  - Judging by what I've heard from the Sinners connected to the corporation, it's a bit different from the other Wings I know.
  While most Wings provide all sorts of conveniences, using their Singularities to improve people's quality of life, R Corp deals mainly in armed force, such as mercenary work.
  - R Corp's might as a Wing depends on the quality of the military services it provides.
  Outis added that however important a unit's size may be, most of its strength in combat will depend on field experience and fortitude of spirit.
  In that sense, she says, R Corp's combatants (soldiers? employees?) are like killing machines with dauntless spirits and excellent health.
  Gregor said that ordinary soldiers often lose the will to fight and then flee the battlefield or panic, and those who don't are the exceptions.
  I wonder if R Corp runs war games and simulators or something like that?
- *Entry #2 · 984.5.9*
  - From what the R Corp Identities say, one can conclude that the Wing has a team called the "4th Pack" with three units: Rabbits, Reindeer and Rhinos.
  - Rabbits are generalists who can be deployed on a wide range of missions.
  - Reindeer have surgically received antlers that convert their mental power into physical power.
  - I haven't personally met the Rhinos yet, but I was told their specialty is sowing chaos.

nodes.Name: S Corp
nodes.Desc:
**Wing S**, the Nest of District 19.

Agriculture. A corrupt royal court. The Blades of the Clouds.

Pec.Name: Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Salpippyeo (Flesh-Blood-Bone)

Agriculture. A corrupt royal court. The Blades of the Clouds.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.11.8*
  - Located in the Nest of District 19.
  - It seems they have a ... "King" ...? And this "King", whatever that means, has "servants".
  - Okay, according to some brief explanations, this appears to be a form of governance. Something like the Nests and Wings... but not quite the same. Don Quixote's eyes were practically shining as she listened, so I'm pretty sure it's far from a standard system of governance.
  - The thing is, every Nest has its own culture and its own way of doing things.
  - I still have no idea what Singularity they use to sustain their Nest.
- *Entry #2 · 984.11.9*
  - Yi Sang is from S Corp. I was told S Corp handles most of the agriculture and livestock farming.
  - The members of the Blade Lineage we ran into recently were also from S Corp. Apparently they left the Nest for a reason similar to Yi Sang's: internal problems and the tyranny of the corrupt.
  - S Corp is in incredible chaos.... I hope that's not where we're headed next.

nodes.Name: T — TimeTrack
nodes.Desc:
**Wing T**, the Nest of District 20.

Time manipulation. Time is currency. Cooperates with W, R and L.

Pec.Name: Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** TimeTrack

Time manipulation. Time is currency. Cooperates with W, R and L.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.26*
  - Located in the "Nest of District 20".
  - It seems they specialize in the use of temporal technologies.
  - I only got to know T Corp through the resonance with the Golden Bough. I've never actually been to T Corp's Nest before, so I'm not sure how true to life that experience was.
  - It seems they value technology and inventions.
   - The entire Nest is literally monochrome. I think having any color at all is a privilege granted only to those with power. Black smoke constantly spewing from countless buildings has darkened the sky.
- *Entry #2 · 984.12.12*
  - Well, I understand that I accidentally manipulated a large amount of time. But out of pure curiosity, I asked Yi Sang how we ended up owing more than ten billion ahn in time tax.
  - Yi Sang explained that each person has their own time tax rate, and that the more "time" you have, the more time tax you have to pay. He went on to explain it with all sorts of mathematical formulas, but I didn't understand even half of what... I mean, not even a quarter of what he said.
  - No matter how much time someone has, they can't use it unless they withdraw the remaining time the day before. With that spare time they can use it right away to make their days longer… or save it to use in another situation. Not that poor people have the financial means to even consider the latter.
  - The CEO of T Corp was a guy named Herbert. I don't think I'd ever met the actual leader of an entire Wing before…
  - Herbert helped the Sinners by pretending to be our "assistant". He used to strive to make the City a better place, or so he says… Honestly, considering the state T Corp is in, I'm not sure I believe it.
  - At first he seemed somewhat depressed. Having let the League of Nine Literati go, having ignored the presence of the Yurodivy in his Nest… But something in me seems to have motivated him again. The question is… why?
  - He also gave me an ominous warning that… turning back time always comes at a steep price.
  -… But how could I not turn back time?

nodes.Name: U Corp
nodes.Desc:
**Wing U**, the Nest of District 21.

A monopoly. Publicly: stasis preservers, products made from whales and merfolk. Real Singularity: **the Resonance Tuning Fork** — a technology for merging and separating matter in resonance, used to create port-ships. Distributes the Laws of the Lake and the variable coordinates.

Pec.Name: Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** The Great Lake

A monopoly. Publicly: stasis preservers, products made from whales and merfolk. Real Singularity: **the Resonance Tuning Fork** — a technology for merging and separating matter in resonance, used to create port-ships. Distributes the Laws of the Lake and the variable coordinates.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.26*
  - Located in the Nest of District 21.
  - They use a Singularity called the Resonance Tuning Fork. It can merge two objects of completely different natures into one, as if they had always been part of each other.
  - Somehow the power of the Resonance Tuning Fork merged guns with monstrous crabs called Trash Crabs. They could use these merged firearms as if they had been born with them.
  U Corp is scattered across the Great Lake, and most of its main facilities are located on its surface.
  - Which means we badly need a ship if we want to go anywhere in U Corp. So we turned Mephistopheles into a ship using the Resonance Tuning Fork.
  - It seems to me that this overlaps with another region called the 'Outskirts'… Hm.

nodes.Name: V Corp
nodes.Desc:
**Wing V**, the Nest of District 22.

Hired the Liu Association against the Crying Children.

Pec.Name: Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** Unknown

Hired the Liu Association against the Crying Children.

nodes.Name: W — WARP
nodes.Desc:
**Wing W**, the Nest of District 23.

Genome-based restoration. Trains: 10 sec = thousands of years of subjective time. Cleanup squads.

Pec.Name: Singularity
Pec.Desc:
**Singularity / specialty:** WARP

Genome-based restoration. Trains: 10 sec = thousands of years of subjective time. Cleanup squads.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.6*
  - Located in the Nest of District 23
  - I still haven't had the chance to visit this place, but I learned a couple of things from the Wing's Identities.
  W Corp runs a transport service known as the "WARP Train", which carries passengers from one station to another in mere seconds.
  WARP Train tickets are apparently very expensive, and I was told how absurd the first-class prices are.
  -...Shouldn't you cut prices and transport people that way?
- *Entry #2 · 984.5.8*
  - I'll write down some additional details I managed to hear.
  - Although you can get anywhere by car, WARP Trains are preferred because traveling by car can be quite difficult.
  Makes sense, if you recall the procedures we had to go through to enter K Corp's Nest.
  - More specifically, it seems the bad roads are a big problem.
  They are so winding and tangled that traveling between Backstreets by car takes an unreasonably long time.
  - Even if the distance is small, the route will be labyrinthine.
  Supposedly there are wide open roads called highways connecting the Nests, but those also come with a number of conditions and costs.
- *Entry #3 · 984.5.9*
  - I learned a shocking fact while talking with the Sinners in W Corp Identities.
   Even though they don't tell me directly... from other people's point of view the trips take no more than a couple of minutes, but in reality they can take a monstrously long stretch of time, robbing passengers of their sanity and deforming their bodies beyond recognition by the time the trip is over.
  Then, a cleanup agent physically sorts out the mess every time.
  -...Thank god we have the bus.
  - All of this is speculation based on conversations with the Identities, so I plan to keep this information to myself.
- *Entry #4 · 984.12.13*
  - After I'd gotten to know many Identities of W Corp employees and learned quite a lot about the WARP Trains from them, I felt comfortable enough to share this information with the Sinners. Looking back, it was a good move. It would have been a disaster to explain to them what WARP Trains were at that moment.
  - Besides being allowed to enter cryo-sleep during the WARP Train trip, we were also given free snacks as part of the first-class package. The blissful expression on Rodion's face (she also took my portion, since I had no mouth to eat it with) made it clear that it was a real delicacy.
  - It did seem somewhat unusual to me that a train which, as far as the public knows, runs for only ten seconds would bother selling packages or onboard meals. When I asked Faust, she explained that their purpose was less practical and more thematic, so that passengers would get the impression they were setting off on a journey.
  - One more thing: I definitely remember that employee crawling into an emergency escape pod. So where did he go?
  - So why don't WARP Trains specialize in transporting cargo? If they have to deal with such difficulties and labor costs to transport people, wouldn't it be far more efficient if they just carried cargo?
  - Wait, I think I've started a discussion —
  - Heathcliff said it's because transporting people is the whole point of the train. That remark seemed to give Yi Sang an idea.
  - Yi Sang pointed out that because of W Corp's cooperation with T Corp, they probably need "time" to run their trains. Moreover, T Corp's CEO said that emotions don't change with time; on the contrary, time changes along with emotions. Something like that, at least.
  - Based on what everyone said, we reached a fairly plausible conclusion. The state of an emotionally transforming consciousness in an effective infinity of time is what drives or powers the WARP Trains. Either that, or WARP Trains are built precisely to induce such a state of consciousness. Some of the Sinners and I applauded Yi Sang and Heathcliff for this hypothesis.

Pec.Desc:

Mining in the "hellholes". Alloy Guardians.

  - Their Nest is in District 24... at least that's what I was told.
  - I haven't been there and don't know whether we're going, but I remember hearing that the Indigo Elder's boat was made of X Corp alloy.
  - According to the Identities, you can find anything at the dig sites, like microwaves or car tires. So they just find these finished goods and… use them right away? How is that even possible?
