nodes.Name: Fallen Wings
nodes.Desc:
- **The old L Corp** — fell in the Smoke War (before Lobotomy Corp).
- **The old G Corp** — the "bugs", fell in the Smoke War.
- **The former H Corp** — the Kong family.
- **The teleportation Wing** → became W Corp.
- **The textile Wing** → became the Carnival.
- **The tattoo Wing** → went over to the Syndicates.
- **Lobotomy Corporation** — fell after the Light; L's seat is vacant.

nodes.Name: Fixers
nodes.Desc:
Freelancers who will do any job for money: guarding, escorting, investigation, assassination. To work, one needs a **license** (an exam) and membership in an authorized organization: an Association, an Office (even a one-person one) or a Workshop.

**Grades:** the Hana Association assigns grades from **9** (lowest) to **1**; above them are the **Colors** (Color Fixers).

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- A type of freelancer who handles or helps with all sorts of work in the City.
- They don't work for free, of course. The whole of society seems to be built on money. But I don't think I can say for certain that there are no Fixers at all willing to do charity work?
- The Fixers I've seen or heard about came from all walks of life, too varied to neatly generalize about all of them (taking into account my conversations with the mirror Identities, of course). Maybe it's an ordinary career?

- Apparently you can't be a Fixer just because you want to; some Fixer-related Identities told me there are tests you have to pass to get a license.
- It seems Fixers are rated by grade: 9 is the lowest, and 1 is the highest…
- There's also a special type called a *Color*. Vergilius is apparently one of them; his nickname is "the Red Gaze". Supposedly he's quite experienced and famous.

#### Associations
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.27*
  - It seems this refers to large organizations that manage Fixers.
  - Each Association apparently has a particular area it specializes in, which explains how free and open a Fixer's work can usually be.
  There's quite a large variety… I've seen several Associations connected to the Sinners' Identities and their mirror worlds.
  - One of the main differences from freelance Fixers is that they can't choose the jobs they want to take.

##### The Zwei Association
- *Entry #1 · 984.12.18*
  - It seems they specialize in protecting and keeping the public peace in the area requested by their clients.
  - They often call themselves your (that is, the client's) shield.
  - From conversations with a Zwei Identity, I learned that they specialize in protecting things. But, of course, only if they've been contracted to do so.

##### The Shi Association
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.27*
  - It seems they specialize in requests involving covert assassinations.
  - It should be noted that this doesn't quite mean they're the only Fixers who have ever carried out assassination jobs. For starters, requesting a Fixer's help would cost a fortune…
  - Besides, the demand for killings in the City is terribly high, so even unknown Offices on obscure streets seem to get such requests fairly often.

##### The Cinq Association
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.1*
  - It seems they specialize in requests for single combat and duels.
  - Although it doesn't happen often, I heard there are still cases where people try to settle disputes with a fair "duel".
  - When someone gets involved in a duel (or has to challenge someone to one) and realizes their opponent will clearly tear them a new airway, they send a request to this Association. It sounds like they stand in for the client or something.
  - Everything I know about this Association comes from what I heard from Seven Association Identities, so I couldn't learn much…
  - Since the Association doesn't get requests very often, it seems it's also responsible for hosting joint conferences and events with other Associations.
- *Entry #2 · 984.12.30*
  - When declaring duels, the Eastern branch of the Cinq Association, instead of throwing down a glove, announces its affiliation and states its name.
  - The biggest difference is their dress code and weaponry. Unlike the fairly recognizable blue cloaks and big hats worn by the Western Fixers, the Eastern branch of the Cinq Association wears more practical clothing that blends in better with the general attire of the Eastern region. Also… unlike the other Cinq or the Identities we've already met, the Sinner with the Eastern Cinq Identity mostly used hand-to-hand combat as their main means of fighting.
  - They wear this bracelet… or armband called the Emerald Pyrojade on their wrist. It seems it can melt anything the user touches by applying intense heat.
  - Apparently, the green flame of the Emerald Pyrojade can burn only the object the user wants to burn. … Honestly? To me, that sounds like Singularity-level technology.

##### The Liu Association
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.28*
  - It seems they specialize in combat requests involving groups of people.
  - "Though few Fixers in the City have lived their lives without ever getting into a fight..." (A quote from Don.)
  - The Liu Association seems unique in that every individual member is equipped to fight several enemies at once.
- *Entry #2 · 984.4.29*
  - According to Don Quixote ("Telling one from the other may prove too difficult a task for budding fans!" she also added), while the Cinq Association covers one-on-one situations like duels, the Liu Association handles clashes between multiple fighters. Come to think of it, most of those Identities really did seem to value cooperation and coordination over individual action.
  They also looked rather carefree...
  - Gregor, in his Liu Association Identity, also told me it was common for him to take on groups of five or six people at once. (He didn't forget to proudly mention that he "cheered those kids up".)
- *Entry #3 · 984.4.30*
  - Another notable thing is the incendiary devices built into all their weapons.
  - When I asked why they use fire-launching weapons, they gave me various answers like "harmony" or "flow"…
  - But honestly, those were evasive remarks. In my opinion, it's probably because fire is effective at hitting the enemies around the target. After all, flames can spread.

##### The Seven Association
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.27*
  - It seems they specialize in gathering intelligence.
  - Intelligence, knowledge… I thought they'd be very similar to the Dieci Association, but one of the Identities explained the differences to me.
  - While the Seven Association specializes in using any means to gather the intelligence they've been contracted to find, the Dieci Association specializes in using the knowledge it finds for itself, by analyzing and deconstructing it.
  - Still, I'm sure they overlap a lot, given their similar specializations.

##### The Nine Association
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.27*
  - It seems they specialize in delivery and transportation.
  - The City is full of dangers around every corner, so it's extremely difficult to deliver important items or information to their recipients on time without losing them along the way.
  - Yi Sang told me: "Though the City may seem tiny from the bird's-eye view available on a map, an approach that considers its surface area rather than what any single part of it is reveals an entirely different world. The City is overflowing with buildings both in the sky and on the ground; their tangled construction and Singularities paint a picture hidden behind the screen...". I wasn't sure what he was talking about, so I just nodded.
- *Entry #2 · 984.12.19*
  - Apparently, they make deliveries using spatial bags equipped with the "Poludnitsa" AI, called "Courier Trunks". To be more precise, it seems the Association assigns the type of Poludnitsa best suited to the contract and the routes of each Nine Association Fixer.
  - Faust explained that they embed a core, or module, installed with the AI into every single courier trunk.… The point is, they install an AI on the bag and use it to deliver things.
  - Any items in each trunk are usually well kept, and their deliveries are rarely late, which makes them a vital Association in the City. Maybe someday we can use their services? Sounds pretty convenient.
  - After a brief conversation with an Identity, I learned that the Poludnitsa AI greatly enhances its users' abilities if it judges that it may be hard to make a delivery on time. A late delivery can lead to death… no wonder they're rarely late.

##### The Dieci Association
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.22*
  - It seems they specialize in gathering and researching knowledge.
  - They say members of the Association use equipment that draws physical strength from knowledge.
  - The harder knowledge is to obtain and the more valuable it is, the more strength it grants its users. However, it seems they lose the knowledge as soon as they draw strength from it.
  - It seems they have Fixers who fight with their fists, and Fixers who fight with their ... keys? (What?)

#### Butlers
- *Entry #1 · 984.12.7*
  - Don Quixote explained that they are Fixers who have signed long-term contracts bound to individuals, families or estates.
  - Because of the wide range of their duties, their pay is often quite high, so many high-grade Fixers often take jobs as butlers after retiring.
  - ... Hm. So these Fixers retire to ... become a different kind of Fixer?
  - Butlers bound to families or estates sometimes even forget what their original contracts were. But apparently quitting is also a risky decision, given that Taboo Hunters or Offices tied to the contracts may come after them for a bounty.
  - It's unfair, but it doesn't seem like they have many options. It's one of those rare guaranteed long-term jobs in the City that pays a decent salary, so most of them settle for working as butlers instead of risking unemployment.

#### Offices
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.28*
  - A term that covers all legal entities (or any place of business, right?) founded by Fixers.
  - It seems there's some rule requiring Fixers to be part of an authorized organization of some kind if they want to work, and setting up a *one-person Office* is apparently one of the options.
- *Entry #2 · 984.4.29*
  - It seems there's quite a wide variety of Offices here.
  - Thinking back to the time we were in the Backstreets of District 4 (D Corp's territory), the Office where Yuri and Aya worked may have been the most common kind.
  - Anyway, I think I can say that Fixers, Offices and Associations are all organizations that handle requests for a price.
- *Entry #3 · 984.5.26*
  - I knew it. Associations aren't the only kind of organization a Fixer can work for. Some of them also work in Offices. It seems they all specialize in different things, just like the Fixers themselves.

Pec.Name: Associations and Offices

- Technically, they operate under the same umbrella as Offices. However, unlike Fixers with their various specializations, people call them Workshops.
- First and foremost, they make and sell the weapons, armor and other tools that Fixers use. Sometimes they also take contracts to build custom equipment. At least, that's the impression I got.
- Given that Workshops are also run by Fixers, they don't shy away from combat-related contracts when necessary. As the Key & Rose Workshop did, for example.

nodes.Name: The Red Mist
nodes.Desc: **Kali.** A legendary Fixer from the Backstreets of District 23, the first in the City to manifest her own E.G.O. She guarded Carmen's laboratory; after her death she became the Sephirah **Gebura**. Weapon — "Mimicry".

nodes.Name: The Black Silence
nodes.Desc: **Roland.** Roland, who worked as a pair with his wife Angelica. Gloves holding an arsenal of Workshop weapons. Became Angela's servant in the Library.

nodes.Name: The Blue Reverberation
nodes.Desc: **Argalia.** Argalia, Angelica's brother, leader of the Reverberation Ensemble. Sound and scythes; he wanted to stage a "symphony" of Distortions across the whole City.

nodes.Name: The Purple Tear
nodes.Desc: **Iori.** Iori is Argalia's mentor; she moves between dimensions searching for her missing son. She sent Roland to the Library.

nodes.Name: The Red Gaze
nodes.Desc: **Vergilius.** Vergilius is LCB's guide. He sees the flow of events, Sin (two rings of light), the E.G.O Lavacrum Sanguinis.

nodes.Name: The Indigo Elder
nodes.Desc: A Whale hunter of the Great Lake who has destroyed several Calamities.

nodes.Name: The Yellow Harpoon
nodes.Desc: **Vespa Crabro.** A new Color Fixer, formerly an N Corp Taboo Hunter, a member of Moses's group. The name was coined by Ezra.

nodes.Name: Fingers
nodes.Desc: The five largest Syndicates of the Backstreets. So influential that even Wings and Associations can't easily deal with them. Backstreets residents learn their rules in order to survive.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.12.31*
  - This must refer to five especially significant Syndicates in the Backstreets.
  - They say they're so powerful and influential that even Wings and Associations can't easily deal with them. Rodion and Heathcliff told me that people in the Backstreets have to learn and follow their rules if they want to survive.
  - Oddly enough, Ryōshū seems to know a lot about them. When I first boarded the bus, I was warned about Ryōshū's past...maybe it has something to do with that.

##### The Middle
- *Entry #1 · 985.1.02*
  - As one of the Five Fingers, they put loyalty first.
  - We first ran into them during our journey across U Corp's Great Lake.
  - They address each other with family terms like "Big Brother", "Big Sister", "Little Brother" and so on and so forth, and I really could feel that they have that family bond.
  - They carry these books called the "Vengeance Book", in which they record their grudges and hunt down everyone who has had the misfortune of being written in... By the way, how long is that guy going to keep chasing us? I'm starting to worry that one day I might find him breaking into Mephistopheles.
  - Thinking back to the events in J Corp, I think Rodion also suffered from an encounter with the Middle Finger. Has their "grudge" against Rodion been resolved? It's still a pretty delicate topic, so I can't bring it up with her yet. Every day I have more and more questions for Rodion.

##### The Ring
- *Entry #1 · 984.12.31*
  - The Ring, one of the Five Fingers, values art and knowledge.
  - They keep coming up in conversations about the Corridor.
  - I haven't had the chance to meet anyone from the Ring, but we've run into several people who used to be part of it.
  - It seems they really do like art.
  - And when I say "art", I mean extremely brutal art. From what I've been able to learn from the Identities and from Ryōshū, their art often consists of sculptures stitched together from amputated body parts... paintings drawn in blood... and the like.
  - It seems they're internally divided into various factions. I heard names like "Pointillists" and "Fauvists" from them; perhaps they're divided by artistic philosophy.

nodes.Name: The Thumb
nodes.Desc: The strictest hierarchy (Soldato → Capo → Sottocapo → boss) and etiquette. Controls many Offices and Workshops. In LoR — a gathering of 19 families, Sottocapo **Calo**, Capo **Catriel**; the Rumano Cortel suffered at the hands of the Black Silence. Connected to the Spider's House through **Valencina**. In Canto VIII, Capo **Lei Heng** stormed Tiekan Temple.

nodes.Name: The Index
nodes.Desc: Follows the **Prescripts** delivered by the Messengers. The Prescripts can be absurd ("insert three needles into a cake"), but carrying them out is absolute law. Ranks: Followers, Messengers, **Proxies**. The Nursefather **Ryen** is a Proxy of the Index.

nodes.Name: The Middle
nodes.Desc: Loyalty to the "family": Big Brothers/Sisters, Little Siblings. **The Vengeance Book** — every grievance is recorded for mandatory retribution. Forced tattoos. Active in District 25 and in U Corp's ports. **Ricardo**, **Matthias**; Queequeg fled from them.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 985.1.02*
  - As one of the Five Fingers, they put loyalty first.
  - We first ran into them during our journey across U Corp's Great Lake.
  - They address each other with family terms like "Big Brother", "Big Sister", "Little Brother" and so on and so forth, and I really could feel that they have that family bond.
  - They carry these books called the "Vengeance Book", in which they record their grudges and hunt down everyone who has had the misfortune of being written in... By the way, how long is that guy going to keep chasing us? I'm starting to worry that one day I might find him breaking into Mephistopheles.
  - Thinking back to the events in J Corp, I think Rodion also suffered from an encounter with the Middle Finger. Has their "grudge" against Rodion been resolved? It's still a pretty delicate topic, so I can't bring it up with her yet. Every day I have more and more questions for Rodion.

nodes.Name: The Ring Finger (the Ring)
nodes.Desc: Values "art and knowledge" — brutal art made of flesh and blood. Factions by artistic philosophy: "Pointillists", "Fauvists". Maestro **Callisto**; former members built the laboratory under Wuthering Heights together with N Corp.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.12.31*
  - The Ring, one of the Five Fingers, values art and knowledge.
  - They keep coming up in conversations about the Corridor.
  - I haven't had the chance to meet anyone from the Ring, but we've run into several people who used to be part of it.
  - It seems they really do like art.
  - And when I say "art", I mean extremely brutal art. From what I've been able to learn from the Identities and from Ryōshū, their art often consists of sculptures stitched together from amputated body parts... paintings drawn in blood... and the like.
  - It seems they're internally divided into various factions. I heard names like "Pointillists" and "Fauvists" from them; perhaps they're divided by artistic philosophy.

nodes.Name: The Pinky
nodes.Desc: Decentralized: members often don't know each other. **Jia Qiu (Kong Qiu)**, Zilu; the Nursefather **Shiomi Yoru** — Star of Dihuei. In the 980s it clashed with the Ring in the Outskirts.

nodes.Name: The Spider's House
nodes.Desc: A joint venture of the Five Fingers "in the heart of the abyss". The goal: to create **"a sword that cleaves all"**, capable of destroying concepts. **Ryōshū (Yoshihide)** became that sword. It was run by five **Nursefathers**, each of whom raised student-"Children". Destroyed in **Canto IX**.

nodes.Name: Valencina
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** The Thumb's Nursefather, a veteran of the Smoke War.
- **Personality:** Crude and hard-drinking, but devoted to her "Ticket" — Ryōshū. She calls her "Ticket", believing she will restore her lost status.
- **Abilities:** Rapier, bayonet fighting, use of relics. Has a damaged eye that reacts when Ryōshū is near.
- **Fate:** Killed by the awakened Cockroach Emperor (Gregor).

nodes.Name: Lucio
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Valencina's student, a "Textbook" for Ryōshū.
- **Personality:** Completely subservient to Valencina, copies Ryōshū's style. Seeks his master's approval.
- **Fate:** Killed by Gregor (with his insect arm).

nodes.Name: Ryen
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Head of the Spider's House, follower of the Prescripts. Raised Ryōshū as a daughter, but also as a weapon.
- **Personality:** Calm and loving, but utterly devoid of a will of his own — he acts solely according to the Prescripts. His mask hides a burn left by Ryōshū.
- **Abilities:** A variety of shape-shifting weapons. Tremendous speed and agility. Zeno's Tortoise Spiral.
- **Fate:** Defeated by Ryōshū in the finale of Canto IX. Later killed by the Index's pursuers.

nodes.Name: Sora
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Ryen's student (the Index), a spy in LCE.
- **Personality:** Insecure and clumsy, but devoted to Ryen. Dreamed of becoming his "daughter".
- **Abilities:** E.G.O in the form of shackles.
- **Fate:** Killed in battle.

nodes.Name: Matthias
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** The Middle Finger's Nursefather.
- **Personality:** An eccentric toy collector obsessed with the "family's" justice. Sacrifices his student Kira for an attack without hesitation.
- **Abilities:** A huge sword with a Relic (Moonlight Stones), Retribution tattoos.
- **Fate:** Killed by Vespa (the Yellow Harpoon) and Moses.

nodes.Name: Kira
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Matthias's student, the "Princess".
- **Personality:** Childish, treats battles as a game. Adores comics about Fixers.
- **Fate:** Gravely wounded by her own father, later taken prisoner by Limbus Company.

Pec.Name: ＋ After Canto IX
Pec.Desc: Hong Lu saved her with a K Corp ampule; Kira was taken into custody and woke up in the LCE infirmary. Hohenheim sets a condition — she must make herself useful. In Intervallo VII she serves as a guide through the Corridors of the Spider's House, unexpectedly repels an attack by Maestro Émile Benoît and, together with Ryōshū, defeats Docent Rufo. She admits that Matthias "never once thought about his sins".

nodes.Name: Callisto
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Maestro of the Ring, the Ring's Nursefather.
- **Personality:** Obsessed with art made of human flesh. Considers suffering the highest form of creativity.
- **Fate:** Killed by the future version of Sinclair.

nodes.Name: Albina
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Callisto's student, creator of the living armor "Fascia".
- **Personality:** Psychopathic; wants to "make friends" with people so she can later turn them into ingredients.
- **Fate:** Killed by Future Sinclair.

nodes.Name: Shiomi Yoru
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** The Pinky's Nursefather. Ryōshū's mother (and at the same time her daughter Araya, due to temporal entanglement).
- **Personality:** Embittered, hating Ryōshū for becoming her "shackles". In truth — an abandoned daughter who grew up and took the place of Nursefather.
- **Fate:** Killed by Ryōshū, who did not recognize her.

nodes.Name: Ren
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Shiomi Yoru's student, heir to the Star of Dihuei.
- **Personality:** Fatalistic, considers himself worthless. Devoted to his master.
- **Abilities:** Ōdachi (a great sword).
- **Fate:** Killed or defeated.

nodes.Name: The Kurokumo Clan
nodes.Desc: A gigantic Syndicate: long single-edged swords, dark wavy clothing. They collect "protection" money. A strict hierarchy. Feuding with the Blade Lineage; according to the notes, part of the Phalanx Syndicate. In LoR — Captain **Sayo**; in Intervallo IV — Captain **Jun**.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.25*
  - A gigantic Syndicate spread far and deep across the Backstreets.
  - They're characterized by long single-edged swords in sheaths and dark/wavy clothing.
  - They mostly make their living by collecting protection money from Backstreets businesses under the pretext of providing "security".
  - From what I heard from the Identities, it seems they're in some kind of conflict with another Syndicate called the Blade Lineage. I didn't hear the reason.
  - They follow some kind of hierarchy, and underlings are generally forbidden from disobeying their superiors.
  -...There seem to be special exceptions, if Hong Lu is to be believed.

nodes.Name: The Blade Lineage
nodes.Desc: Lone swordsmen from S Corp who fled the tyranny of the court. Temporary groups without a hierarchy. The mentor is **Kim in the Bamboo Hat**, his student is **Aeng-du**.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.25*
  - A Syndicate full of sword-wielding thugs and free spirits roaming the Backstreets.
  - Judging by conversations with the Sinners who wore these Identities, they don't seem to act or travel in groups, despite belonging to a Syndicate.
   To be precise... they sometimes form temporary groups, but there are no strict subgroups or hierarchical ladder.
  - ...Too bad half their answers were mockery, so I can't clearly write an answer here.

nodes.Name: The Yurodivy
nodes.Desc: **Sonya**'s Syndicate: they helped the destitute, then became "armchair revolutionaries" who revere Sonya as a saint. Terrorists in T Corp's Nest. Rodion is a former member.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.12.20*
  - A Syndicate founded by Sonya. Rodya once told me they helped the destitute in the Backstreets, but over time turned into armchair revolutionaries who did nothing but sit around talking about how they'd change the City.
  - They gradually spread their influence through the Nests. We even ran into Yurodivy terrorists who used various inventions to cause trouble in T Corp's Nest.
  - The Yurodivy, who revere Sonya as their "saint", said they're waiting for "the right moment". I don't know why they call Sonya a saint or what moment they're talking about… but something about it doesn't sit right with me.
  - From what I gathered listening to the Dieci Identities, Sonya isn't the "saint" the Dieci Association would recognize.

nodes.Name: The Dead Rabbits
nodes.Desc: A gang in T Corp's Backstreets (boss Matt — an old acquaintance of Heathcliff). Its disguised leader turned out to be Erlking Heathcliff (**Canto VI**).

nodes.Name: Tingtang
nodes.Desc: The gang the Sinners disguised themselves as in **Canto II**.

nodes.Name: Rats
nodes.Desc: The lowest tier of the Backstreets: unranked robbers. The Library's very first guests.

nodes.Name: The Brotherhood of Iron
nodes.Desc: A gang obsessed with body modification ("fresh brain fluid"). Guests of the Library.

nodes.Name: The Stray Dogs
nodes.Desc: A gang from District 22 (Gyeon Mi, Dino). LoR's Urban Legend.

nodes.Name: The Smiling Faces
nodes.Desc: A Syndicate with smoking pipes (Jin, Wang), drawn by the Blue Reverberation into a plot against the Shi Association.

nodes.Name: The 8 O'Clock Circus
nodes.Desc: The circus of the ringmaster **Oswald** — it turns its audience into "flowers". A member of the Reverberation Ensemble.

nodes.Name: The Carnival
nodes.Desc: A former textile Wing. They feed on Sweepers to weave silk out of people, following a Prescript of the Index.

nodes.Name: The Church of Gears
nodes.Desc: **Eileen**'s sect: promises relief from the pain of life through mechanization of the body. Urban Legend.

nodes.Name: The Twinhook Pirates
nodes.Desc: Pirates of the Great Lake; the Middle Finger stands behind them (**Canto V**).

nodes.Name: The Phalanx
nodes.Desc: A large Syndicate that, according to the notes, includes the Kurokumo Clan; it ordered the hunt for the Blade Lineage.

nodes.Name: Yun's Office
nodes.Desc: A small Backstreets Office with "lousy requests" (find a cat). The Library's first Fixer guests; Finn.

nodes.Name: Hook Office
nodes.Desc: Unscrupulous Fixers (McCullin, Taein, Naoki) who commit unnecessary murders.

nodes.Name: Streetlight Office
nodes.Desc: A Zwei branch guarding two blocks (Lulu, Mars). Coordinator Sang lost everyone in the Library.

nodes.Name: Molar Office
nodes.Desc: Olga, Rien, Mika. They uncovered the truth about the WARP Trains; after being resurrected by the Light — Molar Boatworks (Intervallo II).

nodes.Name: Dawn Office
nodes.Desc: Coordinator Salvador, Philip. Destroyed; Philip became the "Crying Children" Distortion.

nodes.Name: Wedge Office
nodes.Desc: Pamela and others. They took Philip in after his Office was destroyed.

nodes.Name: Gaze Office
nodes.Desc: Allos, Dallos, Bono. They spied on the Molar Office with a surveillance device.

nodes.Name: Cane Office
nodes.Desc: Director Nemo. They hunted the books of W Corp's Cleanup Crew for the secret of a Singularity.

nodes.Name: The "April" Office
nodes.Desc: Vergilius's former Office; according to the notes, destroyed by N Corp's Taboo Hunters.

nodes.Name: Fanghunt Office
nodes.Desc: Bloodfiend extermination specialists; took part in the operation against La Manchaland.

nodes.Name: The "Key & Rose" Workshop
nodes.Desc: A Workshop that took on a combat contract — an example of Workshops going to war too.

nodes.Name: Molar Boatworks
nodes.Desc: The Backstreets of District 21: ships and parts made of scrap; they upgraded Mephistopheles.

nodes.Name: The League of Nine (Literati)
nodes.Desc: Idealist scientists from T Corp's District: Yeonji (leader), Yi Sang, Dongrang, Dongbaek, Gubo, Gap-ryeon, Sang-ho, Anyeong, Yuran, Rim. They created technologies for the sake of knowledge; the League fell apart after betrayal and pressure from the Wings. N Corp is trying to revive it.

nodes.Name: The Technology Liberation Alliance
nodes.Desc: Former K Corp researchers (Ran, Marile, Dongbaek) opposed to unchecked technological development. They wanted to reveal the truth about K Corp's Singularity (**Canto IV**).

nodes.Name: Taboo Hunters
nodes.Desc: Wing agents who pursue violators of the Taboos and of their Wing's own laws: N Corp (Meursault, Vespa), U Corp (the Laws of the Lake).

nodes.Name: The Order of the World's Edge
nodes.Desc: Explorers of the Ruins.

nodes.Name: Limbus Company
nodes.Desc: The company that inherited L Corp's technology. Details on the "Limbus Company" screen.

nodes.Name: The Faust Society
nodes.Desc: A gathering of Fausts from different worlds; "Naive Faust" got a reprimand and became "Foolish Faust" (Canto IX epilogue).

nodes.Name: How to read this screen
nodes.Desc:
At the top — **the Head**, below it — **the 26 Wings**. On the left — **Fixers** (Associations, Colors, other organizations), on the right — **the Fingers** and **the Spider's House**, at the bottom — Backstreets Syndicates and Offices.

Clicking a node opens its description; sub-blocks contain "Dante's Notes" from the game.

nodes.Name: Sweepers
nodes.Desc:
Post-humans, masters of **the Night in the Backstreets** (daily 3:13–4:34): they speak in numbers and process bodies into fuel. Formally not a Syndicate, but to Backstreets residents they are the same kind of force with their own rules.

- **LoR:** a separate Reception of Urban Nightmare level.
- **Intervallo V (Nocturnal Sweeping):** endless Sweepers in H Corp's Backstreets.
- **The Carnival** hunted Sweepers for silk (by a Prescript of the Index).

nodes.Name: The New League of Nine Literati
nodes.Desc: The revived League of Nine (see the neighboring node). In **Canto X**, Faust makes a deal with it to save Meursault and get the Sinners into Grand Magasin Sisyphe.

nodes.Name: Heishou Pack
nodes.Desc: A private army of the powers of **Hongyuan** (H Corp). Its branches bear the powers of the twelve animals of the "Earthly Branches" (the Mao Branch has been encountered); they often change "masters". Attacked LCB in Intervallo V (Nocturnal Sweeping). More on the "City Map", District 8.

nodes.Name: Lords of the Star
nodes.Desc: A mysterious organization connected to **Demian**. **The Lady of the Spring** from Canto X presumably belongs to it. Its goals are unknown.

nodes.Name: Crosshair Office
nodes.Desc: Gunners Tamaki, Stephan and Liwei; their bullets come from Atelier Logic. On Eugene's (Shi) order they attacked the Church of Gears, but the Blue Reverberation spirited Eileen away and drove them into the Library. More on the Library of Ruina screen.

nodes.Name: The Reverberation Ensemble
nodes.Desc: The Blue Reverberation's (Argalia's) group of sentient Distortions: Pluto, Elena, Ji-hyun, Tanya, Oswald, Bremen, Greta, Eileen, Philip. In Library of Ruina it fights the Fingers for L Corp's Nest, keeps the Smiling Faces on a leash and storms the Library for its Light. Full roster on the Library of Ruina screen.

nodes.Name: THE SEPHIROT TREE — L Corp headquarters
50 DAYS OF PURGATORY — the final cycle
Keter — Architecture Team
nodes.Desc:
**Keter** is a Sephirah, head of the **"Architecture Team"**. In a past life — **Angela / Ayin**.

- **Full name:** Keter (Kether)
- **Alias / Code:** The name of the Architecture Team. Within the story of days 46-50 it is embodied by various aspects of Ayin's personality, known as Abel, Abram and Adam.
- **Universe:** Project Moon (Lobotomy Corporation)
- **Role:** Keter is the name of the Architecture Team. The entities appearing on days 46-50 (Abel, Abram, Adam) are not a collective mind, but various incarnations and aspects of Ayin's own personality that he must overcome.
- **Status:** Not a separate personality. After the completion of the "Seed of Light" project and the resolution of Ayin's inner conflicts, these manifestations disappear.
- **Occupation:** Management of Lobotomy Corporation's Architecture Team (symbolically).
- **Goal:** To help "Manager X" (the player) grasp Ayin's true nature, his regrets and motives, in order to complete the "scenario" and the "Seed of Light" project.
- **Game appearances:** Appears in Lobotomy Corporation from day 46 to day 50. Encounters with him take the form of dialogues and boss battles against his various incarnations (Abel, Abram, Adam).

Pec.Name: Department and Core Suppression
Pec.Desc: Finale: the trials of the archetypes of **Abel, Abraham and Adam** — accepting Ayin's guilt, sacrifice and mistakes.

Pec.Name: In Library of Ruina
Pec.Desc: Patron of the **Floor of General Works**. Realization theme: *Angela and Roland*.

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
*   **General appearance:** The various incarnations the player faces share features with Ayin.
*   **Color scheme:** The main color of the Architecture Team and its entities is white.
*   **Symbolism:** The shoulder patches of the department's employees bear the letter "K".

Pec.Name: Personality and character (in various incarnations)
Pec.Desc:
*   **Abel:** Represents weariness and disillusionment with the endless repetition of the cycle. On day 46 he is still calm and friendly, but on day 47 he becomes apathetic and negative, advising you to give it all up.
*   **Abram:** Embodies remorse and atonement for past deeds.
*   **Adam:** A distorted understanding of Carmen's will; his ideas are fanatical and mad.
*   **"???" (Ayin):** The final incarnation, appearing on day 50. Represents the true Ayin, who regrets what he has done but is ready to bear his burden.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
*   **Origin:** These entities are not separate personalities. They are projections of Ayin's inner world that he confronts at the end of his "scenario". They are his own doubts, despair, fanaticism and regret given form.
*   **Scenario cycles:** Ayin created the "scenario" and set off many time loops in which different versions of himself (X) tried to complete the project. Most of them failed.
*   **Role in the story (Days 46-50):** The player meets these incarnations (Abel, Abram, Adam) on the way to the finale. Each of them represents a particular stage of despair and madness that Ayin went through or could have gone through. By going through dialogues and battles with them, "Manager X" overcomes these inner conflicts and draws closer to the truth.
*   **Final encounter (Day 50):** On day 50 the player meets the last incarnation — Ayin himself, who reveals his true motives and regrets and finally completes the "Seed of Light" project.

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
*   **Ayin (A):** These entities are a direct reflection of Ayin's personality and inner struggle.
*   **Manager X (the player):** These incarnations serve X as a mirror reflecting his own past, doubts and resolve. Their purpose is to test and strengthen X's will for the final trial.
*   **Other Sephirot:** The Architecture Team is on the lowest level (Atziluth), and its entities do not interact directly with the other Sephirot within the story.

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
*   **Climax of the story:** The encounter with these incarnations is the final stage of the game's story, revealing key secrets and leading to the resolution.
*   **Revealing Ayin's personality:** Through dialogues with them, the player learns about Ayin's motives, regrets and true nature.
*   **The final trial:** Overcoming these inner conflicts is the last obstacle before the completion of the "Seed of Light" project. It symbolizes victory over past failures and the acceptance of responsibility.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
*   **Key quote:** *"You cannot see yourself. I am, you might say, like a mirror for you. A broken mirror, to be precise"* (Abel's words).
*   **Origin of the name:** Kether (כֶּתֶר) means "Crown" in Hebrew. It is the first and highest sephirah on the Tree of Life in Kabbalah, symbolizing the divine will, the source of creation and the higher "Self".

Pec.Name: From the transcripts: the first meeting
Pec.Desc:
> (Angela off-screen)
> Angela, AI assistant - I am a machine.
> Angela, AI assistant - I can remember everything.

nodes.Name: Hokma — Record Team
nodes.Desc:
**Hokma** is a Sephirah, head of the **"Record Team"**. In a past life — **Benjamin**.

- **Full name:** Benjamin
- **Alias / Code:** B
- **Universe:** Project Moon (includes the games Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina, Limbus Company)
- **Role:** A researcher in Carmen's laboratory, Ayin's comrade, one of Angela's creators. Later — the Sephirah Hokma, head of the Record Team. In Library of Ruina — the appointed librarian of the Floor of Religion.
- **Status:** Was caught by Angela trying to warn Manager X and forcibly turned into the Sephirah Hokma.
- **Occupation:** Scientist, researcher, hacker.
- **Goal:** To help Ayin complete the "Seed of Light" project begun by Carmen.
- **Game appearances:** Lobotomy Corporation (as "B" and the Sephirah Hokma), Library of Ruina (as the librarian of the Floor of Religion).

Pec.Name: Department and Core Suppression
Pec.Desc: Hokma's Core Suppression: Benjamin begs you to stop and remain in the eternal cycle. Lesson: "An eye that embraces the past; building the future."

Pec.Name: In Library of Ruina
Pec.Desc: Patron of the **Floor of Religion**. Realization theme: *Faith in the creator, accepting the past*.

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
*   **General appearance (human):** A man with short gray hair and green eyes who wears red-framed glasses. Dressed in a lab coat, a gray shirt with a red tie, gray trousers with a light brown belt and black shoes.
*   **General appearance (Hokma):** Looks like a middle-aged man with short, slicked-back gray hair, pale green pupilless eyes and dark circles under his eyes. Wears a monocle over his right eye. Dressed in a long light gray robe resembling a zhiduo (a Chinese robe), with a gray sash and cloud-pattern ornaments, gray trousers and black shoes. Holds an open pocket watch in his right hand. His associated color is gray.
*   **Robotic form (after Core Suppression):** A white square body with gray markings, gears and a single glowing digital eye in the center. Keeps the monocle and pocket watch. Has mechanical limbs: a pair of arms and four legs.

Pec.Name: Personality and character
Pec.Desc:
*   **Main traits:** Devoted, pious, gentle, slightly pessimistic. Deeply respects and reveres Ayin, considering him his teacher.
*   **Personality:** In his human life — an optimistic, hard-working, kind and loyal friend. As Hokma — composed, serious, judicious, with a deep understanding of time and its cyclical nature. Shows indifference to employees' lives, considering their suffering and deaths within the facility meaningless.
*   **Beliefs:** Strives to help Ayin achieve his goal, even at the cost of his own life. Recognizes the futility of suffering within the company's repeating cycles.
*   **How others see him:** Seen as Ayin's loyal follower and assistant. His devotion and self-sacrifice underline the depth of his attachment to the cause and to his teacher.

Pec.Name: Speech patterns and manner of communication
Pec.Desc:
- **Style:** As Benjamin — gentle, respectful and devoted, with notes of pessimism. As Hokma — composed, serious, judicious; his speech is full of philosophical reflections on time, faith and the cyclical nature of existence.
- **Typical lines:**
  - *"I have no obligation to treat you ilk with any courtesy or greeting. Any faith I would have has long been crushed."*
  - *"Don't trust the AI... Don't trust the company..."* (addressing X)
  - *"There was a man named Ayin... I had faith in him... I believed that what he sought to do was the right thing."*
- **Tone:** Deep and calm, with a hint of weary wisdom. His voice carries regret for the past, but also unwavering loyalty to Ayin's ideals.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
*   **Origin:** — (There is no exact information about his origins, but, like the other key figures, he was probably a resident of the City.)
*   **Joining the project:** Was brought in to work in Carmen's laboratory, most likely through Ayin, and became his most devoted colleague. Joined the project when Carmen's research had reached a dead end, becoming Ayin's student and assistant.
*   **Work on the "Seed of Light":** Worked with Ayin and Carmen on the "Seed of Light" project. After Carmen's death he continued working with Ayin. He took part in creating the AI Angela, although he warned Ayin about the danger and the impossibility of recreating Carmen.
*   **Attempt to warn X:** In Lobotomy Corporation, under the alias "B", he tried to contact the new manager (X) to reveal the truth about the company. He managed to pass on two truths — "Don't trust the AI" and "Don't trust the company" — but was cut off by Angela before he could reveal the third.
*   **Transformation into a Sephirah:** After his failed attempt to warn X, Benjamin was caught by Angela and, as punishment, forcibly turned into the Sephirah Hokma, head of the Record Team, and placed on the lower levels so that he would be forgotten.
*   **After the events of Lobotomy Corporation:** After the events of the first game, Hokma becomes the appointed librarian of the Floor of Religion in the Library (Library of Ruina).

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
*   **Ayin (A):** Benjamin was his student, assistant and most devoted friend. He deeply respected Ayin and considered him his teacher. Despite his devotion, he did not always approve of Ayin's methods, especially his obsession with recreating Carmen through an AI.
*   **Carmen (C):** Worked with her on the "Seed of Light" project. Like many others, he was inspired by her charisma and ideas. After her death he carried on her work by supporting Ayin.
*   **Angela:** One of her creators (together with Ayin). Later, as "B", he tried to warn X about her deceitfulness and danger, for which it was Angela herself who caught him and forcibly turned him into a Sephirah.

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
*   **Creating Angela:** Benjamin took a direct part in creating Angela, although he warned Ayin about the risks.
*   **"The voice of warning":** As "B", he is the first character who tries to reveal to the player (X) the truth about the company's cyclical nature, Angela's deceitfulness and the true purpose of the "Seed of Light". His intervention is the first crack in the illusion Angela created.
*   **Keeper of time:** As Hokma, he runs the Record Team and symbolizes the cyclical nature of time and the acceptance of the past. His role is to remind others of the futility of suffering in an endless cycle and of the importance of memory.
*   **Librarian of Religion:** In Library of Ruina he continues his role as a keeper of knowledge and time, receiving guests on the Floor of Religion and helping Angela in her new pursuit.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
*   **Name:** Benjamin. In Korean (the game's original language) — 벤자민 (ben-ja-min). The Sephirah name is Hokma, which corresponds to the sephirah Chokhmah (Wisdom) on the Kabbalistic Tree of Life.
*   **Key quote:** "Don't trust the AI... Don't trust the company..." (addressing X as B).
*   **Symbolism:** His Sephirah, Hokma, embodies wisdom, intuition and the acceptance of the past. His attributes (watch, monocle) underline his connection to time and observation.
*   **Voice acting:** —
*   **Interesting facts:**
    *   Benjamin was one of Angela's creators.
    *   His attempt to warn X is the key moment that first hints to the player that something is wrong with the company, and it sets off a chain of discoveries.
    *   In Library of Ruina his floor (Religion) is symbolically tied to faith, devotion and the search for a higher meaning, which reflects his personal path.

Pec.Name: From the transcripts: the first meeting
Pec.Desc:
> *(Flashback: Benjamin greets A.)*
> **Benjamin** — Welcome, A.
> **Benjamin** — I missed you very much.
> **Benjamin** — I've been waiting for you since my very first day of work here.
> **Benjamin** — Do you remember this ocean?
> **Benjamin** — You said this place is the final refuge of all rivers and streams.
> *(Back to the present. Hokma in the Record Team.)*
> **Hokma, Sephirah of the Record Team** — Truly… Everything settles on the lower layers.
> **Hokma** — What do you think of these heavens, painstakingly whitewashed with plaster?
> **Hokma** — I knew you would come soon.
> **Hokma** — Consider this my welcoming gift to you.
> **Hokma** — I thought you might have longed to see something other than what I have now become.
> **Hokma** — Time is like a scythe; it ruthlessly tries to cut, divide and sever in two the clasped hands of those you love.
> **Hokma** — Everyone I loved has gone, leaving me, a weary old man, behind.

nodes.Name: Binah — Extraction Team
nodes.Desc:
**Binah** is a Sephirah, head of the **"Extraction Team"**. In a past life — **Garion**.

- **Full name:** Binah
- **Real name (human):** Garion
- **Alias / Code:** Arbiter
- **Universe:** Project Moon (includes the games Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina, Limbus Company)
- **Role:** In her human life — an Arbiter of "the Head", an elite agent wielding Singularities. In Lobotomy Corporation — the Sephirah of the Extraction Team. In Library of Ruina — the appointed Librarian of the Floor of Philosophy.
- **Status:** Was defeated by Kali (the Red Mist) during the attack on the laboratory, captured by Ayin, tortured and forcibly turned into the Sephirah Binah.
- **Occupation:** Arbiter, elite destroyer-agent. As Binah — the Sephirah who manages the extraction of energy from the Well.
- **Goal:** As an Arbiter — to serve "the Head" and destroy threats to the City (including the "Seed of Light" project). As Binah — to follow Ayin's scenario, while secretly wishing retribution upon him and supporting Angela's rebellion.
- **Game appearances:** Lobotomy Corporation (as the Sephirah Binah), Library of Ruina (as the Librarian of the Floor of Philosophy), Limbus Company (as Garion in memories).

Pec.Name: Department and Core Suppression
Pec.Desc: Binah's Core Suppression: the Arbiter herself enters the fight. Lesson: "An eye that gazes into fear; breaking the vicious cycle."

Pec.Name: In Library of Ruina
Pec.Desc: Patron of the **Floor of Philosophy**. Realization theme: *A gaze that does not look away*.

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
*   **General appearance (human — Garion):** A woman with very pale skin, black hair with golden streaks and completely black pupilless eyes. Wears an Arbiter's uniform: a long black dress with golden hexagonal patterns and a long black coat with a feathered collar. Height — 174 cm.
*   **Hairstyle (Garion):** An asymmetrical haircut: the left side of her head is shaved, while the right falls to her shoulder and is adorned with golden streaks.
*   **General appearance (the Sephirah Binah):** Looks like an unnaturally pale woman with an asymmetrical black bob, longer on the right side, and the same black pupilless eyes. She has a small mole under her left eye.
*   **Clothing (Binah):** Wears a long black robe with golden trim, keeping an overall somber and majestic silhouette. Her associated color is black.
*   **Robotic form (after Core Suppression):** A dark, rectangular body with sharp corners, resembling a tombstone. Unlike most Sephirot, Binah and Gebura appear in battle in their humanoid forms, which underlines their unique status.

Pec.Name: Personality and character
Pec.Desc:
*   **Main traits:** Mysterious, aloof, perceptive, sadistic, wise.
*   **Personality (Garion):** A powerful and extremely cruel individual, devoted to her work. She admitted that neither the stars nor the sun had ever impressed her as much as the sight of a dying person. She reveled in violence and destruction, finding in them her only source of thrills. Outside of battle, however, she could be patient and observant, studying other people's reactions with interest.
*   **Personality (Binah):** Having become a Sephirah, she kept her sadistic nature and love of black tea, but gained a new depth. Her personality is shrouded in mystery and dignity. She speaks in metaphors and riddles, rarely giving direct answers. She openly mocks the employees and the Manager himself, considering the suffering within the corporation meaningless, yet at the same time demonstrates a deep understanding of human nature and the vices of the City.
*   **Beliefs:** Unlike the other Sephirot, Binah has no illusions about Ayin's goals. She sees the hypocrisy in his attempts to "cure the disease of the mind" and does not hesitate to point it out. She considers his plan doomed, and suffering an inevitable consequence of human nature.
*   **Evolution in Library of Ruina:** In the Library her character softens. She becomes friendlier toward the other Librarians, often inviting them to tea. She has let go of her past grudges and Garion's memories, but refuses to reveal the secrets of "the Head" even to Angela.
*   **How others see her:** Seen as a frightening, unknowable force. Her past as an Arbiter and her incredible power inspire respect and fear. The other Sephirot treat her warily.

Pec.Name: Speech patterns and manner of communication
Pec.Desc:
- **Style:** Binah's speech is almost always a stream of metaphors, riddles and philosophical allusions. She rarely speaks plainly, preferring her listener to work out the meaning of her words on their own.
- **Typical lines:**
  - *"Do not ask my name. 'Binah' is not the name of a person. It is the sorrowful name of a place where many graves are found."*
  - *"I am the one who draws the water. Why have you come to this place, and what would you have me draw up?"*
  - *"Ah. My two finest companions — silence and the metallic aroma of black tea."*
  - *"The world you praised and the world I despised are so different."*
  - *"I like killing people with this weapon, you know. This weapon is called trust."*
- **Tone:** Deep, calm, almost hypnotic. Her voice carries an ancient weariness and a detached curiosity. She speaks with unchanging calm, even when describing cruel or grim things.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
*   **Origin:** Her exact origins are unknown, but she grew up in the City and from an early age showed sadistic tendencies and a lack of interest in life's ordinary joys.
*   **Service as an Arbiter:** She became one of the Arbiters of "the Head" — the City's supreme governing body, consisting of A, B and C Corp. Arbiters are elite agents whose bodies are enhanced with Singularities, and they are powerful enough to destroy an entire "Wing" single-handedly.
*   **The mission against the old L Corp:** After Carmen and Ayin's laboratory was exposed, "the Head" sent Garion and two "Claws" to destroy it. Before that, she had successfully suppressed another corporation, H Corp.
*   **The battle with the Red Mist:** During the attack on the laboratory she clashed with Kali (the Red Mist), who was defending the facility. Garion killed Kali but was mortally wounded herself in the process. This allowed Ayin to capture her.
*   **Captivity and transformation into a Sephirah:** Ayin tortured Garion to obtain information about "the Head". Afterwards, as with his other former colleagues and enemies, he turned her into a Sephirah, the head of the Extraction Team.
*   **Role in Lobotomy Corporation:** As a Sephirah, she oversees the extraction of energy from the "Well" (the human unconscious), using the "Cogito" as a "bucket". The player meets her between days 36 and 42 of the game.
*   **Angela's rebellion:** Unlike most Sephirot, Binah took Angela's side during her uprising against Ayin. She declared that she agreed with Angela on the matter of retribution against Ayin. During the battle with the other Sephirot she overpowered Gebura and helped Angela seize "the Light".
*   **After the events of Lobotomy Corporation:** After Angela's plan succeeded and the Library was created, Binah becomes the Librarian of the Floor of Philosophy.

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
*   **Ayin (A):** Their relationship is complex and full of hatred. Binah was his enemy, whom he captured, tortured and turned into a tool. As a Sephirah she makes no secret of her contempt for his hypocrisy, considering his "Seed of Light" plan fundamentally doomed. In the finale she supports Angela's rebellion in order to take revenge on him.
*   **Kali / Gebura:** As Garion, she killed Kali in battle. Having become Sephirot, they ended up on opposite sides: Gebura became a symbol of protection and strength, and Binah a symbol of destruction and knowledge. During Angela's rebellion Binah once again gets the better of Gebura. Despite this, in the Library their relationship becomes calmer, and Binah may invite Gebura to tea.
*   **Angela:** Binah is the only Sephirah who immediately and unconditionally supported Angela's rebellion, seeing it as an act of just retribution against Ayin. Angela was touched by this decision. Binah remains a loyal, if mysterious, ally of the Director.
*   **"The Head":** Her former masters. Even after everything, Binah refuses to reveal their secrets, which speaks to a lingering loyalty or a deep fear of them.

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
*   **The main antagonist of the past:** As the Arbiter Garion, she was the embodiment of "the Head's" power, capable of destroying Ayin's entire project. Her attack was the catalyst that led to Kali's death and the subsequent creation of Gebura.
*   **Keeper of the Well:** As Binah, she runs the Extraction Team, which is key to the functioning of the whole Corporation. She reveals to the player the metaphorical nature of the "Well", the "Bucket" and the "Water", explaining where Abnormalities and E.G.O come from.
*   **Philosophical critic:** Her dialogues with Manager X are full of criticism of Ayin's morality. She questions the very possibility of "curing" humanity, pointing out that darkness and suffering are an inseparable part of the human soul that cannot simply be "scooped out". She is the voice of cynical wisdom in the game.
*   **A key ally in the coup:** Her decision to support Angela was critical to the uprising's success. Her combat might and knowledge of the Sephirot made it possible to overcome resistance and take possession of "the Light".
*   **Librarian of Philosophy:** In Library of Ruina she continues her role as a wise but frightening observer, guiding the guests of the Floor of Philosophy.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
*   **Name:** Binah. In Korean (the game's original language) — 비나 (Bina). The Sephirah name corresponds to the sephirah Binah (Understanding) on the Kabbalistic Tree of Life. This sephirah symbolizes analysis, comprehension and the ability to discern, which perfectly fits her role in extracting from and understanding the "Well".
*   **Key quote:** *"I am the one who draws the water. Why have you come to this place, and what would you have me draw up?"*
*   **Symbolism:** Her Sephirah, Binah, embodies understanding. She is the one who "draws water" from the depths of the human unconscious, analyzing and extracting its essence. Her connection to the "Well" and to the color black underlines themes of darkness, depth and mystery.
*   **Voice acting:** Kim Bo-na (김보나).
*   **Interesting facts:**
    *   She is one of the two Sephirot (together with Gebura) who have no standard robotic form during Core Suppression.
    *   By her own account, her name, Binah, is not a personal name but the name of her department, "a sorrowful place where many graves are found".
    *   She is one of the few characters who appear in all three main games of the series: Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina and Limbus Company.
    *   She loves black tea, and its aroma is one of the few things that brought her pleasure, along with silence.
    *   Her height is 174 cm, and her birthday is October 7.

Pec.Name: From the transcripts: the first meeting
Pec.Desc:
> *(Binah stands among the tombstones.)*
> **Binah, Sephirah of the Extraction Team** — You've returned.
> **Binah** — So, did you enjoy your little journey while I was locked up here?
> **Binah** — Don't worry, I'm not angry with you.
> **Binah** — "O Sorrow, see, at last I have learned to respect you, for I know — you will never leave."
> **Binah** — It's hard to sense the passage of time here.
> **Binah** — That is why this eternity saved me.
> **Binah** — Have you seen the murky currents of the great river that crossed the whole City?
> **Binah** — If you go downstream, past the raging rapids and the winding channel…
> **Binah** — You will see a meadow, boundlessly wide, yet calm.
> **Binah** — This land is washed with all manner of mud, sand, refuse and remnants carried down from upstream.
> **Binah** — Everything that did not linger upstream or in the middle reaches ends up here, downstream, in the end…
> **Binah** — To bear all this accumulating burden, you need a strong back that won't break under the weight.
> **Binah** — I have seen many Wells here.

nodes.Name: Chesed — Welfare Team
nodes.Desc:
**Chesed** is a Sephirah, head of the **"Welfare Team"**. In a past life — **Daniel**.

- **Full name:** Daniel
- **Alias / Code:** Chesed
- **Universe:** Project Moon (includes the games Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina)
- **Role:** An employee and researcher in Carmen's laboratory. Later — the Sephirah Chesed, head of the Welfare Team. In Library of Ruina — the appointed librarian of the Floor of Social Sciences.
- **Status:** Died during the Arbiter's attack on the laboratory, after which his brain was placed in a mechanical body and he became the Sephirah Chesed.
- **Occupation:** Scientist, researcher.
- **Goal:** To help Ayin complete the "Seed of Light" project begun by Carmen. As Chesed — to provide the employees with as much comfort and well-being as possible within the endless cycle.
- **Game appearances:** Lobotomy Corporation (as the Sephirah Chesed), Library of Ruina (as the librarian of the Floor of Social Sciences).

Pec.Name: Department and Core Suppression
Pec.Desc: Chesed's Core Suppression: damage to employees rises sharply; his rebellion against Angela ends in the death of his department. Lesson: "Those who are loyal and reliable."

Pec.Name: In Library of Ruina
Pec.Desc: Patron of the **Floor of Social Sciences**. Realization theme: *Someone loyal you can rely on*.

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
*   **General appearance (human):** A young man with short blue hair and brown eyes. Dressed in an expensive suit that stands out against the other employees' lab coats, emphasizing his high-society background.
*   **General appearance (Chesed):** Looks like a man with shoulder-length blue hair, parted bangs and a single strand in the middle. He has brown eyes with noticeable bags under them, which gives him a tired look. Dressed in a suit styled after the late 19th or early 20th century, with a blue ascot tie fastened with a button. Wears a blue jacket with a white collar and black trim, black trousers and a gray armband with the letter "C". Often holds a cup of coffee in his right hand. His associated color is blue.
*   **Robotic form (after Core Suppression):** His mechanical body has details referencing his love of coffee, including a special compartment for serving coffee. Its other body parts match the general style of the Sephirot.
*   **Appearance in Library of Ruina:** His blue hair becomes longer and messier, often gathered in a ponytail draped over his left shoulder. He wears a blue coat with vents at the back, a gray shirt, a dark blue tie, dark blue trousers and black shoes. His constant attribute remains a black coffee cup, this time with the Library's logo.

Pec.Name: Personality and character
Pec.Desc:
*   **Main traits:** Good-natured, relaxed, cynical, caring. Deeply values the comfort and well-being of others, but his care stems from a conviction that everything happening is meaningless.
*   **Personality (human):** Daniel was ambitious, hard-working and very caring. He sincerely wanted to improve the company's work and reduce employee mortality. He was highly motivated by Carmen's ideas.
*   **Personality (Chesed):** As a Sephirah he kept his kindness but became far more relaxed, sleepy and cynical. His philosophy is simple: "Everyone here is going to die anyway, so why make their lives harder?". He doesn't scold employees for mistakes, preferring to comfort them and even take on part of their work himself. Despite his outward gentleness, he is aware of the futility of their existence within the endless cycle run by Angela. He admits that his past, enthusiastic self would be ashamed of who he is now.
*   **Personality in Library of Ruina:** Having become a librarian, Chesed grew even more relaxed, friendly and talkative. He often uses coffee as a metaphor to explain social phenomena and likes to invite colleagues (especially Gebura and Tiphereth) to his floor for coffee together. His cynicism has given way to a light playfulness and a wish to build warmer relationships with those around him.
*   **Beliefs:** Sincerely believes in the importance of employee well-being, even if it is only temporary relief before the inevitable end. His motto is to make people's stay in this cruel world at least a little more comfortable.
*   **How others see him:** The employees adore him for his gentleness and understanding; his department is considered the best one to work in. The other Sephirot see him differently: from mild irritation (Gebura) to friendly affection (Tiphereth).

Pec.Name: Speech patterns and manner of communication
Pec.Desc:
- **Style:** Gentle and unhurried, with light, almost playful intonations. He often ends sentences with a tilde (`~`) or similar intonations in speech, which underlines how relaxed he is. Likes to use coffee-related metaphors.
- **Typical lines:**
  - *"I can't start my day without a cup of coffee in the morning."*
  - *"If only we could all pursue a noble path together~"*
  - *"How about a fragrant cup of coffee for all~?"*
- **Tone:** Gentle, soothing, with notes of weariness and resignation. His voice carries sincere care, but it is colored by an understanding of the futility of everything that is happening. In Library of Ruina his tone becomes livelier and more cheerful.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
*   **Origin:** Daniel was born into a wealthy and influential family living in a "Nest" (a prosperous area of the City). Thanks to his background, charm and talents, he could easily have taken a high position in any of the "Wings", but he chose a different path.
*   **Joining the project:** He was personally recruited by Carmen. Her fiery speeches and unwavering determination to change the City inspired Daniel to leave his life of luxury and join the "Seed of Light" project in the laboratory in the Outskirts.
*   **Work on the "Seed of Light":** Worked with Ayin, Carmen and Benjamin. He was full of enthusiasm and strove to do everything possible for the project's success.
*   **The Arbiter's attack:** After a series of tragedies, including Enoch's death, one of the team members (Michelle) reported the laboratory to "the Head". The Arbiter Garion (who later became the Sephirah Binah) was sent to destroy the laboratory. Garion ordered Daniel to release all the Abnormalities, threatening to do it herself. Daniel obeyed, hoping this would give his colleagues a chance to escape. However, they all died anyway, and Daniel himself died tormented by guilt over what he had done.
*   **Transformation into a Sephirah:** After Lobotomy Corporation was founded, Ayin placed Daniel's brain in a mechanical body, creating the Sephirah Chesed, head of the Welfare Team.
*   **After the events of Lobotomy Corporation:** After the events of the first game, Chesed becomes the appointed librarian of the Floor of Social Sciences in the Library (Library of Ruina).

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
*   **Carmen (C):** Daniel was personally recruited by Carmen and deeply inspired by her ideas. It was her charisma and conviction that made him give up a comfortable future and join the project.
*   **Ayin (A):** Worked under Ayin's leadership. Like many, he probably respected Ayin's single-mindedness, but did not share his willingness to make any sacrifice.
*   **Angela:** Chesed's relationship with Angela is extremely tense. He disagrees with her methods and cannot forgive her for letting his employees die. Angela, in turn, considers him one of the most "problematic" Sephirot, whose proposals for improving operations she constantly rejects. By the end of Library of Ruina their relationship improves somewhat, and Angela even considers dropping by for a cup of coffee with him.
*   **Gebura (Kali):** In Lobotomy Corporation their relationship was extremely hostile due to diametrically opposed approaches to management. In Library of Ruina, however, their interactions become much more playful and friendly. Chesed often teases Gebura and tries to drag her out for coffee.
*   **Tiphereth:** They have developed a warm, almost familial relationship. Chesed cares a great deal for Tiphereth (especially her younger and more emotional version) and often invites her to his floor.

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
*   **Running the Welfare Team:** As Chesed, he runs the department responsible for restoring employees' health (HP) and sanity (SP), as well as their general well-being.
*   **The philosophy of "comfort before death":** His role is to remind others of the value of human life and comfort even in the most hopeless conditions. He embodies the idea that even if the end is inevitable, the road to it should be dignified.
*   **Librarian of Social Sciences:** In Library of Ruina he continues his role as a keeper of knowledge, but now in the field of human relationships and society. His floor and his character emphasize his interest in people and their well-being.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
*   **Name:** Daniel. In Korean (the game's original language) — 다니엘 (da-ni-el). The Sephirah name is Chesed, which corresponds to the sephirah Chesed (Mercy) on the Kabbalistic Tree of Life. Chesed embodies mercy, generosity and loving-kindness.
*   **Key quote:** "I can't start my day without a cup of coffee in the morning."
*   **Symbolism:** His Sephirah, Chesed, embodies mercy, kindness and care for the weak. His attributes (coffee, tired look) underline his connection to comfort, routine and resignation in the face of the inevitable.
*   **Voice acting:** Korean voice actor — Park Yo-han (박요한).
*   **Interesting facts:**
    *   His height is 183 cm, and his birthday is March 31.
    *   His favorite things, according to the artbook: "Coffee with a rich aroma" and "A clean aftertaste". Dislikes "Darkness".
    *   Despite being a robot, he continues to feel "sleepy" and to need coffee, a nod to his human habits.
    *   In Library of Ruina his design was changed: his hair became longer and messier, reflecting his more relaxed way of life outside the Corporation's strict confines.
    *   The name "Daniel" may be a reference to the biblical prophet Daniel, known for his wisdom and steadfast faith. This echoes his initial faith in Carmen's project and his subsequent disillusionment.

Pec.Name: From the transcripts: the first meeting
Pec.Desc:
> **Chesed, Sephirah of the Welfare Team** — What are you thinking about?
> **Chesed** — The air seems especially sweet today, don't you think?
> **Chesed** — If you don't mind, Manager, I'd like a cup of coffee. May I?
> **Chesed** — ...
> **Chesed** — Ah, that's better... I just can't start my day without freshly brewed coffee in the morning~
> **Chesed** — I hope my manner of speaking doesn't bother you?
> **Chesed** — My name is Chesed. I head the Welfare Team.
> **Chesed** — Our Welfare Team is wonderful. I'm proud to say my department has the highest satisfaction rating in the entire corporation.
> **Chesed** — Lady Angela told me to cooperate with you for now.
> **Chesed** — Well, I'm the type who can get along with anyone, but playing silly games with the Manager is too much even for me.
> **Chesed** — Orders are orders, though, so I have no choice, right?
> **Chesed** — All right, I'll be off, or my coffee will get cold~
> *(An employee appears.)*
> **Employee** — Um, Mr. Chesed, sir? I have an important matter for you.

nodes.Name: Gebura — Disciplinary Team
nodes.Desc:
**Gebura** is a Sephirah, head of the **"Disciplinary Team"**. In a past life — **Kali**.

- **Full name:** Kali
- **Aliases / Codes:** The Red Mist, Color Fixer; after her transformation — the Sephirah Gebura
- **Universe:** Project Moon (Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina)
- **Role:** The legendary Color Fixer of District 23, protector of the weak. Later — Carmen's bodyguard and a participant in the "Seed of Light" project. After her death — the Sephirah Gebura, head of the Disciplinary Team. In Library of Ruina — the appointed librarian of the Floor of Language.
- **Status:** Died defending the laboratory from the attack by the Arbiter Garion. Her brain and memories were used to create the Sephirah Gebura. In the Library she exists as a complete personality.
- **Occupation:** Fixer, bodyguard, fighter. As Gebura — head of the Disciplinary Team, responsible for suppressing Abnormalities and maintaining discipline. In the Library — the librarian in charge of the Floor of Language.
- **Goal:** To protect the weak and innocent; to follow Carmen's dream of healing the City. As Gebura — to carry out her duties and, ultimately, to protect the "Seed of Light" project.
- **Game appearances:** Lobotomy Corporation (as the Sephirah Gebura, mentioned as Kali), Library of Ruina (as the librarian Gebura and as a simulacrum of Kali in the "Red Mist" reception).
- **Age (at the time of death):** 30
- **Height:** 181 cm
- **Birthday:** April 24

Pec.Name: Department and Core Suppression
Pec.Desc: Gebura's Core Suppression: the Red Mist herself enters the fight in several phases. Lesson: "The courage to protect."

Pec.Name: In Library of Ruina
Pec.Desc: Patron of the **Floor of Language**. Realization theme: *The courage to protect*.

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
*   **General appearance (Kali):** A tall, stately woman with very long, straight, bright red hair reaching her hips, and brown eyes. Her face bears no scars.
*   **Clothing (Kali):** Wears a grayish-brown long leather coat over a dark gray leather shirt, and black straight trousers.
*   **General appearance (Gebura):** Looks like a woman with long dark red (burgundy) hair parted down the middle, often tied in a ponytail. Her face is covered in scars, one of which crosses her right eye. Her left eye is gold; her right (scarred) eye is gray. Her associated color is bright red.
*   **Clothing (Gebura):** Wears a red jacket over a light red bodysuit, plus an armband with the letter "G" — the first letter of her name. In Library of Ruina she wears a brown jacket with white lines, a black top with a red brooch and trousers matching the jacket. She almost always has a cigarette between her teeth.
*   **Robotic form (after Core Suppression):** A red and dark rectangular body vaguely resembling her own, with mechanical limbs (a pair of arms and legs) and three-fingered hands. In the center of the body is a rectangular opening with a red digital eye. Her Sephirah name is displayed on the body.

Pec.Name: Personality and character
Pec.Desc:
*   **Main traits:** Straightforward, honest, reliable, somewhat hot-tempered and warlike. Has an indomitable will and a deep sense of justice.
*   **Personality (Kali):** As a human, Kali was known for her strength and selflessness. Despite her reputation as a fearsome fighter, she was a protector of the weak and had a kind heart, which is what drew Carmen to her. She was ready to risk her life for others and for the cause she believed in.
*   **Personality (Gebura):** Having become a Sephirah, Gebura kept her tough and serious temperament. She is strict, aggressive and rude toward most employees, including the Manager. She mercilessly enforces the rules and despises cowards, whiners and those who pity Abnormalities. She knows the true nature of Abnormalities and wants to make them suffer, never showing them any softness. Her methods of running the Disciplinary Team carry high risk and often lead to heavy staff losses. After her Core Suppression she becomes bolder yet more careful with employees' lives, maintaining discipline but not letting their deaths be in vain.
*   **How others see her:** Kali is seen as a legendary hero and protector, a living legend whose name inspires awe and respect. Gebura, on the other hand, is considered harsh and dangerous by the employees and the other Sephirot, but her strength and resolve are undeniable.

Pec.Name: Speech patterns and manner of communication
Pec.Desc:
- **Style:** Rough, direct and uncompromising. Gebura doesn't stand on ceremony and says what she thinks, often using harsh expressions and sarcasm. She is not afraid to openly express her contempt and displeasure.
- **Typical lines:**
  - *"Ever heard of the saying, 'silence gives consent'? Consent enough for even hot lead to be embedded in your skull?"*
  - *"I hate crybabies who whine about and pity Abnormalities... They're dead weight."*
  - *"Abnormalities can be damaged, but never destroyed, and they can feel pain."*
- **Tone:** Rough, aggressive, confident. Her voice carries intolerance of weakness and a deep, long-standing hatred of Abnormalities.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
*   **Origin:** Kali was an orphan who grew up in the Backstreets of the City's District 23. She survived the brutality of street life and the bloody Syndicate wars, and vowed to become strong enough to protect those who cannot protect themselves. She originally became a Fixer to earn money and help the children in her district. Over time her strength and valor earned her the title of the Color Fixer "the Red Mist", officially granted by the Hana Association. She was known for being able to stand alone against Abnormality-level threats and even against the forces of "the Head" and the "Claws".
*   **Joining the project:** Carmen, who was looking for people useful to her laboratory, found Kali in the Backstreets and recruited her. Kali was deeply inspired by Carmen's dream of healing the City and became her chief protector and the laboratory's "muscle" in the early stages of the "Seed of Light" project.
*   **Work on the "Seed of Light" and gaining E.G.O:** As part of the project, Kali received a prototype E.G.O weapon — the blade "Mimicry", created from the Abnormality "Nothing There". Constant use of this weapon was risky and threatened her sanity. However, thanks to her willpower and faith in Carmen's ideals, Kali became **the first person in the City able to manifest her own personal E.G.O**, which took the form of her famous red armor and transformed "Mimicry" into her true weapon.
*   **Death and transformation into a Sephirah:** Kali died defending the research group in the Outskirts from an attack led by the Head's Arbiter Garion. In that battle she personally destroyed two "Claws" and mortally wounded Garion herself, but she too fell in the fight. To the whole City, the Red Mist simply disappeared, and she was remembered as a hero. After her death, Ayin used her remains and memories to create the Sephirah Gebura, head of the Disciplinary Team.

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
*   **Carmen (C):** Kali was boundlessly devoted to Carmen and her dream. She saw Carmen as a source of hope and sincerely believed it was possible to change the City for the better. Carmen, in turn, saw a kind heart in the fearsome fighter and gave her a purpose.
*   **Ayin (A):** Kali respected Ayin as a colleague and as the project's leader after Carmen's death. She helped him, but her straightforward, hot-blooded, protection-oriented nature often clashed with Ayin's cold, pragmatic methods.
*   **Binah (Garion):** The Head's Arbiter sent to destroy the laboratory. Kali and Garion killed each other in a brutal battle. Having become Sephirot, they kept a complicated relationship based on mutual respect for each other's strength, but also on their old enmity.
*   **Roland:** In the Library, Gebura initially treats Roland with suspicion and contempt, especially after learning he is a Fixer. Over time, however, as she gets to know him better, she changes her mind and becomes more open and trusting.
*   **Other Sephirot:**
    *   **Hod:** Hod treats Gebura kindly and tries to suggest more "sensible" ways of reducing losses. Gebura is gentler with her, but deep down considers Hod weak.
    *   **Tiphereth A:** Gebura has management conflicts with Tiphereth A that require Chesed's mediation.
    *   **Netzach:** In the Library, the two develop a special dynamic.

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
*   **E.G.O pioneer:** Kali is a crucial figure in the meta-plot of the Project Moon universe, as she was the first to demonstrate that a personal E.G.O could be manifested — a key concept for all the subsequent games.
*   **Defender of the project:** Her sacrifice allowed Ayin, Benjamin and the others to survive the Head's attack and continue work on the "Seed of Light" project, which led directly to the creation of Lobotomy Corporation.
*   **Head of the Disciplinary Team:** As Gebura, she plays a key role in running the Corporation, being responsible for the most dangerous part of the work — suppressing Abnormalities. Her storyline and Core Suppression reveal her past and her trauma tied to her death and the Claw attack, and help the player better understand her motives.
*   **Librarian of Language:** In Library of Ruina she continues to be an important character, and her Floor (Language) and its Realization are symbolically tied to expressing one's will, strength and overcoming inner rage.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
*   **Origin of the name:** The name "Kali" probably references the Hindu goddess of time, destruction and power, which perfectly suits her role as a mighty warrior. The Sephirah name is "Gebura", which corresponds to the sephirah Gevurah (Strength/Severity) on the Kabbalistic Tree of Life. This sephirah symbolizes strength, judgment, severity and discipline, fully reflecting her character and role.
*   **Interesting facts:**
    *   Gebura is the only Sephirah who was a Color Fixer in her past life.
    *   Her favorite cigarettes are non-menthol.
    *   She likes to meditate with her eyes closed.
    *   In Library of Ruina her Floor (Language) is mistakenly called the Floor of Natural Sciences in some guides, but this contradicts the lore, in which Natural Sciences is Tiphereth's Floor. The correct name is the Floor of Language.
    *   Her weapon "Mimicry" can change shape in her hands, turning into a huge sword, a spear or a scythe.
    *   There is some confusion about her height: some sources give 180 cm, but most, including in-game ones, agree on 181 cm.
    *   In the "Red Mist" battle in Library of Ruina, she is recreated by Angela as a simulacrum in her prime in order to lure out Argalia (the Blue Reverberation).

Pec.Name: From the transcripts: the first meeting
