Pec.Desc:
> **Gebura, Sephirah of the Disciplinary Team** — …
> **Gebura** — …Huh?
> **Gebura** — What? Who are you?
*[Option 1: I'm the manager.]*
> **Gebura** — Oh, so you're the new manager?
> **Gebura** — Sorry, but you don't look like one at all.
*[Option 2: Stay silent.]*
> **Gebura** — Oh, so you're the manager Tiphereth was talking about?
> **Gebura** — Ever heard the saying "silence gives consent"? Consent enough for hot lead to be embedded in your skull.
> **Gebura** — You'd better watch yourself.
> **Gebura** — Other departments may kiss your ass while you strut around like a haughty manager.
> **Gebura** — But here, that pomposity will tighten into a noose around your neck.
> **Gebura** — Well, since you at least made it here, I suppose you won't be completely useless dead weight.
> **Gebura** — I'm Gebura, head of the Disciplinary Team.

nodes.Name: Tiphereth — Central Command Team
nodes.Desc:
**Tiphereth** is a Sephirah, head of the **"Central Command Team"**. In a past life — **Lisa and Enoch**.

- **Full name:** Tiphereth A, formerly Lisa
- **Alias / Code:** Tiphereth
- **Universe:** Project Moon (includes the games Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina)
- **Role:** One of the two Sephirot running the Central Command Team in Lobotomy Corporation. In Library of Ruina — the Patron Librarian of the Floor of Natural Sciences.
- **Status:** In her human life — an orphan named Lisa; she died under unclear circumstances and was turned into the Sephirah Tiphereth A. After the events of Lobotomy Corporation she receives a physical body and becomes the Patron Librarian of the Floor of Natural Sciences in the Library.
- **Occupation:** In Lobotomy Corporation — a Sephirah, head of the Central Command Team (together with Tiphereth B). In Library of Ruina — the Librarian in charge of the Floor of Natural Sciences.
- **Goal:** To ensure that Enoch's (Tiphereth B's) sacrifice was not in vain, and to help the "Seed of Light" fully bloom.
- **Game appearances:** Lobotomy Corporation (as Tiphereth A), Library of Ruina (as the Patron Librarian of the Floor of Natural Sciences).

Pec.Name: Department and Core Suppression
Pec.Desc: Tiphereth's Core Suppression (A and B): special Qliphoth "Meltdowns" that require precise work. Lesson: to believe that Enoch's sacrifice had meaning.

Pec.Name: In Library of Ruina
Pec.Desc: Patron of the **Floor of Natural Sciences**. Realization theme: *Anticipation of the meaning of existence*.

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
*   **General appearance (Tiphereth A):** A young girl with golden hair in a long ponytail and pale green pupilless eyes. She wears a headband with a bow. Both Tiphereths have a childlike appearance.
*   **Clothing (Tiphereth A):** A white shirt, a brown cape (poncho) and a skirt. A ribbon tied in a bow around her neck. Dark brown stockings and boots.
*   **Color scheme:** The main colors are brown, white and gold (yellow).
*   **Robotic form (after Core Suppression):** A white square body with gold (yellow) elements and a green digital eye in the center. Keeps the bow headband.
*   **Library of Ruina (adult form):** Tiphereth (Lisa) gains a physical body and looks older than in Lobotomy Corporation. She has bright blonde hair, part of it styled into a crown and part let down and decorated with a bow at the side. She wears a yellow coat, a white blouse, an orange bow tie with a gold brooch, an orange shirt-dress with two belts and a waist bag, black leggings and high-heeled shoes.

Pec.Name: Personality and character
Pec.Desc:
*   **Main traits:** Blunt, sharp, pessimistic, yet deeply devoted and caring (especially toward Enoch/Tiphereth B).
*   **Personality:** In Lobotomy Corporation, Tiphereth A is direct and doesn't hesitate to voice her opinion. She makes high demands of the Manager and often criticizes the other Sephirot, considering them incompetent. She tends to expect the worst and think pessimistically. She is impatient and doesn't hide her irritation with those she considers lazy or stupid. Despite her outward harshness, she cares deeply about Tiphereth B, who is her only emotional support. She constantly scolds him for being too soft, but this is really an expression of her care and her fear of losing him again.
*   **Change in personality (Library of Ruina):** Having become a Patron Librarian, Tiphereth (Lisa) becomes more serious and diligent, but keeps her pride. She tries to behave maturely and optimistically to honor Enoch's memory. She often acts as a mediator between the hot-tempered Gebura and the teasing Chesed. However, she still reacts sharply if anyone questions her maturity or treats her like a child. She has also kept her contempt for the "lower" Librarians (the former Upper Layer Sephirot), although she tries to understand them.
*   **Beliefs:** Deeply believes that every being has its own value and meaning of existence. Her main motivation is to make Enoch's death matter and not be in vain.
*   **How others see her:** The other Sephirot probably consider her a grumpy and demanding child, but they also recognize her sincere devotion to her brother and to the cause.

Pec.Name: Speech patterns and manner of communication
Pec.Desc:
- **Style:** Direct, uncompromising, often with sarcastic or dismissive notes. She wastes no time on diplomacy and gets straight to the point. Her speech often betrays her impatience and frustration.
- **Typical lines (Lobotomy Corporation):**
  - *"Of course we are, isn't it obvious? We're twins."*
  - *"Trying to differentiate us is pointless."*
  - *"Don't disappoint me."*
  - *"The upper Sephirot have it too easy."*
- **Typical lines (Library of Ruina):**
  - *"The same book can show different things each time you read it. Understanding a book completely is a repetitive process, you know? ...and I don't want to stay ignorant forever. That's annoying."*
- **Tone:** Impatient and critical, but in moments of vulnerability or when Enoch is mentioned, she becomes sad and serious.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
*   **Origin:** Before the events of Lobotomy Corporation, Tiphereth A was a girl named Lisa. She lived with Enoch and their unnamed mother in a town in the Outskirts. It is unknown whether they were biologically related, but their emotional bond was stronger than that of many blood siblings.
*   **Joining the project:** After Lisa and Enoch were left alone (probably due to their mother's death), they were found by Kali (Gebura) during an expedition into the Outskirts. Carmen ordered the children to be taken in at the laboratory, where they came to live with her, Ayin and the other project members.
*   **Enoch's death:** Enoch, driven by a death wish and a desire to help the project, volunteered for the experiments despite Carmen's protests. Lisa was afraid of the project and distrusted it, seeing Enoch take part in mysterious experiments. In the end, Enoch died during one of the experiments. Lisa was crushed by grief, blamed Carmen and even declared that she should have been the one to die. She also blamed herself for her immaturity.
*   **Transformation into a Sephirah:** It is unknown exactly how Lisa herself died, but her remains, like Enoch's, were used to create the Sephirot Tiphereth. She was given the designation "A", and Enoch "B".
*   **Life as Tiphereth A:** In Lobotomy Corporation, Tiphereth A and B jointly ran the Central Command Team. Because of the department's size, two bodies were needed to run it. However, Tiphereth B's design was flawed, and he had to be replaced regularly, losing all his memories each time. Seeing her brother turned into an empty shell again and again was a source of constant pain and pessimism for Tiphereth A.
*   **Library of Ruina:** After the events of Lobotomy Corporation, Tiphereth A (Lisa) receives a physical body and becomes the Patron Librarian of the Floor of Natural Sciences. She finally accepts Enoch's death and decides to support Angela so that the "Seed of Light" can fully bloom and Enoch's sacrifice can gain meaning.

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
*   **Tiphereth B / Enoch:** Her only emotional support and the person closest to her. Lisa constantly scolds him for his softness, but this is really an expression of her deep attachment and fear of losing him again. His death became the cause of her pessimism and pain, and his regular resets as a Sephirah only deepened her suffering.
*   **Carmen:** As a child, Lisa feared and distrusted Carmen, especially after Enoch began taking part in the experiments. After Enoch's death she blamed Carmen for what happened.
*   **Angela:** In Library of Ruina, Lisa decides to support Angela in order to bring the "Seed of Light" to completion and give Enoch's death meaning.
*   **Other Sephirot (Librarians):** Treats the "lower" Librarians (the former Upper Layer Sephirot) with contempt, calling them "idiots". She especially dislikes Netzach for his laziness. Despite this, she tries to understand them and eventually apologizes for her prejudice.

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
*   **Running the Central Command Team:** Together with Tiphereth B, she leads the largest department in Lobotomy Corporation, responsible for coordinating and allocating teams.
*   **Revealing the tragedy:** Her story and the pain of losing Enoch is one of the most tragic in Lobotomy Corporation. It shows how the "Seed of Light" project broke even the most innocent lives.
*   **A symbol of hope and grief:** Her character embodies grief, pessimism born of loss and, ultimately, acceptance and moving forward. In Library of Ruina she becomes a symbol of hope, striving to give meaning to the sacrifice of the past.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
*   **Name:** Tiphereth A, formerly Lisa. In Korean — 티페리트 (Ti-pe-ri-teu). The Sephirah Tiphereth corresponds to the sephirah Tiferet (Beauty, Harmony) on the Kabbalistic Tree of Life.
*   **Key quote:** *"Trying to differentiate us is pointless. ... Don't disappoint me."*
*   **Symbolism:** Her color is gold (yellow), symbolizing harmony and beauty, but in her case it is a dull, faded gold reflecting loss and pessimism. She represents the aspect of Tiphereth associated with "Judgment" and "Strength".
*   **Interesting facts:**
    *   Height: 159 cm.
    *   Birthday: July 8.
    *   After Core Suppression, Tiphereth permanently changes to a robotic appearance, and the Central Command Team becomes immune to Meltdowns.
    *   In Library of Ruina she still reacts sharply when Roland treats her like a child — for example, hitting him for mocking her height and manner of speech.

Pec.Name: From the transcripts: the first meeting
Pec.Desc:
> **Tiphereth (Lisa)** — Hi, Manager. I'm Tiphereth!
> **Tiphereth (Enoch)** — Nice to meet you. I'm Tiphereth too.
*[Option 1: Are you twins?]*
> **Tiphereth (Lisa)** — Of course, isn't it obvious? We're twins.
> **Tiphereth (Enoch)** — But if you're asking whether we're biological twins, then no.
> **Tiphereth (Lisa)** — In other words, trying to tell us apart is pointless.
*[Option 2: You have the same name?]*
> **Tiphereth (Lisa)** — Of course, isn't it obvious? We're twins.
> **Tiphereth (Enoch)** — But if you're asking whether we're biological twins, then no.
> **Tiphereth (Lisa)** — In other words, trying to tell us apart is pointless.
> **Tiphereth (Lisa)** — We lead the Central Command Team. It's a huge department, so there are two of us to handle everything.
> **Tiphereth (Enoch)** — Like two peas in a pod.
> **Tiphereth (Lisa)** — Isn't that great?
> **Tiphereth (Lisa)** — Since you've survived long enough to meet us, I won't have to bore us both with the basics, like what Abnormalities are and how to manage them, right?

nodes.Name: Netzach — Safety Team
nodes.Desc:
**Netzach** is a Sephirah, head of the **"Safety Team"**. In a past life — **Giovanni**.

- **Full name:** Netzach
- **Human name:** Giovanni
- **Alias / Code:** N
- **Universe:** Project Moon (Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina)
- **Role:** One of the Sephirot, head of the Safety Team in Lobotomy Corporation. In Library of Ruina — the appointed librarian of the Floor of Art.
- **Status:** A former human named Giovanni. After dying as a result of the Cogito experiments, he was reborn in the mechanical body of a Sephirah.
- **Occupation:** AI administrator (Sephirah) of the Safety Team.
- **Goal:** Originally — to help realize the "Seed of Light" project. After his rebirth — an attempt to escape suffering and responsibility through inaction and drug addiction. His true virtue is "The Courage to Carry on with Life".
- **Game appearances:** Lobotomy Corporation (as the Sephirah Netzach), Library of Ruina (as the librarian of the Floor of Art).
- **Layer:** Upper Layer (Asiyah).
- **Sephirah:** Netzach (Hebrew for "Victory", "Eternity"), the 7th Sephirah on the Kabbalistic Tree of Life.
- **Symbolic virtue:** The courage to carry on with life.
- **Symbolism:** In Kabbalah, Netzach embodies victory, eternity, endurance and steadfastness. In the context of the character, this reflects his journey from utter despair to accepting life despite all the suffering.

Pec.Name: Department and Core Suppression
Pec.Desc: Netzach's Core Suppression: HP and SP recovery are disabled. Lesson: find the courage to go on living.

Pec.Name: In Library of Ruina
Pec.Desc: Patron of the **Floor of Art**. Realization theme: *The fearlessness to keep living*.

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
#### Lobotomy Corporation (the Sephirah Netzach)
- **General appearance:** A man with long green hair hanging loose and messy, and narrow brown eyes.
- **Features:** His face always wears a tired, bored expression. One of his eyebrows has a characteristic notch / bald spot.
- **Clothing:** Wears a black business suit with a carelessly loosened green tie. His shirt is not fully buttoned and untucked, reflecting his slovenly nature.
- **Accessories:** A green armband on his arm with the first letter of his name, "N".
- **Posture:** Almost always keeps his hands in his pockets.
- **Color:** His symbolic color is emerald green.
- **Text box color:** Green.

#### Library of Ruina (Librarian)
- **General appearance:** Long green hair with ragged asymmetrical bangs, gathered into a messy bun.
- **Clothing:** Wears a long green cloak-cape (the color of his floor), left open. Underneath — an untucked white button-up shirt and a loosened tie with a glossy green brooch. Black straight trousers and simple white sneakers.
- **Facial expression:** Still keeps his tired expression.

Pec.Name: Personality and character
Pec.Desc:
- **Main traits:** Apathetic, pessimistic, lazy, but deep down empathetic and vulnerable. Suffers from severe survivor's guilt and post-traumatic stress.
- **Personality:** Netzach deeply hates his job at the Corporation and considers it meaningless. He feels helpless and responsible for his employees' deaths. To cope with reality, he neglects his duties and abuses alcohol (beer) and Enkephalin, using them as a way to escape reality.
- **Beliefs:** Sees no point in his work and believes the employees' lives are worthless in the company's endless cycle. Sincerely wishes to be decommissioned or replaced. Despite his outward indifference, he takes every death in his department deeply to heart and is one of the most empathetic Sephirot.
- **How others see him:** The other Sephirot (especially Tiphereth) consider him lazy and a slacker. Angela thinks little of him, but believes he "plays his role well" and sees no point in replacing him.

Pec.Name: Speech patterns and manner of communication
Pec.Desc:
- **Style:** Direct, honest to the point of rudeness. Not inclined to flattery or diplomacy. Speaks quietly, with notes of apathy and sarcasm. Prefers to talk about his own mistakes and shortcomings rather than praise the manager.
- **Typical lines:**
  - *"That's right, I'll be level with you. I don't like my job."*
  - *"Um... you know my name, right?"*
  - *"I tried so hard building a sand castle, and it got swept away by the waves..."*
- **Tone:** Tired, monotonous, with a touch of indifference. Notes of bitterness and sarcasm sometimes slip through.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
- **Origin:** Born in K Corp's Nest, he grew up in an orphanage and never knew his parents. At the orphanage he lived safely, but his life was monotonous and purposeless — "day after day he merely breathed meaninglessly, lived meaninglessly".
- **Joining the project:** Upon learning that Carmen and her team were looking for like-minded people, Giovanni joined the laboratory. He was driven by a desire to find meaning in life and to help the "Seed of Light" project.
- **The Cogito experiments:** Giovanni volunteered for the experiments with the substance "Cogito" in a desperate attempt to save Carmen. These experiments led to his death, after which his consciousness was transferred into the mechanical body of a Sephirah.
- **Role in Lobotomy Corporation:** As the Sephirah Netzach, he was appointed head of the Safety Team. Unable to cope with the constant deaths of employees across the endless cycles, he sank into apathy, abusing Enkephalin and alcohol.
- **Core Suppression:** During Netzach's Core Suppression, his department's regeneration functions are disabled and the interface is distorted. Overcoming this trial symbolizes how Netzach gains "the will to stand tall" and recognizes the value of life despite all the horrors of the facility.
- **After the events of Lobotomy Corporation:** After the Corporation's destruction and Angela's theft of "the Light", Netzach realized he actually has no desire to die. He became the appointed librarian of the Floor of Art in the Library.

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
- **Carmen (C):** Giovanni was deeply in love with Carmen and considered her a friend. It was his devotion to her and his desire to help that brought him to the laboratory and later led him to take part in the Cogito experiments.
- **Ayin (A):** Giovanni disliked Ayin, as he himself mentions in his memories after Core Suppression: "If Carmen were alive, she'd laugh, since A and I couldn't stand each other."
- **Manager X:** Netzach treats the Manager with a mix of apathy and blunt honesty. He prefers a direct approach and talks about his own shortcomings rather than praising X. Sometimes he asks for "forbidden" things, such as installing a beer vending machine to "improve employee welfare".
- **Hod:** Netzach and Hod have a calm, almost friendly relationship. It is Hod who prescribes and dispenses Netzach's Enkephalin. Netzach often asks her for help to get more Enkephalin or to sort out problems with Angela.
- **Tiphereth:** Their relationship is tense due to opposite views on duty and work. Tiphereth is diligent and strict, and often scolds Netzach for laziness and late reports.
- **Angela:** Netzach dislikes Angela, considering her a cold administrator who ensures his suffering. He often provokes her, hoping she will decide to scrap him. Angela, in turn, considers Netzach useless, but admits that he "plays his role" and doesn't require replacement.
- **Roland:** In Library of Ruina, Netzach and Roland strike up a peculiar friendship. They drink beer together, and Netzach gradually "warms up" to Roland over the course of the story.

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
- **Head of the Safety Team:** In Lobotomy Corporation, Netzach's missions focus on minimizing harm to employees: preventing panic and deaths.
- **An empathetic mirror:** Netzach reflects how an endless cycle of suffering and death affects the psyche of even the most resilient. He shows that indifference and apathy are a defensive reaction to unbearable pain.
- **Core Suppression:** His Core Suppression is not just a battle but a symbol of his inner struggle and of gaining "the will to stand tall". It is an important step in accepting reality and carrying on with life.
- **Librarian of the Floor of Art:** In Library of Ruina his floor is dedicated to collecting books about art, which reflects the sensitive, creative nature hidden behind his outward apathy.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
- **Human name:** Giovanni.
- **Sephirah name:** Netzach, which means "victory" or "eternity" in Hebrew.
- **Height:** 175 cm.
- **Birthday:** August 27.
- **Voice acting:** Lee Chang-min (이창민) (Korean voice).
- **Interesting facts:**
  - Netzach is the only Sephirah who openly asks the Manager to install a beer vending machine to "improve employee welfare".
  - In Library of Ruina his Floor of Art is "decorated" with beer cans and art supplies.
  - After the events of Lobotomy Corporation he no longer uses Enkephalin, but still struggles with alcoholism.
  - He is often called a "green marimo ball" (绿藻球) and a "hopeless drunk" (没药救的酒鬼).
  - The symbol of the Floor of Art is the Holy Grail and an Eye, which also resembles a rose.

Pec.Name: From the transcripts: the first meeting
Pec.Desc:
> *(It seems Netzach hasn't shown up yet)*
> **Netzach, Sephirah of the Safety Team** — Ugh, why is the meeting room so far away…
> **Netzach** — Uh, you already know my name, right?
> **Netzach** — ……
> **Netzach** — Got anything else you want to say?
*[Option 1: I do.]*
> **Netzach** — Then let's talk later? I'm not really in the mood to chat right now.
*[Option 2: No.]*
> **Netzach** — Good. See you later.
> **Netzach** — ....
> **Netzach** — You look a little stunned.
> **Netzach** — You know, this isn't the kind of place where people go on about what an honor it is to have you as manager and all that.
> **Netzach** — Not that you were expecting it, probably.
> **Netzach** — That's right, I'll be straight with you. I don't like my job.

nodes.Name: Hod — Training Team
nodes.Desc:
**Hod** is a Sephirah, head of the **"Training Team"**. In a past life — **Michelle**.

- **Full name:** Hod
- **Real name:** Michelle
- **Alias / Code:** None, but as a Sephirah she is known as **Hod**.
- **Universe:** Project Moon (includes the games Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina)
- **Role:** In the past — a junior researcher in Carmen's laboratory. In Lobotomy Corporation — the Sephirah of the **Training Team**. In Library of Ruina — the appointed librarian of the **Floor of Literature**.
- **Status:** Took her own life out of guilt after betraying the laboratory. Her brain was used to create the Sephirah Hod.
- **Occupation:** Research scientist (in the past). As a Sephirah — head of the department responsible for employee training and psychological support. As a librarian — runs the Floor of Literature.
- **Goal:** In life — to take part in the "Seed of Light" project. As a Sephirah — to atone for her betrayal by helping others and to become "a good person".
- **Game appearances:** Lobotomy Corporation (as the Sephirah Hod), Library of Ruina (as the librarian of the Floor of Literature).

Pec.Name: Department and Core Suppression
Pec.Desc: Hod's Core Suppression: employees grow weaker. Lesson: stop pretending to be good and actually become better.

Pec.Name: In Library of Ruina
Pec.Desc: Patron of the **Floor of Literature**. Realization theme: *The hope to become someone better*.

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
*   **General appearance (human, Michelle):** A young girl described as "timid and innocent". She had bright reddish-brown shoulder-length hair adorned with two hairpins and a distinctive cowlick (a stray strand sticking up). She wore a simple lab coat over a beige dress that seemed a little too big for her, emphasizing her youth and fragility.
*   **General appearance (the Sephirah Hod):** Looks like a young woman with long brown hair adorned with two hairpins and her ever-present cowlick. She has blue eyes. She wears a formal black business suit with an orange tie and an orange armband with the letter "H" — the first letter of her name. The main color associated with her in the interface is **orange**.
*   **Robotic form (after Core Suppression):** Once the cognition filter is removed, her true form is a bronze box-shaped body with a single glowing digital eye in the center of its lower part. Her name "HOD" is displayed on the upper part of the body, and an antenna resembling her cowlick sticks out of the top. The body has mechanical arms and legs.
*   **General appearance (Librarian):** In Library of Ruina her hair becomes shorter, shoulder-length, with a more pronounced reddish-brown tint. She wears the patron librarian uniform: a loose-fitting brown coat over a white blouse with puffed sleeves and a knee-length black skirt. The look is completed by a gray tie knotted into a bow with a glossy orange brooch (her Floor's color), strapped ballet flats and white knee socks. In battle, like the other librarians, she uses a black baton.
*   **Height:** 166 cm
*   **Birthday:** September 10

Pec.Name: Personality and character
Pec.Desc:
*   **Main traits:** Extremely kind and compassionate, yet timid and insecure. Her main trait is a drive to help others that often borders on the intrusive. She is deeply troubled by her past and looks for ways to atone.
*   **Personality:** As Michelle, she was "timid and innocent". Having become Hod, she kept her gentleness but added to it a tireless desire to be useful. She is always friendly and cheerful, sincerely cares about the employees and offers them psychological counseling. However, those around her often perceive this care as insincere or intrusive, which hurts her deeply. She is in acute need of others' approval and recognition.
*   **Beliefs:** Hod believes that by helping others and showing kindness, she can atone for her past guilt and become "a good person". She is obsessed with the idea of "being good", but her methods don't always produce the desired result. After her Core Suppression she admits that her kindness was selfish and hypocritical, but decides to keep helping, even if it benefits only herself.
*   **Inner conflict:** Hod's main conflict is her struggle with guilt. She wants to be good, but her past betrayal and her inability to truly help the employees make her doubt herself. She hears voices accusing her of lying and selfishness, which eventually leads to her breakdown.
*   **How others see her:** Many employees and Sephirot see her as weak and annoying. Angela harshly criticizes her programs, considering them useless. Gebura considers her weak but treats her more gently than others. The only one who truly understands her drive toward kindness is Chesed, who is described as "the only other Sephirah who was truly kind".

Pec.Name: Speech patterns and manner of communication
Pec.Desc:
- **Style:** Gentle and unsure, full of apologies and doubts. She often uses filler words and phrases expressing uncertainty ("umm", "probably", "maybe"). Her speech reflects her timid nature and her constant desire to please.
- **Typical lines:**
  - *"Umm, I'm not very skillful in many areas, but I'll try not to be a hindrance, at least...!"*
  - *"Well, I am not perfect, but I won't disappoint you!"*
  - *"I just... want to be a good person."*
  - *"Why does everyone hate me?"*
  - *"I realized that I was being a hypocrite and that I was only being compassionate to my employees for my own sake."*
- **Tone:** Gentle, apologetic, sometimes plaintive. Her voice often carries anxiety and a desire for approval. After her Core Suppression her tone becomes firmer and more self-aware, but keeps its warmth.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
*   **Origin:** Michelle was born and raised in a **"Nest"** (a prosperous area of the City).
*   **Joining the project:** Inspired by Carmen's ideas, she wanted to join the research laboratory in the Outskirts while still very young. Ayin doubted her abilities and warned that their experiments went against the will of "the Head" and were extremely dangerous. But Carmen saw talent and courage in Michelle, persuaded Ayin, and Michelle became the laboratory's youngest member.
*   **Work on the "Seed of Light" and betrayal:** After Carmen's death and a series of tragic events (the deaths of Elijah, Gabriel, Giovanni and Enoch), and after witnessing inhumane experiments, Michelle's psyche could not take it. Gripped by fear and horror, she fled the laboratory and reported all the ongoing experiments to "the Head", becoming a spy. She hoped this intervention would stop the nightmare, but did not expect "the Head" to carry out a bloody massacre in the laboratory, wiping out almost all her colleagues.
*   **Death:** Learning of the consequences of her betrayal and feeling guilty for her colleagues' deaths, Michelle took her own life.
*   **Transformation into a Sephirah:** Ayin, having read about her death in the newspaper, wonders whether he could forgive her if they met in hell. Afterwards her brain was used to create a Sephirah named "Hod", and she was appointed head of the Training Team.
*   **Life as Hod:** In the company, Hod sees her new role as a chance for redemption. She develops and introduces psychological support programs for the employees. However, her good intentions backfire: the employees don't want her help, and one of the program's participants, Tiffany, becomes addicted to Enkephalin and dies. Angela criticizes Hod and orders the program shut down. Crushed by guilt and failure, Hod falls into despair and abuses Enkephalin, which leads to her meltdown and her Core Suppression.
*   **After the events of Lobotomy Corporation:** After the completion of the "Seed of Light" project and Angela's rebellion, Hod becomes one of the librarians in the Library, running the Floor of Literature.

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
*   **Ayin (A):** Ayin initially doubted Michelle, considering her too weak for such dangerous work, but gave in to Carmen's persuasion. After her betrayal and death he feels not hatred toward her but rather regret, hoping she did not die as horribly as rumored and pondering the possibility of forgiveness.
*   **Carmen (C):** Carmen was the only one who truly believed in Michelle. She saw talent and courage in her, defended her before Ayin and supported her. After Carmen's death, Michelle lost that support, which ultimately led to tragedy.
*   **Angela:** Her relationship with Angela is tense. Angela is strict with Hod, harshly criticizes her programs and sees no value in them. Hod is afraid of Angela and gets flustered when Angela expresses displeasure.
*   **Netzach:** Hod and Netzach have a calmer relationship. It was Hod who prescribed his Enkephalin, and he often turns to her for help, for example to avoid trouble with Angela. Hod tries to help him, yet doubts whether she is doing the right thing.
*   **Gebura:** Hod is kind to Gebura and tries to suggest "more sensible" ways of reducing staff losses instead of direct attacks. Gebura treats her more gently than others, but deep down considers her weak.
*   **Yesod:** Yesod disagrees with Hod's methods of dealing with hardship. He believes she seeks comfort for herself and turns a blind eye to reality.
*   **Roland:** In Library of Ruina, Roland notes that the Floor of Literature has a calm and cozy atmosphere, and that Hod herself is just as quiet and peaceful.

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
*   **Tragic catalyst:** Michelle's betrayal was one of the causes that led to the destruction of the old laboratory and accelerated the chain of events that resulted in Ayin founding Lobotomy Corporation.
*   **The embodiment of guilt and redemption:** Hod's story explores guilt, forgiveness and the complexity of "being a good person". Her storyline shows that good intentions don't always lead to good outcomes, and that the pursuit of redemption can be selfish.
*   **A mirror for the player:** In Lobotomy Corporation, her constant doubts and questions about why she is hated despite all her efforts make the player reflect on the nature of altruism and how goodness is perceived.
*   **Librarian of Literature:** In Library of Ruina, Hod continues her role as the "caring" character, creating an atmosphere of comfort and support on her floor, which reflects her unchanging desire to help others, albeit in a new form.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
*   **Name:** **Michelle**. In Korean (the game's original language) — 미셸 (mi-syel). The Sephirah name is **Hod** (Hebrew הוד), which corresponds to the sephirah **Hod** (Glory, Splendor) on the Kabbalistic Tree of Life. In Kabbalah, Hod represents intellect, learning, communication and structured thinking, which perfectly fits her role as head of the Training Team.
*   **Key quote:** *"I just... want to be a good person."*
*   **Symbolism:** Her Sephirah, Hod, symbolizes splendor, glory and intellect. Her color is orange. Her constant need for approval and fear of rejection contrast with the "splendor" of her Kabbalistic name, underlining her inner conflict.
*   **Voice acting:** Kim Ha-ru (김하루) (Korean version).
*   **Interesting facts:**
    *   Michelle was the youngest member of Carmen's laboratory.
    *   Hod is the only Sephirah who, from the very first meeting, sincerely worries about what the Manager thinks of her.
    *   Her psychological support program led to the death of the employee Tiffany due to Enkephalin addiction.
    *   In Library of Ruina she is the only one of the lower-floor librarians who empathizes with Angela's motives, understanding her desire to break out of the endless cycle and gain freedom.

Pec.Name: From the transcripts: the first meeting
Pec.Desc:
> **Hod, Sephirah of the Training Team** — Oh, umm… Hi…
> **Hod** — .....
> **Hod** — You're not angry, are you...?
> **Hod** — I'm Hod. I head the Training Team.
> **Hod** — We… um… what we do… You know, accidents happen in the company.
> **Hod** — But Lady Angela said about half of them could easily be avoided if the employees showed… more initiative.
> **Hod** — So the Training Team gives employees work manuals and provides the necessary training. Well, to try to reduce the number of accidents. We also help employees transferred to other departments adjust to their new place…
> **Hod** — Umm, I'm not very skillful at many things, but I'll try not to be a hindrance, at least…!
> **Hod** — Actually, I'm testing a new program for the employees right now…
> **Hod** — I don't know if it'll work, but… umm…
> **Hod** — Oh, you want to know more about the program?
> **Hod** — As you know, the company is… pretty demanding. Even with regular checkups, many of our employees keep losing their minds…
> **Hod** — I know exactly what that's like.
> **Hod** — I mean, I don't interact with Abnormalities directly, but I know what it's like to lose yourself…

nodes.Name: Yesod — Information Team
nodes.Desc:
**Yesod** is a Sephirah, head of the **"Information Team"**. In a past life — **Gabriel**.

- **Full name:** Gabriel
- **Alias / Code:** Yesod
- **Universe:** Project Moon (includes the games Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina)
- **Role:** In his human life — a researcher who took part in the "Seed of Light" project and the experiments with the substance "Cogito". In Lobotomy Corporation — the Sephirah Yesod, head of the Information Team. In Library of Ruina — the appointed librarian of the Floor of Technological Sciences.
- **Status:** Died as a result of a mental breakdown caused by his attempts to suppress his emotions and by the trauma of a colleague's death. His brain was used to create the Sephirah Yesod.
- **Occupation:** Scientist, researcher, organizer of experiments.
- **Goal:** To ensure safety and order in the laboratory and prevent further deaths. Later, as a Sephirah — to manage the collection and processing of information in the Corporation.
- **Game appearances:** Lobotomy Corporation (as the Sephirah Yesod), Library of Ruina (as the librarian of the Floor of Technological Sciences).

Pec.Name: Department and Core Suppression
Pec.Desc: Yesod's Core Suppression: the image distorts and information becomes unreliable. Lesson: reason without feeling is blindness too.

Pec.Name: In Library of Ruina
Pec.Desc: Patron of the **Floor of Technological Sciences**. Realization theme: *The need to think rationally*.

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
*   **General appearance (human, Gabriel):** A man who wore a lab coat, a black turtleneck and black gloves. After Elijah's death he began wearing more clothing to cover his body completely, leaving only his face exposed. This was caused by his growing paranoia and a desire to protect himself from possible chemical contamination.
*   **General appearance (the Sephirah Yesod):** Looks like a man with short purple hair and brown pupilless eyes, half-covered by a dark shadow. Dressed in a formal dark business suit with a turtleneck, a purple tie and an armband with the first letter of his name, "Y". His associated text box color is mauve. Height — 171 cm.
*   **General appearance (Librarian in Library of Ruina):** Wears a long knee-length purple coat over a white shirt with a dark purple tie and a shiny purple brooch, as well as straight purple trousers with a white belt and black shoes. His appearance is exceptionally neat and orderly.

Pec.Name: Personality and character
Pec.Desc:
*   **Main traits:** Strict, unfeeling, logical, pedantic, perfectionist.
*   **Personality:**
    *   **Gabriel (human):** Initially serious and rational, he tried not to show emotion. Elijah's death was a deep trauma for him, but he suppressed his feelings and focused with redoubled effort on rules and procedures to prevent the tragedy from repeating. His drive for absolute rationality grew into a pathological obsession, which led to a mental breakdown and self-destruction.
    *   **Yesod (Sephirah):** Kept his strictness, rationality and pedantry. He considers emotions and trust in employees unnecessary and even harmful, since they can lead to mistakes and to others using him for their own ends. He takes nicknames like "emotionless" or "cold-blooded" as compliments. He has a complex that makes him always fully clothed, showing no skin except his face. This is tied to a hallucination that haunted him while he was still alive.
*   **Beliefs:** Firmly believes that strict adherence to rules and protocols is the only way to minimize casualties and ensure efficient operation. He considers emotions and personal relationships a hindrance.
*   **How others see him:** Among the employees he is known by the nickname "Viper" for his strict, sharp and "venomous" character. Yesod himself is proud of this nickname, believing it accurately reflects his approach to work.

Pec.Name: Speech patterns and manner of communication
Pec.Desc:
- **Style:** Direct, formal, devoid of emotion. His speech often consists of clear instructions, critical remarks and logical justifications. He isn't inclined to small talk and gets straight to the point.
- **Typical lines:**
  - *"Manager, you are the head of this corporation. You are supposed to set an example for others, but that outfit would warrant at least 10 penalty points in our department."*
  - *"I am Yesod, the Sephirah of the Information Team."*
  - *"Accidents happen. I want them to understand that it's not a big fuss. Dwelling on it only encourages them to cry more, and it will eventually tire them out."*
  - *"A single mistake from us could cause a disaster. I am sure you'd understand the gravity of my work."*
- **Tone:** Cold, strict, detached, with a hint of irritation or impatience when someone fails to meet his standards.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
*   **Origin:** There is no exact information about his origins. He was one of the first members to join the "Seed of Light" project under Carmen and Ayin.
*   **Work on the project:** Gabriel was responsible for organizing and preparing the experiments with the substance "Cogito". He developed procedures and rules for the laboratories and supply storerooms.
*   **Trauma and downfall:** The death of his colleague Elijah (who later became the Sephirah Malkuth) as a result of a "Cogito" experiment was a turning point for Gabriel. Outwardly he stayed calm and rationally attributed what happened to Elijah's own breach of safety rules. Inside, however, he was deeply shaken. He began enforcing the rules with pathological strictness and wearing more clothing to protect himself from possible contamination, and eventually became obsessed with order and safety.
*   **Madness and death:** His condition worsened. He stopped expressing emotions, could not bear even the sight of small patches of his own skin and began scratching himself viciously. Other staff noticed his abnormal behavior and, suspecting an infection, forcibly sent him for a medical examination. The doctors found no physical abnormalities, but his mental disorder progressed. He kept harming himself, which ultimately led to his death.
*   **Transformation into a Sephirah:** After his death, Gabriel's brain was extracted and placed in a mechanical body, creating the AI Sephirah Yesod, head of the Information Team.
*   **After the events of Lobotomy Corporation:** After the events of the first game, Yesod becomes the appointed librarian of the Floor of Technological Sciences in the Library (Library of Ruina).

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
*   **Ayin (A):** Was his supervisor. Gabriel reported the incident with Elijah to him, proposing new safety measures. As Yesod, he followed Ayin's "scenario", but during his Core Suppression his suppressed hatred and despair caused by Ayin's actions burst out.
*   **Carmen (C):** Worked under her in the laboratory. Her death also affected his mental state.
*   **Elijah (Malkuth):** Her death caused his deep psychological trauma and subsequent madness. He suppressed his feelings for her, which ultimately destroyed him.
*   **Netzach:** Their interactions mostly consist of Yesod's strict remarks about rule violations (for example, sharing resources between departments). Netzach, in turn, calls him "the Viper".
*   **Hod:** She tries to show sympathy to the employees after an incident with casualties, but Yesod rejects her offer to comfort them, considering it useless sentimentality.
*   **Roland (in Library of Ruina):** Their relationship is tense. Yesod disapproves of Roland's cynical attitude and his subservience to Angela, considering him "a typical City resident suffering from the disease of the mind". At the same time, Roland notes that, compared to the past, Yesod has "a milder temper".

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
*   **Symbolism and themes:** Gabriel's story is a tragedy about how trying to suppress human emotions and replace them with "absolute rationality" leads to self-destruction. His obsession with rules and safety was an attempt to cope with guilt and helplessness after his colleague's death.
*   **Game mechanics:** As head of the Information Team, Yesod gives the player efficiency-related missions and provides upgrades that let you see employees' HP (health) and SP (sanity), as well as the damage they deal. His Core Suppression is unique in that it doesn't change the game mechanics but distorts the player's visual perception with various filters (blur, negative, offset), reflecting his own distorted perception of reality.
*   **Library of Ruina:** On the Floor of Technological Sciences, Yesod continues his role as a pedantic and demanding supervisor. His dialogues with Roland reveal his past, his guilt over the atrocities committed in L Corp, and his rejection of Angela's methods, which he sees as a repetition of his own mistakes.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
*   **Name:** Gabriel. In Hebrew, the name Gavriel (Gabriel) means "God is my strength". The Sephirah name is Yesod (יסוד), Hebrew for "Foundation". On the Kabbalistic Tree of Life, Yesod is the ninth sephirah, symbolizing connection, foundation and a channel for transmitting divine energy.
*   **Key quote:** "He tried to stick to his principles. He tried to keep his judgment objective. But excessive rationality ended up playing a cruel trick on him. His true dream of preventing the death of any one of us did not come true." — Ayin about Gabriel.
*   **Symbolism:** His Sephirah, Yesod, embodies "Foundation". His obsession with rules, order and control reflects this role as the foundation on which all of the company's work must be built. His attributes (fully covering clothes, formal suit) underline his drive for impenetrability and control. The Floor of Technological Sciences in Library of Ruina, whose symbol is a gear and a moon, continues the theme of knowledge, structure and order.
*   **Voice acting:** None in the game.
*   **Interesting facts:**
    *   Yesod is the shortest of the male Sephirot. His height is 171 cm.
    *   He has a phobia of exposing his skin, a consequence of the mental disorder that began in his human life.
    *   In Library of Ruina he can often be seen straightening Roland's clothes, which underlines his perfectionism and attention to detail.
    *   He got his nickname "Viper" for his sharp tongue and strict, "venomous" character.
    *   His Core Suppression in Lobotomy Corporation is the only one that affects not the gameplay but the player's visual perception, symbolizing his distorted perception of reality.
    *   In Library of Ruina he is one of the few characters who openly criticize Angela's methods, seeing in them a reflection of his own past mistakes.
    *   In an early version of the game, Yesod's height in Library of Ruina was listed as 166 cm, but it was later changed to 171 cm.
    *   Yesod, like the other Sephirot, was created using a dead person's brain, which makes him a kind of "cyborg" or "uploaded consciousness".
    *   In the Korean version of the game his name is written as 예소드 (Ye-so-deu).

Pec.Name: From the transcripts: the first meeting
Pec.Desc:
> **Yesod, Sephirah of the Information Team** — ...
> **Yesod** — Manager, you are the head of this corporation. You are supposed to set an example for others, but in our department that appearance would warrant at least 10 penalty points.
> **Yesod** — The Manager should be no exception. However, the rules state that a Sephirah has no right to impose penalty points on the Manager, so this time I am forced to turn a blind eye.
> **Yesod** — I am Yesod, the Sephirah of the Information Team.
> **Yesod** — The Information Team is responsible for processing and archiving all of our company's data. New information is generated every day, and we must ensure its accuracy, so we always need to be extremely focused and concentrated on our work.
> **Yesod** — You could compare it to a huge library.
> **Yesod** — A single grain of misinformation can lead to an uncontrollable catastrophe.
> **Yesod** — I'm sure you understand the gravity of my work.
> **Yesod** — Every particle of information you read contains the despair and hopelessness of our employees.
> **Yesod** — Please do not take this information lightly.
> **Yesod** — ....
> **Yesod** — It seems my clothing has caught your interest.
> **Yesod** — I cannot stand it when any part of my body is left exposed.
> **Yesod** — I don't remember exactly when I started feeling this way...

nodes.Name: Malkuth — Control Team
nodes.Desc:
**Malkuth** is a Sephirah, head of the **"Control Team"**. In a past life — **Elijah**.

- **Full name:** Malkuth
- **Real name (before becoming a Sephirah):** Elijah
- **Code:** None, but her initial is "M"
- **Universe:** Project Moon (includes the games Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina)
- **Role:** Control Team Sephirah; later — Patron Librarian of the Floor of History in *Library of Ruina*
- **Status:** A former Lobotomy Corporation employee who died as a result of the Cogito experiments. Her mind was transferred into the mechanical body of a Sephirah.
- **Occupation:** Sephirah (AI administrator), formerly a researcher on the "Seed of Light" project
- **Goal:** To work hard to prove her worth and earn recognition, especially from Ayin / Manager X. As a Sephirah — to keep the Control Team running. In *Library of Ruina* — she strives to record the entire history of the City.
- **Game appearances:** Lobotomy Corporation (as the Control Team Sephirah), Library of Ruina (as the Librarian of the Floor of History)

Pec.Name: Department and Core Suppression
Pec.Desc: Malkuth's Core Suppression: department management malfunctions — commands and buttons get mixed up. Lesson: to admit one's mistakes rather than hiding them behind busyness.

Pec.Name: In Library of Ruina
Pec.Desc: Patron of the **Floor of History**. Realization theme: *The will to stand firm*.

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
*   **General appearance (Sephirah, as seen through the Cognition Filter):** Appears as a young woman with short-cut hair that fades smoothly from brown to yellow (ombré). Her eyes are brown and pupilless, with a dark shadow covering half of each eye. She wears a red headband.
*   **Clothing (Sephirah):** Wears a formal business suit, a white shirt, a red tie and an armband with her initial "M". She constantly carries an almost full notebook and a pen.
*   **Robotic form (after Core Suppression):** Once the cognition filter is turned off, her true form becomes visible: a brown rectangular casing serving as her body, with a single glowing yellow digital eye in the center. Her name is written on the front of the casing. She keeps her red headband and still carries her notebook and pen.
*   **Associated colors:** Pale yellow (used in text boxes), as well as red and pale yellow as the department's colors.
*   **Height:** 163 cm.
*   **Birthday:** March 24.

Pec.Name: Personality and character
Pec.Desc:
*   **Main traits:** Cheerful, full of enthusiasm and very hard-working, yet impatient, clumsy and somewhat slow. At first glance she seems the friendliest and most optimistic member of the team.
*   **Drive for recognition:** Her main motivator is a desperate desire to prove her competence and be noticed, especially by Ayin (and later by Manager X). This drive is rooted in her human life, where she felt overlooked and unappreciated.
*   **Attitude toward subordinates:** Malkuth makes the same incredibly high and often unreasonable demands of her employees as she does of herself. She shows little sympathy and is merciless toward those who show weakness or vulnerability, considering them unfit for her department and deserving of "dismissal" (which, in the company's reality, means death). This reflects her own fear of not being good enough.
*   **Duality:** Her outward cheerfulness contrasts with deep inner insecurity, cruelty toward the weak and a feeling of losing control over her own mind and body. She feels isolated, as if "drifting across an ocean without a map".
*   **After Core Suppression:** She becomes noticeably calmer, more peaceable and more honest. She begins to show sympathy for dying employees and to speak more openly about her feelings of isolation and being lost.

Pec.Name: Speech patterns and manner of communication
Pec.Desc:
- **Style:** Energetic, cheerful, sometimes hurried and apologetic about her clumsiness. She talks a lot and can jump from topic to topic. In moments of stress or when discussing "weak" employees, her tone becomes cold and merciless. After her Core Suppression her speech becomes calmer and more thoughtful.
- **Typical lines:**
  - *"Where are my manners! My name is Malkuth! I am in charge of the Control Team!"*
  - *"I will try my best to help you to enhance the performance of this facility."*
  - *"My department has no need for weaklings. Weakness is something that must be weeded out."*
  - *"Haven't you seen how weak employees end up in this place?"*
- **Tone:** Upbeat and full of enthusiasm, with notes of self-deprecation over her clumsiness. When discussing work standards she becomes harsh and uncompromising. After the truth is revealed — weary and seeking support.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
*   **Human life (Elijah):** Before becoming the Sephirah Malkuth, she was a "Seed of Light" project member named Elijah. She was born and raised in a "Nest" (a prosperous area of the City), lived a completely ordinary life, had no special talents and came from a family of modest means.
*   **Joining the project:** Elijah was one of the first to join Ayin's team when the Cogito experiments began. Unlike other City residents, who saw the world "in shades of gray", she wanted to see the "different colors" of life and believed in Carmen's mission.
*   **Work and death:** In the laboratory she was a slow but very passionate worker. Her impatient nature and fear of forgetting everything led her to start a notebook for writing down all her tasks. Desperately wanting Ayin's recognition but constantly feeling ignored by him, she eventually took part in the Cogito experiments on her own initiative and died of an overdose.
*   **Transformation into a Sephirah:** After her death, her mind was transferred into a Sephirah body, and her human appearance was recreated with the cognition filter. As Malkuth, her worst traits — fanatical diligence and cruelty toward the weak — only intensified.
*   **Core Suppression:** During her Core Suppression, Malkuth confronts her inner demons and realizes that her true worth lies not in recognition from others, but in following her own convictions.
*   **After Lobotomy Corporation:** In *Library of Ruina* she becomes the Librarian of the Floor of History, where her drive to record and structure everything finds a new use — she dreams of recording the entire history of the City, "filling in all the gaps".

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
*   **Ayin (A) / Manager X:** The central figure in her life. As a human she desperately sought his approval but felt only neglect. As a Sephirah she keeps this strong attachment to Manager X, but can also show aggression, unleashing on him all the pain built up over years of being ignored.
*   **Angela:** Malkuth interacts with Angela as a superior AI and the Manager's secretary. In one scene Angela interrupts their conversation to send Malkuth off on an errand, underlining her subordinate position.
*   **Other Sephirot:** Malkuth, like the other Upper Layer (Asiyah) Sephirot, is at the very start of the hierarchy. Her stories mention that she would like to get together with the other Upper Layer Sephirot.

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
*   **First introduction to the world:** Malkuth is the first Sephirah the player meets, on Day 1. She sets the tone for the whole game, introducing the basic management mechanics and, more importantly, demonstrating the true, frightening nature of Lobotomy Corporation when she coldly dooms a panicking employee to death.
*   **Running the foundation:** Her department, the Control Team, is the foundation of the whole corporation. She is responsible for basic training and the first missions, without which further progress is impossible.
*   **Introduction to the "Seed of Light" cycle:** Her Core Suppression is the first step toward completing the "Seed of Light" project. After it, the "Seed of Light" grows to 10%.
*   **Symbolism:** Malkuth embodies the danger of a blind drive for recognition, workaholism and perfectionism taken to absurd extremes. She shows how good intentions (wanting to be a good worker) can become distorted into cruelty.
*   **Librarian of History:** In *Library of Ruina* she plays a key role, keeping and recording the knowledge gained in battles, which ties directly to her past habit of keeping records.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
*   **Name:** Malkuth (Hebrew: מלכות) means "Kingdom". It is the tenth and lowest sephirah on the Tree of Life in Kabbalah, symbolizing the physical world and perception. This perfectly fits her role as the first, most "down-to-earth" department the player encounters.
*   **Key quote:** *"I will try my best to help you to enhance the performance of this facility."*
*   **Voice acting:**
  - Korean version: Lee Areum (이아름)
  - Japanese version: Natsumi Takamori (高森 奈津美)
*   **Interesting facts:**
  - Her human name, Elijah, is a reference to the biblical prophet Elijah.
  - She often compares her failures to cooking blunders, for example saying she "ruined a dish by adding salt instead of sugar".
  - Her reward for Core Suppression is increased movement speed for all employees and immunity to Qliphoth Meltdowns.
  - In *Library of Ruina* her look changes slightly: her hair grows longer, and new details appear on her suit.
  - In *Limbus Company*, one of Faust's Identity variants (Regret Faust) is connected to Malkuth, and her E.G.O is called "Regret", a direct reference to her feelings.

Pec.Name: From the transcripts: the first meeting
Pec.Desc:
> *(Quick footsteps can be heard)*
> **Malkuth, Sephirah of the Control Team** — Manager, Manager! I made it just in time, right? The time is… Only a minute late. Well, I think that still counts as "on time"! Congratulations on taking up your post at Lobotomy Corporation, Manager!
> *(Angela speaks over the loudspeaker)*
> **Angela, AI assistant** — I don't wish to interrupt this touching moment, Malkuth, but at Lobotomy Corp. every second counts. Please keep it brief and go prepare for the meeting.
> **Malkuth** — Hmm… Looks like Miss Angela is in a bad mood today… But hey, at least the other Sephirot are looking forward to meeting you! Well, maybe… not all of them…
> **Malkuth** — Oh, where are my manners! My name is Malkuth! I head the Control Team! Since we're the Control Team, we carry a huge responsibility! I'll do my very best to help you by improving the core functions of this facility, Manager!
> **Malkuth** — I'm sure you're a little nervous right now. It takes some time to get used to how things work here. I know from experience! But don't worry, I'll definitely help you!
> **Malkuth** — I'm, um, not exactly the best at everything. I used to be a problem Sephirah, you know. I'd sew buttons on the wrong way or add salt to food instead of sugar… But you'll manage anyway! Just like I did — I'm sure you'll do great, Manager!
> **Malkuth** — I'll give you an easy task since it's your first day! Good luck!
> *(A knock at the door)*
> **Employee** — I can't take it anymore! Manager, you're in there, aren't you? I'm begging you, let me out of here. I know you can do it, you're the manager! You're not like the rest of us! You can do anything!
> **Employee** — Why do you want to quit? Don't you like working in the Control Team? Every day here is a joy for me!
> **Employee** — It's so horrible, I can't take it anymore! I'll go insane! Nothing here is normal!
> **Malkuth** — Do you really think you can't handle it?

nodes.Name: Tiphereth B — Enoch
nodes.Desc:
The other half of Tiphereth. - **Full name:** Tiphereth B, formerly Enoch
- **Alias / Code:** Tiphereth
- **Universe:** Project Moon (includes the games Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina)
- **Role:** One of the two Sephirot running the Central Command Team in Lobotomy Corporation.
- **Status:** In his human life — an orphan named Enoch. He died during the "Cogito" experiments and was turned into the Sephirah Tiphereth B. He was permanently shut down at Tiphereth A's request.
- **Occupation:** In Lobotomy Corporation — a Sephirah, head of the Central Command Team (together with Tiphereth A).
- **Goal:** In his human life — he wished for death and wanted to help the project so as to "live in a happy world next time". As a Sephirah — to support the Manager and his "sister" Tiphereth A.
- **Game appearances:** Lobotomy Corporation (as Tiphereth B).

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
*   **General appearance (Tiphereth B):** A young boy with short golden hair and blue pupilless eyes. He has a childlike appearance.
*   **Clothing (Tiphereth B):** A white shirt, a brown cape (poncho) and a skirt. A ribbon tied in a bow around his neck. Dark brown stockings and boots.
*   **Color scheme:** The main colors are brown, white and gold (yellow).
*   **Robotic form (after Core Suppression):** A white square body with gold (yellow) elements and a blue digital eye in the center.

Pec.Name: Personality and character
Pec.Desc:
*   **Main traits:** Gentle, kind, optimistic, thoughtful and prone to existential reflection.
*   **Personality:** Tiphereth B is the complete opposite of his "sister". He is quiet, polite and optimistic. He always tries to support the Manager and the other Sephirot instead of criticizing them. He believes things can change for the better. He is also very thoughtful and often sinks into reflection on the nature of himself and the other Sephirot, which irritates Angela.
*   **Attitude toward others:** He is kind to everyone, including Manager X, although X's silence makes it hard to keep up a conversation. He is also very attached to Tiphereth A and depends on her, despite her constant reproaches. He sees her not only as a colleague but as the person closest to him.
*   **Beliefs:** In his human life he believed his sacrifice would help create a better world. He considered dying so as to "live in a happy world next time" to be his purpose.
*   **How others see him:** The other Sephirot probably see him as a sweet but naive child. Tiphereth A constantly scolds him for being too soft, but actually values his kindness.

Pec.Name: Speech patterns and manner of communication
Pec.Desc:
- **Style:** Gentle, polite, encouraging. Unlike the sharp and blunt Tiphereth A, Tiphereth B speaks more smoothly and diplomatically, often softening her harsh remarks. His speech reveals his thoughtful nature.
- **Typical lines (Lobotomy Corporation):**
  - *"Greetings, I'm Tiphereth too."*
  - *"We're not twins biologically."*
  - *"I like the middle Sephirot because they make me laugh."*
  - *"Be more understanding."* — addressing Tiphereth A.
- **Tone:** Calm, warm, with notes of sadness and thoughtfulness. His voice sounds softer and quieter than his sister's.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
*   **Origin:** Before the events of Lobotomy Corporation, Tiphereth B was a boy named Enoch. He lived with Lisa and their unnamed mother in a town in the Outskirts.
*   **Joining the project:** Like Lisa, he was found by Kali and taken in at Carmen's laboratory. Unlike Lisa, Enoch embraced the project enthusiastically. Seeing other children in the Outskirts die every day, he felt that he and Lisa were lucky just to be alive, and wanted to help the project so as to "live in a happy world next time".
*   **Taking part in the experiments and death:** Despite Carmen's repeated attempts to dissuade him, Enoch volunteered for the experiments, driven by a death wish and a desire to help. He died during one of the "Cogito" experiments.
*   **Transformation into a Sephirah:** His remains were used to create the Sephirah Tiphereth B.
*   **Life as Tiphereth B:** His design as a Sephirah was flawed. He had to be replaced regularly, and each new version lost all its memories. He began to wonder about the nature of his existence, asking whether he was even himself. Tiphereth A, seeing his suffering and unable to bear it any longer, eventually asked for him to be shut down permanently. After his shutdown, Tiphereth A was left alone, taking over the entire management of the Central Command Team.

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
*   **Tiphereth A / Lisa:** His "sister" and the person closest to him. He depends on her and tries to soften her harshness. Despite her constant reproaches, he knows she cares about him and is deeply attached to her himself. He sees her as his support and protection.
*   **Manager X:** Tiphereth B tries to be friendly and supportive toward X, although X's silence makes it difficult.
*   **Angela:** Angela is cold toward Tiphereth B and dislikes his existential musings, as they distract him from work.
*   **Carmen:** Enoch was probably grateful to Carmen for her care, but his own death wish outweighed all her warnings. He respected her project and wanted to contribute to it.
*   **Other Sephirot:** He is fond of the "middle" Sephirot, especially Gebura and Chesed, because they make him laugh.

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
*   **Running the Central Command Team:** Together with Tiphereth A, he leads the largest department in Lobotomy Corporation.
*   **A tragic victim:** His story is that of an innocent victim whose life was broken by the "Seed of Light" project. His death became the catalyst for Lisa's (Tiphereth A's) pessimism and pain.
*   **A symbol of hope and emptiness:** He symbolizes pure, naive hope that was shattered by reality. His constant resets and memory loss also symbolize the emptiness and loss of identity that the Lobotomy Corporation system brings.
*   **Influence on Tiphereth A:** It was his death and subsequent suffering that shaped Tiphereth A's character and became her main motivation.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
*   **Name:** Tiphereth B, formerly Enoch. In Korean — 티페리트 (Ti-pe-ri-teu). The Sephirah Tiphereth corresponds to the sephirah Tiferet (Beauty, Harmony) on the Kabbalistic Tree of Life.
*   **Key quote:** *"We're not twins biologically."*
*   **Symbolism:** His color is gold (yellow), symbolizing harmony and beauty, but in his case it is a pale, fading light reflecting his imperfection and tragic fate. He represents the aspect of Tiphereth associated with "Mercy" and "Compassion".
*   **Interesting facts:**
    *   Height: 159 cm.
    *   He is one of the few characters who directly states that he and Tiphereth A are not biological twins.
    *   His shutdown is one of the saddest moments in the story, underlining the inhumanity of the system.
    *   Unlike the other Sephirot, he had no pronounced rebellion or "meltdown". His tragedy was quiet and gradual.

nodes.Name: Carmen (C)
nodes.Desc:
- **Full name:** Carmen
- **Alias / Code:** C
- **Universe:** Project Moon (includes the games Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina, Limbus Company)
- **Role:** A key character and the catalyst of almost every event. Founder and lead researcher of the "Seed of Light" project. Discoverer of the substance "Cogito". After her death she became an entity known as "the Voice of Distortion", whose influence and philosophy play a central role in the stories of Library of Ruina and Limbus Company.
- **Status:** Committed suicide, but her consciousness continued to exist within "the Light" as "the Voice of Distortion".
- **Occupation:** Scientist, researcher. Founder of the laboratory that later became L Corp (Lobotomy Corporation).
- **Goal:** To cure humanity of the "disease of the mind" through the "Seed of Light" project, so as to return the "faded light" to people's souls.
- **Game appearances:** Does not appear directly in Lobotomy Corporation's gameplay. Mentioned in memories and story cutscenes. In Library of Ruina and Limbus Company her voice and influence play an important role as "the Voice of Distortion".

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
*   **General appearance:** A young woman with fair skin, long dark blonde hair and crimson eyes.
*   **Hairstyle:** Her hair is gathered into a high ponytail. She uses a hair clip shaped like a red teddy bear.
*   **Clothing:** An olive-green shirt with a slanted front and four buttons, under a white lab coat. A black miniskirt (or dark shorts) and shoes matching the shirt. Sometimes depicted holding a folder of documents.

Pec.Name: Personality and character
Pec.Desc:
*   **Main traits:** An exceptionally enthusiastic, altruistic and ambitious person whose actions were guided by a sincere desire to change the City for the better.
*   **Charisma:** She had incredible charisma and insight, and easily won people's trust. Her fiery speeches made people follow her, preferring to work in her small company over working for the "Wings".
*   **Beliefs:** She valued the process over the result and could not accept "collateral damage" or sacrifices for the sake of reaching a goal. She cared deeply for others, often at her own expense.
*   **How others see her:** The image of Carmen depends heavily on who is telling the story. While some (such as Ayin) saw her as a source of hope and nobility, others (such as Roland) noted that her influence had a sinister tinge and that her convictions resembled the speeches of a cult leader.

Pec.Name: Speech patterns and manner of communication
Pec.Desc:
- **Style:** Inspired, charismatic and persuasive. Her speech has an almost hypnotic effect; she knows how to reach people and appeal to their deepest feelings. As "the Voice of Distortion", her style becomes enveloping and seductive.
- **Typical lines:**
  - *"No matter what I may become, please finish what I started."*
  - *"I'll confess. I'm much weaker than everyone thinks. In front of others, I confidently say that everything will be fine, follow me, but..."*
- **Tone:** Warm, encouraging and full of hope in life. As "the Voice" — soft, beckoning and insinuating, with a slight echo, lulling and nudging people to accept their true desires.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
*   **Origin:** She was born and raised in a "Nest" (a prosperous area of the City), but unlike most residents, she was deeply troubled by the suffering and injustice in the world.
*   **Founding the laboratory:** Inspired by the idea of changing the world, she founded a research laboratory in the "Outskirts". Her charisma and sincerity drew many talented people to the team, including the future founders of L Corp.
*   **The "Seed of Light" project:** The project's goal was to return the "faded light" to people's souls in order to change a City mired in corporate wars and human suffering. The substance "Cogito" was meant to be the key to this.
*   **Tragic turning point:** After the death of a child named Enoch, who died during one of the experiments, Carmen fell into a deep depression. Accusations from another team member, Lisa, were the last straw, and she lost faith in herself and her project.
*   **Suicide and its aftermath:** Carmen tried to take her own life in order to stop the production of "Cogito". However, her colleagues A and B did not let her die completely, placing her body in a cryogenic chamber. Her nervous system was extracted and placed in a tank to continue producing "Cogito".
*   **Creating Angela:** Based on Carmen's personality and memories, Ayin and Benjamin created the AI Angela, but the cold, calculating creation that resulted was nothing like its prototype.

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
*   **A (Ayin):** Carmen was Ayin's colleague and mentor. Despite their common goal, their methods differed: unlike Ayin, Carmen could not sacrifice people. She trusted him and believed that he would be the one to finish the work she had begun.
*   **B (Benjamin):** Like A, he was one of Carmen's closest associates and took part in preserving her body after her suicide attempt.
*   **Daniel:** A talented employee from a "Nest", personally invited into the corporation by Carmen.
*   **Other employees:** Thanks to her charisma, Carmen enjoyed the absolute trust and loyalty of everyone who worked in her laboratory.

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
*   **Catalyst of events:** It was her ideas and actions that led to the creation of Lobotomy Corporation and set off the chain of events underlying the stories of Lobotomy Corporation and Library of Ruina.
*   **"The Voice of Distortion":** After the events of Lobotomy Corporation, Carmen, restored by the power of "the Light", became a formless entity known as "the Voice of Distortion". She is the mysterious voice that pushes City residents to become Distortions or to attain E.G.O, embodying their strongest and most hidden desires.
*   **The nature of her influence:** Her actions after death are ambiguous. She claims she only wants to help people be true to themselves and love themselves, yet her methods often lead to suffering and uncontrolled violence, which makes her philosophy dangerous.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
*   **Key quote:** *"No matter what I may become, please finish what I started."*
*   **Origin of the name:** In English-language sources her name is Carmen. In Korean (the game's original language) her name is written as 카르멘 (ka-reu-men).

Pec.Name: ＋ Appearance in Limbus Company (Canto X)
Pec.Desc: Carmen's Voice speaks to the Sinners in Grand Magasin Sisyphe; she distorted the Giant Jeanne and preaches the liberation of people from society's expectations; Carmen's influence gave rise to the **Nothingness (Les Néants)** faction. Meursault resists her because of his history with his mother. At the end, Carmen advises Dante to **visit the Library**.

nodes.Name: Ayin (A) / X
nodes.Desc:
- **Full name:** Ayin
- **Alias / Code:** A, X
- **Universe:** Project Moon (Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina)
- **Role:** Founder and leader of the "Seed of Light" project after Carmen's death, one of the instigators of the Smoke War, founder of Lobotomy Corporation, creator of Angela (together with Benjamin).
- **Status:** Vanished into "the Light" after the project's completion. His further fate is unknown; presumably his consciousness merged with "the Light".
- **Occupation:** Researcher, scientist, project leader.
- **Goal:** To complete the "Seed of Light" project begun by Carmen and cure the City's residents of the "disease of the mind".
- **Game appearances:** Does not appear directly in gameplay, but is the central figure of the story. Mentioned in memories, cutscenes and through his "scenario". In Library of Ruina he appears in Angela's flashbacks.

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
*   **General appearance:** A man with short black hair, pale skin and yellow eyes.
*   **Clothing:** An almost entirely black outfit (shirt, trousers, belt, shoes) under a white lab coat. Often depicted with his hands in his lab coat pockets.
*   **Build:** Tall, with a lean build.
*   **Height:** 176 cm.

Pec.Name: Personality and character
Pec.Desc:
*   **Main traits:** Pragmatic, focused on results rather than process. He had a strong will and was capable of enduring sacrifice and hardship to achieve his goal.
*   **Determination:** He was ready to do anything, including manipulation and sacrifice, to complete the "Seed of Light" project.
*   **Attitude toward people:** Unlike Carmen, he did not concern himself with "collateral losses" and could sacrifice people for the sake of success. After Carmen's death he became more withdrawn and skeptical and stopped trusting people, which led to the creation of Angela (together with Benjamin).
*   **Charisma:** Despite his reserve, he had charisma and the ability to listen, which let him gather people around him.
*   **Inner conflict:** Despite his coldness, deep down he felt regret and pain over what he had done. In his final speech he admits that he would change everything if he could, but considers his actions a "necessary evil" that no one else could have committed.

Pec.Name: Speech patterns and manner of communication
Pec.Desc:
- **Style:** Neutral and results-focused. His lines are short, direct and emotionless. Ayin isn't inclined to long explanations or small talk, preferring to get straight to the point.
- **Typical lines:**
  - *"A machine must behave as a machine."*
  - *"If these wrong doings can finally cut this vicious cycle once and for all... I will gladly take this burden upon myself."*
- **Tone:** Serious, detached and pragmatic. Emotion rarely shows in his voice, except in rare moments of deep regret, as in his final monologue.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
*   **Beginning of his work:** He was one of the first to join Carmen in her laboratory in the Outskirts to work on the "Seed of Light" project. He could have worked for any "Wing", but chose to follow Carmen.
*   **Carmen's death:** After the death of the child Enoch during an experiment, Carmen fell into depression and tried to take her own life. Ayin found her in the bathroom and, to preserve her, extracted her brain and nervous system, placing them in a tank to continue producing "Cogito".
*   **Leading the project:** After Carmen's death, Ayin took over the project. He became one of the instigators of the Smoke War in order to destroy the old "Wing L" and take its place, founding Lobotomy Corporation.
*   **Creating Angela:** Having lost his trust in people, Ayin, together with Benjamin, created the AI Angela to help run the project. However, he treated her coldly and dismissively, which later led to tragic consequences.
*   **Creating the Sephirot:** Ayin turned his dead colleagues and enemies into Sephirot — AIs that run the Corporation's departments — in order to use their knowledge and experience.
*   **The scenario and memory erasure:** Realizing he could not complete the project personally, Ayin created a "scenario" — a detailed 50-day plan of action. He erased his own memory and became "Manager X" in order to walk this path anew, unburdened by the past.
*   **Completing the project:** As "X", he successfully led the corporation through all its trials, suppressed the Sephirot's rebellion and on day 50 completed the "Seed of Light" project, releasing "the Light" into the City.

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
*   **Carmen:** His mentor, colleague and close friend. Ayin was deeply devoted to Carmen and her ideals. It was he who found her after her suicide attempt and took action to preserve her essence.
*   **Angela:** His creation (made together with Benjamin), whom he treated with disdain, considering her merely a machine. This attitude became the source of Angela's deep resentment and hatred, which led to the events of Library of Ruina.
*   **Benjamin:** A close associate. Together with Ayin he stood at the origins of the project and took part in creating Angela.
*   **Binah:** A former Arbiter of "the Head", sent to destroy the laboratory. Ayin captured her, tortured her for information and then turned her into the Sephirah Binah.
*   **Kali (Gebura):** A legendary mercenary who worked for the laboratory. She died defending it from Binah and was later revived by Ayin as the Sephirah Gebura.

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
*   **The central figure of the story:** All the events of Lobotomy Corporation are a direct consequence of Ayin's plan, his "scenario". He is the key figure around whom the game's entire story revolves.
*   **Creator of the Corporation and the Sephirot:** He founded Lobotomy Corporation and created all the Sephirot, defining the structure of the gameplay and the game's world.
*   **Completing the "Seed of Light" project:** His actions led to the project's successful completion and the spread of "the Light", the key event linking Lobotomy Corporation to Library of Ruina.
*   **Influence on later events:** His cruel treatment of Angela led directly to her rebellion and the events of Library of Ruina.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
*   **Key quote:** *"If these wrong doings can finally cut this vicious cycle once and for all... I will gladly take this burden upon myself."*
*   **Origin of the name:** Ayin (אין) means "nothing" or "emptiness" in Hebrew. In Kabbalah, Ayin is the state of non-being that precedes creation. The creators deliberately gave the character this name to emphasize his philosophical role.

nodes.Name: Benjamin (B)
nodes.Desc:
- **Full name:** Benjamin
- **Alias / Code:** B
- **Universe:** Project Moon (includes the games Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina, Limbus Company)
- **Role:** A researcher in Carmen's laboratory, Ayin's comrade, one of Angela's creators. Later — the Sephirah Hokma, head of the Record Team. In Library of Ruina — the appointed librarian of the Floor of Religion.
