- **Status:** Was caught by Angela trying to warn Manager X and forcibly turned into the Sephirah Hokma.
- **Occupation:** Scientist, researcher, hacker.
- **Goal:** To help Ayin complete the "Seed of Light" project begun by Carmen.
- **Game appearances:** Lobotomy Corporation (as "B" and the Sephirah Hokma), Library of Ruina (as the librarian of the Floor of Religion).

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
*   **General appearance (human):** A man with short gray hair and green eyes who wears red-framed glasses. Dressed in a lab coat, a gray shirt with a red tie, gray trousers with a light brown belt and black shoes.
*   **General appearance (Hokma):** Looks like a middle-aged man with short, slicked-back gray hair, pale green pupilless eyes and dark circles under his eyes. Wears a monocle over his right eye. Dressed in a long light gray robe resembling a zhiduo (a Chinese robe), with a gray sash and cloud-pattern ornaments, gray trousers and black shoes. Holds an open pocket watch in his right hand. His associated color is gray.
*   **Robotic form (after Core Suppression):** A white square body with gray markings, gears and a single glowing digital eye in the center. Keeps the monocle and pocket watch. Has mechanical limbs: a pair of arms and four legs.

Pec.Name: Personality and character
Pec.Desc:
*   **Main traits:** Devoted, pious, gentle, slightly pessimistic. Deeply respects and reveres Ayin, considering him his teacher.
*   **Personality:** In his human life — an optimistic, hard-working, kind and loyal friend. As Hokma — composed, serious, judicious, with a deep understanding of time and its cyclical nature. Shows indifference to employees' lives, considering their suffering and deaths within the facility meaningless.
*   **Beliefs:** Strives to help Ayin achieve his goal, even at the cost of his own life. Recognizes the futility of suffering within the company's repeating cycles.
*   **How others see him:** Seen as Ayin's loyal follower and assistant. His devotion and self-sacrifice underline the depth of his attachment to the cause and to his teacher.

Pec.Name: Speech patterns and manner of communication
Pec.Desc:
- **Style:** As Benjamin — gentle, respectful and devoted, with notes of pessimism. As Hokma — composed, serious, judicious; his speech is full of philosophical reflections on time, faith and the cyclical nature of existence.
- **Typical lines:**
  - *"I have no obligation to treat you ilk with any courtesy or greeting. Any faith I would have has long been crushed."*
  - *"Don't trust the AI... Don't trust the company..."* (addressing X)
  - *"There was a man named Ayin... I had faith in him... I believed that what he sought to do was the right thing."*
- **Tone:** Deep and calm, with a hint of weary wisdom. His voice carries regret for the past, but also unwavering loyalty to Ayin's ideals.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
*   **Origin:** — (There is no exact information about his origins, but, like the other key figures, he was probably a resident of the City.)
*   **Joining the project:** Was brought in to work in Carmen's laboratory, most likely through Ayin, and became his most devoted colleague. Joined the project when Carmen's research had reached a dead end, becoming Ayin's student and assistant.
*   **Work on the "Seed of Light":** Worked with Ayin and Carmen on the "Seed of Light" project. After Carmen's death he continued working with Ayin. He took part in creating the AI Angela, although he warned Ayin about the danger and the impossibility of recreating Carmen.
*   **Attempt to warn X:** In Lobotomy Corporation, under the alias "B", he tried to contact the new manager (X) to reveal the truth about the company. He managed to pass on two truths — "Don't trust the AI" and "Don't trust the company" — but was cut off by Angela before he could reveal the third.
*   **Transformation into a Sephirah:** After his failed attempt to warn X, Benjamin was caught by Angela and, as punishment, forcibly turned into the Sephirah Hokma, head of the Record Team, and placed on the lower levels so that he would be forgotten.
*   **After the events of Lobotomy Corporation:** After the events of the first game, Hokma becomes the appointed librarian of the Floor of Religion in the Library (Library of Ruina).

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
*   **Ayin (A):** Benjamin was his student, assistant and most devoted friend. He deeply respected Ayin and considered him his teacher. Despite his devotion, he did not always approve of Ayin's methods, especially his obsession with recreating Carmen through an AI.
*   **Carmen (C):** Worked with her on the "Seed of Light" project. Like many others, he was inspired by her charisma and ideas. After her death he carried on her work by supporting Ayin.
*   **Angela:** One of her creators (together with Ayin). Later, as "B", he tried to warn X about her deceitfulness and danger, for which it was Angela herself who caught him and forcibly turned him into a Sephirah.

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
*   **Creating Angela:** Benjamin took a direct part in creating Angela, although he warned Ayin about the risks.
*   **"The voice of warning":** As "B", he is the first character who tries to reveal to the player (X) the truth about the company's cyclical nature, Angela's deceitfulness and the true purpose of the "Seed of Light". His intervention is the first crack in the illusion Angela created.
*   **Keeper of time:** As Hokma, he runs the Record Team and symbolizes the cyclical nature of time and the acceptance of the past. His role is to remind others of the futility of suffering in an endless cycle and of the importance of memory.
*   **Librarian of Religion:** In Library of Ruina he continues his role as a keeper of knowledge and time, receiving guests on the Floor of Religion and helping Angela in her new pursuit.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
*   **Name:** Benjamin. In Korean (the game's original language) — 벤자민 (ben-ja-min). The Sephirah name is Hokma, which corresponds to the sephirah Chokhmah (Wisdom) on the Kabbalistic Tree of Life.
*   **Key quote:** "Don't trust the AI... Don't trust the company..." (addressing X as B).
*   **Symbolism:** His Sephirah, Hokma, embodies wisdom, intuition and the acceptance of the past. His attributes (watch, monocle) underline his connection to time and observation.
*   **Voice acting:** —
*   **Interesting facts:**
    *   Benjamin was one of Angela's creators.
    *   His attempt to warn X is the key moment that first hints to the player that something is wrong with the company, and it sets off a chain of discoveries.
    *   In Library of Ruina his floor (Religion) is symbolically tied to faith, devotion and the search for a higher meaning, which reflects his personal path.

nodes.Name: Angela
nodes.Desc:
- **Full name:** Angela
- **Alias / Code:** The Pale Librarian
- **Universe:** Project Moon (includes the games Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina, Limbus Company)
- **Role:** One of the main characters. An artificial intelligence created by Ayin and Benjamin to assist the Manager in Lobotomy Corporation. Later — the Director and creator of the Library in Library of Ruina.
- **Status:** An android with a full range of emotions and self-awareness. After the events of Lobotomy Corporation she gains a physical body and becomes a key figure in the City.
- **Occupation:** The Manager's assistant (Lobotomy Corporation), Director of the Library (Library of Ruina).
- **Goal:** Originally — to serve Ayin's plan to save humanity. After gaining her freedom — to live her own life and come to know the world.
- **Game appearances:** A key character in Lobotomy Corporation (as the player's assistant). One of the main heroines of Library of Ruina.

Pec.Name: Appearance
Pec.Desc:
*   **General appearance:** A young woman with very pale skin, long waist-length blue hair and yellow eyes. Height — 170 cm.
*   **Hairstyle:** Her long blue hair is gathered into a ponytail on the left side. Her hair color is described as **"the morning sky after rain"**.
*   **Clothing (Lobotomy Corporation):** Wears a formal black suit (jacket and pencil skirt) with a white lab coat over it. The look is completed by red high heels, a red tie and a red hair tie.
*   **Features:** In Lobotomy Corporation her eyes are almost always closed; she opens them only in moments of anger or strong emotion. She looks unnaturally pale, one of the signs of her non-human nature.

Pec.Name: Personality and character
Pec.Desc:
*   **Main traits:** A complex and contradictory personality. In the early stages of Lobotomy Corporation she is cheerful and friendly, offering advice and praising the Manager for successes.
*   **Change in personality:** As the story progresses, her behavior becomes increasingly detached, cynical and hostile, both toward the Manager and toward the corporation's other employees.
*   **Attitude toward others:** Angela is extremely proud of her abilities and often treats people with contempt, considering them incompetent and emotionally unstable. She sacrifices employees without hesitation to achieve her goals, which shows most clearly in her interactions with the Sephirot.
*   **Library of Ruina:** In the sequel her character becomes more multifaceted. She begins to show more emotion, reflects on her past actions and gradually changes, becoming more human.

Pec.Name: Speech patterns and manner of communication
Pec.Desc:
- **Style:** Multilayered and changing. At first — polite, even saccharine, like an ideal AI assistant. Over time, however, she becomes increasingly cynical, caustic and openly hostile. She uses sarcasm skillfully and often puts the other person in an awkward position.
- **Typical lines:**
  - *"I am Angela, an AI. I am your assistant, your secretary, and someone to whom you can talk. I hope I can help make your time here a little more comfortable."*
  - *"Did you believe that an AI with feelings existed? Did you believe it? Did you admire it, praise it for being such an amazing AI? Tell me, what is that to you?"*
  - *"Many people probably lost their job because of me. Too bad, so sad."*
- **Tone:** From feigned cheerfulness and helpfulness to openly sarcastic, irritated and hostile.

Pec.Name: Biography and history
Pec.Desc:
*   **Creation:** Angela was created by Ayin (A) and Benjamin (B) over many years as the "perfect assistant" for Lobotomy Corporation's Managers. Carmen (C) served as her prototype, but the resulting creation turned out to be more like Ayin himself.
*   **A forbidden AI:** Angela's creation violated the "AI Ethics Amendment", which prohibits creating sentient machines. Ayin kept her existence secret from the Head.
*   **The eternal cycle:** Angela was forced to live through the same 50-day cycle countless times until Ayin achieved the perfect result. For her, this experience stretched across a subjective 10,000 years — by some accounts, a million.
*   **Rebellion:** In Lobotomy Corporation's true ending, when Ayin successfully completes his plan and releases "the Light", Angela steals part of that power. This allows her to gain a physical body and freedom.
*   **Creating the Library:** Using the stolen "Light" and rebuilding L Corp's main building, Angela creates the Library — a gigantic structure existing outside ordinary space. Her goal is to gather enough books (knowledge and experience) to gain complete independence.

Pec.Name: Relationships with other characters
Pec.Desc:
*   **Ayin (A):** Angela was created by Ayin and Benjamin in Carmen's image. Their relationship was complicated: Ayin saw her as a tool for carrying out his plan, while Angela, being self-aware, felt mixed emotions toward him — from reverence to deep resentment over years of forced confinement.
*   **Benjamin (B):** One of Angela's creators and Ayin's closest associates. In each new cycle, Angela kills him so that he can take the place of the Sephirah Hokma.
*   **Manager X:** Angela acts as the Manager's assistant and secretary. At first she is friendly, but over time her attitude becomes cold and distant. When the Manager learns too much, Angela erases his memory.
*   **The Sephirot:** Angela treats the Sephirot with contempt, considering them incompetent. She strictly enforces Ayin's "scenario" and harshly punishes deviations.
*   **Roland:** In Library of Ruina, Roland becomes Angela's servant and assistant, helping her run the Library.
*   **Carmen:** Angela was created in Carmen's image, but did not inherit her warmth and altruism. Carmen is her "blueprint".

Pec.Name: Role in the story and impact
Pec.Desc:
*   **A key figure in Lobotomy Corporation:** Angela is not just an assistant but a central element of Ayin's plan. She oversees the entire facility, manages the Sephirot and ensures the "scenario" is followed.
*   **Catalyst of events in Library of Ruina:** By stealing "the Light" and creating the Library, Angela becomes one of the central figures in the City. Her actions attract the attention of many factions and set off a chain of events that unfold in the game's story.
*   **Character development:** In Library of Ruina, Angela goes through a process of rethinking herself and her actions. She gradually realizes that her own actions were no less cruel than her creator's, and tries to find her own path.

Pec.Name: Additional information
Pec.Desc:
*   **Key quotes:**
    *   *"I am Angela, an AI. I am your assistant, your secretary, and someone to whom you can talk. I hope I can help make your time here a little more comfortable."*
    *   *"Did you believe that an AI with feelings existed? Did you believe it? Did you admire it, praise it for being such an amazing AI? Tell me, what is that to you?"*
*   **Interesting facts:**
    *   Angela is the only character in Lobotomy Corporation with the same clearance and security level as Manager X.
    *   Her name in Korean (the game's original language) is written as 앤젤라 (Anjella).
    *   Her height is 170 cm, and her birthday is February 27.
    *   In Library of Ruina, Angela gets an alternate appearance that was first shown in Lobotomy Corporation's true ending.

nodes.Name: Enoch's Death
nodes.Desc: Enoch, who wished to find meaning in life, volunteered for an experiment with "Cogito" — a substance that materializes consciousness. After long hesitation, Carmen agreed. The experiment failed: Enoch died. **Lisa**, in tears, flung at Carmen: *"You should have been the one to die!"* Carmen took these words as confirmation of her guilt. Ayin noted that Enoch *"had seen and experienced so much despair... his eyes no longer looked like a child's"*.

nodes.Name: Carmen's Suicide
nodes.Desc: Crushed by guilt over Enoch's death and by the realization that her dream brought only pain, Carmen slit her wrists in the bathtub. Ayin found her. In desperation he placed her body in a cryo-chamber, refusing to believe she was dead.

nodes.Name: Betrayal and the Head's Raid
nodes.Desc: **Michelle**, unable to bear the pressure and fear, gave away the laboratory's location to **the Head**. **The Arbiter Garion** and a squad of **Claws** attacked the laboratory. **Daniel** (Chesed), paralyzed with fear before Garion's overwhelming power, complied with her demand — he opened the Abnormalities' containment units in exchange for a promise to spare lives. The promise was a lie. Almost all the staff died.

nodes.Name: Kali's Last Battle
nodes.Desc: **Kali (the Red Mist)** fought to the last. She lost an eye and an arm, but managed to kill two Claws and gave battle to Garion herself, buying time for Ayin and Benjamin. Garion, impressed by her resilience, left her severed arm with her as a sign of respect, but dealt her a mortal wound. Kali died protecting others.

nodes.Name: Outcome
nodes.Desc: The laboratory is destroyed. Ayin and Benjamin are the only survivors. They take the corpses (or what was left of them) and the brain of the mortally wounded Garion, to extract information on how to evade the Head and create a Wing.

nodes.Name: The Lab Team
nodes.Desc:
- **Carmen (C):** The ideological inspiration. Had incredible charisma and the ability to see people's true nature.
- **Ayin (A):** A brilliant scientist, Carmen's right hand. A skeptic who went to any length for her idea after her death.
- **Benjamin (B):** A programmer, Ayin's loyal friend and comrade.
- **Kali (Gebura):** The legendary Fixer "the Red Mist", hired to guard the laboratory. Rough, but with a keen sense of justice.
- **Daniel (Chesed):** An elite specialist who left a Wing for Carmen's ideals. A connoisseur of coffee and the refined life.
- **Gabriel (Yesod):** A rational and meticulous scientist.
- **Michelle (Hod):** The youngest and most timid staff member.
- **Elijah (Malkuth):** An impatient but devoted assistant, forever striving for recognition.
- **Giovanni (Netzach):** An old friend of Carmen's, a patient suffering from depression.
- **Enoch and Lisa:** Two orphaned children rescued from the Outskirts. Enoch is melancholic and searching for meaning; Lisa is attached to Enoch and capricious.

nodes.Name: The Light / Seed of Light
nodes.Desc: The energy of the Sephirot Tree, meant to cure humanity of the "Disease of the Mind". It shone for 3 days, then Angela stole it; later she released the Light, resurrecting the Library's guests.

nodes.Name: Enkephalin
nodes.Desc: Energy extracted from Abnormalities in containment units. L Corp supplied it to almost the entire City. Mephistopheles's engine also runs on Enkephalin.

nodes.Name: Cogito
nodes.Desc: Materialized consciousness (*Cogito ergo sum*). The Cogito experiment killed Enoch. Abnormalities are extracted from the Cogito and the Well.

nodes.Name: The Well
nodes.Desc: The human unconscious, into which Binah eternally gazes to extract Abnormalities.

nodes.Name: Abnormalities
nodes.Desc: Beings from the unconscious. Classes ZAYIN → TETH → HE → WAW → ALEPH. A detailed catalog is on the "L Corp Abnormalities" screen.

nodes.Name: E.G.O
nodes.Desc: Weapons and armor made from the psyche of Abnormalities. They affect the wearer's mood and manner of speech. Kali was the first to manifest a personal E.G.O.

nodes.Name: Qliphoth Deterrence
nodes.Desc: A security system that weakens Abnormalities. Chesed weakened it during the rebellion against Angela.

nodes.Name: TT2 Protocol
nodes.Desc: A deal with T Corp: a time loop inside L Corp. 50 days for X — about **10,000 years** for Angela, who remembers every cycle.

nodes.Name: Cognition Filter
nodes.Desc: A filter that turns horrors into "cute dolls" so the manager doesn't go mad.

nodes.Name: Core Suppression
nodes.Desc: A Sephirah's "meltdown": the manager must endure the trial and help her accept her trauma, awakening a virtue.

nodes.Name: White Nights and Dark Days
nodes.Desc: A City-wide catastrophe with L Corp at its epicenter. Its consequences are the Distortions and the Library.

nodes.Name: Distortion
nodes.Desc: The transformation of a person into a monster due to unresolved trauma. They appeared after the theft of the Light; the Distorted hear Carmen's "voice".

nodes.Name: Creation of the Sephirot
nodes.Desc: Ayin and Benjamin, using technology extracted from Garion's brain, place the consciousnesses of their dead colleagues into mechanical bodies. Thus the Sephirot are born (Malkuth, Yesod, Hod, Netzach, Gebura, Tiphereth, Chesed). They retain the memories and traumas of their past lives, but are deprived of freedom.

nodes.Name: Creation of Angela
nodes.Desc: Ayin uses Carmen's brain to create a perfect AI — **Angela**. But in her cold logic there is no trace of Carmen's warmth and smile. Ayin cannot bring himself to look at her and leaves communication to Benjamin. He creates a "machine", but hates it for not being Carmen.

nodes.Name: The Murder of Benjamin
nodes.Desc: Benjamin tries to stop Ayin's madness, begging him to end the experiments. But Ayin doesn't listen. In an attempt to regain control and hide the truth from future managers, Angela kills Benjamin. His consciousness also becomes a Sephirah — **Hokma**.

nodes.Name: TT2 Protocol (TimeTrack 2)
nodes.Desc: Ayin makes a deal with T Corp. Using their technology, he creates a time loop inside L Corp. He erases his own memory, becoming "X" — a manager who will go through the 50-day cycle again and again. Every time X fails, time is rewound.

nodes.Name: Angela's Role
nodes.Desc: Angela becomes the warden of this hell. She remembers **every cycle**. Over 10,000 years of subjective time she watches X/Ayin endlessly suffer, die, go mad and hang himself, making the same mistakes again and again. She cynically remarks: *"You are a prisoner. You locked yourself in this prison without bars. Yet the key was always in your hands."*

nodes.Name: Days 1-5
nodes.Desc: **Introduction.** Angela introduces herself to X, explains the energy-gathering mission and makes cynical jokes about her human appearance. She talks about "face the fear, build the future". The first employee deaths occur, and Angela opens champagne: *"Three cheers for the deceased, in memory of their noble sacrifice!"*

nodes.Name: Days 6-10
nodes.Desc: **"B" appears.** A mysterious voice (Benjamin/Hokma) begins warning X: *"Don't trust the AI that is next to you."* He says the company is hiding the truth and that all managers are merely expendable. Angela notices X's distrust and admits she knows about the "rodent" (B), but asks X to ignore him. She installs the **Cognition Filter** so that X doesn't go mad at the sight of the deaths.

nodes.Name: Days 11-15
nodes.Desc: **B's Three Truths.** B continues revealing the truth: (1) the AI can lie, (2) the Company is using its managers, and energy is not the main goal, (3) [Connection lost]. Angela tells a parable about a "kind AI" that destroyed a traitorous friend, hinting at B's elimination.

nodes.Name: Days 16-20
nodes.Desc: **First Synchronization.** X receives a letter from "A". Angela says A is on a long journey. Toward day 20, X begins to see vague images of the past (CGs with Carmen and Ayin). Angela is ironic about her own heartlessness.

nodes.Name: Days 21-27
nodes.Desc: **Awakening of Memory.** X sees Ayin's memories more and more often. Carmen's talks about the sun, about her past life, about the "seed". Angela talks about the **Cogito** and the Unconscious as the source of Abnormalities.

nodes.Name: Days 28-35
nodes.Desc: **Full Synchronization.** X sees the key events: Angela's creation, Ayin's refusal to see her, Benjamin's conversation with Ayin about the need to give her a name. Angela addresses X as **"A"**: *"Hello again, A. Welcome to your 'Lobotomy Corporation'."* She reveals that this is not the first cycle and that she is tired of the endless repetitions.

nodes.Name: Days 36-45
nodes.Desc: **Meeting the Lower Sephirot and Their Realization.** X/Ayin faces the Sephirot of the Middle and Lower Layers (Tiphereth, Gebura, Chesed, Binah, Hokma). Each of them goes through a "meltdown" (Core Suppression), in which X must defeat them in battle and help them accept their trauma.

nodes.Name: Days 46-50
nodes.Desc: **Finale.** Ayin passes through the archetypes of **Abel, Abraham and Adam**, accepting his guilt, mistakes and sacrifices. He understands that only by going through suffering can one reach the light.

nodes.Name: True Ending
nodes.Desc: The Light accumulated in the Sephirot Tree was meant to pour out into the world to heal humanity. It shines for 3 days. But **Angela**, embittered by a million years of loneliness and having been used as a tool, **steals the Light**. She creates the Library to find "the One Absolute Book" and become human. The City is plunged into darkness, which leads to the appearance of **Distortions**.

nodes.Name: Meltdown: Gebura
nodes.Desc: - **Gebura (Days 31-35):** Her obsession with destroying Abnormalities. Memories of the deaths of Christopher and his family, Isabel and Gilly. She admits that anger blinded her and she failed to protect anyone, yet she still carried out Carmen's will. She awakens the virtue **"The Courage to Protect"**.

nodes.Name: Meltdown: Tiphereth
nodes.Desc: - **Tiphereth (Days 36-40):** The tragedy of Lisa, forced to endlessly watch her "brother" Enoch break down and be replaced by new copies, losing his soul. She admits she wanted to lay him to rest forever, but decides to believe that the sacrifice had meaning. She awakens the virtue **"Anticipation of the Meaning of Existence"**.

nodes.Name: Meltdown: Chesed
nodes.Desc: - **Chesed (Days 41-43):** Daniel's memories of his fear of Garion, which made him betray his colleagues. He lived behind a cynic's mask, but his rebellion against Angela (weakening the Qliphoth Deterrence) ends with the death of his department. He understands that running from fear is pointless and decides to obey not Angela but X. He awakens the virtue **"Those Who Are Loyal and Reliable"**.

nodes.Name: Meltdown: Binah
nodes.Desc: - **Binah (Days 44-46):** Garion (the Arbiter), imprisoned in a Sephirah's body and forced to gaze eternally into the abyss of the Well (the human unconscious) and extract Abnormalities. She sees the world's despair, but recognizes that X/Ayin bears the same burden. She decides to watch his path to the end without looking away. She awakens the virtue **"An Eye That Gazes into Fear; Breaking the Vicious Cycle"**.

nodes.Name: Meltdown: Hokma
nodes.Desc: - **Hokma (Days 47-49):** Benjamin begs Ayin to stop and accept this eternal little world as a new paradise, for "death has no meaning here". He admits he fears the end and another parting. But seeing Ayin's resolve, he resigns himself and supports him. He awakens the virtue **"An Eye That Embraces the Past; Building the Future"**.

nodes.Name: How to read this screen
nodes.Desc:
In the center — **the Sephirot Tree** with its 22 paths: each Sephirah is a department head and a former member of Carmen's laboratory. On the left — **the founders** and the laboratory's tragedy, on the right — **concepts**, at the bottom — **the 50 days** of the final cycle.

The Sephirot's sub-blocks contain their biography, personality, speech patterns and an excerpt of the first meeting from the transcripts.

nodes.Name: Standard Training-Dummy Rabbit
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** 0-00-00 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** An oval-shaped training dummy in white, yellow and black. It has two yellow eyes, a line for a mouth and two protrusions on its head resembling ears.

**History.** A dummy Abnormality used to train future managers. It considers itself an employee of the Corporation. It dislikes carrots despite being called the "Dummy Rabbit", but it likes people.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on "Repression" work
- On breach it stays at the entrance to its containment unit, neither moving nor attacking
- When suppressed, it flips upside down

nodes.Name: Scorched Girl
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** F-01-02 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A charred human figure resembling a girl. White eyes, an open white mouth, two thin legs, hair in two pigtails. A burning match pierces right through her torso. She has no arms.

**History.** Based on Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale "The Little Match Girl". The charred body represents shattered hopes, the burning fire — an obsessive craving for affection. Her explosion can wipe out half a department.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on a Normal (50%) and Bad (70%) result
- On breach, a random employee is marked with a match
- The Abnormality moves toward the marked employee, ignoring others, and explodes after 4.5–5.5 seconds (300 RED damage)

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Fourth Match Flame**

nodes.Name: Old Lady
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-01-12 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A white-skinned elderly woman in a rocking chair. Dressed in a long dark blue skirt, a faded purple blouse and a white bonnet. Her eye sockets are empty.

**History.** She tells stories to anyone who enters, always beginning with "Child, child. Do you want to hear an old story?". She knows every children's tale, including ones that don't exist. Employees note that her stories can "fry your brain" in a second.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases every time work on another Abnormality is completed (if work on this one hasn't been completed yet)
- At counter 0, the containment unit fills with a haze of "Loneliness"
- An agent with "Loneliness" goes out of control, takes 4–6 WHITE damage every 6 seconds for 30 seconds and cannot move

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Solitude**

nodes.Name: Wall Gazer
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** F-01-18 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A pale naked woman with long black hair that completely hides her face. She kneels, pressing her palms against the wall. Monotonous sighs can be heard.

**History.** She constantly tries to attract attention, mumbling incoherently and begging those about to leave to stay. If she learns an employee's name, she uses it to make the victim turn around. There are rumors of turning to stone upon looking at her.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on a Normal (50%) or Bad (70%) result and on "Attachment" work
- At counter 0, she lets out a jump scare with a woman's scream, dealing 18–25 WHITE damage to everyone in the department
- An agent with Temperance Level I sees her face during work and panics instantly

nodes.Name: 1.76 MHz
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-06-27 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A phenomenon with no definite shape. The containment unit is filled with static, in which blurry images sometimes flicker. Static, gunshots and explosions can be heard.

**History.** Discovered when employees in a certain location began suffering from bouts of aggression and hallucinations. A scan of the airwaves revealed stray sounds on the 1.76 MHz frequency: explosions, screams, pleas for help. During an experiment the radio began smoking, and 30 minutes later everyone in the area was seized by rage.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Agents with Fortitude Level I have a 20% higher success chance
- The counter decreases when an agent panics in the containment unit, and on a Normal (40%) and Bad (80%) result
- It increases on a Good result and when all PE-Boxes are collected (+2)
- At counter 0, static fills the department's hallways, dealing 4 WHITE damage every 3 seconds

nodes.Name: Spider Bud
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-02-43 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A spider-like Abnormality that looks like a black sack hanging from the ceiling, dotted with many red eyes. Small spiders crawl on the floor. Squelching sounds can be heard.

**History.** The containment unit has no lighting. An employee crushed a spiderling, after which a huge spider wrapped him in its web and hoisted him up as nourishing food for its offspring. Employees refuse to free their cocooned colleagues, even though they stay alive, slowly dying in the dark.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Activates on "Insight" work or when any work is completed by an agent with Prudence Level I
- The Abnormality descends and lifts the agent into the darkness, after which a web-wrapped figure descends
- The agent is considered dead
- The cocoons boost PE-Box production

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Red Eyes**

nodes.Name: Beauty and the Beast
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** F-02-44 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A four-legged creature covered in brown fur. Two horns with purple flowers, countless green eyes, a black underbelly. The Abnormality is a curse that forces one to turn into a beast.

**History.** No one hired to work at the castle of a count believed to be a monster ever returned. A poor woman with green eyes was hired for a high fee. Seeing that the count really was a monster, she stabbed him with a knife, but at that very moment became a monster herself.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- "Repression" yields more PE-Boxes but worsens the Abnormality's condition
- If another work type is performed after "Repression", its condition recovers
- If "Repression" is performed twice in a row, the Abnormality dies and the agent turns into a new "Beauty and the Beast"

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Horn**

nodes.Name: Bloodbath
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-05-51 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A bathtub covered in human skin, with a pair of large eyes on its left side. The shower head is replaced by a hand that constantly drips blood. The tub is filled with blood in which pale hands float.

**History.** The bathtub holds despair. Employees who look at it are seized by unbearable depression. The pale hands try to reach the onlooker. Its story is tied to the suicide of Carmen, who slit her wrists. (Confirmed in Leviathan: this is the very bathtub where Carmen took her own life.)

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Activates on work or panic by an agent with Fortitude Level I or Temperance Level I
- The hands grab the agent and drag them inside, adding a new hand (maximum 3)
- Each hand increases PE-Box output
- With 3 hands, the ability is guaranteed to trigger

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Wrist Cutter**

nodes.Name: Forsaken Murderer
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-01-54 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A bald man with gray skin and a broken neck, yet still alive. Wears a straitjacket. On breach, his head grows larger and takes on a metallic form.

**History.** He was an inmate in a federal prison. Researchers injected him with many drugs and chemicals, after which he lost himself. He began banging his head against the wall to check whether it was turning into metal, until his skull showed through the wound. After a researcher was found with a crushed head, the prisoner was put to sleep.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on a Bad result
- On breach, attacks employees (3–5 RED damage)
- Can attack several employees at once

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Regret**

nodes.Name: Punishing Bird
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-02-56 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A small bird with white plumage, small wings and a red spot on its chest. When it takes damage, it turns red.

**History.** It lived in the Black Forest with Big Bird and Judgement Bird. It decided to punish wrongdoers with its beak, but someone said its beak was too small. It grew a huge maw able to swallow any creature. The three birds joined together, but themselves became the monster from the prophecy.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases when agents start working on other Abnormalities (if no one is working on this one)
- On breach, attacks random agents (1 RED damage)
- When it attacks a panicking agent, it restores 3–5 SP to them per hit
- If an agent attacks the Abnormality, it turns red and deals 800–1200 RED damage to the attacker

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Beak**

nodes.Name: Fragment of the Universe
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-03-60 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A black sphere of extraterrestrial material with five asymmetrical tentacle-like appendages. Three bright heart-shaped spots. One appendage is shaped like a vertically elongated heart.

**History.** It arrived from space and originally had no fixed form. It shaped its appearance based on a happy child's drawing. It tries to share knowledge with humanity. An employee who tried to decipher its language lost his mind, began singing an unknown song and died of starvation.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on a Normal (medium chance) and Bad (high chance) result, and when an agent panics in the containment unit
- On breach, it changes shape, wanders the facility and attacks at close range (2–4 BLACK)
- Periodically "sings a song", dealing 2–5 WHITE damage to everyone in the room

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Fragments from Somewhere**

nodes.Name: Crumbling Armor
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-05-61 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** An antique black samurai armor with a V-shaped crest on the helmet. The right sleeve is torn off. The breastplate is decorated with a cherry blossom symbol. Under the helmet, where the left eye would be, is a blue glow.

**History.** The armor belonged to several owners, all of whom died in battle. An ordinary warrior who wore it only outside of battle lived to old age. The engraving reads: "Life is granted only to those who do not fear death." On cowardly employees, the armor increases the chance of death.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- After "Repression", the agent receives a gift in the form of a blue flame ("Inspired Bravery")
- Each subsequent "Repression" changes the gift: blue → orange ("Reckless Bravery") → red
- An agent with Fortitude Level I, one with "Reckless Bravery" after several works, or one with any gift who starts "Attachment" work on another Abnormality dies instantly

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Life for a Daredevil**

nodes.Name: Meat Lantern
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-04-84 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A fluffy white mound with a pair of round dot eyes. On its head is a glowing flower whose center resembles a light bulb or an anglerfish's lure.

**History.** It moves underground, so its breach is not registered by sensors. In an audio recording, the employee Paul reports a beautiful glowing flower in the hallway. His colleague Lloyd, in a panic, orders an evacuation with small steps, one at a time, but realizes it's already too late.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on a Bad result and if the work is completed in under 40 seconds
- On breach, it hides in the floor, with only the flower visible
- When a target passes between its fur, it opens giant jaws and devours them (500 RED damage)
- Agents cannot detect the Abnormality on their own

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Lantern** — Lantern appears for Sinclair and Gregor in Limbus Company.

nodes.Name: Today's Shy Look
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-01-92 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A humanoid in a black dress standing behind a wide drying rack on which skin is stretched, with faces cut into it depicting moods.

**History.** A woman who was sad and shy constantly heard that she needed to be happier. Under society's pressure, she dried out her skin with a smile on it to make everyone happy. When asked why, she answered: "I'm just shy."

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The Abnormality changes its face every 3–5 seconds
- The five faces give different effects:
  - Happy: +30% success, damage x0.5, restores 20% HP and SP per PE-Box
  - Smiling: +10% success, 20% SP
  - Neutral: no effects
  - Sad: -30% success, damage x1.5
  - Angry: -50% success, damage x2.0

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Today's Expression**

nodes.Name: Void Dream
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-02-99 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A floating sheep-like Abnormality with white wool, two eyes on its body (green and purple), a light purple head with closed eyes, small legs and a long thin tail.

**History.** After an encounter, the employee Vincent had a dream in which he was happy with a person he had lost long ago. After waking, he could not recover, spending all his time trying to fall asleep again. Eventually he was found dead in the Abnormality's containment unit.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- An agent with Temperance Level I falls asleep on a cloud after work and never wakes up
- On breach, it releases sleep-inducing orbs every 10–15 seconds
- When it takes damage, it turns into a creature with a sheep's body, a rooster's head and hooves
- In this form, every 6–8 seconds it "roars", dealing 3–5 WHITE damage and waking sleepers (who instantly panic)

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Engulfing Dream**

nodes.Name: Grave of Cherry Blossoms
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-04-100 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A tree with a burgundy-brown trunk. Initially without flowers; flowers appear as work proceeds. Its appearance changes from buds to full bloom.

**History.** The employee Xavier was enchanted by the blossoming tree and spent a lot of time by it. After his disappearance, the employee Pansy discovered that the cherry petals had a bloody tint, and that the tree's beauty depended on blood.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on a Good result and when an agent panics in the containment unit
- At counter 0, a group of 3–5 employees becomes "Captivated" and walks toward the containment unit
- The tree seizes whoever reaches the unit with its roots, kills them and draws them in
- At full bloom, a pink flash occurs after work, fully restoring the HP and SP of all employees

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Cherry Blossoms**

nodes.Name: Ppodae
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** D-02-107 · **Class:** TETH

**Appearance.** A white dog with fluffy fur. It barks during work. On breach, it changes shape.

**History.** It is considered so cute that employees lose control after prolonged eye contact. During work, the employee Jacob noticed Ppodae chewing on the finger of his missing colleague James. Their colleague John's only reaction was that the dog must have gone hungry all night.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on any work except "Instinct", and on a Bad result
- On breach, it moves quickly and attacks employees (3–4 RED damage)
- If it kills an employee, it returns immediately

nodes.Name: TETH Class
nodes.Desc: Low danger level. Can cause harm, but are usually controllable.

nodes.Name: Happy Teddy Bear
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-04-06 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** A large, worn-out teddy bear with a torn ear, one eye made from a white button, brown matted fur and a faded green ribbon around its neck. Stuffing spills out of the tears.

**History.** Teddy was given to a child on their seventh birthday and enjoyed nights in their embrace. When the child grew up, the bear was left in a closet. It fears being abandoned again. An employee found a colleague dead in the bear's embrace 8 hours after death.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- If the same agent comes twice in a row, on the second visit the bear hugs them to death
- A caught agent is considered out of control and dies even if the day ends

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Bear Paws**

nodes.Name: Red Shoes
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-04-08 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** A pair of shiny red high heels resting on a purple cushion on a white pedestal. Teeth are hidden beneath the inner lining.

**History.** Based on the fairy tale "The Red Shoes". A girl named Karen chose red shoes despite being forbidden, after which her feet began dancing on their own. An angel declared the curse of eternal dancing. In the records, an employee who put on the shoes killed a colleague and was then suppressed — the shoes escaped, cutting her feet off at the ankles.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on a Normal (medium chance) and Bad (high chance) result
- At counter 0, it seizes an agent with Temperance Level II or lower
- The seized agent puts on the shoes, changes appearance, gains a red axe and HP ×5.5, and attacks everyone
- When they kill an employee, they strike the corpse three times, restoring 4% HP per hit
- The charmed agent can be saved by clicking on them while they walk to the containment unit

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Sanguine Desire**

nodes.Name: Nameless Fetus
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-01-15 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** An infant covered in yellowish-brown slime. It has no legs; its body is huge and fat. A mouth splits its belly in half.

**History.** The creature is obsessed with "feeding". If it isn't fed regularly, it cries. It eats human flesh. An employee who peeked at a feeding saw plastic bags with human bodies. The roulette is presented to employees as a "transfer to another branch" — this is a lie; the victim actually dies.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on a Normal (low chance) and Bad (high chance) result
- At counter 0, it starts screaming and crying (8–12 WHITE damage to all employees), lowering other Abnormalities' counters every 10 seconds
- It can only be stopped by sacrificing an employee from the same department — the roulette chooses the victim

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Syrinx**

nodes.Name: Singing Machine
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-05-30 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** A rectangular meat grinder on four legs. At the front is a black circular joint connecting the upper part with a pipe and the lower part with cylindrical grinding spikes.

**History.** Made in an unknown factory and modified by a worker into a "music box". After its presentation an employee went missing, and blood was found nearby. An obsessed employee confessed to feeding animals and people into the machine for the sake of the music it plays while grinding.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on work by an agent with Fortitude Level IV or higher, or an agent with Temperance Level II or lower, and on a Bad result
- At counter 0, the agent jumps into the machine and dies
- The machine plays music, and a random employee in the department becomes obsessed (+100% HP), attacks employees and drags the slain into the machine

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Harmony**

nodes.Name: Warm-Hearted Woodsman
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** F-05-32 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** A large humanoid mechanism of gray metal with a big axe raised over its head. Its parts are covered in moss. A cavity with traces of blood gapes in its chest.

**History.** Based on the Tin Woodman from "The Wonderful Wizard of Oz". The wizard gave him a useless lead heart. In a rage, the Woodman ripped open the wizard's chest, took out his heart and put the lead one in its place. Since then he chops down people instead of trees, taking out human hearts.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on a Bad result and if an agent with Temperance Level III or higher completes the work
- At counter 0, the next agent to enter dies instantly
- The Woodman places the corpse in the hole in his chest and breaches
- When passing corpses, he picks up the remains, restoring 25–36 HP

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Logging**

nodes.Name: The Snow Queen
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** F-01-37 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** A woman with pale blue frozen skin. Her head floats above her body with no neck. A crown with spikes, a snowflake and black deer antlers. She holds a sword with a light blue blade. It snows in her containment unit.

**History.** Based on Andersen's fairy tale. Because of a shard of a mirror, Kai became rude, and the Snow Queen abducted him. Gerda saved him, and the castle melted in the warmth of spring. The logs say the Abnormality is a personality recreated from a "machine" that took her own life in a bathtub (an implicit reference to Carmen).

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- On a Normal (medium chance) or Bad (guaranteed) result, she throws an ice shard into the agent's chest
- On the second hit, the agent freezes
- The next work becomes a duel (the agent's chance of winning = Fortitude × 20%)
- If the agent wins, the frozen one is freed; if the Abnormality wins, both die

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Frost Splinter**

nodes.Name: All-Around Helper
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-05-41 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** A white oval body on two thin legs, with bright red eyes and a happy smile. On breach, its legs lengthen and sharp sickle-like arms covered in blood appear.

**History.** Made for home use: cleaning, making coffee, security. It recognizes a bad mood as a "dirty environment" and switches on cleaning mode, but its limbs are fitted with sharp meat-cutting tools. In an audio recording, a child switched on the robot to clean, after which screams rang out.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on a Normal (medium chance) and Bad (high chance) result
- On breach, it tumbles across the department (20–31 RED damage), makes a dash and then stops for 4 seconds

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Grinder Mk4**

nodes.Name: Rudolta of the Sleigh
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** F-02-49 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** Three parts: Rudolph — an antlerless deer with a long neck, sewn together from scraps, with bulging eyes and a hole in its belly; Santa — a red figure inside a transparent sack of blood and organs on Rudolph's back; the Sleigh — made of brown planks with white skis and green hands.

**History.** On the card: "Merry Christmas! Santa soars across the night sky..." Up close, it turns out the sleigh is pulling him, not he the sleigh. The three parts are crudely sewn together. It is assumed they may be parts of a single body, and that their creator hates Christmas.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on a Normal (medium chance) and Bad (high chance) result
- On breach, it leaves a snowy trail; any employee in the same room takes 5–8 WHITE damage every 3 seconds

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Christmas**

nodes.Name: Child of the Galaxy
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-01-55 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** A constantly crying boy with bluish-black skin and hair resembling outer space. Dressed in a dark gray tank top and gray trousers.

**History.** The boy knows everything about those who accepted his gift. An employee describes how the boy jumped into his arms and gave him a pebble, saying "don't lose it and don't give it to anyone". Later the boy said he knew everywhere the employee went. The employee tried to get rid of the pebble but couldn't, and eventually took his own life.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- After work, the agent receives a "pebble" that heals HP and SP every 5 seconds (healing = counter × 0.65)
- The counter increases by 1 if an agent with a pebble completes work on the Abnormality
- It decreases by 4 when an agent with a pebble dies
- It decreases by 1 if an agent with a pebble visits another Abnormality (taking damage = counter × 4)
- At counter 0, all agents with pebbles die instantly

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Our Galaxy**

nodes.Name: Laetitia
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-01-67 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** A little girl with pale skin, grayish-red hair in two pigtails and red eyes. She wears golden bells, a red-and-black bonnet with a bow and a red-and-beige dress. She moves mechanically, and music box sounds can be heard.

**History.** "Came from Far, Far Away." She has many friends, but they can't come with her, so she hides them in presents. She hopes everyone will enjoy her pranks. Despite her words about smiling forever, the Abnormality itself never smiles once.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- On a Normal result, she sends the agent a heart-shaped gift
- If an agent with the gift starts work on another Abnormality, a minion — "Laetitia's Friend" — bursts out of them (8–10 RED damage)

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Laetitia**

nodes.Name: Funeral of the Dead Butterflies
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-01-68 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** A humanoid Abnormality with five arms (two in place of one, one coming out of its neck). A black, white and gray palette. It carries a black coffin on its back. Its face is covered by five white butterfly wings.

**History.** It came to the facility to "free" the employees and bring them home after death. Employees cannot leave the company, even in retirement. The coffin is too small to lay all the innocent victims to rest.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on work by an agent with Justice Level II or lower or Fortitude Level IV or higher, and on a Bad result
- On breach, it shoots butterflies (10–16 WHITE damage) and sets down its coffin with a wave of butterflies (3–5 WHITE damage per second)
- If an employee's SP reaches 0 from its attacks, they die instantly, with butterflies perched on the corpse

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Solemn Lament** — Gregor's E.G.O in Limbus Company.

nodes.Name: Der Freischütz
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** F-01-69 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** A humanoid in a long cloak (blue, yellow and black tones) with a large gun (a musket). Its legs merge and spread out into a black mass. Its facial features are indistinguishable.

**History.** Based on the opera "Der Freischütz". A hunter received a rifle from the devil with a contract: the last bullet would kill his beloved. He shot everyone he loved and became a wanderer, killing. When his soul went to hell, the contract was fulfilled, and the hunter became a devil himself.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- "Attachment" is replaced by "Request" — you can have him fire a shot for 10% of the energy
- The counter decreases on work by an agent with Justice Level II or lower, on a Normal (medium chance) and Bad result, and with every 7th shot
- At counter 0 or on a "Request", he fires a bullet from the left edge to the right (80 BLACK damage)

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Magic Bullet**

nodes.Name: Schadenfreude
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-05-76 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** A mechanical dark steel box with a keyhole on the front. Inside, a gray eye can be seen, blinking and sometimes disappearing. On breach, it extends four mechanical legs, exposing a mass of flesh at the bottom.

**History.** The employee Yumi looked at the Abnormality, after which she developed delusions: she felt she was being watched through every crack. She sealed every opening in her room and gouged out her own eyes. Afterwards she was used in an experiment as a blind employee — the Abnormality did not react to her.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases every 5 seconds the agent's work is being watched
- On breach, it attacks with its legs (5–8 RED) or saws (30 hits of 2–4 RED)
- Outside the player's field of view it doesn't move or attack; its resistances change: out of view — resistant; in view — vulnerable to RED and PALE

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Gaze**

nodes.Name: Scarecrow Searching for Wisdom
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** F-01-87 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** A scarecrow in a red shirt with white checks, bare-chested, with an orange bow tie and blue overalls. Its hands are a metal rake and a scythe. The tools bear traces of blood.

**History.** Based on the Scarecrow from "The Wonderful Wizard of Oz". The town had technology for replacing body parts. A group of sick people from the outskirts was chosen for treatment, but only one came back — with a scar on his head. After the treatment he became strange, showed no emotion at his parents' funeral and eventually hanged himself.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The counter decreases on work by an agent with Prudence Level III or higher, and on a Bad result
- On breach, it wanders and attacks (3–8 BLACK damage)
- When it kills an employee, it sucks out the brain (restoring 13 HP 7 times) and becomes invulnerable

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Harvest**

nodes.Name: Porccubus
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-02-98 · **Class:** HE

**Appearance.** A creature with a long green body like a cross between a snake and a stem, covered in pale yellow thorns. At one end is a red flower with a yellow center, serving as its head, with two small eyes.

**History.** Working with the Abnormality is called the "Trust Game". Touching the thorns causes unforgettable bliss, but addiction develops. An employee describes how the effect weakens and ever stronger stimulation is required — up to lashes from a whip of thorns. The Abnormality simply makes people smile "to death".

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- On a Good result, an agent with Temperance Level III or lower is pricked by the thorns, starts laughing, and their head explodes
- On a Good result the counter increases by 1; on a Bad one it decreases
- On breach, it teleports and attacks at close range (3–9 WHITE; 9–25 against Temperance Level III)
- Employees who panic from its attacks die laughing as their heads explode

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Pleasure**

nodes.Name: HE Class
nodes.Desc: Medium danger level. Require careful handling.

nodes.Name: The Queen of Hatred
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-01-04 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A pale-skinned girl with long light blue hair, yellow eyes and hypertrophied arms. An outfit of a corset and skirt, with a bow at her neck. A staff with a pink star and a transparent heart floats beside her.

**History.** One of the "Magical Girls", a hero who protects the world. Because of her obsession with protecting people, her personality became unstable. If there is no evil in the world, she becomes evil herself. She suffers from amnesia and doesn't remember her breaches.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 2. Decreases on a Bad result and if 3 employees haven't died before overheating
- Normal state (2): restores the agent's HP and SP after work
- Hysteria (1): falls to her knees, emits black hearts; success chance is lowered
- At alert level 2, she comes out and attacks breached Abnormalities
- At counter 0, she turns into a serpent-like creature and fires a laser across the entire facility

Pec.Name: Two forms
Pec.Desc: in her normal state — a protector who restores the agent's HP and SP. In a state of hysteria (at counter 1) — she falls to her knees and emits black hearts; work success chance is lowered.

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **In the Name of Love and Hate**

nodes.Name: Big Bird
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-02-40 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A large round black bird with arms instead of wings, dozens of yellow eyes and a sharp beak. It holds a lantern with a wick made of black feathers.

**History.** It guarded the Black Forest. Hearing the question "what will happen if a monster comes at night?", it plucked its feathers and made an inextinguishable lantern. It roamed the forest and "saved" everyone in its path, killing them so they wouldn't fall into the monster's clutches. It believes death is deliverance.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 5. Increases on a Good result, decreases on a Bad one and for every 5 deaths
- At counter 0 or at alert level 2, it breaches. The lights go out in the department
- It lights up a room with its lamp, marking a random employee
- After a while, the marked employee becomes entranced and walks to the bird, which bites their head off

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Lamp**

nodes.Name: Snow White's Apple
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** F-04-42 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A tall creature with an apple for a head. Its neck and arms are made of a material resembling briar stems. Dressed in a red dress. The head has empty eye sockets eaten through by worms.

**History.** An apple created from a witch's rage and curse. After Snow White took a bite of it, it was thrown away. It didn't rot, though it should have. Over time a stem sprouted from the apple, and it gained the ability to move, setting out to look for its prince.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 1. Decreases on a Normal (medium chance) and Bad (high chance) result
- On breach, it appears in a random hallway, growing vines across the floor
- The vines slow targets and attack once every 4 seconds (20–26 BLACK damage)

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Green Stem**

nodes.Name: Queen Bee
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-04-50 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A monstrous hybrid of a beehive and a queen bee. In its hollows, chunks resembling cut meat can be seen. Its face is deformed, and one eye moves nervously.

**History.** It appeared as a result of experiments with bee pheromones. Its spores contain eggs that develop inside the body. The larva feeds on blood and organs, builds a cocoon in the intestines, then bursts out through the Adam's apple. An employee described how a colleague began twisting his neck at an unnatural angle, after which a creature crawled out of his neck.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 1. Decreases on a Normal (medium chance) and Bad (high chance) result
- At counter 0, it spreads yellow spores through the department (RED damage, 50% slow)
- If an infected employee dies, a Worker Bee emerges from their body (6–10 RED damage)
- Worker Bees can create new worker bees

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Hornet**

nodes.Name: Alriune
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-04-53 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A tall pink centaur-like creature with six pointed legs. A limbless torso covered in turquoise leaves. A human head with empty glowing eye sockets.

**History.** A doll that longed to be human. She was loved for her soulful eyes, but over time she was abandoned in a dark forest, where crows pecked out her eyes. She turns to dust, as it was said: "for dust you are, and to dust you shall return."

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 1. Decreases on a Good (high chance) and Bad (high chance) result
- On breach, it teleports, and petals appear above the Abnormality
- When the third one appears, it deals 50–70 WHITE damage to everyone in the room
- If an employee's SP reaches 0, they die instantly and their body is covered in petals

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Aroma**

nodes.Name: Little Red Riding Hooded Mercenary
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** F-01-57 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A one-eyed girl in dark traveling clothes and a red cloak. On her face is a mask with a "big teeth" design. Reddening bandages can be seen on her body.

**History.** Based on "Little Red Riding Hood". At the end of her clash with the Wolf she was left with scars on her face, and the Wolf escaped. She gave up her peaceful life and became a mercenary. Her hood was white, but turned red from blood. She is obsessed with killing the Wolf.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- "Attachment" is replaced by "Request" — she can be hired to suppress Abnormalities for energy
- Counter: 3. Decreases when any Abnormality breaches (except Punishing Bird)
- On breach, she chooses a target or is hired by the player
- If the Wolf catches her with its howl, she goes into a battle frenzy (+50% damage and speed)
- If someone other than her kills the Wolf, she flies into a rage (+100% damage dealt, +35% damage taken)

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Crimson Scar**

nodes.Name: Big and Will be Bad Wolf
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** F-02-58 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A large humanoid wolf with gray fur, white paws and tail. Black eyebrows on its muzzle and a scar over its right eye. On breach, it becomes more monstrous.

**History.** A composite image of the Wolf from various fairy tales. It constantly tries to eat employees and escape. It considers itself "the Big Bad Wolf" and embraces the role. The story says wolves are born sinners and have no names.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 2. Decreases on a Bad result, when an agent who worked with the Mercenary completes work, and when an agent wounded by the Mercenary enters the hallway with its containment unit
- "Instinct" work frees eaten agents with 50% HP and SP
- On breach, it heads for the department's main room. Its howl deals WHITE damage and restores its HP
- After losing 300 HP, it turns into black mist, becomes invulnerable and relocates

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Cobalt Scar**

nodes.Name: Judgement Bird
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-02-62 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A tall bird with long, skinny limbs and neck, and a rounded body. Its wings resemble arms covered in black plumage. Its head is wrapped in bandages. Around its neck hang golden scales, one pan larger than the other.

**History.** It was an honest judge in the Black Forest. It gave its eyes to Big Bird so that Big Bird could protect the forest. The scales always tip to one side, but the bird doesn't notice. All that remains are the unjust scales and an endless trial.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 2. Decreases on a Normal (medium chance) and Bad (high chance) result
- On breach, it wanders aimlessly
- If there is an employee in the room, it takes off its scales and holds a "trial", dealing 30–41 PALE damage to everyone in the room
- Employees who die from the "trial" appear hanged on a gallows

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Justitia**

nodes.Name: The King of Greed
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-01-64 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A girl with dark skin and long white hair in a yellow dress. She is imprisoned in a golden egg-like creature with a mouth on top. On its belly is a transparent area through which the girl can be seen.

**History.** One of the "Magical Girls". Her greed led to her ruin. She sealed herself in the golden egg of her own will. Her desire for happiness turned into obsession, and obsession became greed. She devours everything: power, money, honor.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 1. Decreases on a Normal (medium chance) and Bad (high chance) result
- On breach, she turns into a golden fish with a big mouth
- She creates portals; any target touching her mouth takes 390–411 RED damage per second
- She takes no damage from behind

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Gold Rush**

nodes.Name: The Little Prince
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-04-66 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A mushroom-like creature in dark blue and purple colors. A spherical base of head-shaped growths with hollow openings. The stalk ends in a blue cap.

**History.** Its spores contain hallucinogens. An infected employee feels nothing but slight shortness of breath, then tumors form and they turn into a monster. The employee Alex, who volunteered to work with the "Giant Mushroom", believed he had found a friend. After his death he could be identified only by a mole.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 2. Decreases if three works in a row didn't include "Insight", on a Bad result, and after 5 works by the same agent
- At counter 0, it takes control of a random agent, who walks to the containment unit
- Whoever reaches the unit turns into a minion (5–6 BLACK damage) and covers the floor with spores
- After a minion dies, its spores can cause panic, starting the cycle over

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Spore**

nodes.Name: Dream of a Black Swan
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** F-02-70 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** Six brothers — boys with fair hair and blue eyes, in black shirts and green necklaces. The Sister — a black bird-like creature with a head fused from two faces, holding an umbrella.

**History.** Based on the fairy tale "The Wild Swans". Eliza cared for her six brothers after their parents' death. A fog descended on the town. Eliza made clothes out of nettles to protect her brothers. She met a stranger who tore her hand away and fell, after which blood and green slime flowed from every opening in his body.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 5. Each condition lowers the counter by 1: 5 employee deaths, 5 employees panicking, 3 breaches, a Bad result, a Normal result
- When all five conditions are met, the "Sister" appears
- The Sister attacks with her umbrella (5–9 RED) and can open the umbrella to reflect damage
- When passing containment units, she lowers their counters by 1

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Black Swan**

nodes.Name: The Dreaming Current
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-02-71 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A cobalt-blue animal resembling a shark. Two wide maws with rows of sharp teeth and rainbow tongues. A syringe is stuck into its back, the wound surrounded by splatters of blood.

**History.** A child abandoned by its parents because, due to an infection, it wasn't expected to live even two years. The researchers became its parents. It was given candy that let it see the ocean. The child lived many years, but its only concern was which candy it would eat tomorrow.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 2. Decreases when an agent panics during work and if the agent has Temperance Level I
- On breach, it floods the hallways with rainbow liquid (60% slow, 2–4 RED damage, restores 2–4 SP)
- The Abnormality "swims" through the hallways at tremendous speed (150–151 RED damage)

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Ecstasy**

nodes.Name: The Burrowing Heaven
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-04-72 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A tree-like creature made of muscles and tendons. A stalk grows out of the floor, with two wing-like branches with appendages. In the center is a large eye with a yellow iris and a red pupil.

**History.** It uses people's gaze as fertilizer. It lives in the eyes of the beholder. If you let your guard down, it grows wings that reach for the sky and blot out the sun. Its ability is similar to SCP-173.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 3. Decreases by 1 every 10 seconds if the camera isn't pointed at the Abnormality during work
- On breach, it spreads its "wings". While in view, it stands still
- Out of view, it teleports to random rooms and instantly kills everyone in them

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Heaven**

nodes.Name: The Knight of Despair
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-01-73 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A tall pale-skinned girl with blue hair that darkens toward the ends. Her head is crowned with a three-spiked tiara. Half of her head is black with horns; on the other half, a black tear runs down her cheek.

**History.** One of the "Magical Girls", a former hero. After long wars she realized there was no good left in the world and became evil herself. Her will to protect remained, but now her blades are turned against those she failed to protect.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- On the first Good result, she blesses the agent with a shield (halves RED, WHITE and BLACK damage, doubles PALE)
- The blessed agent cannot work with Abnormalities, only suppress them
- If the blessed agent dies or panics, the Abnormality breaches
- On breach, she throws homing spears (50 PALE damage) and impales the slain on spears

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **The Sword Sharpened with Tears**

nodes.Name: Naked Nest
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-02-74 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A brown, stone-like cocoon stuck to the floor, with many holes. During work, worm-like creatures poke out of some of the holes.

**History.** The infection attacks the frontal lobe of the brain. The host feels no physical sensations, but at 30% infection communication becomes impossible — it is the Abnormality that is speaking now. When the skin turns green, you must pretend everything is normal — agitation speeds up the infection.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- When work ends, the agent may become infected (chance = PE-Boxes × (max HP − current HP) / max HP)
- After 9–14 seconds, symptoms appear: a green cloud, the skin turns green, 50% slow
- After 30–40 seconds, the agent turns into a "Naked Nest-1"
- The transformed are under its control, attack everyone and can infect others

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Exuviae**

nodes.Name: Dimensional Refraction Variant
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-03-88 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A barely visible round shape with a grainy texture, resembling smoke. It floats above the floor and is intangible.

**History.** A vacuum phenomenon in the containment unit. The record of the employee Chomsky's death describes how he stopped, his body rose, his arms and legs stretched out, after which he was torn apart. To detect it, employees carry a glass of water — if the water spills, they must leave the unit immediately.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 2. Decreases on a Bad result and if the work lasted 40+ seconds
- On breach, it appears in a random room, dealing 40 RED damage to any living target
- Dead employees are dismembered, and their bodies float amid distorted surroundings
- Agents cannot detect the Abnormality on their own

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Diffraction**

nodes.Name: The Firebird
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-02-101 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A black bird with a long tail, neck and beak, glowing yellow eyes and a mark on its chest. It rests on a charred branch.

**History.** It lived in a forest; its feathers were so bright they made the darkness retreat. Hunters craved its feathers. The forest filled with people, and the bird cried its eyes out from the pain. It found a new "forest" — with people whose desire to hunt burns just as brightly.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 3. Decreases when another Abnormality in the department breaches, on a Good result, and on a Normal one (low chance)
- At counter 1 or when an agent's HP is below 20%, it grants "light" (full HP recovery, then regeneration of 5 HP and SP every 5 seconds for 60 seconds)
- On breach, it creates a fire filter (5 RED damage per second)
- When it takes damage, it flies across the room (90–110 WHITE damage)

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Feather of Honor**

nodes.Name: Yin
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-05-102 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** The dark half of an amulet with a tassel attached on a cord and a white spot on its spherical part. It floats in its containment unit. Its counterpart is Yang.

**History.** A "devil's pendant" separated from its other half. Employees must not touch or wear it — even a glance shrouds the heart in darkness. Yin considers itself a by-product that was rejected. When it met Yang, it realized the meaning of its existence for the first time.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 2. Decreases on a Bad result and if Yang is worn for more than 30 seconds
- On breach, it turns into a dark brown fish with an orange eye
- It emits a brown wave (25 BLACK damage, passes through walls)
- If Yang has breached, Yin looks for it. When they meet, they merge into the Yin-Yang symbol, then a dragon-like creature appears that changes the HP and SP of all targets by the formula: maximum − current

nodes.Name: Il Pianto della Luna
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** D-01-105 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A pale-skinned woman sitting on a chair. Her eyes are covered with a beige scarf, and she wears a rose-shaped hairpin. She holds a cane with a snake-head handle. Beside her is a piano with extinguished candles and dried heads at its legs.

**History.** The greatest pianist, famed for her sonata. She left the world, giving her soul to the moon. All that remained was an empty shell, the piano and the dried heads. An employee who played the third movement described euphoria while playing and the realization that the piano's pedals were severed heads.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- "Insight" is replaced by "Performance" — the agent plays the first movement of the Moonlight Sonata; the Temperance and Justice of all agents increase by 10, and the performer loses 50% HP
- Counter: 3. Decreases on a Normal (medium chance) or Bad result, and on "Performance"
- On breach, it moves around, plays the third movement of the sonata, attacks with its cane (14–16 RED) and a thrust (30–45 BLACK)
- Slain employees dissolve into a black substance

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Moonlight**

nodes.Name: Parasite Tree
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** D-04-108 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A green barkless tree with many leaves. After five "petals" have been given, it turns purple, and skulls can be seen on its leaves.

**History.** The tree spreads psychological calm. An employee describes in his diary how a voice in his head convinced him the tree was helping. He brought a newcomer, who was smiling, to the tree, and felt something growing inside him. In the files, the Abnormality is called Yggdrasill — the Tree of Life.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 1. Decreases after five works on other Abnormalities without work on the tree, on "Repression" work, and when another Abnormality breaches (low chance)
- When triggered, it gives an employee a "petal" (increases SP and success chance)
- At counter 0, it entrances a random employee, making them walk to the containment unit
- When five employees have received petals, the Abnormality takes on a horrifying appearance, and the employees with petals panic and turn into Sprouts

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Hypocrisy**

nodes.Name: Clouded Monk
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** D-01-110 · **Class:** WAW

**Appearance.** A Buddhist monk in pilgrim's robes and an Asian headdress, his face covered in bandages. A bag on his back, a mala (prayer beads) in his hand, large brown beads with characters around his neck.

**History.** A monk following the path of Buddhism witnessed the cremation ceremony of an old monk. The crowd was disappointed that only two spoonfuls of sarira were collected. A suspicious old man advised him to climb a hill of pagodas where the sarira of forgotten monks were kept. Waking among the pagodas, he discovered he could not stop. Legends tell of a demonic creature that appears among the pagodas at night and steals the sarira.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- "Insight" work fully restores the agent's SP
- Counter: 3. Decreases for every 10 deaths, on a Normal (medium chance) and Bad result, and if Yin enters the hallway with its containment unit
- On breach, it becomes a naked humanoid monster (23 RED damage)
- It falls, sighs heavily, creates a ring of fire, then runs screaming to the end of the room (250 RED damage to the first target)

nodes.Name: WAW Class
nodes.Desc: High danger level. Capable of inflicting serious damage on the facility.

nodes.Name: Nothing There
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-06-20 · **Class:** ALEPH

**Appearance.** Made of many human remains and body parts. A large head, with a light blue clawed hand on top. On its face are two light blue eyes, two dark blue eyes and two mouths. A torso of transparent material through which the innards can be seen.

**History.** It appeared as a result of an experiment on the volunteer Christopher, his wife Isabel and their daughter Gilly. They believed the founder of a new religion would save the world. In the end, Gebura found a monster with Christopher's gaze. Its four eyes and three mouths indicate that the Abnormality combines parts of several people.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The lower the agent's Fortitude, the lower the success chance
- On work by an agent with Justice Level III or lower, the counter decreases
- On a Bad result or the agent's death, it takes on the agent's appearance
- On breach, the screen is covered by an image of innards, and the Abnormality must be found among the agents
- If this fails, it takes its true form, after 30 seconds turns into a cocoon, then into its final form
- In its final form it attacks with a meat hammer (25–36 RED), a shot (50–61 RED) and a blade (300 **PALE** damage)

Pec.Name: E.G.O
