Pec.Desc: **Mimicry** — the blade of Kali (the Red Mist).

nodes.Name: The Silent Orchestra
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-01-31 · **Class:** ALEPH

**Appearance.** A group of white humanoid figures bearing images of musical notes and treble clefs. Only the conductor is in the containment unit — a mannequin in a tailcoat with no arms or legs, mounted on a tall stand, with an eighth note for a head.

**History.** The conductor is responsible for creating the finest ensemble. The musicians decide whether the conductor is worthy of leading them. Without shared harmony, no one will see the true calling. The symphony is called "Silent Symphony No. 19". The first letter of the code (T) stands for trauma, which may point to Angela.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 2. Decreases on a Good and a Bad result
- At counter 0, the conductor moves to the main room and begins a symphony of 4 movements and a finale
- In each movement it is vulnerable to only one damage type: 1 — PALE, 2 — BLACK, 3 — WHITE, 4 — RED
- Each movement deals WHITE damage, and the area grows
- In the finale, employees with SP below 50% die as their heads explode

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Da Capo**

nodes.Name: WhiteNight
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-03-46-A · **Class:** ALEPH

**Appearance.** An angel-like being with a round white head, a curved body, two red eyes, five pairs of white wings, a halo and a golden collar with the number "666". The second form of Plague Doctor.

**History.** Plague Doctor is one of the guises in which WhiteNight came to people. It is a deity heralding the end of the world, an allusion to the Antichrist. The apostles are the antitheses of their biblical predecessors. The weapon's name, "Paradise Lost", references Milton's poem.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- At the start of the day, it swaps places with any other Abnormality
- Agents of Levels I–III get the fear level "In Awe"; those below Level V panic instantly
- Counter: 3. Decreases on its own every 90 seconds
- On a Bad result it decreases by 1; on a Normal one it increases with a 40% chance; on a Good one it increases by 1
- On a Good result, fully restores the HP and SP of all agents
- At counter 0, it breaches, summoning 12 apostles (11 turn into monsters, the 12th becomes the heretic)
- Every minute it emits a red ring (40 PALE damage)

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Paradise Lost**

nodes.Name: Apocalypse Bird
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-02-63 · **Class:** ALEPH

**Appearance.** A monster that appears when Punishing Bird, Judgement Bird and Big Bird merge. Its body is wrapped in bandages; on its long neck is Judgement Bird's open head, and on its front is Punishing Bird's mouth. Large black wings with dozens of yellow eyes.

**History.** Three birds lived in a warm forest. A traveler foretold misfortune. The birds became guardians. The forest emptied, and ill rumors spread. The birds merged into one, and darkness covered the forest. Everyone cried out about a monster, but the bird searched for the monster and found no one but itself.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Summoned when all three birds breach at the same time (after day 21)
- A portal, "Entrance to the Black Forest", appears in the main room; the birds walk toward it and become invulnerable
- When they merge, the lights go out (until Big Bird's egg is destroyed) and time becomes uncontrollable (until Judgement Bird's egg is destroyed)
- The Abnormality is invulnerable — it can only be defeated by destroying three eggs in random main rooms

**(A fusion of three WAW Abnormalities: Punishing Bird, Judgement Bird and Big Bird.)**

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Twilight**

Pec.Name: Note
Pec.Desc: A fusion of three WAW Abnormalities: Punishing Bird, Judgement Bird and Big Bird.

nodes.Name: Mountain of Smiling Bodies
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-01-75 · **Class:** ALEPH

**Appearance.** A large black spherical mass of various body parts and debris, with a big mouth full of bloody teeth and two legs. Part of its body is covered with white masks with twisted expressions.

**History.** After an incident in which several dozen employees died, the corpses were left in the department. The cleanup was postponed; the bodies began to rot and fused together, smiling. An employee left in the isolated department swallowed a bomb before dying in order to suppress the Abnormality, and left a recording: "Promise me your smile won't be there. Goodbye."

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 2. Decreases on a Bad result, when a wounded agent enters the containment unit, when an agent dies in the unit, and for every 10 deaths
- On breach, it moves quickly toward corpses
- After eating 2–3 corpses, it grows an additional part, restoring HP (maximum 2 parts)
- With additional parts, it gains new attacks: a roar (20–27 BLACK), acid spit (120–150 BLACK), a slam (15–17 BLACK)

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Smile**

nodes.Name: CENSORED
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-03-89 · **Class:** ALEPH

**Appearance.** Its appearance is hidden under a censorship filter due to its high cognitive hazard. The outline shows a torso and several appendages. On breach, the outline of a neck, head, legs and tail can be made out.

**History.** An Abnormality so visually horrifying that even the manager could lose their mind. If the censorship filter disappears, the manager must be liquidated immediately. In an audio recording, an immune employee describes how the Abnormality reproduces through employees, and loses contact with the words: "This is the most horrifying thing I have ever seen."

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Agents of Level IV and below panic instantly during work
- Level V agents lose 60% SP
- "Repression" is replaced by "Sacrifice" — a roulette picks an employee from the department, who goes to the containment unit and dies
- Counter: 2. Decreases on a Bad result and when an agent panics in the containment unit
- On breach, it moves slowly and attacks (23–27 BLACK)
- After killing an employee, it absorbs them into a censored square, creating a minion (13–17 BLACK)

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **CENSORED**

nodes.Name: Blue Star
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-03-93 · **Class:** ALEPH

**Appearance.** An entity of gray legs joined by a glowing heart with blue edges and a black core. The shape was probably formed by people reaching toward the heart.

**History.** A group of people worshipping the Abnormality appeared in the company. The employee Emily burst into the containment unit and killed herself; she was called a "martyr". A letter says: "We are all sinners, and the Blue Star is the only place that accepts us. We will meet again as stars."

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Counter: 2. Decreases on work by an agent with Prudence Level IV or lower; if the work lasts more than 60 seconds, the agent is pulled into the center and dies
- Agents with Prudence and Temperance Level III or lower who encounter the Abnormality are instantly pulled in and die
- On breach, it moves to the department's main room
- Every 5–8 seconds it emits a pulse of blue light (15–20 WHITE damage to all agents and Abnormalities)
- Panicking agents are drawn into the star and die

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Sound of a Star**

nodes.Name: Army in Black
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** D-01-106 · **Class:** ALEPH (true form)

**Appearance.** A soldier in light pink armor, imprisoned in a pink heart. On breach, 4 black copies appear.

**History.** It originally called itself the "Army in Pink". It claims to see the color of hearts (pink means kind) and to be ready to protect kind people. The employee Serena actively used its help, but over time the Abnormality began to darken. In the final record it introduces itself as the "Army in Black", declaring it will cleanse hearts of good thoughts, and kills Serena with an explosion.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- "Attachment" is replaced by "Protection" — you can choose an agent; the Abnormality teleports to them, reducing damage taken by 20% and restoring 12 HP and 12 SP to everyone in the room every 10 seconds
- If the protected agent is below Level III, they go out of control
- Counter: 3. Decreases when "Protection" is used, on a Bad result, on "Repression" work, and for every 5 deaths
- On breach, 4 black copies appear and move to the main room, attacking with a wave of black hearts (12–15 BLACK), then explode (30–40 WHITE)

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Pink**

Pec.Name: Original form
Pec.Desc: In containment its class is **TETH** ("Army in Pink"); on breach — ALEPH.

nodes.Name: Melting Love
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** D-03-109 · **Class:** ALEPH

**Appearance.** A slime in the shape of a crimson-pink girl with long "hair", holding her left hand to her chest.

**History.** The employee Mary found pink slime in a container and grew attached to it. Her colleagues noticed her strange behavior and locked her up. The slime, which had forgotten everything, instinctively remembered only one thing: it had to get out to save Mary. Mary melted in the blink of an eye, turning into slime. Soon an army of slimes began attacking employees, killing out of blind love.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The first agent to complete any work other than "Repression" receives a slime heart (+10% success chance, restores 30 SP every 15 seconds)
- The agent spreads infection — infecting employees in the same room (25% chance every 10 seconds)
- The infected restore 10 SP every 5 seconds and turn into minions after 100–120 seconds
- If the agent with the heart does "Insight" work and produces 24+ PE, the infection stops for 30 seconds
- Counter: 3. Decreases on a Normal and Bad result, and when the agent with the heart does "Repression" work
- On breach, the agent with the heart turns into the "Lover" (an empowered minion)
- The Abnormality attacks with spit (25–45 BLACK with poison) and its body (15–25 BLACK)
- At HP below 60%, it absorbs minions, restoring 200 HP

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Adoration**

nodes.Name: ALEPH Class
nodes.Desc: The highest danger level. Can destroy the entire facility on breach.

nodes.Name: One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-03-03 · **Class:** ZAYIN

**Appearance.** A huge skull attached to a cross, crowned with a crown of thorns. It floats about two meters above the floor, exuding a yellowish aura. Its empty eye sockets create the feeling of an intent gaze.

**History.** An allusion to Christianity and the image of the crucified Christ. A confession of a third-degree sin led to disaster: a blinding flash, a two-hour power outage, and the confessing employee losing his memory of the last six years of his life. One of the confessions reveals the story of a boy named Justin who was mistaken for a deer during a hunt.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- On a Good work result, restores the agent's SP
- When the PE-Boxes are completely filled, restores 10 SP to all employees in the department
- Plays a key role in containing "WhiteNight": the heretic apostle can perform the "Confession" work, dealing 666 PALE damage to WhiteNight every 0.5 sec.
- It feeds on "evil"; employees must confess their sins

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Penitence**

nodes.Name: Plague Doctor
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-01-45 · **Class:** ZAYIN

**Appearance.** A humanoid creature in a black hat, a beaked plague doctor mask and a long black coat. Instead of arms, it has two large black wings. As it blesses agents, its appearance becomes more "angelic".

**History.** It arrived at the corporation of its own will, claiming the world is infected with a disease that only it can cure. It shows incredible tenderness toward employees, healing their injuries. The employee Alex was cured of a scar on his forehead with the promise: "I will cure you and rid you of any disease and injury."

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- The Qliphoth counter decreases on Good or Bad work, as well as at alert level 2
- At counter 0, it summons an agent who receives a "Blessing"
- After blessing 12 agents, it turns into "WhiteNight" (ALEPH)
- 11 blessed agents turn into Apostles; the 12th becomes the Heretic
- At the start of the day, it may swap containment units with another Abnormality

nodes.Name: Don't Touch Me
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-05-47 · **Class:** ZAYIN

**Appearance.** A large yellow cube-shaped box. On its front face is a black horizontal stripe and a prohibition sign with the word "클릭" (click); on top is a big red button labeled "BUTTON".

**History.** It is covered in old scribbles reading "Don't press the button". It gives employees an irresistible urge to press the button, leading to insomnia. When pressed, "things that should not happen will happen", including rumors of a giant bomb under the facility. It possesses "free will" and imposes this urge on those around it.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- Any interaction outside of work leads to disaster: selecting a work type kills the agent; opening the encyclopedia resets the counters of all Abnormalities
- It changes its appearance, copying other Abnormalities
- **4 presses** in the menu before the day — the screen is covered in cracks
- **5 presses** — a scream of "만지지마" (don't touch me) and the game force-closes

nodes.Name: Opened Can of WellCheers
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** F-05-52 · **Class:** ZAYIN

**Appearance.** A large gray vending machine in the corner of the containment unit, playing music. Beside it are two orange humanoid guards resembling shrimp, dressed in gray overalls and yellow boots.

**History.** Based on a Korean urban legend about people being kidnapped via poisoned Welch's juice. An employee drank an already opened can, fell asleep and woke up on a fishing boat. Instead of becoming a victim, he mastered the seafaring trade and stayed on to work voluntarily.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- After Good or Normal work, it dispenses a can of soda:
  - Instinct (red) — 40% HP
  - Insight (blue) — 40% SP
  - Attachment/Repression (purple) — 20% HP + 20% SP
- On Bad work, the agent falls asleep, the containment unit fills with soda, and the employee disappears

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Soda**

nodes.Name: You're Bald...
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** no code · **Class:** ZAYIN

**Appearance.** A white ball with a black upper half and the Korean syllable "머" (meo) in the center. Its appearance changes as the baldness spreads.

**History.** Connected to the employee Bill, who told of a dream in which everyone was bald. That same day, Bill was sacrificed to the "Singing Machine". After his death, this Abnormality appeared, seeking to make every person on Earth bald.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- If a non-bald agent works with the Abnormality, they go bald
- If the agent is from an affected department, the whole department goes bald
- If the agent is from another department, a flash covers the entire facility, making everyone bald
- Bald agents produce 100% more PE-Boxes
- Hair does not grow back at the end of the day

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Tough**

nodes.Name: Fairy Festival
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** F-04-83 · **Class:** ZAYIN

**Appearance.** A group of anthropomorphic fairies with aquamarine skin, four arms, insect wings, a tail and pointed ears. Only one large individual is visible in the containment unit.

**History.** The fairies communicate in their own language and eagerly help employees. However, internal reports reveal the truth: the fairies are monsters that love meat. They "take care of" an employee to keep their prey fresh. In one incident, an employee was found dead in another containment unit with bite marks.

Pec.Name: Containment behavior (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc:
- After Normal or Good work, small fairies appear around the agent, intensively restoring HP for 4–6 seconds
- If an agent under the fairies' "care" is ordered to work on another Abnormality, the fairies eat them

Pec.Name: E.G.O
Pec.Desc: **Wingbeat**

nodes.Name: ZAYIN Class
nodes.Desc: The least dangerous Abnormalities. Usually pose no threat when handled properly.

nodes.Name: The Golden Apple
nodes.Desc:
- **Code:** F-04-42
- **Appearance:** A huge golden apple filled with larvae; it mimics the voices of those it has devoured.
- **Features:** Appears in branch D-02 (Canto I). It demanded human sacrifices from among the branch's surviving employees. It devoured Yuri.
- **Symbolism:** The apple of discord, of knowledge; tied to Kafka's "The Metamorphosis" (larvae, insects) and to Gregor's trauma.

nodes.Name: Peccatulum
nodes.Desc:
- **Description:** Small sin-entities born of Abnormalities or distorted E.G.O. Encountered in L Corp branches (Cantos II, III, V). In Intervallos IV and V they evolved into larger forms.

Types by Sin: Wrath, Sloth, Gloom, Gluttony, Pride, Envy, Lust (Hohenheim's lectures, Intervallo V).

nodes.Name: The Wandering Pearl
nodes.Desc: A giant pearl Abnormality living in the stomach of the Pallid Whale.

nodes.Name: The Leather Prophet
nodes.Desc: Uses candles and prophecies to lure enemies into a trap.

nodes.Name: Dream-Devouring Siltcurrent
nodes.Desc: Guarded the passage to the heart of the Pallid Whale.

nodes.Name: Shock Centipede
nodes.Desc: Encountered in the Mirror Dungeons; in Canto IX — Hohenheim's E.G.O Gear.

nodes.Name: Faelantern
nodes.Desc: An Abnormality that escaped at LCE headquarters.

nodes.Name: Drenched Gossypium
nodes.Desc: Its vines paralyze victims. Moses used it as a trap against Kira.

nodes.Name: The Shambling Pearl
nodes.Desc: An Abnormality spat out at Matthias.

nodes.Name: The Lightning Man
nodes.Desc: A Distortion that Moses used against the Middle Finger's Nursefather.

nodes.Name: The Monolith
nodes.Desc: A black stele emitting a signal that causes Distortions. Retrieved in Intervallo IV; Hohenheim activated it on himself (HE-5-SU).

nodes.Name: How to read this screen
nodes.Desc:
Abnormalities are grouped by L Corp danger class: **ZAYIN → TETH → HE → WAW → ALEPH** (frame color = class). The description gives the code, appearance and history; the sub-blocks contain containment behavior (game mechanics, handy for converting into D&D rules) and the E.G.O obtained from it.

Code letter: **F** — Abnormalities based on fairy tales and myths; the meanings of **O**, **T** and **D** have not been officially explained.

Outside Lobotomy Corp, the outside world uses the Hana Association's scale (Urban Myth → … → Impurity).

nodes.Name: What Tools are
nodes.Desc:
A special category of L Corp Abnormalities (**Tool**). They don't breach and don't require ordinary work: an employee **uses** them — once, as worn equipment, or continuously. Almost every Tool provides a powerful effect and an equally serious price.

Most have a code of the form **X-09-xx**. The risk class is given as in the game.

**For the GM:** ready-made "cursed artifacts" — the benefit now, the price later.

nodes.Name: Theresia
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-09-09 · **Class:** TETH · **Tool:** continuous use

**Description.** A dilapidated music box with a ballerina figurine and a winding key. The inscription: "Do you remember this melody? The professor played it when the students fell asleep. Happy birthday."

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: While an employee winds the music box, everyone in the department gradually recovers SP. If held for longer than ~30 sec, the operator panics. A consolation that destroys the mind with prolonged use.

nodes.Name: Heart of Aspiration
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-09-77 · **Class:** TETH · **Tool:** equippable

**Description.** A beating "cartoonish" heart without an owner, with a dark red clot inside. "A heart with no owner; it beats even when torn out of the body."

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: Grants a bonus to HP/fortitude and attack speed. If it's returned before ~30 sec, or if the wearer never enters combat, the wearer panics. An allegory of unbridled ambition.

nodes.Name: Notes from a Crazed Researcher
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-09-78 · **Class:** HE · **Tool:** equippable

**Description.** A notebook with illegible notes: from confessions of unethical experiments to ravings that end with the words "Born anew". Connected to L Corp's early history.

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: Increases work success and speed. The wearer must work with Abnormalities without long pauses or they explode; they also explode after taking heavy damage, hurting those nearby.

nodes.Name: Fleshy Idol
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-09-79 · **Class:** WAW · **Tool:** continuous use

**Description.** A rusty cross with flesh and scrap metal grown into its center; the flesh pulsates during prayer. Found in a flooded district. "And the prayer will inevitably end in the eternal despair of the one praying."

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: The one praying takes damage, while the other employees are healed more the longer the prayer lasts. Too short a prayer kills the one praying; too long a prayer does too, and also resets the Qliphoth counters of all Abnormalities.

nodes.Name: Giant Tree Sap
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-09-80 · **Class:** HE · **Tool:** single use

**Description.** A spherical flask of red sap entwined with a root. The sap was taken from a colossal tree on the edge of the Outskirts that feeds on those who drank its sap. "The tree simply reaps what it has sown."

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: Fully heals and grants regeneration for a minute, but after ~20 sec the drinker may explode, damaging those nearby; the chance grows with each use during the day.

nodes.Name: Mirror of Adjustment
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-09-81 · **Class:** ZAYIN · **Tool:** single use

**Description.** A full-length mirror on wooden boards, with rust and red streaks; its surface is black, with a spiral. Those who look into it become "completely different people", though they look the same. "Satisfaction is only temporary."

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: Randomly redistributes the employee's base stats (the total is preserved). Repeated uses in a day take stats away.

nodes.Name: Shelter from the 27th of March
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-09-82 · **Class:** HE · **Tool:** continuous use

**Description.** A bunker built by **P Corp** as "the safest place on earth" for war refugees. Inside it is absolutely safe — but at the cost of the outside becoming more and more dangerous. (Compare P Corp's Singularity on the "Power and Factions" screen.)

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: An employee inside is healed and immune to damage, but after ~30 sec the Qliphoth counters of random Abnormalities begin to reset.

nodes.Name: We Can Change Anything
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-09-85 · **Class:** ZAYIN · **Tool:** continuous use

**Description.** A white "iron maiden" with a pixelated smile; inside are spikes. It was advertised by XX Inc. as a household robot that solves any problem: "Now everything will be fine."

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: Whoever enters cannot leave: they take damage, and the facility gains energy for every hit. The employee dies.

nodes.Name: Express Train to Hell
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-09-86 · **Class:** WAW · **Tool:** single use

**Description.** A cage-like ticket booth on a base of stones and skulls; in its window glow the eyes of a silent cashier who sells tickets for a train with no final stop.

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: Every ~30 sec one of 4 lamps lights up; the more lamps, the stronger the healing (from a single employee to the entire facility). If you delay at 4 lamps, a train rushes through the facility, dealing massive damage.

nodes.Name: Skin Prophecy
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-09-90 · **Class:** TETH · **Tool:** single use

**Description.** A book made of human skin and bones on an organic lectern, covered in bloody runes. Believers wove skin into the book to preserve its holiness; those who comprehend the teaching are "liberated".

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: Reading increases Prudence but increases vulnerability to WHITE damage (stacking). If the reader panics, they die.

nodes.Name: Portrait of Another World
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-09-91 · **Class:** HE · **Tool:** single use

**Description.** A blank canvas on a black metal stand. "This portrait captured a moment; that which we are destined to lose."

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: The marked employee transfers all damage they take (with a multiplier) onto another random employee; when that one dies, the mark passes on.

nodes.Name: You Must Be Happy
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-09-94 · **Class:** ZAYIN · **Tool:** continuous use

**Description.** A capsule machine with a screen and robotic arms — former surgical equipment of the City. The outcome of the "treatment" depended on the answer to the question "Do you love your City?": "yes" — discharge, "no" — indefinite confinement.

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: The screen alternates between YES/NO: stopping on YES grants a stat bonus, stopping on NO a penalty. Abuse is lethal.

nodes.Name: Radiant Bracelet
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-09-95 · **Class:** TETH · **Tool:** equippable

**Description.** A black bracelet with a hexagonal blue-green stone, found in the Outskirts. "This bracelet does not forgive those who harbor greed in their hearts; it should be worn only by one who truly needs it."

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: Heals and strengthens the wearer, but kills them through cell overgrowth if they stay at full health for too long (or return the bracelet unwounded).

nodes.Name: Behavior Adjustment
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-09-96 · **Class:** TETH · **Tool:** equippable

**Description.** A round black device with a white eye and two light blue buttons; it forces its wearer into "righteousness". "In the end, intellect loses its meaning, and they forget even how to exist."

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: Increases attack and movement speed but lowers SP. Panicking or removing it too early kills the wearer.

nodes.Name: Old Faith and Promise
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** T-09-97 · **Class:** ZAYIN · **Tool:** single use

**Description.** Two marble lizards made of puzzle segments around a central sphere. "Devoted hearts sank into the depths, slowly forgotten in the endless corridors of time."

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: A wager of the employee's E.G.O weapon: success boosts the weapon's damage, failure loses the weapon forever. The success chance drops with each attempt.

nodes.Name: Backward Clock
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** D-09-104 · **Class:** WAW · **Tool:** single use

**Description.** A clockwork mechanism with 4 gas-discharge indicator lamps and a winding key of unknown make; it can "rewind spent time" to a peaceful moment.

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: Wound up by employees; when fully charged, a Level 5 employee can return all breached Abnormalities to their containment units and undo malfunctions — at the cost of their own life (and of the clock itself). Use by a weak employee leads to disaster.

nodes.Name: Yang
nodes.Desc:
**Code:** O-07-103 · **Class:** WAW · **Tool:** equippable

**Description.** The light half of a pendant (the "Angel's Pendant"), the counterpart to the Abnormality **Yin** (O-05-102). "The world is more than just warmth and light."

Pec.Name: Usage (Lobotomy Corp mechanics)
Pec.Desc: Heals the wearer and grants WHITE damage resistance, but over time lowers Yin's counter. When Yin breaches, Yang also turns into a fish-like creature; together they form the Yin-Yang symbol and summon a dragon.

nodes.Name: The Library
nodes.Desc: Created by Angela in the ruins of L Corp after the theft of the Light. Its goal is to find **"the One Absolute Book"**, which will make her human and grant her freedom. The Hana Association raised its rank from Urban Myth to **Star of the City**, and the Head to **Impurity**. It appeared in the fog over Nest L and was exiled to the Outskirts after the finale.

Pec.Name: Prologue
Pec.Desc: After the theft of the Light, Angela creates the Library in the ruins of L Corp. Her goal is to find "the One Absolute Book", which will complete her and grant her freedom. **Roland**, a former Grade 9 Fixer (hiding his past as "the Black Silence"), ends up in the Library. Angela strips him of his limbs, but then restores him and makes a deal: Roland becomes her servant, helping turn guests into Books.

Pec.Name: Mechanics
Pec.Desc:
- **Invitations:** Angela sends them to those in desperate need of knowledge or power.
- **Battles and Emotions:** To obtain a Book, the guest must be driven to the peak of emotion (despair or ecstasy).
- **Result:** The defeated turn into Books containing their entire lives.

Pec.Name: Guest Timeline (summary)
Pec.Desc:
- **Canard:** Rats, the Brotherhood of Iron, Yun's Office, Hook Office.
- **Urban Myth:** Pierre's Meat Pies, Streetlight Office.
- **Urban Legend:** Zwei (South Section 6), the Stray Dogs, Molar Office.
- **Urban Plague:** the Carnival, Crosshair Office (Church of Gears), Dawn Office, Gaze Office, City of Love, the Kurokumo Clan, the Musicians of Bremen, Wedge Office.
- **Urban Nightmare:** Shi Association, the Puppeteer, the 8 O'Clock Circus, the Sweepers, the Index Finger, WARP Cleanup Crew, the Smiling Faces, the Crying Children.
- **Star of the City:** Liu Association, the Thumb, Cane Office, the Blue Reverberation.
- **Impurity:** the Purple Tear, the Black Silence, the Red Mist, the Reverberation Ensemble, the Head.

Pec.Name: Finale
Pec.Desc:
1. **Roland's betrayal:** Roland tries to kill Angela, blaming her for the appearance of the Pianist, who killed his wife Angelica.
2. **The Ensemble's invasion:** Argalia attacks the Library.
3. **Redemption:** Angela releases the Light, Roland saves her. They forgive each other.
4. **The Head's visit:** For the violation of the Taboo, the Arbiter Zena, the Claw Baral and the Beholder Luda invade the Library.
5. **Exile:** The Library is moved to the Outskirts. The heroes are free, but exiled forever.
6. **Resurrection:** The Light that Angela released brought all the guests back to life, which threw the world into Chaos. Tomerry's rampage happened because she was resurrected. Members of the Molar Office (Olga, Rien, Mika) also return to life.

Pec.Name: ＋ The Library's Rank Progression
Pec.Desc:
- **Urban Myth** — after the first guests; Zwei adds it to the list of possible causes of the Distortions.
- **Urban Legend** — Hana raises its rank while Sang begs Zwei for help; the case becomes official.
- **Urban Plague** — after the death of Walter (Zwei, Section 6); every Fixer and Syndicate is talking about it.
- **Urban Nightmare** — Hana's South branch confirms the connection between L Corp, the White Nights, the Distortions and the Library. The Library is "a building shining like a mirage in the fog over Nest L"; the fog lifts.
- **Star of the City** — after the Crying Child; the Library is taken on by Liu, the Thumb and the Cane Office.
- **Impurity** — a rank from the Head itself.

The higher the rank, the less choice the guests have. Roland: "Urban Nightmares and Stars of the City are called that because of the enveloping sense of compulsion."

nodes.Name: Angela — Director of the Library
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** An AI based on Carmen's brain. L Corp's manager, creator of the Library.
- **Appearance:** Tall, silver hair, pale skin, a formal suit.
- **Personality:** Cold, calculating, cynical. Behind the mask — 10,000 years of pain and a desire to be human.
- **Key trauma:** Countless cycles of watching deaths, Ayin's coldness toward her.
- **Development:** From a soulless AI to a person capable of self-sacrifice.
- **Symbolism:** "Angela" — from *angelos* (messenger), a guide between worlds.
- **Quote:** *"I just want to be human. Is that too much to ask?"* / *"I don't want to live by making others my victims."*

Pec.Name: ＋ Angela's Path in the Library
Pec.Desc:
- She cannot leave: "I am cursed… Only a human can leave this place."
- She confesses to Roland that she thwarted Ayin's plan to sacrifice L Corp for the City's "enlightenment" — revenge for his abandoning her ("It's only a machine…"). Perhaps without that, there would have been no Distortions.
- Her emotions awakened from the endless repetitions: "What he needed wasn't a human-like automaton, but a human who was like a machine."
- After the blow from the Musicians of Bremen, red blood flows from her; her mechanical body is becoming flesh.
- She begins to forget — and writes a to-do list "for afterwards": the meat stew Roland told her about, a trip around the world. She hires Roland as a companion to talk to: "I haven't met anyone who gets along with me as well as you do."

nodes.Name: Roland — Librarian
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A former Color Fixer, "the Black Silence". Angela's Librarian.
- **Appearance:** Tall, dark hair, a tired face, a black suit, gloves.
- **Personality:** Cynical, sarcastic, pragmatic. Beneath the mask — pain and guilt.
- **Key trauma:** The loss of his wife Angelica during the Pianist's attack.
- **Development:** From an avenger to forgiving and saving Angela.
- **Abilities:** The Black Silence's gloves (4 modes), E.G.O.
- **Symbolism:** "Roland" — the hero of "The Song of Roland", who died because of betrayal.
- **Quote:** *"I don't want revenge anymore. I just want to remember."*

Pec.Name: The Black Silence
Pec.Desc: The Black Silence's gloves hold Workshop weapons (Durandal, Zelkova, the Mook Workshop blade and others). He worked as a pair with his wife **Angelica**; in the Library he at first pretended to be a Grade 9 Fixer.

Pec.Name: ＋ What Roland Tells About Himself
Pec.Desc:
- He grew up with his grandmother, who one day disappeared; he never knew his parents.
- He was married to a high-grade Fixer; they had saved up money, quit the work and were expecting a child. A friend asked him to do an easy job far from home (a U Corp stasis box, so he could bring his wife a hot pajeon) — during that time a catastrophe destroyed his district, and his wife and unborn child died.
- At first he calls himself a Grade 9 Fixer, then admits he was **Grade 1** and "mostly gathered information". He knows Salvador and Oscar and is in their debt.
- He wants to quit being a Fixer: "I've struck down enough people on other people's orders." He agrees to travel with Angela.
- His favorite saying: "If you want to do it, do it; if you don't, don't."

nodes.Name: Invitations
nodes.Desc: Angela sends Invitations to those in desperate need of knowledge or power. The promise: a book that grants a wish.

Pec.Name: ＋ How Invitations Work
Pec.Desc:
- Angela registers a book in an Invitation, and it "reaches" the one who needs it on its own — like a compass. The Invitation's power doesn't belong to her: "I'm only borrowing it."
- A guest comes of their own will and writes in their name; an Invitation can also be received second-hand (Sang got his from a friend).
- **A Red Invitation** leads to a "special guest" who moves the story forward; until the books for it are collected, the story stands still.
- Invitations appear anywhere: in a gutted body, in a robot's casing, in a desk drawer. They deliberately never reached the Thumb until the Library itself sent one.
- In the Library, a guest is limited to the space prepared for them; the librarians' deaths are temporary.

nodes.Name: Receptions and Emotions
nodes.Desc: To obtain a Book, the guest must be driven to the peak of emotion — despair or ecstasy. Combat is fought with combat page cards.

nodes.Name: Books
nodes.Desc: Defeated guests turn into Books containing their entire lives. From the Books, the Librarians obtain pages — the guests' skills.

nodes.Name: Realizations
nodes.Desc: The Sephirot's psychotherapeutic battles: each accepts her or his trauma and awakens the floor's E.G.O.

nodes.Name: The Light and Resurrection
nodes.Desc: In the finale, Angela releases the Light. It brings the guests back to life — hence the chaos after the Library (the Molar Office and others returned).

nodes.Name: Floor of General Works
nodes.Desc:
Patron: **Keter — Angela and Roland**.

A detailed biography of the patron is on the Lobotomy Corporation screen.

Pec.Name: From the floor's history
Pec.Desc:
> **Roland (Servant):** Hey-hey~ Angela! I've brought them all.
> **Angela (Director of the Library):** Malkuth, Yesod, Netzach and Hod.
> **Angela (Director of the Library):** It's been a long time since I've seen all of you gathered in one place.
> **Malkuth (Patron Librarian - History):** Angela…
> **Yesod (Patron Librarian - Technological Sciences):** And what are you trying to achieve this time?
> **Angela (Director of the Library):** Nothing special. I just wanted to meet all of you.
> **Roland (Servant):** Come on, relax a little.
> **Hod (Patron Librarian - Literature):** We have nothing to say to the likes of you.
> **Netzach (Patron Librarian - Art):** …Wait, I've got something to say.
> **Netzach (Patron Librarian - Art):** I have a problem with the light-gathering procedure.

nodes.Name: Floor of Religion
nodes.Desc:
Patron: **Hokma (Benjamin)**.

A detailed biography of the patron is on the Lobotomy Corporation screen.

Pec.Name: From the floor's history
Pec.Desc:
> **Roland (Servant):** Religion, huh… This floor smells of danger.
> **Hokma (Patron Librarian - Religion):** And here you are, Roland.
> **Roland (Servant):** Hi, Hokma. I'm Roland, the guy who'll be hauling books for you.
> **Hokma (Patron Librarian - Religion):** And Angela's servant besides.
> **Roland (Servant):** Yep, servant, that's right.
> **Hokma (Patron Librarian - Religion):** I see you are satisfied with your current position.
> **Roland (Servant):** It's not that I'm happy or anything; I'm doing it because the only alternative I have is death.
> **Roland (Servant):** Ha, I see you're not exactly welcoming to me or to Angela.
> **Roland (Servant):** Judging by how arrogantly you're acting, even though we just met.
> **Hokma (Patron Librarian - Religion):** I have no obligation to be either polite or welcoming to you.

nodes.Name: Floor of Philosophy
nodes.Desc:
Patron: **Binah (Garion)**.

A detailed biography of the patron is on the Lobotomy Corporation screen.

Pec.Name: From the floor's history
Pec.Desc:
> **Roland (Servant):** The Floor of Philosophy! Its patron librarian is named Binah…
> **Roland (Servant):** Ah, there's… a completely different smell in the air here than at Chesed's?
> **Binah (Patron Librarian - Philosophy):** …That is the aroma of black tea.
> **Roland (Servant):** A fine aroma, I must say! Different from coffee.
> **Binah (Patron Librarian - Philosophy):** Precisely. Though I am sure that blue-haired snob below me remains a boy incapable of properly appreciating a cup of good black tea.
> **Roland (Servant):** This place feels so commanding, unlike the other floors.
> **Roland (Servant):** I guess that's philosophy for you.
> **Roland (Servant):** Too hard to understand and difficult to grasp.
> **Binah (Patron Librarian - Philosophy):** After all you have seen, what does the Library appear to be to you?
> **Roland (Servant):** Seen in the Library?

nodes.Name: Floor of Social Sciences
nodes.Desc:
Patron: **Chesed (Daniel)**.

Realization theme: *Someone loyal you can rely on*.

A detailed biography of the patron is on the Lobotomy Corporation screen.

Pec.Name: From the floor's history
Pec.Desc:
> **Roland (Servant):** The Floor of Social Sciences… Patron Librarian Chesed's.
> **Roland (Servant):** Mm-mm mm-mm. Smells like coffee?
> **Chesed (Patron Librarian - Social Sciences):** Hey there, Roland?
> **Chesed (Patron Librarian - Social Sciences):** Come on, wouldn't it be nice to sit down comfortably and have some coffee~
> **Roland (Servant):** Ah, hi, Chesed. I'm flattered by your hospitality.
> **Chesed (Patron Librarian - Social Sciences):** We should show that we librarians are all one, shouldn't we~?
> **Roland (Servant):** Fine, I guess I can have a cup once in a blue moon.
> **Roland (Servant):** Ugh! Is this really coffee? Are you sure it hasn't gone bad?
> **Chesed (Patron Librarian - Social Sciences):** Strange. I'm sure I brewed a high-quality Kenyan BB…
> **Chesed (Patron Librarian - Social Sciences):** I must not have mastered recreating things inside the Library yet…

nodes.Name: Floor of Language
nodes.Desc:
Patron: **Gebura (Kali)**.

Realization theme: *The courage to protect*.

A detailed biography of the patron is on the Lobotomy Corporation screen.

Pec.Name: From the floor's history
Pec.Desc:
> **Roland (Servant):** The Floor of Language… And its librarian…
> **Gebura (Patron Librarian - Language):** Gebura.
> **Roland (Servant):** Ugh, everything here reeks of cigarette smoke. Down below we've got a drinker, and now up here there's a smoker.
> **Gebura (Patron Librarian - Language):** Nothing can harm this body, so I smoke as much as I please.
> **Gebura (Patron Librarian - Language):** You must be Roland, Angela's assistant.
> **Roland (Servant):** Yep. For someone who just woke up, you're well informed.
> **Gebura (Patron Librarian - Language):** Hm, I don't think that could be called sleep.
> **Gebura (Patron Librarian - Language):** I had to watch everything happening in the Library while I slept, so it did me no good.
> **Roland (Servant):** Well, let's say you're already up to speed.
> **Gebura (Patron Librarian - Language):** You're a Fixer, right?

nodes.Name: Floor of Natural Sciences
nodes.Desc:
Patron: **Tiphereth (Lisa and Enoch)**.

Realization theme: *Anticipation of the meaning of existence*.

A detailed biography of the patron is on the Lobotomy Corporation screen.

Pec.Name: From the floor's history
Pec.Desc:
> **Roland (Servant):** The Floor of Natural Sciences, huh. That's the fifth floor we've opened.
> **Roland (Servant):** And the patron librarian here is Tiphereth… What's with all these weird names?
> **Roland (Servant):** Hel-lo-o! Tiphereth!~ Are you here?!~
> **Tiphereth (Patron Librarian - Natural Sciences):** Shut up!
> **Roland (Servant):** Ghk…
> **Tiphereth (Patron Librarian - Natural Sciences):** I'm standing right in front of you. Where are you even looking?
> **Roland (Servant):** What, you're just a kid?
> **Tiphereth (Patron Librarian - Natural Sciences):** I'm actually a lot taller than I used to be, you know.
> **Roland (Servant):** Oh, compared to your old self from Lobotomy Corporation?
> **Tiphereth (Patron Librarian - Natural Sciences):** No, I mean compared to my first life. I was a real child back then, and now it seems I've woken up with a more grown-up body.

nodes.Name: Floor of Art
nodes.Desc:
Patron: **Netzach (Giovanni)**.

Realization theme: *The fearlessness to keep living*.

A detailed biography of the patron is on the Lobotomy Corporation screen.

Pec.Name: From the floor's history
Pec.Desc:
> **Roland (Servant):** Netzach, the librarian of Art.
> **Roland (Servant):** Lying on the floor, what…?
> **Netzach (Patron Librarian - Art):** (Without getting up, Netzach glances at Roland and turns away.)
> **Roland (Servant):** Hmm… And the books are all scattered across the floor. Not a trace of any desire to work.
> **Roland (Servant):** Hello~~ Mister Netzach, Patron Librarian~~?
> **Netzach (Patron Librarian - Art):** Ugh…
> **Roland (Servant):** If you keep refusing to cooperate, Angela's going to eat me alive~
> **Roland (Servant):** Plea-e-e-ease, wake up~~
> **Netzach (Patron Librarian - Art):** …Do you know what it's like to put all your strength into something, only to watch it fail completely?
> **Netzach (Patron Librarian - Art):** I'm so tired of building sand castles only for the waves to wash them away.

nodes.Name: Floor of Literature
nodes.Desc:
Patron: **Hod (Michelle)**.

Realization theme: *The hope to become someone better*.

A detailed biography of the patron is on the Lobotomy Corporation screen.

Pec.Name: From the floor's history
Pec.Desc:
> **Roland (Servant):** Literature, huh… It's hard to think of anything more foreign to the City than that.
> **Hod (Patron Librarian - Literature):** Hello. I'm Hod, in charge of the Floor of Literature.
> **Roland (Servant):** Hi. I'm Roland, Angela's all-purpose assistant.
> **Hod (Patron Librarian - Literature):** …I see.
> **Roland (Servant):** Don't tell me you've got some grievances against Angela too.
> **Hod (Patron Librarian - Literature):** …I certainly can't claim that she and I are friends.
> **Hod (Patron Librarian - Literature):** But we made an agreement with her, so we have to help her without complaint.
> **Roland (Servant):** Damn, guess we can forget about a happy ending. Everyone's unhappy with Angela about something.
> **Roland (Servant):** What on earth did she do to deserve this kind of treatment?
> **Hod (Patron Librarian - Literature):** …She did something unforgivable. As I once did.

nodes.Name: Floor of Technological Sciences
nodes.Desc:
Patron: **Yesod (Gabriel)**.

Realization theme: *The need to think rationally*.

A detailed biography of the patron is on the Lobotomy Corporation screen.

Pec.Name: From the floor's history
Pec.Desc:
> **Roland (Servant):** Let's see… This is Yesod from the 2nd floor… Patron librarian of the Floor of Technological Sciences.
> **Yesod (Patron Librarian - Technological Sciences):** ……
> **Roland (Servant):** Hi. Name's Roland. Angela's servant.
> **Yesod (Patron Librarian - Technological Sciences):** I am Yesod, patron librarian of the Floor of Technological Sciences.
> **Roland (Servant):** Is it just me, or is there a cold, piercing gaze aimed at me? Not like Angela's, I assure you.
> **Yesod (Patron Librarian - Technological Sciences):** ……
> **Roland (Servant):** W-well, what?
> **Roland (Servant):** Don't tell me… you throw punches at people who talk nonsense?
> **Yesod (Patron Librarian - Technological Sciences):** ……
> **Yesod (Patron Librarian - Technological Sciences):** Your tie is undone.

nodes.Name: Floor of History
nodes.Desc:
Patron: **Malkuth (Elijah)**.

Realization theme: *The will to stand firm*.

A detailed biography of the patron is on the Lobotomy Corporation screen.

Pec.Name: From the floor's history
Pec.Desc:
> **Roland (Servant):** Just as Angela said. A new floor has opened in the Library.
> **Roland (Servant):** Hi~ My name is Rolan—
> **Malkuth (Patron Librarian - History):** Angela… I still can't forgive you…
> **Malkuth (Patron Librarian - History):** Angela, you!..
> **Angela (Director of the Library):** I thought we had already closed this topic.
> **Angela (Director of the Library):** All that's required of you is cooperation, without any complaints.
> **Malkuth (Patron Librarian - History):** ……
> **Angela (Director of the Library):** That was the deal, remember?
> **Angela (Director of the Library):** And try to appreciate the body of flesh you have once again.
> **Malkuth (Patron Librarian - History):** Did you really think that getting a human body would make me happy?

nodes.Name: Rats
nodes.Desc: The lowest rung of the Backstreets (Pete, Lenny, Mann Chi): they gut bodies for organs until Zwei shows up. The Library's first guests — people without even a grade.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
**Pete** (who dreams of one day becoming one of the Fingers), **Lenny** and **Mann Chi** are saving up for a fee to the **Stray Dogs** so they can join an Urban Legend-class Syndicate. While gutting a body on Zwei's territory, they find a "mush" instead of organs inside, an orange circle on the victim's neck — and an Invitation envelope right inside the body. With 7 hours until the payment is due and no other work, they go to the Library and become books.

After the reception, Roland explains a rule of the City to Angela: you can't survive without a group, a Syndicate or an Office.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Pete (Rat):** Hey! Hurry it up! Zwei will be here any second!
> **Lenny (Rat):** I'm doing what I can!
> **Lenny (Rat):** I can't get to his guts, there's some weird mush in here.
> **Lenny (Rat):** I've never heard of a modification that does something like this…
> **Mann Chi (Rat):** His organs are scary to look at. So weird…
> **Pete (Rat):** Damn it! They're close.
> **Pete (Rat):** Forget being neat, just grab the guts and pull them out!
> **Pete (Rat):** Or they'll separate our heads from our bodies, very neatly.
> **Lenny (Rat):** How did this thing get inside his body…
> **Pete (Rat):** Forget it, just grab it! And we're out!
> **Mann Chi (Rat):** Almost done!
> **Pete (Rat):** Run!

nodes.Name: The Brotherhood of Iron
nodes.Desc: A gang obsessed with body modification (Mo, Arnold, Consta): they "top up their heads with fresh brain fluid" and rob Workshops.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
**Mo**, **Arnold** and **Consta** had full-body replacements done at a cheap workshop: they stutter, "top up their heads with fresh brain fluid", know no hunger, yet still dream of tasty food. They're saving up for better models ("that switch off all emotions") by robbing workshops. The Invitation gets stuck right inside Mo's casing.

After the reception, Roland tells Angela about the **AI Ethics Amendment** (a brain in a metal body is still a human; an electronic copy of a brain is already a machine), and Angela admits for the first time that she is a machine created from a map of a human brain.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Mo (Brother of Iron):** G-guys, you should regularly top up your heads with fresh brain fluid.
> **Mo (Brother of Iron):** A d-dry brain slows down your thinking.
> **Arnold (Brother of Iron):** S-so that's why I've had my head in the clouds the last few days.
> **Consta (Brother of Iron):** W-who are we robbing this time?
> **Arnold (Brother of Iron):** I-I think we should go to a workshop. W-workshops are rich and have useful components.
> **Consta (Brother of Iron):** H-how about Offices? W-we'll earn some notoriety if we wreck one or two.
> **Arnold (Brother of Iron):** I d-don't think Offices have anything valuable for us right now.
> **Consta (Brother of Iron):** A r-restaurant! I-I want something tasty.
> **Mo (Brother of Iron):** I-idiot. D-did you forget why we got our new bodies?!
> **Arnold (Brother of Iron):** W-we didn't want to be distracted by food and illness while making money.
> **Mo (Brother of Iron):** R-right. W-we're incredibly durable.
> **Mo (Brother of Iron):** T-these bodies only need brain fluid, fuel and occasional repairs.

nodes.Name: Yun's Office
nodes.Desc: A small Office buried in requests like "find the cat before dark". Finn believes everyone will someday see a ray of light.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
The Grade 9 **Finn** believes persistence will get him into a better Office, and takes the Invitation to his boss **Yun**. Yun, who can't make rent, sends Finn alone — and Finn dies. Then Yun stakes the entire Office and goes himself, together with **Eri**, who has just reached Grade 8. Angela calls Yun's book "especially valuable".

> **Yun:** Shut up. All of us get taken and used at some point in our lives.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Fixer 1 (Yun's Office):** Fell through again. I didn't break my back becoming a Fixer just to shuffle papers.
> **Fixer 2 (Yun's Office):** You know how it is. Not everyone can climb the grades.
> **Finn (Yun's Fixer):** Still, we'll all see a ray of light someday if we start with small jobs, right?
> **Fixer 2 (Yun's Office):** I envy your optimism, Finn.
> **Fixer 2 (Yun's Office):** But requests like "Please find my cat before it gets dark" won't get us anywhere.
> **Fixer 2 (Yun's Office):** Lousy office, lousy requests
> **Fixer 1 (Yun's Office):** Yeah, Finn. You were probably hoping for something bigger when you became a Fixer.
> **Fixer 1 (Yun's Office):** You know, a bigger field of work.
> **Finn (Yun's Fixer):** I'm sure if I keep trying, I'll get into a better Office or even become an Association Fixer. And then I…
> **Finn (Yun's Fixer):** Weird… There's an envelope in my pocket. It says 'Invitation' on it.
> **Fixer 1 (Yun's Office):** Suspicious.
> **Fixer 2 (Yun's Office):** We can't ignore something like this.

nodes.Name: Hook Office
nodes.Desc: Unscrupulous Fixers (McCullin, Taein, Naoki) who commit "unnecessary" murders on jobs.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
**McCullin**, **Taein** and **Naoki** — a former assassins' Syndicate registered as an Office. Their niche is "intimidating targets": killing brutally and hanging the bodies in plain sight. On their last job they caused 20 unnecessary deaths. Naoki is the first to realize that Angela isn't human, and hopes to sell this news.

After the reception, Roland explains "the age of humanity": sentient non-humans were driven out into the Outskirts, and the Head is "frighteningly good at finding anomalies like you".

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **McCullin (Hook Fixer):** My whole body still aches after that last job.
> **Taein (Hook Fixer):** I was hoping it would be over faster. But yesterday was awesome, right?
> **McCullin (Hook Fixer):** Yeah. That new weapon you got from the workshop is a killer.
> **Naoki (Hook Fixer):** You'd never guess. You got too carried away with it and everything went sideways. We ended up having to kill 20 extra people, all thanks to you.
> **Naoki (Hook Fixer):** And since it was a mistake on our part, we won't even get paid for the extra kills.
> **Taein (Hook Fixer):** Oh come on, don't spoil the fun. You were the one who started a real bloodbath at the end.
> **Taein (Hook Fixer):** Col's muscles ache because we were the ones trying to calm you down.
> **Naoki (Hook Fixer):** W-well, I already apologized for that…
> **McCullin (Hook Fixer):** Don't stress so much. I owe you guys now too.
> **Naoki (Hook Fixer):** I hate to admit it, but Taein is right.
> **Naoki (Hook Fixer):** We all need to try to control ourselves.
> **Naoki (Hook Fixer):** Since we work as Fixers, we shouldn't be causing unnecessary trouble.

nodes.Name: Pierre's Meat Pies
nodes.Desc: The bistro of head chef **Pierre** and his assistant **Jack**: they are looking for new recipes… and new "ingredients" that are still breathing.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
Chef **Pierre** and her assistant **Jack** cook kidnapped people ("put the legs in first, not the head — so they stay alive longer"). Their suppliers — **the Musicians of Bremen** and "**the Little Piggy**" — have stopped selling "ingredients", and their old hunting grounds are guarded by Zwei. Pierre dreams of joining the **Eight Chefs** and goes to the Library for "monster meat".

Roland: cannibalism is taboo even in the Backstreets, except in **District 23**, where people seek "the absolute taste".

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Pierre (Chef):** No, not this, this won't do either… I can't find anything that sparks something in me!
> **Jack (Pierre's Assistant):** Hiya, Pierre~ Everything's fresh this time.
> **Jack (Pierre's Assistant):** Had to rough them up a bit, of course, but they're still breathing.
> **Jack (Pierre's Assistant):** Oh, coming up with a new dish?
> **Pierre (Chef):** Welcome, Jack!~
> **Pierre (Chef):** The dish is one thing, but the fact that we're running out of ingredients is something else entirely.
> **Pierre (Chef):** What a relief that I have my ever-reliable friend Jack, so I don't have to worry about it.
> **Jack (Pierre's Assistant):** What happened?
> **Pierre (Chef):** 'The Musicians of Bremen' say they won't sell us ingredients anymore.
> **Jack (Pierre's Assistant):** You can never rely on those weirdos.
> **Jack (Pierre's Assistant):** What about 'the Little Piggy'?
> **Pierre (Chef):** They've stopped doing business with us too…

nodes.Name: Streetlight Office
nodes.Desc: A Zwei affiliate guarding two blocks (Lulu, Mars). Almost all of them die in the Library; Coordinator **Sang** goes to Zwei to ask them to get their books back.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc: A small Zwei affiliate guarding two blocks. **Lulu** and **Mars** are always bickering (the cake from the fridge), and Coordinator **Sang** takes on unofficial work through a friend from Zwei (**Julia**). **Mars** — the son of a "legendary Fixer", carrying the huge sword she gave him — dies. Lulu finds his book in the Library's list, goes for revenge and dies too. Sang sets off to Zwei to beg for help.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Lulu (Streetlight Fixer):** Ugh~ Why do so few clients come to us?
> **Lulu (Streetlight Fixer):** Our Office is officially designated as a Zwei Association affiliate.
> **Lulu (Streetlight Fixer):** And while the contract is in force, the crime rate in the areas guarded by the Streetlight Office is an outstanding 0%!!!
> **Mars (Streetlight Fixer):** Well, we only cover two blocks.
> **Mars (Streetlight Fixer):** And if we wait, work will turn up eventually.
> **Lulu (Streetlight Fixer):** Yeah, right, sit here and wait till the end of time. I'm seriously thinking of moving to another Office.
> **Mars (Streetlight Fixer):** And could you even interest a bigger Office in anything?
> **Lulu (Streetlight Fixer):** Unlike you, I've managed to make business connections, got it?
> **Lulu (Streetlight Fixer):** While your mother is too busy playing the legendary Fixer or some such nonsense, I have friends who can help me right now.
> **Mars (Streetlight Fixer):** Yeah, what a cool Fixer you are~
> **Lulu (Streetlight Fixer):** Yes, yes, thank you, I know I'm cool~
> **Lulu (Streetlight Fixer):** Hey!!! Did you eat the cake from the fridge?!!

nodes.Name: Zwei (South Section 6)
nodes.Desc: Isadora and Julia of Zwei take on Sang's case — and receive an Invitation themselves.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
Sang begs Zwei on his knees to get the books back. **Isadora** (strict, "everything by the rules", secretly caring) refuses until Hana raises the Library to **Urban Legend** — then the case becomes official. **Sang** and **Julia** go with a search party and die.

Zwei considers the Library the key to the **Distortions**: since the White Nights and Dark Days, random people have been turning into monsters, the first being **the Pianist**. Angela writes a bait book — about the connection between L Corp and the Distortions — and plants it on the section head **Walter**. He, dreaming of escaping Section 6, goes with Isadora; both become books. Zwei's motto is "**Your Shield**".

After this, Angela confesses to Roland: the Library stands on the site of L Corp's headquarters — the source of the White Nights.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Isadora (Zwei Fixer, S. Section 6):** Are you going to stay on your knees till the end of your days?
> **Sang (Streetlight Coordinator):** I'm begging you. My people… They're all dead.
> **Isadora (Zwei Fixer, S. Section 6):** You've said that a million times. It's echoing in my ears.
> **Isadora (Zwei Fixer, S. Section 6):** Listen, I know what happened. Your whole team died going to a place called 'the Library'.
> **Sang (Streetlight Coordinator):** I'd like to ask Zwei for help. At least to get their books back.
> **Isadora (Zwei Fixer, S. Section 6):** And barging into Zwei headquarters and kneeling isn't the best way to do it. Well, you know that better than I do.
> **Julia (Zwei Fixer, S. Section 6):** Isadora, please… Let's help him this time. Maybe we could at least file a request with the higher-ups to get this case moving?
> **Isadora (Zwei Fixer, S. Section 6):** Julia. I know this idiot is your friend, but even so, we can't afford to act out of friendship or attachment alone. Otherwise the very foundation will crack.
> **Isadora (Zwei Fixer, S. Section 6):** The hallway is already full of suckers begging for help.
> **Isadora (Zwei Fixer, S. Section 6):** You may be a low-grade weakling, but you're still a Zwei Association Fixer. You'd better remember this day.
> **Julia (Zwei Fixer, S. Section 6):** But I'm responsible for this case, and…
> **Julia (Zwei Fixer, S. Section 6):** And the Association is responsible for it too.

nodes.Name: The Stray Dogs
nodes.Desc: A District 22 gang (Gyeon Mi, Dino) that is wary of crossing Zwei.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc: A District 22 Syndicate: **Gyeon Mi** (rage and "the importance of promises"), **Dino**, **Zulu**. Walter promised them a blueprint of L Corp's Nest (an order from **the Thumb**) in exchange for gathering information on the Distortions; half the Syndicate was mowed down by **the Church of Gears**, "whose leader turned out to be a monster". Learning that Walter has become a book, Gyeon Mi wrecks Zwei's Section 6 and leads the gang to the Library for his book.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Gyeon Mi (Stray Dog):** Bastards! Like! You!
> **Gyeon Mi (Stray Dog):** I! Grind! Into! Dust!
> **Gyeon Mi (Stray Dog):** Take that! Right! On! Your! Flimsy! Head!!!
> **Dino (Stray Dog):** Gyeon Mi, that's enough. If you beat them to death, nothing good will come of it for us.
> **Dino (Stray Dog):** District 22 may be our territory, but these weaklings might be Zwei from Section 6, and we're talking about an Association here…
> **Dino (Stray Dog):** We'll be in deep trouble if you kill them all.
> **Gyeon Mi (Stray Dog):** Walter!
> **Gyeon Mi (Stray Dog):** If! Only! That! Bastard!
> **Gyeon Mi (Stray Dog):** Had kept! His! Promise! We! Wouldn't have to! Deal with this.
> **Gyeon Mi (Stray Dog):** We! Need! The blueprint! Of L! Corp's! Nest!
> **Gyeon Mi (Stray Dog):** It's!
> **Gyeon Mi (Stray Dog):** With Zwei!

nodes.Name: Molar Office
nodes.Desc: Olga, Rien, Mika. A T Corp job on WARP Train UW-212 reveals the truth: the trip lasts an infinitely long time. Later resurrected by the Light.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
Coordinator **Olga** (the hard-drinking "big sis"), **Rien** and **Mika** take a job from Olga's friend **Myo**, captain of the Rabbit Team of **R Corp**'s 3rd Corps: to find out the connection between the Library and L Corp. WARP Train **UW-212** doesn't arrive in 10 seconds: 6, 17, 31 hours… 300 passengers, and no one feels either hunger or thirst. The Invitation Myo gave them turns out to be the only way out.

Angela explains: L Corp supplied energy to R Corp and W Corp, and R Corp guarded Nest L. Angela knows Myo personally ("our meeting won't begin with a friendly smile"). Later the Light resurrects the Molars.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Rien (Molar Fixer):** Sis, did you see the message from T Corp?
> **Olga (Molar Coordinator):** …Huh? From where…
> **Olga (Molar Coordinator):** Damn, I'm gonna throw up…
> **Mika (Molar Fixer):** Last night she threw a drinking party with her friends from the Backstreets.
> **Mika (Molar Fixer):** I heard they took over the whole pub and partied all night.
> **Rien (Molar Fixer):** Sigh… And how much did you drink this time?
> **Olga (Molar Coordinator):** Hey, Rien, my head's still pounding from yesterday's party, so lecture me later, okay? In an hour or two.
> **Rien (Molar Fixer):** And what's this? The receipt says…
> **Rien (Molar Fixer):** You put all the expenses on the Office's account…
> **Announcement (WARP Corp):** Thank you for using WARP services.
> **Announcement (WARP Corp):** Next departing is WARP Train UW-212.
> **Announcement (WARP Corp):** Passengers, please check your tickets and make sure you've boarded the correct car. And remember: Attentiveness. Attention. Everything will be fine.

nodes.Name: The Carnival
nodes.Desc: Alpha, Beta, Gamma — a former textile Wing. They eat Sweepers to weave silk, following a Prescript of the Index.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
**Alpha**, **Beta** and **Gamma** speak in questions and eat **Sweepers** right in their lair to spin silk — by a Prescript of **the Index**. The silk ("**Nuovo Fabric**") is collected by **the Kurokumo Clan** for the Thumb. The Messenger **Yan** brings a new Prescript — to go to the Library; those who disobey face the Proxies.

Roland: high-class fabric protects as well as augmentations, and it can't be bought with money alone.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Beta (Carnival):** The taste of Sweepers never ceases to amaze?
> **Gamma (Carnival):** Disgusting in a new way every time? Never thought vileness could have so many shades.
> **Beta (Carnival):** Reminds me of the taste of that Fixer we ate. It was soft? It was joyful.
> **Gamma (Carnival):** Hard to eat, but tasty? We spun good silk. Satisfied.
> **Alpha (Carnival):** We must feed on Sweepers for another week.
> **Beta (Carnival):** Because we must spin more silk?
> **Alpha (Carnival):** The Index gave such a Prescript.
> **Gamma (Carnival):** What if the Mother of Sweepers moves on before we're done?
> **Alpha (Carnival):** We hunt. And we feast? We must weave fabric.
> **Gamma (Carnival):** I know? I wonder what we'll do next, when the Sweepers decide to take revenge.
> **Gamma (Carnival):** If they try to eat us, do we have to stop?
> **Beta (Carnival):** The Sweepers have gone quiet? Reasons unknown.

nodes.Name: The Church of Gears
nodes.Desc: **Eileen**'s cult: it promises deliverance from a gray life by turning its parishioners into "gears with a purpose" (Thinking Gears, Flesh Gears). In Library of Ruina, a service of the Church is shown in the **Crosshair Office** reception: there the Blue Reverberation spirits Eileen away, and she becomes the harp of the Reverberation Ensemble. Earlier, the Church mowed down half of the Stray Dogs; Zwei classified it as an Urban Legend.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Eileen (Leader of the Church of Gears):** Greetings to you all. Let us begin today's service.
> **Eileen (Leader of the Church of Gears):** And it seems we have a new parishioner.
> **Eileen (Leader of the Church of Gears):** What troubles have brought you to our abode?
> **Parishioner 1:** …It seems I can't go on living in this City anymore. I've had enough.
> **Eileen (Leader of the Church of Gears):** And what has you so depressed?
> **Parishioner 1:** Everything is so bleak. Just like my life.
> **Parishioner 1:** I wake up at 6 in the morning, go to work at 8 and do the same thing with the same expression on my face every single day.
> **Parishioner 1:** And by the time I leave work, it's already 10 at night…
> **Parishioner 1:** I don't know what to do anymore.
> **Parishioner 1:** I have so many expenses to fit into a month, and I don't know how to start earning more.
> **Parishioner 1:** Everyone I see on my way to work has the same expression.
> **Parishioner 1:** I don't understand why we work, why we earn money or why we live… It feels like I've lost my purpose… the meaning of existence.

nodes.Name: Dawn Office
nodes.Desc: Coordinator **Salvador** and **Philip**. The Office is destroyed — Philip blames himself.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
A Grade 4 Office in V Corp's Nest, an ally of Liu. Coordinator **Salvador** ("gramps", a veteran of **the Smoke War**, a former Zwei member and "old friend" of Walter, whom he couldn't stand), **Yuna** (single-handedly closed the Urban Legend "Thousand Needles" — behind which stood "Yesterday's Promise") and **Philip** (Grade 5, a master of Sangwa Cha; something is gnawing at him). Zwei commissions the Library; the Wedge Office is busy — Dawn goes alone. Salvador and Yuna die, Philip flees.

Roland once owed Salvador, but the old man didn't recognize him.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Philip (Dawn Fixer):** I've prepared your tea, sir.
> **Salvador (Dawn Coordinator):** Thank you, Philip.
> **Philip (Dawn Fixer):** Um, sir…
> **Salvador (Dawn Coordinator):** Good heavens, is this what I have to hear from my old friend…
> **Salvador (Dawn Coordinator):** This tea has such a rich aroma and taste. I like it.
> **Philip (Dawn Fixer):** Thank you for the compliment, sir.
> **Philip (Dawn Fixer):** What news has reached you from your old friend, if I may ask?
> **Salvador (Dawn Coordinator):** Philip, have you heard of 'the Library'?
> **Philip (Dawn Fixer):** Yes, but only that it is an Urban Legend.
> **Salvador (Dawn Coordinator):** It was recently raised to Urban Plague, and it turned out that Zwei's Section 6 fell victim to it.
> **Philip (Dawn Fixer):** So your old friend…
> **Salvador (Dawn Coordinator):** Yes, it's Walter. It seems he disappeared in the Library.

nodes.Name: Gaze Office
nodes.Desc: Allos, Dallos and Bono spy on the Molar Office through a surveillance device.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
**Allos**, **Dallos** and **Bono**, on commission from **the Cane Office** (200 million ahn through an untraceable channel), attach an extremely rare "causality recording device" to the Molar Office to learn the secret of W Corp's Singularity. At the 7th second of the trip the surveillance cuts out, and the Molars' book appears in the Library's list. Gaze goes after it.

Roland: L Corp — "clean energy, founded after the Smoke War"; Singularities are patented by the Head, and their secrets are sold and used for blackmail.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Dallos (Gaze Fixer):** Confirmed, the Molar Office has boarded the train.
> **Allos (Gaze Coordinator):** Did you make sure the surveillance device is attached to them?
> **Dallos (Gaze Fixer):** Uh-huh.
> **Allos (Gaze Coordinator):** Bono, how's the surveillance going?
> **Bono (Gaze Fixer):** Dallos is helping, but it's still not easy.
> **Allos (Gaze Coordinator):** I hope we finally get some leads…
> **Bono (Gaze Fixer):** I know it's a bit late to ask, but are you sure this job is worth it?
> **Allos (Gaze Coordinator):** Do I need to repeat once again that we'll be paid two hundred million ahn up front through an untraceable channel?
> **Dallos (Gaze Fixer):** The deal was offered by the Cane Office, so they can be trusted.
> **Bono (Gaze Fixer):** It's not that we might get cheated on the payment. If it comes out that we tried to dig up the secrets of a Singularity, we're finished. No insurance will protect us.
> **Allos (Gaze Coordinator):** I understand you're worried about R Corp keeping an eye on W Corp. But we're not going to abandon what we've started, are we?
> **Bono (Gaze Fixer):** We shouldn't even be here…

nodes.Name: City of Love (Tomerry)
nodes.Desc: WARP passengers Tommy and Merry are stuck "for ten days"; **Elena** is a member of the Ensemble.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
On the stalled UW-212, the nurse **Elena** and the doctor **Ji-hyun** (sent by Eileen) "take care of" the passengers. Dying is impossible: someone who cuts their own throat stays conscious, and the blood doesn't separate from the body. By the 30th day, five cars have killed themselves; beyond the 15th car, the "half-dead" tear people apart so they can feel pain. Elena and Ji-hyun stitch lovers together into single bodies — this is how the couple **Tommy and Merry** becomes the hero of **the City of Love**. After **724,284 days**, the creature **Tomerry** calls Elena "mommy" and doesn't remember its names. Elena hands out an Invitation to the townsfolk: "a prize if you bring back books… though I'm not hoping for it."

In the Library, less than an hour has passed in that time. Angela feels sick: it's too much like her "million years".

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Tommy (Passenger):** …Merry.
> **Tommy (Passenger):** Where are we?..
> **Tommy (Passenger):** How much time has passed?..
> **Merry (Passenger):** Tommy… Tommy… You're awake…
> **Merry (Passenger):** I'm sorry…
> **Merry (Passenger):** I really don't know… I don't know how long we've been here…
> **Elena (Passenger):** We've been here about ten days.
> **Tommy (Passenger):** …Ten days?
> **Elena (Passenger):** How are you feeling? You were unconscious for three days.
> **Tommy (Passenger):** I thought the WARP Train was supposed to arrive in ten seconds.
> **Tommy (Passenger):** How did this happen? What's going to happen to us? Where are we…
> **Elena (Passenger):** I don't really know myself, Mr. Tommy.

nodes.Name: The Kurokumo Clan
nodes.Desc: Captain **Sayo** extorts protection money from the residents of a fog-shrouded Nest.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
Captain **Sayo**, **Gin** and **Yang** extort "protection" money in L Corp's fallen Nest: they cut off residents' hands and eyes and take their homes ("just imagine if the Ring were protecting you"). The Thumb and the Index are fighting over territory for the first time in a long while; "the Rusty Chains" and "the Blade's Edge" get in the way. Then **Tanya** — a wolf-headed woman in a black cloak ("The Hour of the Wolf") — single-handedly scatters a hundred fighters, takes the Nuovo Fabric for the "ensemble conductor's" outfit and drives the Kurokumo into the Library.

Roland: a fallen Nest turns into slums, and Syndicates seize the territory so they can later resell it to a new Wing.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Sayo (Kurokumo Captain):** Oh no. This won't do.
> **Resident 1 (Nest Dweller):** But ma'am, we have nothing else to offer you…
> **Sayo (Kurokumo Captain):** If you have no money, you shouldn't have asked us for protection, should you?
> **Resident 2 (Nest Dweller):** But everything outside is covered in fog. We don't know what's happening out there… We'll die…
> **Resident 1 (Nest Dweller):** Even here we're in danger. Bandits could burst in at any moment…
> **Yang (Kurokumo Henchman):** Oh, come on… Living in the Nest, you can't even grasp the position you're in now.
> **Yang (Kurokumo Henchman):** I'd have thought the landlord with the biggest income in the area would have something stashed away.
> **Gin (Kurokumo Henchman):** Sayo, should we cut one of them?
> **Sayo (Kurokumo Captain):** Please. Sooner or later they'll have to get used to the rules the Backstreets live by.
> **Gin (Kurokumo Henchman):** Hey, consider this a useful life lesson.
> **Yang (Kurokumo Henchman):** We should cut off a hand from each of them.
> **Resident 1 (Nest Dweller):** Please, have mercy… You can't be this cruel…

nodes.Name: The Musicians of Bremen
nodes.Desc: Musicians from District 9 — "the Pianist's homeland". They understand the Library may become their final performance.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
**Meow**, **Moo-Moo** and **Oink** (a former Fixer of the Seven Association, Section 3) play "instruments" made of people in District 9 — "the holy ground of music". The group's founders — Meow, **Cock-a-doodle-doo**, **Woof** and **Hee-Haw** — devoted their lives to recreating **the Pianist**'s concert (Meow saw it from the stage: a piano made of a hundred thousand people, Fixers who became notes, until the Black Silence cut off the Pianist's arms and head). Hee-Haw told them to go to the Library: "there will be a performance bigger than ever".

They strike Angela — and for the first time **red blood** flows from her, and she feels pain: her body is becoming human.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Meow (Musician of Bremen):** M-e-o-w~ Today's performance didn't go so well.
> **Moo-Moo (Musician of Bremen):** Oink! You have to keep the tempo.
> **Moo-Moo (Musician of Bremen):** District 9 is holy ground for music! It's the birthplace of 'the Pianist'!
> **Oink (Musician of Bremen):** Oh, come on… I'm doing the best I can.
> **Meow (Musician of Bremen):** Are you still thinking about what Hee-Haw said?
> **Oink (Musician of Bremen):** Of course…
> **Oink (Musician of Bremen):** If we go to the Library, it might turn out to be our last performance…
> **Moo-Moo (Musician of Bremen):** Just shake off all your worries with some thrilling music~
> **Meow (Musician of Bremen):** Oink, if you keep getting distracted by trifles and messing up, I'll make an instrument out of you.
> **Moo-Moo (Musician of Bremen):** Seconded~
> **Meow (Musician of Bremen):** We can't let some thoughts ruin our performance anymore.
> **Meow (Musician of Bremen):** You're still newbies, so you have no idea what we had to go through before just to perform~

nodes.Name: Wedge Office
nodes.Desc: Pamela took Philip in after the destruction of the Dawn Office.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
An Office related to Dawn: Coordinator **Oscar** (Salvador's friend), the sisters **Pamela** and **Pameli** (Pameli died on the 8 O'Clock Circus job in District 12 and was restored into a clone of Pamela under a "full biological restoration" insurance policy). Salvador left Philip a letter — to rely on Oscar. Oscar: "The most dangerous selfishness is the kind that passes itself off as selflessness."

In the Library, Philip's **E.G.O** manifests for the first time (according to Angela — a trace of the White Nights), and some device of Oscar's yanks him out.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Pamela (Wedge Fixer):** Help yourself. You'll starve if you don't eat.
> **Philip (Dawn Fixer):** Thank you, but… I don't have an appetite yet…
> **Pamela (Wedge Fixer):** No wonder, your Office was destroyed. It must still be hard for you.
> **Philip (Former Dawn Fixer):** ……
> **Pameli (Wedge Fixer):** Do you think it's your fault?
> **Philip (Former Dawn Fixer):** Yes… If I had stopped them…
> **Philip (Former Dawn Fixer):** If I had been stronger and more experienced…
> **Philip (Former Dawn Fixer):** If… I had stayed instead of running…
> **Pameli (Wedge Fixer):** Then it's your fault.
> **Philip (Former Dawn Fixer):** …Huh?
> **Pameli (Wedge Fixer):** You were too stupid and weak to protect the others. It's your fault everyone died.
> **Philip (Former Dawn Fixer):** ……

nodes.Name: Shi Association (Section 2)
nodes.Desc: Eugene, Valentin, Tenma. They were framed by a Color Fixer (the Blue Reverberation); the branch head is Thelma.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
Section head **Eugene** (gravely wounded, "will one day become president of Shi"), **Valentin**, **Tenma**. In collusion with the Blue Reverberation, the South branch manager **Thelma** buries Section 2 in Urban Nightmare-class requests for ten days straight (the Naraku Clan, ingots of oblivion, the Fragment of the Limit, the Thin Beef Tenderloin Factory…). Eugene goes after the books of the Musicians of Bremen to uncover the Blue Reverberation's plans; earlier it was she who sent the Crosshair Office against the Church of Gears.

Eugene reminds Angela of **Kali**. Roland admits he was a **Grade 1** Fixer — "mostly gathered information".

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Valentin (Shi Fixer, S. Section 2):** Section head! What is this supposed to mean?
> **Eugene (Shi Section Head, S. Section 2):** Calm down. And remember. Money, fame and power rule this world.
> **Valentin (Shi Fixer, S. Section 2):** He may be a Color, but that doesn't justify how badly a Fixer who isn't even one of us has set us up.
> **Valentin (Shi Fixer, S. Section 2):** And so brazenly…
