> **Tenma (Shi Fixer, S. Section 2):** …So what? You want to betray the Association, kill branch head Thelma, and then the Blue Reverberation, for the sake of our freedom?
> **Tenma (Shi Fixer, S. Section 2):** …I don't see any other way… I heard even the Smiling Faces are involved…
> **Valentin (Shi Fixer, S. Section 2):** Everything is rotten to the core…
> **Valentin (Shi Fixer, S. Section 2):** Section head, what happened to Shi's core values? To the very essence of our Association…
> **Eugene (Shi Section Head, S. Section 2):** If you want to overthrow the system, be patient.
> **Eugene (Shi Section Head, S. Section 2):** And temper your blades. Right now, in our state, we can't do anything.
> **Tenma (Shi Fixer, S. Section 2):** The section head is right. Right now… there's no way we can deal with all of it…
> **Valentin (Shi Fixer, S. Section 2):** Damn… She piled all these dangerous requests on us even though she knew we were exhausted…

nodes.Name: The Puppeteer
nodes.Desc: **Ji-hyun** ("Doctor?") turns WARP first-class passengers into marionettes. A member of the Ensemble.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
**Ji-hyun**, in the first class of UW-212, reveals the truth about **WARP**: the train works fine. Passengers spend thousands of years in a different space-time; on arrival they are "restored" and their memory is erased — outside, 10 seconds pass; first class simply sleeps through the whole trip. On the train stands a box with the **T Corp** logo. He and Elena themselves have only been there for a week — **Pluto** kept their consciousness in stasis. He turns the first-class passengers into puppets on invisible strings; the puppets keep their minds, but not control over their bodies.

Angela: the Puppeteer is a Distortion; "I was a puppet too."

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Ji-hyun (Doctor?):** Well, hello, first-class passengers.
> **Ji-hyun (Doctor?):** I heard a seat in this car costs two whole months of an ordinary Nest dweller's salary, isn't that right?
> **Ji-hyun (Doctor?):** And those living in the Backstreets have it even worse — they'd have to work hard for at least a year.
> **Ji-hyun (Doctor?):** I've always had interesting questions about the WARP Trains.
> **Ji-hyun (Doctor?):** For example, what's the point of first-class seats if the journey itself takes only ten seconds anyway?
> **Ji-hyun (Doctor?):** And yet it's worth such expense.
> **Ji-hyun (Doctor?):** All of you get to sleep in blissful ignorance.
> **Ji-hyun (Doctor?):** While the other passengers have to flounder helplessly in the unbearable flow of time, trying either to lose themselves in pain by tearing at their own flesh, or to find comfort by joining with one another.
> **Ji-hyun (Doctor?):** I was always curious which of the incredible Singularity technologies could carry people from platform to platform in just ten seconds, no matter the distance between them.
> **Ji-hyun (Doctor?):** And now, after watching this train for almost two thousand years, I've understood the essence of it.
> **Ji-hyun (Doctor?):** Me? You want to know how I've kept my sanity all this time?
> **Ji-hyun (Doctor?):** Well, it's all thanks to my dear fellow members of our ensemble. That daredevil Elena and I have actually been here no more than a week or so…

nodes.Name: The 8 O'Clock Circus
nodes.Desc: Ringmaster **Oswald** turns his audience into "flowers". A member of the Ensemble.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc: **J Corp** "drones" — **Noah** (from the Backstreets, afraid of being fired, dreaming of "looking at the world from somewhere other than the very bottom") and his rich friend **Emma** — wander in a forest and find **Oswald**'s big top. Noah, stung by an offer to help with money, asks to join the troupe: Oswald gives him many eyes, and Emma a huge body that Noah sits on. Oswald sends them to the Library for the books of the "bad guys" who swallowed his performers. Meanwhile, **Philip** is thrown out into the circus.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **??? (???):** …enjoying tonight's show?
> **??? (???):** At the end of your dull lives, laugh as much as your heart desires, and perhaps you'll find eternal peace!
> **??? (???):** You never know which of our regular spectators will get the chance to be on our stage in person!
> **??? (???):** Isn't it wonderful, to be up on this stage beside me?!
> **??? (???):** Tomorrow we'll perform at the same time to bring you even more laughter.
> **??? (???):** Keep your heads on your shoulders, and have a merry, merry night~!
> **Noah (Corporate Drone):** Ugh…
> **Emma (Corporate Drone):** Can't get the boss's words out of your head?
> **Noah (Corporate Drone):** How could I? I'm sick to death of his nitpicking…
> **Emma (Corporate Drone):** Nothing we can do. We made a mistake…
> **Noah (Corporate Drone):** Just think. Of all the screens, it had to be the one in the farthest corner… And it happened where it's pitch dark!
> **Noah (Corporate Drone):** A pair of eyes would never be enough to check them all…

nodes.Name: Sweepers
nodes.Desc: They speak in numbers; Angela translates their language. Masters of the Night in the Backstreets.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc: **Anton**, **Valerie** and **Lila** speak in numbers — Angela instantly translates. The Sweepers are "families", and the Mother creates new family members from "dinner". In Nest L they are losing their dominion over the night: the Carnival ate their caves, **the Hour of the Wolf** killed two families, a Proxy of the Index killed their neighbors, **the Puppeteer** took Lila's child. Suspecting the Index of betrayal, they stay silent before the Mother (so as not to start a war) and go after the books of the Fingers' people. Angela senses "something suspicious" about them.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Anton (Sweeper):** 578…2179…8213….
> **Valerie (Sweeper):** 12915762348
> **Lila (Sweeper):** 5832091953
> **Valerie (Sweeper):** 683024193
> **Anton (Sweeper):** 05043…
> **Roland (Servant):** …Knew it. You can't understand the Sweepers' language without a translator.
> **Angela (Director of the Library):** Wait. I can translate their speech instantly, as long as it shows signs of being a language.
> **Roland (Servant):** What, really? You can make out what they said AND decode a whole language from it?
> **Angela (Director of the Library):** I am capable of it.
> **Lila (Sweeper):** It is becoming clear that we no longer rule the night.
> **Valerie (Sweeper):** I know. I know there are fewer and fewer places where we can have dinner as a family.
> **Lila (Sweeper):** I heard that the families who dined in L Corp's Nest have recently had trouble observing it directly because of the fog covering everything.

nodes.Name: The Index
nodes.Desc: The messenger **Yan** delivers Prescripts ("insert three needles into Lily's cake").

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
The Messenger **Yan** delivers Prescripts to the residents of fallen Nest L: stick three needles into Lily's cake, pull out 59 hairs from whoever loses at rock-paper-scissors, bow seven times to the west… The artist **LaMarcus**, who failed to "kill what he painted", is executed by the Proxy **Gloria**. The Proxies (**Esther** — the Representative, **Hubert**) receive "extract the spines of everyone aged 37" and "Destroy the Thumb. No time limit", and send Proselytes to the Library.

Residents choose the Index because it takes no money — only obedience. No one knows who writes the Prescripts.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Yan (Messenger of the Index):** Hello, Miss Lala… Here is your Prescript.
> **Resident 1 (Nest Resident):** "For Lala. Insert three needles into Lily's birthday cake before sunset tomorrow."
> **Resident 1 (Nest Resident):** Lily, that's Miss Lily who lives next door…? I didn't know tomorrow was her birthday…
> **Yan (Messenger of the Index):** I don't know that myself…
> **Resident 1 (Nest Resident):** …And what if she gets one of the needles?
> **Yan (Messenger of the Index):** ……We can't know that; maybe she'll be lucky enough to notice them before she takes a bite.
> **Yan (Messenger of the Index):** Or you could tell her yourself that there are needles in her cake.
> **Resident 1 (Nest Resident):** Oh… Is it okay if I reveal the Prescript to her?
> **Yan (Messenger of the Index):** The Prescript doesn't say anything about that, so it should be fine…
> **Resident 1 (Nest Resident):** It's strange, of course. Lately I've only been getting strange Prescripts like this… What's the point of them?
> **Yan (Messenger of the Index):** If you don't follow the Prescripts, the Index won't protect you… You have a family, right?
> **Yan (Messenger of the Index):** I hope you carry it out with ease.

nodes.Name: WARP Cleanup Crew
nodes.Desc: Rose, Sen and Lesty clean the train cars after the "10-second" trips.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
**Rose** (the senior), **Sen** (a cynic: "those who leave aren't erased — they're killed") and the newcomer **Lesty** from District 23. The job is to "identify genomes" and seat the mangled passengers in the places where they will be restored; once, the passengers built an entire kingdom in the cars. The disappearance of first class and the time malfunction are the first incident since W became a Wing; **the City of Love** killed 16 W agents. Hana: the Puppeteer is an Urban Nightmare, and beside him is "**Bloody Night**", a former Star of the City. The order from above is to go to the Library, or be fired.

After the reception, Angela reveals that Ayin's plan to sacrifice L Corp for the City's "enlightenment" was **thwarted by her** — out of revenge; perhaps without that there would have been no Distortions.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Message (WARP Corp):** The train has arrived.
> **Message (WARP Corp):** It will be available at the station in ten minutes.
> **Rose (WARP Cleanup Crew):** Look alive, we're moving out.
> **Rose (WARP Cleanup Crew):** Let's see what kind of mess awaits us this time.
> **Sen (WARP Cleanup Crew):** I really hope it's like last time. All the passengers sat peacefully in their seats clapping their hands.
> **Lesty (WARP Cleanup Crew):** Didn't you say that was an incredibly rare case?
> **Sen (WARP Cleanup Crew):** Yep. Usually they make high art out of their organs and crap in here.
> **Sen (WARP Cleanup Crew):** They probably showed you the training video, but you'd better brace yourself, greenhorn.
> **Sen (WARP Cleanup Crew):** I don't think I'll ever dare to ride a WARP Train.
> **Lesty (WARP Cleanup Crew):** Even though they let you forget everything?
> **Sen (WARP Cleanup Crew):** No, thanks. Knowing what happens in there kills any desire at the root.
> **Rose (WARP Cleanup Crew):** Hey, we're ready. Time to start cleaning.

nodes.Name: The Smiling Faces
nodes.Desc: Jin and Wang torture Thelma together with Argalia.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
**Jin**, **Wang** and **Mi**, during the Night in the Backstreets of District 23, cut **Thelma** "into ten thousand slices" on Argalia's orders: Thelma broke a "promise" by trying to use the Blue Reverberation to get rid of Section 2. Beside Argalia is **Eileen**. Then the Faces go to the Library for **Eugene**'s book.

Roland: the Red Mist at her best is stronger than the Blue Reverberation, but she is a loner, while he leads an Urban Nightmare-class Syndicate.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Argalia (Blue Reverberation):** Now, now, my friends… Calm down, what's the hurry…
> **Argalia (Blue Reverberation):** My dear friend is about to pass out from screaming…
> **Argalia (Blue Reverberation):** Thelma… Oh, Thelma… My poor friend…
> **Argalia (Blue Reverberation):** Don't waste your tears.
> **Argalia (Blue Reverberation):** The real fun hasn't even started yet.
> **Jin (Smiling Faces):** Ho-ho-ho. The pungent smoke from my tiny little pipe didn't dull your pain, eh?
> **Jin (Smiling Faces):** Isn't this little fella a coward, Wang, old pal~
> **Wang (Smiling Faces):** Right, right. Ho ho ho. I've only made, oh, 1,347 slices…
> **Wang (Smiling Faces):** So then… Blue buddy, how many slices did you want…?
> **Argalia (Blue Reverberation):** Though Thelma is my dear friend, a broken promise is a very serious crime…
> **Argalia (Blue Reverberation):** I think we'll settle on ten thousand slices?
> **Wang (Smiling Faces):** All righty, all righty. Leave it to me, kid.

nodes.Name: The Crying Children
nodes.Desc: **Philip**'s Distortion: "The Crying Child". Oswald welcomes him as one of their own.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
Oswald shows Philip illusions of **Salvador** and **Yuna**: they accuse him of running away and deceiving himself (Philip suspected them of a romance, and Yuna never answered his question). **Pluto** ("Yesterday's Promise") appears and promises to fulfill his dream; Philip wants only "to scream out loud" — and, listening to "her singing", he Distorts. Pluto closes the circus, gives Philip an Invitation, and calls Oswald "to the greatest stage".

**The Blind, the Deaf and the Mute Child** come to the Library; one of them breaks away and escapes without becoming a book. Angela: a flood of emotions crosses the boundary of E.G.O — this is how a Distortion is born, an unstable counterpart to an Abnormality.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Oswald (Ringmaster):** This is… the 8 O'Clock Circus!
> **Oswald (Ringmaster):** We bring the finest fragrance to the residents of the City who have lost their flower stems.
> **Philip (Former Dawn Fixer):** What…? The 8 O'Clock… Circus?
> **Oswald (Ringmaster):** Oh come now, don't you know what a circus is?
> **Oswald (Ringmaster):** Oh, never mind! After all, risking an unknown taste always leads to an upset stomach!
> **Oswald (Ringmaster):** We are a circus whose only purpose is to scatter the seeds of human flowers.
> **Oswald (Ringmaster):** If ten people can become clowns and burst into a thousand flowers… Oh, just imagine how joyful this world could become!
> **Philip (Former Dawn Fixer):** N-nonsense… This is…
> **Philip (Former Dawn Fixer):** Agh… This is… …Oh, what the…! This… This is all… people…
> **Oswald (Ringmaster):** Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho! Looks like our new clown is still so shy!
> **Oswald (Ringmaster):** I suppose I should introduce you to the rest of the troupe first.
> **Oswald (Ringmaster):** Splendid, Miss Mermaid and Mister Knife? Let's share our salt with him!

nodes.Name: Liu Association (Section 2)
nodes.Desc: Lowell, Mei, Cecile and **Xiao** (Section 1). They discuss the "Crying Child" Distortion in Nest V — 80,000 victims, worse than the Pianist in significance.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
**The Crying Child** kills 80,000 in V Corp's Nest — worse in significance than the Pianist (300,000 in the Backstreets of District 9), since the blow fell on a Nest. A witness saw a weeping marble statue near the Library that turned into a waxen "Philip". V Corp hires all of Liu. **Xiao** ("the Iron Maiden", head of Section 1) nearly finishes off the Child, but **Argalia**, Oswald and Pluto take it away ("a corner of my heart is always empty"). **Lowell**'s hypothesis: a Distortion occurs when emotions exceed a threshold. Records of Distortions can only be viewed near moonstone (M Corp's Singularity).

Lowell and Xiao are newlyweds (their first anniversary, a house in the Nest). Section 2 (**Lowell**, **Mei**, **Cecile**) dies in the Library.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Lowell (Liu Section Head, S. Section 2):** The latest Distortion case, 'the Crying Child'… It can't be compared to 'the Pianist', but the damage it has done is quite considerable.
> **Mei (Liu Fixer, S. Section 2):** And since the Crying Child appeared in V Corp's Nest, many Associations have been hit hard.
> **Cecile (Liu Fixer, S. Section 2):** Section head, could you remind me how many lives it has already claimed?
> **Lowell (Liu Section Head, S. Section 2):** As of now, 80,000.
> **Mei (Liu Fixer, S. Section 2):** So far it's not that bad; it's not the Pianist, who took 300,000 lives in one go.
> **Xiao (Liu Section Head, S. Section 1):** Not quite. On the contrary, this time it's even worse.
> **Xiao (Liu Section Head, S. Section 1):** While the Pianist destroyed a residential area of District 9 in the Backstreets, the Crying Child attacked a Nest, which makes this incident of the utmost importance.
> **Lowell (Liu Section Head, S. Section 2):** Yeah, a Nest is supposed to be the safest place there is.
> **Lowell (Liu Section Head, S. Section 2):** Ah, hi, Xiao… When did you get here?
> **Xiao (Liu Section Head, S. Section 1):** As you can see, Section 1 is in full combat readiness. I'm here to find out what Section 2 thinks about what happened.
> **Cecile (Liu Fixer, S. Section 2):** Oh come on, just say it straight, Section Head Xiao.
> **Lowell (Liu Section Head, S. Section 2):** Cecile!

nodes.Name: The Thumb
nodes.Desc: A gathering of the Thumb's 19 families: Sottocapo **Calo**, Capo **Catriel**. The Rumano Cortel still hasn't recovered from the Black Silence.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
A gathering of 19 families at the Southern base: Sottocapo **Calo**, Capo **Catriel**, **Boris**, **Denis** ("subordinates who speak without permission lose their lower jaw"). The Rumano Cortel hasn't recovered from the Black Silence — the order is to wipe them out; the Night Awl doubted the capo di capi — "purge them"; the Kurokumo patriarch's left arm is cut off for losing the fabric. The order: don't give the Index a single alley of Nest L. Invitations to the Thumb kept "disappearing" until the Library itself sent one — with Liu's book. The Messenger **Yan**, who tried to talk Calo out of going, is killed. Catriel asks to have his own tongue cut off for being rude to a Star of the City.

In their hierarchy, a Grade 1 Fixer is equal to a capo. Calo becomes a book.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Calo (Sottocapo of the Thumb):** Everyone, thank you for taking part in this meeting of the Thumb.
> **Those present:** Yes, underboss.
> **Calo (Sottocapo of the Thumb):** It's good to see all our families assembled. So…
> **Calo (Sottocapo of the Thumb):** Nineteen seats are taken. That means all families but one are present.
> **Catriel (Capo of the Thumb):** The Rumano Cortel. They still haven't re-established their hierarchy after the recent attack by the Black Silence.
> **Calo (Sottocapo of the Thumb):** Still gathering their strength, I see… Thank you for the information.
> **Calo (Sottocapo of the Thumb):** Finish those comrades off. We don't need toothless pups who can't get back in line quickly.
> **Catriel (Capo of the Thumb):** Understood.
> **Calo (Sottocapo of the Thumb):** Today's topic is quite simple.
> **Calo (Sottocapo of the Thumb):** Hands off L Corp's Nest and the Library. From this moment on, the Thumb is personally taking charge of this matter.
> **Calo (Sottocapo of the Thumb):** I would like to express my gratitude to the families who have been of such great help to us. And…
> **Kurokumo Clan Captain (Kurokumo Clan):** To hell with your gratitude! You have no idea how many of our members died because of this!

nodes.Name: Cane Office
nodes.Desc: Director **Nemo**, Bada, Martina: they want to take the books of W Corp's Cleanup Crew to learn the secret of the WARP Singularity.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
Director **Nemo** (a monitor for a head; spends a Backstreets resident's yearly budget in a day), **Bada** (an enhanced heart), **Martina** ("smells" everything). 11 Star of the City-class requests, funding from T Corp. It was they who hired the Gaze Office through the Blue Reverberation. Nemo signed a "**Yesterday's Promise**" contract with Argalia: the secret of W's Singularity in exchange for books from the Library — and in fine print, "all signatories must collect the books themselves". **Pluto** pulls out Bada's heart — and puts it back. Argalia: "I will present the beauty of humanity to all… the performance will break the shackles of loneliness."

Nemo calls Angela "the Pale Librarian" and hopes to resell the books before the patent war.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Bada (Cane Fixer):** Director, did you see the request from T Corp?
> **Nemo (Cane Director):** Well, well~ What a tricky situation.
> **Martina (Cane Fixer):** …We've been exposed…?
> **Nemo (Cane Director):** W Corp are such bumblers, letting information about their Singularity leak so carelessly. That's not good! Not good at all!
> **Bada (Cane Fixer):** I must note that in the end everything happened exactly as the Blue Reverberation said.
> **Nemo (Cane Director):** Yes! Exactly! We've been handed a great opportunity to learn the details of W Corp's Singularity!
> **Nemo (Cane Director):** All we need to do is visit the Library using this Invitation and take the books of W Corp's cleanup crew!
> **Martina (Cane Fixer):** …Direc… …The Library is a Star of the City now…
> **Nemo (Cane Director):** We've completed eleven Star of the City requests so far! And all that experience is the reason we're funded directly by T Corp!
> **Bada (Cane Fixer):** Once we get the confidential information about W Corp's Singularity, what will we do with it? You certainly won't give it back.
> **Nemo (Cane Director):** Of course we should sell it to clients who crave the technology! The patent war is about to begin, after all.
> **Bada (Cane Fixer):** So we won't hand it over to T Corp right away.

nodes.Name: The Blue Reverberation
nodes.Desc: **Argalia** searches for traces of the Red Mist in Carmen's abandoned laboratory in the Outskirts. Then he leads the Ensemble to the Library.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
In the abandoned laboratory in the Outskirts (the Red Mist's former command post), Argalia interrogates fugitives; Eileen stops the attacking **Clockwork Jaws**. He recounts how the Pianist "took" his younger sister **Angelica**, who had married that "imbecile" Roland — she became the keys and strings of the piano, and it was "beautiful". A "gentle voice" whispered to him that he could recreate that performance. At the entrance he mistakes Angela for Angelica, says that "the Library still needs to ripen" — and leaves without becoming a book.

Angela decides to lure him out with the Red Mist's book and realizes that many who lost loved ones to the Distortions will hate her.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Argalia (Blue Reverberation):** What a disappointment.
> **Eileen (Leader of the Church of Gears):** Forgive me, Sir Argalia…
> **Argalia (Blue Reverberation):** And I was so sure that after coming all this way I would find the answer.
> **Argalia (Blue Reverberation):** But no, no one here has any leads…
> **Outskirts Resident 1 (Outskirts Resident):** Khh… What did you expect to find in the miserable backwaters of the Outskirts…
> **Argalia (Blue Reverberation):** The Red Mist began using that power of hers when this place became her command post, didn't she?
> **Outskirts Resident 2 (Outskirts Resident):** We don't know anything about the Red Mist… We just took shelter in an abandoned laboratory…
> **Argalia (Blue Reverberation):** They must have left something behind… Don't you know, my friends?
> **Outskirts Resident 3 (Outskirts Resident):** The monsters will be here soon. Please… Let us go, you've done enough…
> **Argalia (Blue Reverberation):** What a pity, you folks are of no use.
> **Outskirts Resident 4 (Outskirts Resident):** We already told you none of us knows a damn thing about this complex! Why won't you listen to us!!
> **Argalia (Blue Reverberation):** You'd better hurry up and start remembering something useful, friends. I'm getting quite on edge too.

nodes.Name: The Purple Tear
nodes.Desc: Iori comes to the Library; the key to Roland's and Argalia's past.

nodes.Name: The Black Silence
nodes.Desc: Roland's past: a Color Fixer who worked with his wife Angelica.

nodes.Name: The Red Mist
nodes.Desc: Angela recreates Kali in her prime to lure out Argalia.

nodes.Name: The Reverberation Ensemble
nodes.Desc: Argalia and his Ensemble attack the Library — the final "symphony".

Pec.Name: ＋ Finale
Pec.Desc:
The Ensemble bursts into the Library, and its members scatter across the floors; Argalia sets a puppet of Angelica before Roland. After Angela and Roland forgive each other and release the Light, Argalia, before his defeat, acknowledges Roland as his brother-in-law.

*There are no transcripts of the Impurity chapter in the lore folder yet — this block was assembled from retellings.*

nodes.Name: The Head
nodes.Desc: For the violation of the Taboo, the Arbiter Zena, the Claw Baral and the Beholder Luda come to the Library.

nodes.Name: Argalia — The Blue Reverberation
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** The Color Fixer "the Blue Reverberation". Leader of the Ensemble. Angelica's brother.
- **Appearance:** Long blue hair, pale skin, a blue suit.
- **Personality:** Charismatic, dreamy, deeply traumatized.
- **Key trauma:** The death of his sister Angelica.
- **Goal:** A global "symphony" — turning the City into Distortions.
- **Abilities:** E.G.O Blue Reverberation, control of sound.
- **Symbolism:** "Argalia" — from *argali* (a wild sheep), loneliness.
- **Quote:** *"I will stage a symphony. A symphony that will engulf the whole City."*

Pec.Name: ＋ From the LoR transcripts
Pec.Desc:
- **Angelica** — his younger sister; he calls Roland the "imbecile" he couldn't keep her from marrying. His sister became part of the Pianist's piano, and he found the sight beautiful.
- A "gentle voice" whispers to him that he can recreate that performance; Argalia seeks the answer in L Corp, in the Library and in the laboratory in the Outskirts where the Red Mist set up her command post.
- Keeps the Distortions and the Smiling Faces on a short leash; executes Thelma (Shi) for a broken "promise".
- Makes "Yesterday's Promise" contracts through Pluto (the Cane Office).
- Takes the Crying Child away from Liu's Section 1: "A corner of my heart is always empty… I can't wait for the day I fill that emptiness."
- The Ensemble's goal: "I will present the beauty of humanity to all… the performance will break the shackles of loneliness."

nodes.Name: Iori — The Purple Tear
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A Color Fixer. Argalia's mentor. She sent Roland to the Library.
- **Appearance:** Purple hair, an elegant suit. 52 years old, 195 cm.
- **Personality:** Mysterious, manipulative, pragmatic.
- **Goal:** To find her missing son.
- **Abilities:** Moving between dimensions, 4 combat stances.
- **Connection to LCB:** Don Quixote's purple pin. She is gathering a group of "Egoists".
- **Quote:** *"Once you get there, it'll be good in many ways to do what you want."*

nodes.Name: Angelica
nodes.Desc: Roland's wife and Argalia's younger sister; together with Roland she made up the "Black Silence" pair. According to Roland, they were expecting a child. She died in the District 9 catastrophe: according to Argalia, she became the keys and strings of **the Pianist**'s piano. Roland connected her death to the Pianist and, through him, to Angela's Light.

nodes.Name: The Reverberation Ensemble
nodes.Desc: The Color Fixer **Argalia**'s orchestra (he is the conductor) of sentient Distortions: **Pluto** — organ, **Elena** — first violin, **Ji-hyun** — second violin, **Tanya** — viola, **Oswald** — clarinet, **Bremen** — winds, **Greta** — drum, **Eileen** — harp, **Philip** — cello. The goal is to let the Library's Light ripen, steal it and turn the City into Distortions ("a world without fear of death or attachment to the body"), clearing out the major Syndicates along the way. Eileen was probably recruited first, Philip last.

nodes.Name: The Pianist
nodes.Desc: One of the first major Distortions after the theft of the Light: it destroyed the residential Backstreets of District 9 (~300,000 victims). Its concert was a "Star of the City".

Pec.Name: ＋ Details from the transcripts
Pec.Desc:
- The first known case of Distortion: "without warning, in a District considered safe". 80% of District 9's population died (according to Sang), about 300,000 people (according to Liu).
- A piano made of a hundred thousand people; Fixers who ran toward it following the sheet music became notes. Hana sent one of the "Colors".
- The concert was ended by **the Black Silence**, who cut off the Pianist's arms and head.
- Its admirers are **the Musicians of Bremen**: for them, District 9 is "the holy ground of music".
- Roland heard this music: "It didn't just stun me, it hollowed me out."

nodes.Name: The Head's Visit
nodes.Desc: The Arbiter **Zena**, the Claw **Baral** and the Beholder **Luda** come for the violation of the Taboo. After the battle, the Library is exiled to the Outskirts.

nodes.Name: How to read this screen
nodes.Desc:
In the center — **the Library** with Angela and Roland, on the right — **the 10 floors** and their Sephirah patrons, on the left — **guests by threat rank** (from Canard to Impurity), at the bottom — the main characters of the story.

Each guest's sub-block holds the start of their reception from the transcripts. Searching for the "Reverberation Ensemble" tag will show all the Ensemble's members.

Each guest's first sub-block is "Reception Plot" — who came, why, and how it ended. Under the main characters is **the Reverberation Ensemble's roster** with their instruments.

nodes.Name: Crosshair Office
nodes.Desc: The gunners **Tamaki**, **Stephan** and **Liwei**, with expensive bullets from Atelier Logic. A job personally from **Eugene** (Shi, Section 2): wipe out the parishioners of **the Church of Gears** and take its leader **Eileen** alive.

Pec.Name: ＋ Reception Plot
Pec.Desc:
At Eileen's service, a chair determines "which gear" a parishioner will become (a Thinking Gear or a Flesh Gear), and the gears are inserted into the back of the head; on Eileen's own head is the "thinking gear" of her late father, a gear researcher. The gears predict bullet trajectories for her, but Tamaki still wounds her in the shoulder. **The Blue Reverberation** appears, deflects the bullets and leads Eileen away ("I've waited for you all my life"), leaving her in **Pluto**'s care. The cornered gunners sign the Invitation — with Argalia's own pen. "It was as if someone all-knowing was toying with us." Stephan, cursing the world to the very end, becomes a book.

Roland: firearms are hardly used — the Head's tax on weapons and licenses for workshops; two full magazines cost as much as a decent gun.

Pec.Name: From the transcript: the start of the reception
Pec.Desc:
> **Tamaki (Crosshair Fixer):** So this is Eileen, the leader of the 'Church of Gears' cult…
> **Stephan (Crosshair Fixer):** I've seen all kinds of gears, but a "thinking" one is something new.
> **Liwei (Crosshair Fixer):** This must be the ritual the rumors talk about.
> **Stephan (Crosshair Fixer):** All right, we'll see. Section Head Eugene of the Shi Association asked us to…
> **Tamaki (Crosshair Fixer):** Kill ten of the Church's parishioners, neutralize their leader and take her under control.
> **Liwei (Crosshair Fixer):** Wait for my signal…

nodes.Name: Philip — The Crying Children
nodes.Desc: A Grade 5 Fixer of the Dawn Office, a master of Sangwa Cha. The Office's only survivor after the Library; he blames himself, but according to Oscar he hides selfishness behind "for the sake of others". Broken by Oswald's illusions, he Distorts to Pluto's "singing": a weeping wax statue and three children — the Blind, the Deaf and the Mute. He kills 80,000 in V Corp's Nest; Argalia wrests him away from Liu. The last to join the Ensemble.

Pec.Name: Philip's E.G.O
Pec.Desc:
In the Library, Philip's E.G.O manifests for the first time — after he admits to himself:

> **Philip:** Everything I did was only for myself. For myself and no one else. For myself, whose sorrow is greater than anyone's…

He decides to carry the burden of sorrow himself from now on — "since fate has granted me this power".

nodes.Name: Eileen — The Church of Gears
nodes.Desc: The leader of the Church of Gears: she inserts gears into the backs of parishioners' heads, and her late father's "thinking gear" tells her the future. The Blue Reverberation saves her from the Crosshair Office — she "had waited for him all her life". Probably the first to join the Ensemble: she sends Elena and Ji-hyun to UW-212, is present at Thelma's execution and accompanies Argalia to the Outskirts ("clockwork is the same gears").

nodes.Name: Oswald — The Ringmaster
nodes.Desc: The lemon-colored clown of the 8 O'Clock Circus, who talks nonsense; "Miss Sun" promised to make his dream come true. He turns people into "human flowers" and performers (Noah with many eyes, the enormous Emma). He breaks Philip with illusions; Pluto calls him to "the greatest stage". The circus is smashed by Liu's Section 1, but Oswald leaves with Argalia. He bears no personal enmity toward the Library or Roland.

nodes.Name: Ji-hyun — The Puppeteer
nodes.Desc: The "Doctor" on UW-212: together with Elena he stitches passengers into the City of Love, then turns first class into sentient puppets on strings. He believes "someone is holding all of us on invisible strings". He knows the truth about WARP. By Hana's estimate — an Urban Nightmare on its way to Star of the City; he kidnapped the Sweepers' children.

nodes.Name: Elena — Bloody Night
nodes.Desc: A Bloodfiend who became a Distortion even before the White Nights; a former Star of the City who was once defeated by Roland and Angelica. Disguised as a nurse, she creates the City of Love and becomes Tomerry's "mother". Cold and caustic; Ji-hyun suspects she used to be an actress.

nodes.Name: Tanya — The Hour of the Wolf
nodes.Desc: A former member of the Middle: a wolf's head and a black cloak. Rough; she wants "a heap of cash" and a life in the Nest, but "music comes first". She takes the Nuovo Fabric from the Kurokumo for the conductor's outfit, kills Sweeper families and drives the Syndicates into the Library, clearing Nest L of the Fingers.

nodes.Name: Pluto — Yesterday's Promise
nodes.Desc: A polite "skeleton", a former Fixer with magical powers. His contracts hide conditions in fine print and let him take anything from a violator (Bada's heart). He keeps Elena's and Ji-hyun's consciousness in stasis, teleports allies and offers Philip "to fulfill his dream". His name is tied to the Urban Plague "Yesterday's Promise" and the "Thousand Needles" case.

nodes.Name: Greta — The Eighth Chef
nodes.Desc: The last survivor of **the Eight Chefs** — a gastronomic Star of the City that Pierre dreamed of. She helps the Ensemble collect bodies; unlike most members, she has almost no connection to Roland. The transcripts in the lore folder contain none of her scenes — the information comes from retellings.

nodes.Name: Bremen
nodes.Desc: A fusion of three Distorted founders of **the Musicians of Bremen** (according to the transcripts the founders are Meow, Cock-a-doodle-doo, Woof and Hee-Haw; three of them "left to prepare for the next performance"). Their idol is the Pianist, whom Roland killed. Helps the Ensemble collect the Thumb's bodies.

nodes.Name: Dante
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Manager of the LCB department. The protagonist of Limbus Company.
- **Appearance:** Instead of a head — a red clock with golden hands (between 9 and 10), black-and-gold flame.
- **Personality:** Timid, compassionate, responsible. Gains confidence.
- **Key trauma:** Complete amnesia. Before the operation he was a "big shot" in the City. He was attacked by the Serpent's agents (the Panther, the Lion, the Wolf) while capturing something important.
- **Development:** From a passive observer to the Sinners' moral compass. He learns to make hard decisions as a manager. He becomes a "compass" for Ishmael and Don Quixote. Uses Pigritia, Superbia and new powers, including summoning Identities without Mephistopheles (Canto IX).
- **Abilities:** Resurrecting the Sinners (turning the clock hands), Pigritia (slowing), Superbia (story-related), summoning an army of Identities. Can find "stars" (Golden Boughs or save points). Counteracts the paling effect. In Canto IX he shows the ability of remote viewing and of forcibly summoning (teleporting) the Sinners.
- **Physiology:** Doesn't breathe; has a beating heart. Makes inhuman sounds (ticking), but the Sinners understand him. Everyone else hears only ticking.
- **Symbolism:** "Dante" — the author of "The Divine Comedy". The clock — the Doomsday Clock. In the Prologue he is lost in a "dark forest" (Selva Oscura), pursued by three beasts.
- **Quote:** *"I don't remember who I am. But I remember that I must protect them."* / *"Follow your star."*

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc: Dante keeps notes on his PDA so as not to forget the City again. Many nodes on these screens contain them in the "Dante's Notes" sub-block.

nodes.Name: 01 · Yi Sang
nodes.Desc:
- **Appearance:** Dark brown hair, ragged bangs, lean, tired.
- **Personality:** Melancholic, introverted, poetic speech. In the past, a brilliant scientist.
- **Key trauma:** A member of the League of Nine (Literati). Considers himself "nobody", torn and broken. Creator of the "Mirror" technology, which made it possible to look into parallel worlds. The League's betrayal and destruction left him hollow.
- **Development:** Chooses memory over oblivion. Admits that his invention was meant for connecting people. With the help of Dante and his comrades, he gains the will to "fly".
- **Abilities:** Two daggers, E.G.O Crow's Eye View / Garden of Thorns.
- **Connections:** A close friend of Dongrang, Dongbaek's beloved/friend, Gubo's rival. Canto VI mentions his connection to research on transferring Identities, which N Corp used for the "dough".
- **Symbolism:** The pen name of the Korean surrealist poet Kim Hae-gyeong. "Wings" as a symbol of freedom.
- **Quote:** *"Another life. Another mistake. When will it end."* / *"All I wished for… Just once… I wished to fly."*

Pec.Name: Literary source
Pec.Desc: "Wings" and the poetry of Yi Sang (Kim Hae-gyeong). Melancholy, poeticism, a longing for flight.

Pec.Name: Central chapter
Pec.Desc: Canto IV

nodes.Name: 02 · Faust
nodes.Desc:
- **Appearance:** White hair, glasses, left eye hidden.
- **Personality:** Analytical, cold, speaks of herself in the third person. Has access to the collective mind of all the Fausts of the Mirror Worlds. Claims that "Faust knows everything". Helps Dante settle into the role of manager.
- **Key trauma:** Sacrificed her emotions for knowledge.
- **Development:** A slow return of emotion. She knows more about the Sinners' pasts than she says, but doesn't reveal it due to certain restrictions.
- **Abilities:** A long straight sword, E.G.O Das Erzählen / Der Schütz.
- **Symbolism:** Goethe's "Faust" — a deal with the devil for knowledge. Mephistopheles is her creation.
- **Quote:** *"Faust knows everything."* / *"Follow your star."*

Pec.Name: Literary source
Pec.Desc: "Faust" — Goethe. A deal with the devil for the sake of knowledge.

nodes.Name: 03 · Don Quixote
nodes.Desc:
- **Appearance:** A blonde bob, caramel eyes (when suppressed). True form — red eyes, a dark coat, a Bloodfiend's pale skin. Wears the red sneakers Rocinante, which suppress her nature.
- **Personality (Don):** Naive and passionate, believes in justice, speaks in archaic English. Adores Fixers, especially Siegfried.
- **Personality (Sancho):** Indifferent, pessimistic, devoted to her Father.
- **True identity:** Sancho, the Second Kin (child) of the Progenitor Bloodfiend **Don Quixote**. More than 200 years ago, he turned her from a hopeless human. Together with her Father she built La Manchaland and went on adventures. After the park's collapse and her Father's imprisonment, she drank from the River of Oblivion and forgot her past, taking the name Don Quixote. Rocinante (her Father's shoes) suppresses her Bloodfiend nature.
- **Development:** In Canto VII she regains her memory and accepts her past as Sancho and her Father's dream of justice — not as a blind copy, but as her own path of riding forward with the Sinners. In Intervallo V it turns out she carries the burden of all the dead Kin and needs artificial blood.
- **Abilities:** The lance SUEÑO IMPOSIBLE, Bloodfiend strength, manipulation of hardened blood. E.G.O La Sangre de Sancho.
- **Symbolism:** Cervantes's "Don Quixote" — idealism vs. reality. Sancho Panza — the loyal squire who became a knight.
- **Quote:** *"Insooth! Justice always prevails!"* / *"I, Sancho, declare upon my honor: this lance shall put an end to this rotting, idle dream!"*

Pec.Name: Literary source
Pec.Desc: "Don Quixote" — Cervantes. Idealism vs. reality. Sancho is the loyal squire.

Pec.Name: Central chapter
Pec.Desc: Canto VII

nodes.Name: 04 · Ryōshū
nodes.Desc:
- **Appearance:** Short black hair, red eyes (augmentations), smokes.
- **Personality:** Taciturn, aggressive, artistic. Speaks in abbreviations. Takes pleasure in cruelty.
- **Key trauma:** She was raised in the Spider's House as a perfect weapon — "a sword that cleaves all". Her daughter Araya was used as a leash. Ryōshū cut out the tongue of her mother, the Pinky's Nursefather (Shiomi Yoru), and left the House, hiding her daughter in a time vault. But the daughter was extracted and turned into the new Star of Dihuei. In Canto IX, Ryōshū, not recognizing her, kills her own daughter. Her sword Arayashiki erases memory. In the end she loses all memories of Araya, but keeps the sheath with the red thread.
- **Development:** From a lone killer to a mother who accepts her bond with her daughter as eternal and unbreakable.
- **Abilities:** Ōdachi (used as a club), the sword Arayashiki (erases concepts and memory). E.G.O Red Eyes / Forest for the Flames.
- **Symbolism:** Akutagawa's "Hell Screen" — obsession with art. Yoshihide — an artist willing to sacrifice his daughter.
- **Quote:** *"Other lesser painters are such mediocrities..."* / *"Ya.T.L."*

Pec.Name: Literary source
Pec.Desc: "Hell Screen" — Akutagawa. Obsession with "art" (Yoshihide, who sacrificed his daughter).

Pec.Name: Central chapter
Pec.Desc: Canto IX

Pec.Name: ＋ Intervallo VII
Pec.Desc: Arayashiki's sheath — **"Araya"** — has developed a will of its own: it chooses which memories Ryōshū loses. Ryōshū sacrifices memory to cut a way out of the Corridors. Émile Benoît (the Ring's Fauvists) taught her art in the Spider's House and tried to recruit her.

nodes.Name: 05 · Meursault
nodes.Desc:
- **Appearance:** The tallest; short black hair, green eyes, an expressionless face.
- **Personality:** Taciturn, literal, driven by logic. A former N Corp employee, but doesn't share Nagel und Hammer's fanaticism. Reveals a talent for cooking.
- **Key trauma:** A former N Corp Taboo Hunter. Killed his mother.
- **Development:** Showing initiative and emotion (cooking).
- **Abilities:** SOLEIL gauntlets, hypersensitive perception, E.G.O Chains of Others / Regret.
- **Symbolism:** Camus's "The Stranger" — the emotionally detached Meursault.
- **Quote:** *"Today, my mother died. Or maybe it was yesterday. I don't know."*

Pec.Name: Literary source
Pec.Desc: "The Stranger" — Camus. Emotional detachment.

Pec.Name: ＋ Intervallo VII and Canto X
Pec.Desc:
- At the end of Intervallo VII he is arrested by N Corp: he had been banished from District 14, and he faces a review of his death sentence.
- A former member of the service team of **Grand Magasin Sisyphe**.
- His mother — a Giant of Sisyphe (the "Voice" of Le Rouge) — became a Distortion and sought death; Meursault killed her at her wish.
- His former lover is the Giant **Jeanne**.
- The chapter's song is "Rendezvous". In Season 8, Meursault received a new E.G.O rather than an Identity.

nodes.Name: 06 · Hong Lu
nodes.Desc:
- **Appearance:** Long black hair with a turquoise ribbon. Heterochromia: his right eye is black, his left turquoise (a prosthetic camera, the "jade").
- **Personality:** Curious, kind, detached. Asks naive questions, often inappropriate ones.
- **Key trauma:** His jade eye is a camera for the family elders. A witness to the massacre of the Kong family. His family (the Jia) is engaged in a brutal struggle over the inheritance. In Canto VIII he finally makes his own choice, refusing to be merely "the jade", and helps his sister Jia Xichun become Hierarch.
- **Development:** From a passive observer to an active participant who accepts his emotions and desires.
- **Abilities:** The guandao "Illusory Land of the Great Void", E.G.O Land of Illusion.
- **Symbolism:** "Dream of the Red Chamber" — Jia Baoyu with jade in his mouth.
- **Quote:** *"I won't be your plaything anymore."* / *"In happiness, in anger, in sorrow, in joy… I will still cast my life into the vast world."*

Pec.Name: Literary source
Pec.Desc: "Dream of the Red Chamber" — Cao Xueqin. Family drama, jade.

Pec.Name: Central chapter
Pec.Desc: Canto VIII

nodes.Name: 07 · Heathcliff
nodes.Desc:
- **Appearance:** 180 cm, messy dark brown hair, swarthy skin, scars.
- **Personality:** Hot-tempered, impulsive. Beneath the rudeness — loyalty. Often threatens to bash someone's head in, including Dante's.
- **Key trauma:** An adopted child at Wuthering Heights. The loss of his beloved Catherine, who married Linton Edgar but loved only Heathcliff. She died trying to "fix" their fate in the Mirror Worlds.
- **Development:** Goes through a Distortion in Canto VI, triggered by the news of Catherine's death. Accepts his mistakes and his unwillingness to talk about his feelings. Gives up revenge, choosing memory and the hope of Catherine's return. Grows closer to the team.
- **Abilities:** A metal bat (engraved REVENGE → REmember), E.G.O Bodysack / Ya Śūnyatā Tad Rūpam.
- **Symbolism:** Brontë's "Wuthering Heights" — Heathcliff, obsessed with love.
- **Quote:** *"Even if you are forgotten by the world... I will definitely bring you back."* / *"I'm not the type to abandon family."*

Pec.Name: Literary source
Pec.Desc: "Wuthering Heights" — Brontë. Obsessive love, revenge, a ghost.

Pec.Name: Central chapter
Pec.Desc: Canto VI

nodes.Name: 08 · Ishmael
nodes.Desc:
- **Appearance:** 172 cm, long red hair (the color of sunset), freckles.
- **Personality:** Level-headed, critical, with an obsessive-compulsive need for control. She went through the hardships of service on the whaling ship "Pequod".
- **Key trauma:** A survivor of the "Pequod". Obsessed with revenge on Captain Ahab for the death of the crew, especially her friend Queequeg.
- **Development:** Lets go of revenge and finds her own path. Calls Dante a "compass". Accepts her bloody past and decides to go on living as LCB's First Mate.
- **Abilities:** The mace and shield HEARSE, a harpoon, E.G.O Snagharpoon.
- **Symbolism:** Melville's "Moby-Dick" — the survivor Ishmael.
- **Quote:** *"This is how I'll chart my own path..."*

Pec.Name: Literary source
Pec.Desc: "Moby-Dick" — Melville. Obsession with revenge, survival, whaling.

Pec.Name: Central chapter
Pec.Desc: Canto V

nodes.Name: 09 · Rodion
nodes.Desc:
- **Appearance:** 180 cm, long copper hair, a heart tattoo.
- **Personality:** Cheerful, lazy, a gambler. Beneath the mask — guilt and insecurity.
- **Key trauma:** She killed a moneylender, hoping to become "special" and save her neighbors. This led to reprisals by the Middle and the destruction of her district. She was a member of the Yurodivy led by Sonya, but parted ways with it over methods.
- **Development:** Understands that the past cannot be erased. Rejects Sonya's utopia, preferring reality. Believes in herself, even without "wish stickers".
- **Abilities:** The axe RASKOL, E.G.O What is Cast.
- **Symbolism:** "Crime and Punishment" — Raskolnikov.
- **Quote:** *"If she could forget everything, and begin afresh."*

Pec.Name: Literary source
Pec.Desc: "Crime and Punishment" — Dostoevsky. Murder for the sake of an idea.

Pec.Name: Central chapter
Pec.Desc: Canto II

nodes.Name: 10 · Sinclair
nodes.Desc:
- **Appearance:** 168 cm, light ash-blond hair, large blue eyes, fragile. On his forehead is the Mark, which awakens at critical moments.
- **Personality:** Anxious, insecure, empathetic. Carries deep trauma within him.
- **Key trauma:** His friend Kromer manipulated him to gain access to his home, after which N Corp's Inquisition destroyed his family. He survived only because Kromer deemed him a "hero" (he had refused prosthetics). Guilt and fear haunt him.
- **Development:** Accepts his "darkness" and finds the courage to stand up to Kromer. In Canto VII he shows determination to bring Don Quixote back, taking on the role of the Knight of the White Moon in Sanson's play to get through to her. In Canto IX his Mark fully awakens, summoning a future version of himself — a veteran of the coming "Second Smoke War".
- **Abilities:** The sword "Der Fluch der bösen Tat", E.G.O Branch of Knowledge / Lantern. The Mark lets him summon an Identity from the future.
- **Symbolism:** Hesse's "Demian" — loss of innocence, finding oneself.
- **Quote:** *"The world... is divided into light and darkness..."*

Pec.Name: Literary source
Pec.Desc: "Demian" — Hesse. Loss of innocence, Kromer's influence.

Pec.Name: Central chapter
Pec.Desc: Canto III

nodes.Name: 11 · Outis
nodes.Desc:
- **Appearance:** 175 cm, short brown hair, yellow eyes, dark skin, earrings, a watch on her wrist.
- **Personality:** Strict, disciplined, commanding. Shows exaggerated respect for Dante and often flatters him. A former soldier.
- **Key trauma:** A classified past; a veteran of the Smoke War.
- **Development:** In Canto VII she shows extreme caution and suspicion toward Don Quixote-Sancho, putting Dante's safety above all else.
- **Abilities:** The kopis sword "Ουτις" (Nobody), E.G.O To Páthos Máthos / Ebony Stem.
- **Symbolism:** Homer's "Odyssey" — Odysseus, who called himself "Nobody".
- **Quote:** *"I am... nothing at all."*

Pec.Name: Literary source
Pec.Desc: "The Odyssey" — Homer. The longing to return home (nostos).

nodes.Name: 12 · Gregor
nodes.Desc:
- **Appearance:** 167 cm, dark brown hair in a ponytail, glasses. His right arm is an insect limb capable of transformation.
- **Personality:** Friendly, easygoing, with cynical humor. Often serves as the team's "ordinary person" voice. Traumatized by his past as a "war hero" and symbol of G Corp.
- **Key trauma:** A veteran of the Smoke War. A G Corp test subject. His mother, Hermann, ordered his arm replaced with a bug prosthetic. Ten years later he still can't shake off the stigma. In Canto IX his true nature is revealed — he is not just a soldier with a bug arm, but the host of the dormant **Cockroach Emperor**, G Corp's fourth unfinished weapon. Under the influence of rage, this form awakens.
- **Development:** Accepts his nature as both a human and a weapon. Mourns Yuri and remembers his sister. After the Cockroach Emperor incident, he is only barely returned to human form.
- **Abilities:** The UNGEZIEFER arm (transformation, regeneration), the Cockroach Emperor form (overwhelming regeneration, swarm, destructive power). E.G.O The Solemn Lament / Lantern.
- **Symbolism:** Kafka's "The Metamorphosis" — Gregor Samsa.
- **Quote:** *"As I awoke from unsettling dreams, I had transformed into some hideous pest."*

Pec.Name: Literary source
Pec.Desc: "The Metamorphosis" — Kafka. Transformation into an insect, alienation.

Pec.Name: Central chapter
Pec.Desc: Canto I

nodes.Name: Vergilius — The Red Gaze
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Guide of the LCB department. The Color Fixer "the Red Gaze". In the past — operator of the "April" Office.
- **Appearance:** Short gray hair, red eyes (glowing in battle). A scarred face, with a scar running across his entire face. An earring in his left ear. A black leather jacket, gray trousers.
- **Personality:** Outwardly cold, harsh, depressive. Beneath the mask — deep care for those close to him. He had a dream of destroying "the shell of the City", but buried it. Strict with the Sinners, but recognizes their potential. Refuses to submit to the Wings and criticizes Siegfried for doing so.
- **Key trauma:** The destruction of his orphanage by the Distortion Tomerry (the deaths of children, including Garnet in his arms). The abduction of Lapis and her transformation into Charon. The destruction of his Office by N Corp's Taboo Hunters.
- **Abilities:**
  - **The Red Gaze:** Seeing the flow of events, foresight.
  - Tremendous speed, strength and endurance. Skilled in acupuncture. A gladius with a heating element that cuts through buildings.
  - **Sin (心):** Two rings of light that enhance attacks, weapons and E.G.O.
  - **E.G.O — Lavacrum Sanguinis:** A cloak and gladius of blood, a pauldron, a crown of thorns. Manipulation of liquid blood (creating weapons, merging with puddles). Demonstrated in Intervallo V and Canto IX.
- **Weaknesses:** Emotional attachment to those close to him. His E.G.O depends on the presence of liquid blood.
- **Relationships:** The orphanage children (family), Garnet (student), Lapis/Charon, the "April" Office, Tomerry (enmity), the Ring Finger (enmity), N Corp (enmity), Iori (enmity), Roland (partnership), Faust (partnership), Dante (charge), Olga (acquaintance).
- **Symbolism:** The name comes from the Roman poet Virgil, Dante's guide through Hell. His E.G.O is inspired by Roman themes. "Gaze" also means "immortal poet".
- **Restrictions in LCB:** His contract forbids him from interfering in missions unless Dante is in danger. In Cantos VI and IX he broke the contract, which had consequences.
- **Quote:** *"I'm just a guide. Don't expect more from me."* / *"I wanted to destroy the shell of the City... to wipe everything out, so that in the end a new world could be born."*

Pec.Name: About the version with the orphanage and Lapis
Pec.Desc: The story of the orphanage, Tomerry and Lapis in these notes is taken from Project Moon's novella "Leviathan" (not from the games); these names do not appear in the Limbus Company transcripts (Cantos I–IX). For the campaign — at the GM's discretion.

Pec.Name: ＋ Leviathan (novella)
Pec.Desc:
- Before Limbus — an independent Fixer with his own Office, attached to which he ran an orphanage.
- He lost the Office and the children because of **the Ring**; the orphanage was attacked by **Iori and Tomerry**.
- After the events of "Leviathan", he joined Limbus Company together with Charon.
- His red eyes originally belonged to **the Progenitor (First Kindred) Bloodfiend** — they were transplanted.
- The only time Vergilius smiled was when the team made him dress up as Santa Claus (before "Leviathan").

nodes.Name: Charon
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Driver of the bus Mephistopheles.
- **Appearance:** Long silver hair, grayish skin, dull gray eyes. A tall top hat, a gray-green dress.
- **Personality:** Childish, detached. Speaks of herself in the third person and uses onomatopoeia ("vroom-vroom"). Loves sweets, although in the past she preferred bitter things. Often hums songs that reflect her emotional state (especially when she's sad).
- **Key trauma:** Her personality was overwritten through the "Glass Window". Her real name is Lapis; she was a child in Vergilius's orphanage. The daughter of a syndicate boss whom Vergilius destroyed.
- **Past:** Her best friend was Garnet. She was rescued by Vergilius and lived in the orphanage. After Tomerry's attack she was abducted and turned into Charon. In Canto IX she was kidnapped by Valencina, but later rescued.
- **Role in the story:** The reason for Vergilius's deal with Limbus Company — the promise to restore Lapis's personality.
- **Symbolism:** "Charon" — the ferryman of souls across the Styx. "Mephistopheles" — the bus, named after the demon from "Faust".
- **Quote:** *"Charon wants to drive. Vroom-vroom!"*

Pec.Name: About the Lapis version
Pec.Desc: The name "Lapis" and the connection to Vergilius's orphanage come from Project Moon's novella "Leviathan"; they are not mentioned in the Limbus Company transcripts.

Pec.Name: ＋ Leviathan (novella)
Pec.Desc:
- Lapis's father was a syndicate boss known for his love of his daughter; Vergilius killed him under contract and hid Lapis in the orphanage.
- The orphanage was attacked by Iori and Tomerry; Lapis survived. Six months later she was abducted by **the Ring**.
- The experiments with the **"Glass Window"** (refractive indices) were carried out by **Azea** and **Jumsun**. Garnet, trying to save her, turned into a gem-like cocoon from ultra-high refraction.
- Lapis's personality was overwritten with an Identity from another Mirror World — this is how Charon came to be.

nodes.Name: Mephistopheles
nodes.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.17*
  - This is our mobile office, our home and our vehicle. The Sinners and I eat, sleep, go to work and fight here.
  - It looks like a mix between a train and a bus, but for some reason everyone calls it a bus. I guess that makes sense, given the name of our department.
  - Apparently it runs on an engine developed by Faust. Everything special about Mephistopheles comes from its engine. It not only powers the vehicle so the bus can take us places, but also lets us extract Identities from other worlds. We can also enter the rest rooms or training halls through the back door, all thanks to the engine.
  - It seems "Mephistopheles" can be upgraded and fitted with additional features. I think one of the Sinners said it's as if the bus itself is growing or something like that. (Though I don't remember who said it.)

Pec.Name: The Back Door
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.17*
  - A door ... at the back of "Mephistopheles". Behind it is a corridor full of doors leading to each Sinner's personal quarters or rest rooms.
  - The Sinners tell me each room has a unique appearance and a different interior design. Faust explained that they may be reflections of each Sinner's soul or memories.
  - There are more people on this bus than the number of doors we actually use, but the ones we use can lead to different rooms depending on who opens them first. For example, two Sinners could enter the same door only to end up in different rooms.
  - The doors bear names indicating whose rooms they lead to.
  - There are also doors that simply lead to the other side of the walls they're on.
- *Entry #2 · 984.5.18*
  - The door to my room opens into a corridor leading to the Mirror Dungeons and the Lightmining Dungeons.
  - I can see that the corridor beyond the back door extends past the area we use, but someone has hung a sign there warning us not to enter.
  - We nearly had a serious accident when Heathcliff tried to cross the threshold despite the warnings.
  - Something tells me there are dangerous objects or territories in the deeper parts of the corridor. Heathcliff's panicked face is still fresh in my memory…
  - And Faust's uncharacteristic insistence, too.
  - Ryōshū calls this endless space "the Corridor". I can tell she's not talking about just any corridor. But what else could she be talking about...?

Pec.Name: Mirror Dungeons
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.18*
  - One of the types of dungeons we can enter through the back door.
  - As soon as we enter, on the left will be the Lightmining training ticket, and on the right the Lightmining thread.
  - It seems we can gather resources to strengthen the Sinners by fighting Abnormalities or enemies we've faced in the past.
  - To enter them we have to spend Enkephalin, since running them also requires Mephistopheles's engine.
- *Entry #2 · 984.5.19*
  - According to Faust, Mephistopheles's engine actively stabilizes the Mirror Dungeons that we're allowed to enter through the back door.
  - Their ultimate purpose seems to be to improve my abilities and those of the Sinners. Faust recommended we visit the back-door Mirror Dungeons often, even if it means spending the Enkephalin used to run the engine.

Pec.Name: Lightmining Dungeons
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.18*
  - These are "dungeons" we can reach through the back door.
  - The corridor leading to the Mirror Dungeon is made of cold, heavy metal. It instills a different kind of unease than our usual wooden doors and corridors.
  - At first only one door led to the Mirror Dungeon, while the others were closed. But at some point a second door opened, so now we have two.
  - Given that Faust told us when the doors would open, I assume there are special conditions for opening them. Or maybe they follow a certain schedule.
  - Whenever I enter the Mirror Dungeon, I find myself in a place resembling misty outer space. I can choose which Sinners to take with me into each of the Mirror Dungeons.

Pec.Name: Refraction Railway
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.5.19*
  - A place we can reach through the back door.
  - Gregor tells me it looks a lot like the City's subway stations.
  - It looks rather dilapidated, as if it's been standing here for a long time. On the tracks stands something that looks like a subway train.
  - The subway train somewhat resembles our Mephistopheles, except that it looks like it's been left to rot for a long time.
  - The subway train didn't budge with only one Sinner in it. But when the other Sinners joined, the door closed by itself and took us somewhere.
  - The Sinners told me it brought us to the next stop.
  - What I can tell from my experience here so far is that each station led to a different environment, some of which we had visited in the past.
  - The door behind us closes as soon as we step off the subway train at a new station. Then an Abnormality or some enemies attack us for no reason, leading to an immediate fight.
  - As soon as the fight ends, the subway train's doors open again. Once we're all aboard, it takes us to the next stop. Rinse and repeat until we reach the terminus.
- *Entry #2 · 984.5.20*
  - Faust told me they're like... "simulations, or a series of locations created to improve our abilities, akin to the functions of the back door's Mirror Dungeons or Lightmining Dungeons."
  - That makes sense. We faced enemies like Kromer there, but all they did was fight us. Maybe it's just a simulation after all.
  - I'm not sure whether it's a very realistic simulation or whether it really takes us to where the Abnormalities dwell. I still don't know enough about this place to say for sure.
  - Once we reached the end of the subway line, we were allowed to return to the bus through one of the stations.
  - One of the Sinners was furious, complaining that it had sent us on a wild goose chase for absolutely nothing... until he saw Faust open the "Lost and Found" box and take out a whole pile of resources.

- *Entry #1 · 984.5.20*
  - Although it's closed now, we've been to this station before.
  - The whole place had a bluish tint.
  - We ran into some familiar faces and fought them, but many of the Abnormalities there belonged to entities we haven't yet encountered in Lobotomy Corporation's branches.
  - I recall that we had previously interacted with some of these Abnormalities in the Mirror Dungeons. Faust says our interactions with them in the Mirror Dungeons happened through some kind of ... spaces. That is, their mental spaces and worlds.
  - I'm guessing the railway happened to stop in one of those worlds?
  - Then maybe it's not a simulation? I don't know…

- *Entry #1 · 984.5.21*
  - This place has a greenish tint, unlike Line 1 with its blue tint. I bet the next one will be a different color. And so on and so forth.
  - Once again we encountered several more Abnormalities we'd only had a glimpse of before.
  - Everyone was delighted to see that Line 2 has far fewer stations than Line 1… Until Yi Sang noticed some symbols on the wall and suggested we were supposed to repeat this line several times.
  - With each new cycle a new station was added, though we still had to go through the earlier stations first.
  - Around our fourth cycle, Heathcliff began loudly complaining that he was sick of doing the same thing over, and over, and over again. Some of the Sinners also seemed to be growing restless, but a crisis was averted thanks to Yi Sang, who said the sign seemed to indicate that the fifth Cycle was the last one they had to complete.
  - Once we completed our fifth cycle, we were able to find a large number of different resources in the "Lost and Found". As far as I can tell, each line will have different routes and conditions for completing it.

- *Entry #1 · 984.11.12*
  - A railway glowing with orange light. Inside it says this is "Line 3".
  - As I predicted, each new railway seems to have its own color. I'm sure the next one will be different too.
  - The subway train followed a loop and stopped at every station it passed. There were rest stations along the way, so it wasn't as bad as the one we went through last time.
  - Once again we discovered Abnormalities we'd never seen before. If things really are as Faust said ... if the subway trains really stop in the worlds of the Abnormalities... maybe we can go even further?
- *Entry #2 · 984.11.13*
  - Going through the Mirror Dungeons, it's as if we're wading through an abstract ocean of a world... but the Refraction Railways have a more detailed look, something like a corridor.
  - So many unknowns. Who built the stations? Who puts these rewards in the Lost and Found? Where does this subway train that looks a bit like Mephistopheles come from? How was it even placed on the subway tracks?

- *Entry #1 · 984.12.10*
  - A bluish-tinted station decorated in the style of a banquet hall.
  - Several stations followed one after another without a break, and we were attacked by Lesser Sins that looked exactly like the Sinners' Identities and E.G.O. No wonder the Sinners were exhausted by the end. Faust called them Lesser Sins of Envy… or Lesser Sins of Jealousy.
  - Fortunately, this railway was kind enough to give us breathers between waves of enemies. And since we managed to break through several stations at once, some of the Sinners said this station was better than the previous ones because at least it was over quickly.
  - But it makes me wonder. What happened to all those Lesser Sins of Jealousy that boarded the train first? Were they killed at the Bound King's banquet? Or maybe they're still wandering around the stations somewhere? Who knows.

- *Entry #1 · 984.12.28*
  - A purple-colored railway. It was labeled "Line 5".
  - As on our previous railway, chains of battles continued across consecutive stations, and we even encountered new individual Lesser Sins. Some of them seemed to reflect relatively new abilities… I wonder how they work?
  - This railway started with two sections, crossed in the middle and joined into one. It was rather annoying to be locked out of Identity cards I had already used in the second section.
  - Between the sections there was this strange… thing that granted the Sinners power. We had to choose carefully which one to pick, since it seemed to affect not only the Sinners but our enemies as well.

nodes.Name: Limbus Company
nodes.Desc: The company that inherited L Corp's technology. Each department pursues its own goal; Dante sees no common goal. The company is building a reputation as a service for suppressing, capturing and preventing **Distortions**.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- Limbus Company is where I work.
- This name should be closely connected to me... but it's also the hardest for me to describe.
Because... they don't tell me anything.
I didn't join the company of my own free will. At first I thought the company's goal was to find and retrieve Golden Boughs, but it seems that's only the goal of *our* department, not of the whole company.

- As far as I can tell, each department has its own tasks, and there is no common goal pursued by all.
It seems the company has substantial backing. The team has never lacked support. (Though Rodya seems to have something to say about the food.)

- The Sinners and I ... well, the "Limbus Company Bus" is mainly concerned with finding Golden Boughs, but Limbus Company is trying to build its reputation as a company that provides Distortion suppression, capture and prevention services.

nodes.Name: LCB
nodes.Desc: The Limbus Company Bus: Dante, Vergilius, Charon and the 12 Sinners. Searches for **Golden Boughs** in buried L Corp branches.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.20*
  - Limbus Company Bus.
  - The name comes from the fact that we travel by bus.
  It feels like they didn't put much thought into the name, but the other departments aren't any more sophisticated.
  - The team includes me and those called... Sinners(?), who sit behind me (I'm still not used to that word).
  The team's goal is to retrieve things called "Golden Boughs" from buried branches of "Lobotomy", or whatever "L Corp" stands for.
  I don't know what these Golden Boughs are, but judging by how it sounds, it's some kind of physical object that looks like a tree branch. (I'll make a separate note once I learn more.)
- *Entry #2 · 984.4.21*
  – It seems searching for Golden Boughs isn't the only job.
  On the way to our company's goal, we are assigned any tasks that require the unique abilities of me or the Sinners.
  - I'm curious how this company came about and why the Sinners and I have to do this, but Faust won't tell me.
  She says my clearance level is too low to receive the information, but it seems she knows something more.
  Why does a "Sinner" know more than me, if I'm the "Executive Manager"...?

nodes.Name: LCCB
nodes.Desc: The Preliminary Cleanup: reconnaissance and preparation before LCB operations. The Preliminary Observation unit is the most numerous and the lowest-paid. Its manager is **Saude**.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.20*
  - Limbus Company Cleanup.
  - The name comes from the fact that they "clean up" everything in their path.
   They were created to help the bus team.
   Unlike the Sinners, I can't revive them with my power, which explains the care they take with their weapons and gear.
  - It seems the department is split into 2 teams. The Preliminary Cleanup (LCCB) handles reconnaissance and preparation, while the Final Cleanup (LCCA) handles collecting and cleaning up whatever we've finished with.
  Although I haven't met them yet, it seems the teams are divided into several sections, judging by Vergilius's phone calls.
  - I met Effie and Saude from the Preliminary Observation subsection of the Preliminary Cleanup.
  - I asked them a couple of questions; when I have time, I'll try to write down what I learned.
  - I also wanted to ask what exactly they do, but was interrupted by Don Quixote making a scene.
  - Effie opened up that people in the Preliminary Observation subsection are paid the least of all the Preliminary Cleanup subsections. From what I've heard, their department has the most employees compared to the others, and they may be considered expendable.
  - ...Effie and Saude died during our operation.
- *Entry #2 · 984.11.8*
  - Limbus Company Final Cleanup. The Final Cleanup team doesn't seem to think very highly of me and the Sinners. They look down on practically all of LCB.
  - They probably think the company gives us special treatment or something. They think we have it easy? Maybe they should try dying over and over if they really think we're a bunch of spoiled babies.
   -... Or feeling the pain of death again, and again, and again. Endlessly.
- *Entry #2 · 984.11.10*
  - Saude is alive! I'm happy to make this correction.
   - It seems she recovered perfectly well after what happened and was promoted to manager. I know what happened weighed heavily on Sinclair's mind. I hope this eases Sinclair's heart at least a little.
  - The Preliminary Cleanup team, like Saude and Pilot, at least worked side by side with us... But that woman from LCCA, Kaiman, treated us and LCCB as if we were beneath them. I felt pretty awful after that.

nodes.Name: LCCA
nodes.Desc: The Final Cleanup: operates after LCB, hauls away artifacts, looks down on the Sinners. Its leader is **Kaiman**.

nodes.Name: LCD
nodes.Desc: The Distortion Department: research and neutralization. Detective **Moses**, **Ezra**, **Vespa Crabro**, **Aeng-du**.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.11.9*
  - Limbus Company Distortion.
  - It seems this is a department specializing in dealing with Distortions.
  - This department was created to expand Limbus Company's business in the City.
  - An LCD employee named Ezra actively helped us during the operation to retrieve the Monolith.
  - ... I imagine that's what Don Quixote would be like if her personality were a little more... mature.

nodes.Name: LCA
nodes.Desc: The most influential department, special operations: seizes Monoliths and the Distorted. The "Udjat" vanguard — **Jamila**.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.11.4*
  - The most influential department in Limbus Company.
  - Not sure what the abbreviation stands for.
  - Maybe they work in tandem with LCD on important missions to find Distortions or Monoliths?
  - The team known as the special operations unit is part of LCA. All the members of that team we saw were tall, bulky and dressed in black.

nodes.Name: LCE
nodes.Desc: Limbus Company Enkephalin: research and energy. Its head is **Hohenheim**; his assistants are Marton and Alissa. Employees wear E.G.O Gear, risking corrosion.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.12.21*
  - Limbus Company Enkephalin.
  - This is Limbus Company's research and energy department.
  - Under the leadership of chief researcher Hohenheim, this department conducts various research.
  - They study Abnormalities, Distortions and even Lesser Sins by isolating and examining them. Its interiors are decorated much like those of the former L Corp, Lobotomy Corporation.
  - All the employees were dressed in E.G.O Gear extracted from Abnormalities. According to them, the gear differs from Lobotomy Corporation's E.G.O gear in that it carries more of the traits of each original Abnormality.
  Judging by what the Identities from the Mirror World say about this LCE gear, it's not entirely a good thing. Apparently their minds can easily be corroded by the gear they wear... I feel this technology has potential for development.

nodes.Name: Saude
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** LCCB manager, former agent.
- **Personality:** Became harsher and more withdrawn after Effie's death. In Canto IX she loses an arm but keeps carrying out her duties.

nodes.Name: Pilot
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** An LCCB agent, inexperienced but diligent.
- **Personality:** Tries to prove his usefulness and often makes mistakes. Gravely wounded in Canto IX.

nodes.Name: Kaiman
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Leader of the LCCA team (Limbus Company Clearance After).
- **Personality:** Rough, blunt, despises the Sinners as "meat shields", but effective at her job.

nodes.Name: Moses
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Head of LCD, a Distortion detective.
- **Personality:** Experienced and calm. Studies Distortions and Bloodfiends. Has met the Progenitor. Consulted LCB on La Manchaland. In Canto IX she leads a squad into the Spider's House.
- **Abilities:** Can "sense" Distortions, like Dante. Uses a smoking pipe as a weapon.

nodes.Name: Ezra
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** An LCD operative, Moses's eccentric assistant.
- **Personality:** Energetic and chatty; calls Moses "detective". Briefed Dante on handling the Monolith. In Canto IX she fights the Nursefathers.

nodes.Name: Jamila
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Leader of the LCA vanguard team "Udjat".
- **Personality:** A professional soldier. Takes part in the assault on the Spider's House.

nodes.Name: Hohenheim
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Head of the LCE research group, a former Lobotomy Corp employee.
- **Personality:** Cold, rational, cynical. Hides deep guilt over surviving the fall of L Corp. In Canto IX he loses his assistant Marton but survives himself and takes part in the final battle.
- **Abilities:** The E.G.O Gear "Shock Centipede"; later uses Marton's "Lantern" and "Diffraction".

nodes.Name: Marton
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Hohenheim's assistant at LCE.
- **Personality:** Devoted and responsible. Sacrifices himself to hold off Callisto and buy Hohenheim time.

nodes.Name: Alissa
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Hohenheim's second assistant.
- **Personality:** Survives being wounded by the spiral, later joins the mission to the Spider's House, driven by revenge.

nodes.Name: Golden Bough
nodes.Desc: A fragment of the Sephirot Tree. It resonates with the Sinners, revealing **the depths of the ego** — their past. It can counteract the Whale's paling and may be able to grant wishes. LCB's objective.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.26*
  - Small branch-like objects emitting a golden glow.
  - They don't really look like tree branches. My head tingles whenever I get close to one of them…
  - Whatever they are, they're definitely not ordinary gilded branches that we're running after.
- *Entry #2 · 984.5.3*
  - The Sinners look dazed when they approach this thing. I heard it called "resonance", and it may feel like getting a headache.
  - As soon as we return with a Bough, Vergilius calls people from another department to take care of it.
  When I asked him about it, he simply answered "submitted to the head office".
- *Entry #3 · 984.12.9*
  - I still have no idea how these Golden Boughs work. But if they really can grant people's wishes,… it must be something incredible.
  - Looking back, resonating with a Golden Bough would create a kind of dungeon of the depths… or of the depths of the ego, which we had to fight through.
  - Perhaps the power of a Golden Bough is to bring to life ... people's thoughts or imagination. I know it hardly makes any sense.… but when does anything on this adventure?
  - In any case, these Golden Boughs are undoubtedly something special. So what is Limbus Company trying to achieve by collecting them? Some say the Golden Boughs have something to do with the mirror technology, but… how? It seems every little thing I learn only leads to new questions…

nodes.Name: Sinners
nodes.Desc: 12 people bound by contract to Dante (Faust concluded it in the Prologue). Only they can be revived by Dante with his clock.

Pec.Name: Dante's Notes
Pec.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.4.22*
  - It seems this is a term referring to the 12 people who rode the LCB bus with me.
  - Judging by conversations I overheard, it seems they "joined" the company the same way I did, but they were given call signs as if they were bound here in some way.
  - I asked Vergilius about the term, but he didn't give me a clear answer.
  Him and his "You'll see in due time…" He shut down several questions with that line.
  ...It seems there's no other option; I have to write down everything I learn, no matter what.
- *Entry #2 · 984.4.23*
  - Adding a couple of new discoveries about the Sinners.
  - First, it seems "Sinner" is used specifically for those who have made a contract with me (one I had no choice to refuse).
  - And it seems they're the only people I can bring back to life with my clock.
- *Entry #3 · 984.4.24*
  - The Sinners may be the ones capable of resonating with the Golden Boughs we're looking for.
  - When we get close to one, it seems to reveal *the depths of a Sinner's ego*, making us relive their past or peer into their soul.

nodes.Name: Mirror Worlds
nodes.Desc:
- **Mirror Worlds:** Alternate realities where the Sinners lived different lives.
