- **Origin:** A technology for reflecting possibilities, created by **Yi Sang** (the "Mirror" / Yeonsim) based on the "glass window" of his mentor Yeonji.
- **Identity:** An "imprint" of a Sinner from a Mirror World, loaded through Mephistopheles.
- **Extraction:** Managed by Faust; requires Golden Boughs.
- **Limitations:** Causes a dissociative disorder — a confusion of memories.
- **Dante's new abilities:** In Canto IX, Dante demonstrates the ability to forcibly summon the Sinners' Identities onto the battlefield without using Mephistopheles.

nodes.Name: Identities
nodes.Desc:
Alternate versions of the Sinners from the Mirror Worlds, loaded through Mephistopheles's engine. They cause a confusion of memories.

| Category | Description | Examples |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| **Fixer Associations** | Sinners as Association members | Seven Association Yi Sang |
| **Wings** | Sinners as corporate employees | W Corp. Cleanup Agent Don Quixote |
| **Syndicates** | Sinners as Syndicate members | Kurokumo Clan Heathcliff |
| **E.G.O** | Sinners with Abnormality E.G.O | Lobotomy E.G.O::Lantern Sinclair |
| **Special** | Unique, tied to the story | The One Who Shall Grip Sinclair |

nodes.Name: Dante's Clock
nodes.Desc: Turning the hands resurrects the Sinners at the cost of Dante's pain. The ticking counteracts the paling; in Canto IX Dante summons Identities without Mephistopheles and sees at a distance.

nodes.Name: Aspect
nodes.Desc: Something Dante must "capture" — the key to his memories.

nodes.Name: Distortions and the Monolith
nodes.Desc: Distortion — the transformation of a person into a monster due to trauma. **The Monolith** — a black stele that causes Distortions. Hohenheim introduced a classification by Sin Affinity and expected damage.

nodes.Name: Peccatulum
nodes.Desc: Lesser sins: Wrath, Sloth, Gloom, Gluttony, Pride, Envy, Lust. They evolve.

nodes.Name: E.G.O Corrosion
nodes.Desc: The wearer loses control of their E.G.O and becomes something like an Abnormality themselves.

nodes.Name: The PDA Device
nodes.Desc:
- *Entry #1 · 984.12.8*
  - This is a device issued to me by the company. I write diary entries on it, like right now, and sometimes communicate with the Sinners' Identities. Some kind of mirror technology was probably used in making this device.
  - I used this device to communicate with Catherine. It must have been the power of the Golden Bough that let me speak with her directly. Did they stick a Golden Bough inside this device? Or… maybe the presence of that Golden Bough let me communicate with her through some supernatural channel, even with a device as mundane as this one.

nodes.Name: N Corp and the "dough"
nodes.Desc: Director **Hermann** conducts experiments with the Mirrors and the overwriting of Identities. **"Dough"** — a primordial form of a human without a personality. N Corp's board of directors is assembling the roster of the **Malleus Maleficarum**.

nodes.Name: Bloodfiends
nodes.Desc: A race dependent on blood: Progenitors → the Second Generation → lesser ones; Kin and Blood Bags. They fear water and obey the Taboo of filial piety. Hemobars could not replace living blood.

nodes.Name: Prologue
nodes.Desc: Dante, stripped of his memories and turned into a "clock-head", is attacked by the Panther, the Lion and the Wolf, who serve the mysterious Serpent. Faust saves him and makes a contract binding the 12 Sinners to his time. Vergilius (the Red Gaze) joins as the guide. Dante becomes the Executive Manager of the LCB department. Charon drives the bus Mephistopheles, which runs on Enkephalin. The journey into the Inferno begins.

nodes.Name: The Panther, the Lion and the Wolf
nodes.Desc: Beast-agents of the mysterious **Serpent** who attacked Dante in the "dark forest" while he was "capturing" something important.

nodes.Name: The Serpent
nodes.Desc: The mysterious master of the three beasts. Its goals are unknown.

nodes.Name: Canto I — Gregor
nodes.Desc: The first mission to an abandoned L Corp branch (D-02) in District 4. The Sinners face remnants of the old G Corp's soldiers, Gregor's former comrades-in-arms. They meet Yuri (a former L Corp employee) and Grade 8 Fixers (Hopkins, Aya). Hopkins's betrayal; the deaths of Aya and Yuri to the "Golden Apple" Abnormality. The appearance of Hermann (Gregor's mother and the creator of his arm), as well as Gubo and Jia Huan. The Golden Bough is lost, but the Sinners survive. Gregor keeps Aya's gas mask in memory of Yuri and his sister.

nodes.Name: Yuri
nodes.Desc: A former L Corp employee, a Fixer. Dies to the Golden Apple; Gregor keeps Aya's gas mask in her memory.

nodes.Name: Aya
nodes.Desc: A Grade 8 Fixer, Yuri's partner. Dies.

nodes.Name: Hopkins
nodes.Desc: A Fixer who betrayed the group in branch D-02.

nodes.Name: Hermann
nodes.Desc: Director of N Corp, Gregor's mother and the creator of his arm. A recurring antagonist: experiments with the Mirrors, the "dough" and the Malleus Maleficarum.

Pec.Name: ＋ Canto X (post-credits)
Pec.Desc: After Sisyphe's fall, Hermann's group obtains materials connected to the **"Protoplast"** — a hint that Sisyphe's collapse was staged.

nodes.Name: Gubo
nodes.Desc: A former member of the League of Nine, took Yi Sang away to N Corp.

nodes.Name: Jia Huan
nodes.Desc: Hong Lu's brother, working for N Corp; a Hierarch candidate in Canto VIII.

nodes.Name: Canto II — Rodion
nodes.Desc: An operation in J Corp's Nest (District 10) — infiltrating the casino. Joint work with LCCB (Saude, Effie). The Sinners disguise themselves as members of the Tingtang Gang. Rodion gambles against the leaders of rival Syndicates (including Sonya of the Yurodivy). Rodion's past is revealed: she killed a tax collector to feed her neighbors, but this led to reprisals by the Middle and the destruction of her district. Sonya shows her an ideal world through resonance with the Golden Bough, but Rodion rejects the illusion. Sonya helps obtain the Bough. Hermann watches Sonya and discusses further plans.

nodes.Name: Sonya
nodes.Desc: The founder of the Yurodivy, a "saint". Showed Rodion an ideal world through resonance with the Bough.

nodes.Name: Effie
nodes.Desc: An LCCB agent, died in Canto III.

nodes.Name: Saude
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** LCCB manager, former agent.
- **Personality:** Became harsher and more withdrawn after Effie's death. In Canto IX she loses an arm but keeps carrying out her duties.

nodes.Name: Canto III — Sinclair
nodes.Desc: A journey to K Corp's Nest (District 11). A clash with N Corp's Inquisition (Nagel und Hammer), which destroyed Sinclair's hometown, Kalv. A meeting with Siegfried (a K Corp Fixer), an old acquaintance of Vergilius. Don Quixote breaks a Taboo at the checkpoint. Sinclair's past is revealed: his friendship with Kromer, the betrayal, the massacre of his family, the two coins. Effie and Saude die (it later turns out that Saude survived and became an LCCB Manager). In branch K-02, Kromer resonates with the Golden Bough, turning into a monstrous form. Demian appears, kills Kromer and speaks in riddles about Sinclair's future. The Bough is obtained, but the team is badly wounded.

nodes.Name: Kromer
nodes.Desc: Sinclair's childhood friend who manipulated him; resonates with the Bough and turns into a monster.

Pec.Name: ＋ Clarification on Limbus canon
Pec.Desc: In Limbus Company, Kromer is an N Corp inquisitor, the main antagonist of Canto III, who slaughtered Kalv and Sinclair's family; she is killed by Demian. Her **older sister is Heinrich Kromer** (The One Who Holds), a Giant of Sisyphe in Canto X.

nodes.Name: Demian
nodes.Desc: A mysterious young man who killed Kromer; speaks in riddles about Sinclair's future.

nodes.Name: Siegfried
nodes.Desc: A K Corp Fixer, an old acquaintance of Vergilius, Don Quixote's idol.

nodes.Name: Intervallo I — Hell's Chicken
nodes.Desc:
Between Cantos III and IV. The company arrives in K Corp's Nest to meet a client. It turns out to be **Samjo** — a secretary from the Food Resource Development Department, working for **Chief Dongrang**. Samjo hires them to resolve a **Distortion Phenomenon** that has struck the owner of "Eunbong's Bar & Grill". The owner, Papa Eunbong, lost his secret recipe and turned into a chicken monster. Chicken-headed creatures attack passersby.

The Sinners split into two cooking teams (led by Ryōshū and Gregor) to cook a dish that will open the Distorted one's heart. A competitor, the manager of "Bodhisattva Chicken", stole the recipe and burned it in the **Conceptual Incinerator**. After a series of failures, Outis's dish awakens Papa Eunbong's memories of his mother. The Distortion is resolved. As a reward, the Sinners receive a plush doll. Samjo, impressed, decides to offer them serious work (setting up Canto IV).

nodes.Name: Samjo
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Dongrang's meticulous secretary. A former dreamer turned pedantic bureaucrat. He hired LCB in Intervallo I to test their competence.
- **Fate:** Dies trying to prove the safety of the regeneration ampules.

nodes.Name: Papa Eunbong
nodes.Desc: The owner of "Eunbong's Bar & Grill", who distorted into a chicken monster after losing his recipe.

nodes.Name: Canto IV — The Unchanging
nodes.Desc: A central chapter dedicated to **Yi Sang**. The team receives a request from **Dongrang**, a talented K Corp researcher. They must recover his laboratory in a former L Corp branch, which has been seized by **the Technology Liberation Alliance**.

Pec.Name: The Beginning
Pec.Desc: An Abnormality breach occurs in K Corp's Nest. The Sinners suppress them, running into suspicious corporate drones recording people's suffering.

Pec.Name: The Client
Pec.Desc: The Sinners meet Dongrang and his secretary **Samjo**, who had already hired them for a test (Intervallo I). Among the Sinners, Yi Sang recognizes Dongrang — an old friend from **the League of Nine**.

Pec.Name: The Liberation Alliance
Pec.Desc: During the conversation, the laboratory is attacked. It turns out that Dongrang's colleague **Schrenne** was a traitor. The Alliance is led by **Dongbaek** (a former beloved/comrade from the League), who uses the E.G.O Spicebush. Her goal is to reveal the truth about K Corp's Singularity and destroy it.

Pec.Name: The Truth about K Corp
Pec.Desc: In the "Viewing Room", Dongrang reveals **the Weeping Beast** — a colossal creature caught in a loop of suffering. Its tears, recorded on video, are the source of the regeneration ampules. Samjo dies proving the safety of the "refined" tears. Unrefined tears return everything to its "original form".

Pec.Name: A Clash of Ideals
Pec.Desc: Dongbaek seeks to roll the world back to an "era without technology", when people were "innocent". Dongrang argues that they were both stuck in the past, but he moved on. Their argument escalates into a battle. Dongrang provokes Dongbaek by belittling her sacrifices, which leads to her distortion/empowerment.

Pec.Name: The Depths of the Ego
Pec.Desc: The Golden Bough's resonance draws everyone into Yi Sang's memories. The Sinners are forced to act out the story of the rise and fall of the League of Nine (Literati) to reach the center.

Pec.Name: The League's History
Pec.Desc: Talented inventors (Yi Sang, Dongrang, Dongbaek, Gubo, Yeonji, Rim and others) gather in T Corp to create technology for the sake of knowledge. Based on Yeonji's "glass window", Yi Sang creates **the "Mirror" (Yeonsim)**. But their popularity attracts the attention of the Wings. Because of betrayal (Dongrang sold the group out to T Corp to save his healing technology) and pressure from the authorities, the League falls apart. Its members are torn apart and scattered. Gubo takes Yi Sang away to N Corp.

Pec.Name: Finale
Pec.Desc: Dongrang deals Dongbaek a fatal blow, "granting her peace". After the battle he himself begins to distort under the influence of E.G.O, but with Yi Sang's help and the Sinners' support he comes to clarity. He realizes he had been chasing empty shells (rewards) while rejecting his true desires (saving lives). Yi Sang also accepts his trauma — he realizes he created the mirror to connect hearts, and finds the desire to "fly". Dongrang dies covering up the truth about the corporation. Director **Alfonso** erases everyone's memory of the Weeping Beast, but Dante keeps his memories. The Golden Bough is obtained.

Pec.Name: Aftermath
Pec.Desc: Yi Sang comes to see himself as part of a new group and accepts his past. His connection with Rim and Demian points to a deeper conspiracy.

nodes.Name: Dongrang
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A brilliant K Corp researcher, inventor of free healing technology, a member of the League of Nine, the client of Canto IV.
- **Personality:** Eccentric, nostalgic. Hides deep pain behind a mask of cynicism and cheer. He deserted the League, selling out his comrades to save his technology. In the end, he himself becomes a victim of the system he created.
- **Fate:** Dies trying to atone, having killed Dongbaek out of mercy.

nodes.Name: Dongbaek
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Former leader of the Technology Liberation Alliance, a member of the League of Nine. Hates K Corp's technology for its cruelty.
- **Goal:** To destroy K Corp's Singularity and throw humanity back to an era without technology.
- **Fate:** Killed by Dongrang.

nodes.Name: Alfonso
nodes.Desc: The director of K Corp; erased everyone's memory of the Weeping Beast.

nodes.Name: Schrenne
nodes.Desc: Dongrang's colleague, who turned out to be a traitor.

nodes.Name: The Weeping Beast
nodes.Desc: "Something full of tears" — K Corp's Singularity. Its offspring are used to produce ampules.

nodes.Name: Rim
nodes.Desc: A member of the League of Nine; his connection to Demian hints at a deeper conspiracy.

nodes.Name: Intervallo II — S.E.A.
nodes.Desc: After Canto IV. To travel to U Corp, Mephistopheles has to be modified into an amphibious vehicle. The team arrives in the Backstreets of District 21, on the shore of the Great Lake. There they meet **Molar Boatworks** (Olga, Rien, Mika) — former Fixers who died in the Library and were revived. They specialize in ships and parts made of scrap.

Pec.Name: Scrap Collecting
Pec.Desc: The Sinners hunt Trash Crabs and harvest parts from them to upgrade the bus.

Pec.Name: Ishmael's Crisis
Pec.Desc: Arriving at the Lake puts Ishmael under severe stress. She keeps insisting that the group isn't ready to sail, about the danger of the Whales and the team's incompetence. Her behavior leads to an open conflict and a fight with **Heathcliff**. Dante tries to calm them both down by using his authority as manager. Vergilius conducts "educational talks".

Pec.Name: Modification
Pec.Desc: The group defeats the Trash Crab King and obtains the last part. Mephistopheles turns into a bus-boat.

Pec.Name: Setting Sail
Pec.Desc: Despite internal disagreements, the group sets sail across the Great Lake to reach the L Corp branch.

nodes.Name: Olga
nodes.Desc: Head of Molar Boatworks, former coordinator of the Molar Office.

nodes.Name: Rien and Mika
nodes.Desc: Members of the Workshop.

nodes.Name: The Trash Crab King
nodes.Desc: The last parts "donor" for the bus-boat.

nodes.Name: Canto V — The Evil Defining
nodes.Desc: A central chapter dedicated to **Ishmael**. Having arrived in Port Marlin, LCB must meet with the LCC agent Pilot, learn the coordinates of the L Corp branch and face the harsh reality of the Great Lake.

Pec.Name: The Twinhook Pirates
Pec.Desc: Pilot's team has been captured by pirates. The Sinners try to negotiate, but Ishmael, enraged by their methods, kills one of the kidnappers. From the pirates they learn that behind them stands **Big Brother of "the Middle"** (Ricardo). They rescue Pilot and learn that **Manager Saude** (from Canto III) is alive and has been promoted.

Pec.Name: The Great Lake
Pec.Desc: Mephistopheles travels across the Lake, observing its Laws. The Sinners learn about **the Merfolk**, the Five Calamities and the huge Whales (the Porous Hand).

Pec.Name: Clash with the Middle
Pec.Desc: The group is attacked by **Ricardo**, a Big Brother of the Middle. It turns out Heathcliff accidentally stole his haircut coupons, which is a mortal insult. The Middle's forces overwhelm the Sinners, killing them over and over. Ricardo nearly smashes Dante's clock. At the critical moment, **the Indigo Elder** (a Color Fixer and whale hunter) appears and gravely wounds Ricardo, forcing the Middle to retreat.

Pec.Name: The Pallid Whale
Pec.Desc: It turns out the Golden Bough was swallowed by the Pallid Whale — one of the Five Calamities. The Indigo Elder agrees to help with the hunt. Ishmael proposes a plan — to get inside the Whale through its mouth.

Pec.Name: Inside the Whale
Pec.Desc: The group discovers "Pequod Village", the surviving crew of the ship **"Pequod"** led by **Captain Ahab**. It turns out Ishmael was a member of this crew. Ahab is a charismatic fanatic who has devoted her life to killing the Pallid Whale, considering it the source of all evil. Because of it she lost a leg, an eye and her entire former crew, whom she mercilessly sacrificed. Ahab proposes a temporary alliance to kill the Whale from the inside, and then promises Ishmael her life. Ishmael agrees, driven by hatred.

Pec.Name: Queequeg
Pec.Desc: A harpooner who was Ishmael's only friend and a member of the Middle. She fled the Syndicate, inflicting horrific scars over her tattoos. She accompanies the group through the right atrium. In the finale she sacrifices herself (or succumbs to the paling) in the battle with Ahab.

Pec.Name: The Heart of the Whale
Pec.Desc: The group reaches the heart. Ishmael, using her E.G.O, pierces the Whale's heart, killing the monster. Instead of finishing off Ahab, she lets her live. Ishmael realizes that her obsession was imposed on her by Ahab, and decides to chart her own path, making Dante her compass.

Pec.Name: Finale
Pec.Desc: The Indigo Elder appears and pulls the group out. The Whale dies; one of the Calamities is destroyed. Ishmael accepts her role as First Mate and trusts Dante to lead them to new adventures.

Pec.Name: Post-credits Scene
Pec.Desc: **Hermann** (N Corp) finds Ahab alive on the wreckage and offers her a new purpose — hunting Pallid Whales in the Mirror Worlds, giving her the chance for endless revenge.

nodes.Name: Ahab
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** The ruthless and charismatic captain of the whaling ship "Pequod". She lost a leg and an eye in a previous clash with the Pallid Whale. She fanatically pursues the goal of killing "the source of all evil". She manipulates her crew, forcing them to sacrifice themselves for her goals.
- **Fate:** Loses to Ishmael but is left alive. In the end she joins Hermann.

nodes.Name: Queequeg
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** The "Pequod"'s harpooner, Ishmael's closest friend. A former member of the **Middle** Syndicate.
- **Tragedy:** She fled the Middle, cutting the tattoos out of her body. She lived in self-isolation. She died (succumbed to the paling) in the Whale's heart; her spirit helped Ishmael kill the beast.

nodes.Name: The Indigo Elder
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A Color Fixer. A legendary Whale Hunter who has destroyed several of the Lake's Calamities.
- **Personality:** A taciturn philosopher seeking a challenge. He has crossed the edge of understanding and keeps hunting the strongest creatures to test his limits.
- **Abilities:** Throwing a huge harpoon with unimaginable force.

nodes.Name: Ricardo
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A Big Brother of **the Middle** (the Middle Finger) in U Corp's ports.
- **Personality:** An eccentric bandit obsessed with hair care. Absolutely devoted to the Vengeance Book.
- **Abilities:** Creating powerful shockwaves, Middle techniques.

nodes.Name: Pilot
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** An LCCB agent, inexperienced but diligent.
- **Personality:** Tries to prove his usefulness and often makes mistakes. Gravely wounded in Canto IX.

nodes.Name: Intervallo III (pt. 1) — Miracle in District 20
nodes.Desc: During the long voyage to T Corp, the Sinners suffer from boredom. Heathcliff, who has received an invitation to Wuthering Heights, frets over his upcoming meeting with Catherine and wants to look presentable. Don Quixote proposes a plan: using the instability of the Back Door, enter the world behind one of the doors, where, she says, there are symbols of "the Red Sack" and "the Deer Man" — legendary Fixers who deliver presents.

Pec.Name: The Gift Factory
Pec.Desc: Don Quixote, Heathcliff and Dante secretly go through the Back Door and end up at a gnome factory in the Outskirts. The gnomes, led by Dodoru, pretend to be friendly, promising fancy clothes. However, it turns out they kidnap people and make them into "presents" for the monsters of the Outskirts who were exiled from the City.

Pec.Name: Rescuing Crayon
Pec.Desc: In the sacks on the sleigh they find a surviving girl, **Crayon**, from Cloud Village. The gnomes put the group to sleep with gas, but Dante is immune. The other Sinners, led by Faust and worried by the disappearance, find them through the same door. They fight their way through the factory.

Pec.Name: Santata and Domino
Pec.Desc: In the assembly shop they face the giant **Santata**, the factory's boss, who makes presents out of hatred for people. At the last moment **Domino**, a monster hunter from Cloud Village, appears and helps neutralize Santata (piercing his belly to release the toxic gas typical of northern giants). The Sinners rescue Crayon.

Pec.Name: Finale
Pec.Desc: Domino explains the harsh reality of the Outskirts and the impossibility of getting into the City. The Sinners return to Mephistopheles, narrowly escaping before the door closes. Don Quixote brings a sack of Christmas decorations to brighten the journey. Heathcliff shows Catherine's invitation letter for the first time (with the postscript "I'll be waiting. — Cathy"), which strengthens his resolve to return to Wuthering Heights with dignity.

nodes.Name: Crayon
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A girl from Cloud Village in the Outskirts.
- **Personality:** Curious, naive, dreaming of living in the City. She was kidnapped by the gnomes to be processed into a present.
- **Fate:** Rescued by the Sinners and the hunter Domino. Returns with Domino to the ruined village.

nodes.Name: Domino
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A monster hunter from Cloud Village.
- **Personality:** Stern and practical. Understands the hopelessness of life in the Outskirts and the impossibility of moving to the City.

nodes.Name: Santata
nodes.Desc: The giant boss of the gift factory; makes gifts out of people because he hates them.

nodes.Name: Dodoru
nodes.Desc: The leader of the gnomes.

nodes.Name: Intervallo III (pt. 2) — Yield My Flesh…
nodes.Desc: Takes place before the arrival at T Corp's Nest (a prequel to Canto VI, showing the route through the Backstreets of District 20).

Pec.Name: The Feud
Pec.Desc: The Sinners get caught in a battle between the Kurokumo Clan and the Blade Lineage. They rescue the wounded swordswoman **Aeng-du**.

Pec.Name: The Blade Lineage
Pec.Desc: Aeng-du tells them that her group fled S Corp; their mentor **Kim in the Bamboo Hat** accepted an invitation to the Library (the events of Library of Ruina, where they were defeated), after which they woke up in T Corp. They are being hunted by the Kurokumo Clan on the Phalanx's orders.

Pec.Name: Kaiman and the Mission
Pec.Desc: **Kaiman** (LCCA) shows up on the bus and delivers an order from top management: neutralize the Distortion in the Yongjin Building and retrieve the **Monolith**. LCB also serves as a "Distortion control company" to build up the company's reputation.

Pec.Name: The Yongjin Building and the Distortion
Pec.Desc: The Sinners fight their way through floors filled with (evolved) Peccatula. The Kurokumo captain **Jun** guarded the door because the Monolith was inside, and Kim in the Bamboo Hat had Distorted, killing everyone around him. In the office they find the mentor — he has become the "Blade Demon" Distortion.

Pec.Name: The Abyss of the Ego
Pec.Desc: A battle with Kim in the abyss of his ego, in memories of the massacre of his charges. **Ezra** (LCD) intervenes over the radio, instructing them on how to seal the Monolith.

Pec.Name: Secondary Distortion
Pec.Desc: Aeng-du, seeing her mentor's state, nearly Distorts herself from the Monolith's lingering influence and her own grief. LCA agents seize the Monolith, as well as both Kim and Aeng-du, to be studied by LCD, claiming this will help them better understand Distortions.

Pec.Name: Finale
Pec.Desc: Mission accomplished. The bus continues on to Wuthering Heights, towards the events of Canto VI.

Pec.Name: ＋ Numbering
Pec.Desc: By the game's official numbering, "Yield My Flesh to Claim Their Bones" is **the second part of Intervallo III** (along with "Miracle in District 20"). Intervallo IV is "Timekilling Time" and "Murder on the WARP Express" (added to the chronicle below).

nodes.Name: Aeng-du
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A salsu (swordswoman) of the Blade Lineage, later a member of LCD.
- **Personality:** Devoted and impulsive. She wanted to save her mentor Kim in the Bamboo Hat, but nearly Distorted herself after killing him.
- **Fate:** Taken in by LCD for recovery. Later joined LCD.

nodes.Name: Kim in the Bamboo Hat
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A mentor of the Blade Lineage, Distorted by the Monolith.
- **Personality:** Guilt over the deaths of his charges. Distorted into a blade demon.
- **Fate:** Neutralized by LCD.

Pec.Name: ＋ Intervallo VII · Mnestic Experience
Pec.Desc: His real name is **Kim Lip**. He was the bodyguard of the Right State Councillor in S Corp and shared his ideals, but the councillor framed him with fabricated evidence and branded him with the **Nobi** mark, which drains one's strength; his friend **Im Gyeong-eop** secretly freed him. In District 14, the Docugraph's Distortion forces Kim to relive it all; with Aeng-du's support ("to live in shame, hiding under a hat") he accepts his failures and temporarily manifests E.G.O.

nodes.Name: Jun
nodes.Desc: A Kurokumo captain who guarded the door to the Monolith.

nodes.Name: Kaiman
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Leader of the LCCA team (Limbus Company Clearance After).
- **Personality:** Rough, blunt, despises the Sinners as "meat shields", but effective at her job.

nodes.Name: Ezra
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** An LCD operative, Moses's eccentric assistant.
- **Personality:** Energetic and chatty; calls Moses "detective". Briefed Dante on handling the Monolith. In Canto IX she fights the Nursefathers.

nodes.Name: Canto VI — The Heartbreaking
nodes.Desc: A central chapter dedicated to **Heathcliff**. The team arrives in T Corp's Backstreets, with the aim of eventually entering the Nest and visiting the Wuthering Heights estate.

Pec.Name: Arrival
Pec.Desc: In T Corp's Backstreets they run into gangs, the "Dead Rabbits" and strange robberies in which time is demanded as currency. Heathcliff recalls his youth in a local gang. Soon it becomes clear that people are disappearing everywhere.

Pec.Name: Wuthering Heights and the "funeral"
Pec.Desc: At the estate they are greeted by the head butler, **Nelly**. Heathcliff is expected not for a wedding but for the reading of a will. Catherine is dead. Gathered at the estate are her brother **Hindley Earnshaw** and her husband **Linton Edgar**, along with their retinues and hired Syndicates (the "Dead Rabbits" led by boss Matt — an old acquaintance of Heathcliff). Catherine's will states that the inheritance will go to whoever solves her riddles and is first to reach the Golden Bough after seven lightning strikes.

Pec.Name: The Labyrinth of the Estate
Pec.Desc: The estate turns out to have been altered, its corridors winding. With the help of Catherine's diary, which "responds" to Heathcliff's presence and reveals hidden ink, the Sinners make their way to the basement. Along the way they see memories of Catherine, Heathcliff, Hindley and Linton that reveal their complicated relationships: Heathcliff was taken in at the estate, but Hindley hated him; Linton was jealous and provocative; Catherine loved Heathcliff but hid it, because she considered marrying him degrading.

Pec.Name: The Basement and the Experiments
Pec.Desc: In the basement they discover a laboratory built by former members of the Ring and N Corp (led by **Azea**, an old friend of Yi Sang). There, the missing people languish in glass capsules — "raw material" for experiments in overwriting Identities. In the center is Catherine's coffin, hooked up to machines. It turns out that Catherine, having seen through the mirror the endless suffering of Heathcliffs in other worlds, decided to erase all Catherines so that the Heathcliffs could be happy. To do this, she invited Catherines from other worlds to kill her, and then themselves. Linton, blindly in love with her, funded and carried out this plan.

Pec.Name: The Erlking and the Wild Hunt
Pec.Desc: The leader of the "Dead Rabbits" turns out to be not Matt, but a Heathcliff Identity from another world — **Erlking Heathcliff**, who leads "the Wild Hunt", an endless army of summoned Identities, to kill every Heathcliff in every reality, considering them the cause of Catherine's suffering. He absorbs suffering and uses it as fuel.

Pec.Name: Heathcliff's Distortion
Pec.Desc: Learning the truth, Heathcliff falls into despair and **Distorts** into a giant wolf (Fenrir), attacking everyone. Dante and the Sinners manage to bring him back to his senses. The ticking of Dante's clock plays a key role, as does Heathcliff's realization that he must not destroy but set things right.

Pec.Name: Sacrifice and Acceptance
Pec.Desc: The Erlking tries to complete the ritual of annihilation, but Heathcliff realizes the problem was not their existence but their silence. He pierces himself with the Golden Bough to "call" Catherine, and reaches her consciousness, scattered throughout the estate. They confess their love to each other through the diary. Catherine rejects the plan to erase herself, declaring that she loves not every Heathcliff, but her one and only.

Pec.Name: Finale
Pec.Desc: A duel with the Erlking. The power of the Golden Bough and the love of Heathcliff and Catherine break the spell. The Erlking and the other Catherines vanish. Nelly, who turns out to be the one who showed Catherine the mirror (driven by a desire to break the cycle of her own suffering in every world), takes one Golden Bough for Hermann, saying that Hermann is waiting for the "dough" — the primordial form of a human. The second Golden Bough burns out to white. Catherine vanishes, but Heathcliff vows to bring her back. The Sinners continue on their way.

nodes.Name: Catherine Earnshaw
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Heathcliff's beloved, mistress of Wuthering Heights.
- **Personality:** Passionate, selfish, loving. She loved Heathcliff but considered marrying him "degrading". After he left, she married Linton. Having seen through the mirror the endless suffering of the Heathcliffs, she decided to destroy all Catherines.
- **Fate:** Died; her consciousness was scattered throughout the estate. At the end of Canto VI she is reunited with Heathcliff through the diary and rejects her plan. She vanishes, but Heathcliff vows to bring her back.

nodes.Name: Nelly
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** The head butler of Wuthering Heights, Heathcliff's and Catherine's nanny.
- **Personality:** Caring but secretive. She showed Catherine a shard of the mirror to break the cycle of suffering in which she herself was the eternal victim as a servant.
- **Fate:** Betrays Heathcliff and takes an intact Golden Bough for Hermann.

nodes.Name: Hindley Earnshaw
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Catherine's older brother.
- **Personality:** Cruel, envious, a drunkard. He lost Wuthering Heights gambling and is obsessed with getting it back. He Distorted into a wolf and attacked the Sinners.
- **Fate:** Killed in the course of his Distortion.

nodes.Name: Linton Edgar
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Catherine's husband.
- **Personality:** Sickly, blindly in love with Catherine. He fulfilled her every whim, including funding the laboratory and the personality-overwriting experiments. He died by becoming "dough" — a pure form of a human.
- **Fate:** Turned by Azea into a formless mass ("dough"), then killed.

nodes.Name: Erlking Heathcliff
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A Heathcliff Identity from an alternate world, leader of the Wild Hunt.
- **Personality:** A ruthless hunter of himself. Kills every Heathcliff in every world, considering him the cause of Catherine's death.
- **Abilities:** Summoning an army of Identities (Hindleys, Lintons, Josephines). Enormous strength. Consumed by the idea of "atonement".
- **Fate:** Destroyed in a duel with Heathcliff, when Heathcliff accepts his feelings and rejects the path of destruction.

nodes.Name: Azea
nodes.Desc: An old friend of Yi Sang who ran the Ring / N Corp laboratory in the estate's basement.

nodes.Name: Canto VII — The Dream Ending
nodes.Desc:
A central chapter dedicated to **Don Quixote**. The team arrives at P Corp.

- **Zone 1: The Blood Shooting Gallery.** The Sinners go through the attractions and defeat the Barber (one of the leading Bloodfiends). The mysterious Bloodfiend **Sanson** appears and forces Don Quixote to tell the story of her "adventures", beginning with her duel with the Knight of the White Moon.

- **Zone 2: The Cursed House.** The Sinners go through a haunted house. Sanson keeps drawing the story out of Don Quixote: she and the Knight of the White Moon (**Bari**) became friends. The Knight showed her the Rivers of the Ruins, including the River of Oblivion. Sanson forces Don Quixote to admit that she ran from her past by drinking from Lethe.

Pec.Name: The Contract with P Corp
Pec.Desc: The head of the Archiving Department, **Cesara**, hires LCB to destroy the **La Manchaland** phenomenon and capture its creator. Along the way they are searching for a Golden Bough. The operation is a joint one with several squads of Fixers (the Hana Association, Zwei, Cinq, the Fanghunt Office, Jia Xichun's group).

Pec.Name: Don Quixote's Duel
Pec.Desc: Before entering, Don Quixote challenges the Cinq Fixer **Camille** to a duel, outraged that no one plans to rescue the park's victims, only to destroy it. She loses, but her sincerity is remembered.

Pec.Name: The Denouement
Pec.Desc: The truth is gradually revealed. Don Quixote is **Sancho**, the Second Kin (child) of the Progenitor Bloodfiend **Don Quixote** (the Father), who created La Manchaland as a utopia of coexistence. The dream collapsed because of an unquenchable thirst for blood. The Family rebelled and imprisoned the Father, impaling him on stakes and binding him to the Ferris wheel so that he would feed the park. Sancho, unable to bear the collapse of the dream, with Bari's help reached the River of Oblivion and erased her own memory, taking her Father's name — Don Quixote. Rocinante, a gift from her Father, suppressed her Bloodfiend nature.

Pec.Name: Battle with the Father
Pec.Desc: Sancho, having regained her memory, accepts herself. She fights against her Father, who now considers his dream a mistake and wants his children simply to be happy, feeding on people. Sancho rejects this and defeats him in a duel, once again declaring her dream. La Manchaland collapses. Dante supports her, and she finally accepts the name **Don Quixote** as a symbol of her aspiration, not of deception. The Father dies in her arms, blessing her to continue the adventure.

Pec.Name: Finale
Pec.Desc: The Sinners take the Golden Bough. Sancho, now rightfully calling herself Don Quixote, finds a new purpose — to ride toward her dream, no longer alone, but with her twelve companions.

nodes.Name: Father Don Quixote
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** The Progenitor Bloodfiend, creator of La Manchaland and Sancho's "Father".
- **Personality:** An idealistic dreamer inspired by Bari's stories about Fixers. He built the park for coexistence. After its failure, he was imprisoned by his own Family and bound to the Ferris wheel, where his dream distorted into a desire simply to give his Children what they want — blood.
- **Fate:** Defeated by Sancho in a duel, he died with a smile, blessing her to carry on the dream.

nodes.Name: Sanson
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A hypnotist Bloodfiend in La Manchaland, a guide and "director".
- **Personality:** Theatrical, manipulative. He made Don Quixote relive her forgotten past, playing the role of the Knight of the White Moon and other characters.
- **Abilities:** Hypnosis, forcing others into roles, creating illusions.

nodes.Name: Dulcinea
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** The Second Kin of Don Quixote (the Father), the Lady of the Parade.
- **Personality:** Narcissistic, envious of Sancho's "innocent gaze". Suffered from hunger and took part in the rebellion.
- **Fate:** Defeated by the Sinners and Sancho; later fought against them on the Father's side.

nodes.Name: The Barber (Nicolina)
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A Third Kin, maker of masks and costumes.
- **Personality:** A mad seamstress who sewed masks onto the Bloodfiends' faces so they would always smile.
- **Fate:** Killed by the Sinners.

nodes.Name: The Priest (Curiambro)
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A Third Kin, La Manchaland's confessor.
- **Personality:** He fervently believed in the Father's dream but suffered from bloodlust. He blessed the rebellion but was crushed by guilt.
- **Fate:** Defeated by the Sinners.

nodes.Name: Bari
PName: Bari — Knight of the White Moon
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A mysterious Fixer and adventurer who inspired Father Don Quixote. She traveled with Sancho through the Ruins and led her to the River of Oblivion.
- **Personality:** Valiant, true to her oaths. For centuries she secretly helped the Sancho who had forgotten everything, sending her books and letters.
- **Abilities:** Incredible swordsmanship, knowledge of the Ruins, the rivers and "the laws of Fixers".

nodes.Name: Cesara
nodes.Desc: Head of P Corp's Archiving Department, the client of the operation.

nodes.Name: Camille
nodes.Desc: A Cinq Association Fixer who defeated Don Quixote in a duel.

nodes.Name: Intervallo V (pt. 1) — LCB Regular Check-Up
nodes.Desc: Following Canto VII and the arrival at H Corp. The Sinners travel through a portal to Limbus Company's headquarters for a routine medical check-up. They are tested by the LCE department led by **Hohenheim**. The check-up includes a series of tests: a team battle without Dante, quizzes, fitness tests and fights against Peccatula to assess the Sinners' progress since being bound to the Golden Bough.

Pec.Name: Hohenheim and LCE
Pec.Desc: Hohenheim is LCE's chief researcher, a former Lobotomy Corp employee who survived the fall of a branch. He demonstrates the E.G.O Gear developed by Limbus Company. His assistants: Marton and Alissa.

Pec.Name: Lectures
Pec.Desc: Hohenheim lectures on the nature of the Peccatula (Wrath, Sloth, Gloom, Gluttony, Pride, Envy, Lust), testing the Sinners' knowledge.

Pec.Name: Individual Tests
Pec.Desc: The Sinners fight Peccatula in various combinations. Heathcliff is unexpectedly chosen as Hohenheim's assistant for his "spontaneity and intuition".

Pec.Name: The Power Hierarchy
Pec.Desc: The results of the "pre-contract" physical fitness tests are announced. Ranking: 1 — Don Quixote, 12 — Yi Sang (although Yi Sang mistakenly thought he came first). Gregor is excluded as a "special case" because of his arm.

Pec.Name: The Don Quixote Incident
Pec.Desc: Giving in to Hohenheim's provocation, Don Quixote takes off Rocinante to prove she is in control of herself. Her Sancho nature is unleashed, and she is overcome by the combined thirst of all the dead Kin. The Sinners and **Vergilius**, who appears (intervening and using his E.G.O), barely manage to bring her back to her senses. Hohenheim concludes that Don Quixote now carries the burden of the whole Family and recommends she regularly consume artificial blood.

Pec.Name: A New Classification
Pec.Desc: Hohenheim announces the switch to a new Distortion classification system based on Sin Affinity (as with the Peccatula) and expected damage, replacing the old L Corp system. He demonstrates the Monolith.

Pec.Name: Hohenheim's Distortion
Pec.Desc: At the end of the check-up, Hohenheim voluntarily activates the Monolith on himself. He turns into the Distortion HE-5-SU. The Sinners dive into his Depths of the Ego and learn the story of his cowardice during the fall of the L Corp branch and the sacrifice of his partner Johann. The Sinners return him to his normal state. Hohenheim admits the failure of his hypothesis of self-sufficiency and thanks them.

Pec.Name: Finale
Pec.Desc: The Sinners return to the bus, which arrives at H Corp (Hongyuan). They celebrate the New Year together. Canto VIII begins.

nodes.Name: Hohenheim
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Head of the LCE research group, a former Lobotomy Corp employee.
- **Personality:** Cold, rational, cynical. Hides deep guilt over surviving the fall of L Corp. In Canto IX he loses his assistant Marton but survives himself and takes part in the final battle.
- **Abilities:** The E.G.O Gear "Shock Centipede"; later uses Marton's "Lantern" and "Diffraction".

nodes.Name: Marton
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Hohenheim's assistant at LCE.
- **Personality:** Devoted and responsible. Sacrifices himself to hold off Callisto and buy Hohenheim time.

nodes.Name: Alissa
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Hohenheim's second assistant.
- **Personality:** Survives being wounded by the spiral, later joins the mission to the Spider's House, driven by revenge.

nodes.Name: Johann
nodes.Desc: Hohenheim's partner, who sacrificed himself when the L Corp branch fell.

nodes.Name: Canto VIII — The Surrendered Witness
nodes.Desc: A central chapter dedicated to **Hong Lu**. LCB arrives at H Corp, where Hong Lu and Jia Xichun return to take part in the "War for Family Hierarch" — a brutal contest for the throne of the Wing's Head.

Pec.Name: The Jia Family and Daguanyuan
Pec.Desc: Hong Lu (Jia Baoyu) and Jia Xichun arrive at the luxurious Daguanyuan mansion. Hong Lu is coldly received by his parents and his grandmother **Jia Mu** (the current Hierarch). They remind him that he is the family's "jade", that his duty is to witness the world and to return when the time comes.

Pec.Name: The First Round
Pec.Desc: The candidates present proof of immortality before the judges. Hong Lu hadn't planned to take part, but at the last moment, on LCB's orders, he enters as a candidate. To pass, Ryōshū cuts him in half, and Dante resurrects him before the judges' eyes, demonstrating "immortality". This angers Jia Xichun, since LCB has betrayed their temporary alliance.

Pec.Name: Intrigues
Pec.Desc: The other candidates — **Xue Baochai** (Hong Lu's fiancée from the Xue family), **Jia Huan** (a brother working for N Corp), **Xue Pan** (a sadist from the Xue), **Jia Qiu** (a mysterious brother connected to the Pinky), **Wang Zhao**, **Shi Huazhen** and others — present their answers. The first round is accompanied by chaos: Xue Pan releases monsters from vessels, killing many candidates and spectators.

Pec.Name: Jia Qiu and the Past
Pec.Desc: Jia Qiu (real name Kong Qiu) is the last survivor of the annihilated Kong family. He is using the Assessment for his own purposes. After he leaves the stage, the remaining candidates continue the fight for coins.

Pec.Name: The Second Round
Pec.Desc: A battle in a labyrinth for coins. LCB teams up with Jia Xichun to help her win. At the decisive moment, Jia Qiu and Jia Huan suddenly leave the contest, leaving their coins to LCB. The Sinners give the coins to Xichun, letting her take first place, while they themselves take second, fulfilling their mission to obtain the Golden Bough.

Pec.Name: Betrayal and Chaos
Pec.Desc: While Xichun is away at the ascension ritual, a coup begins in Daguanyuan. Discontented families (the Shi, the Xue, part of the Wang), backed by outside forces (R Corp, K Corp, X Corp, the Thumb, the Middle, N Corp), try to seize power before Xichun becomes Hierarch and gains control of the Heishou Pack.

Pec.Name: Tiekan Temple
Pec.Desc: Hong Lu leads the Sinners to Tiekan Temple to speed up the ritual. They fight traitorous soldiers. On a bridge they are met by **Lei Heng** (a Capo of the Thumb, one of the Ten Blades of the East). Zilu takes his blow to save Wei. Jia Qiu appears and engages Lei Heng, letting the Sinners pass.

Pec.Name: The Xianren and the Anamnesis Worm
Pec.Desc: In the temple, the Sinners discover "the Enlightened" (the immortal elders) and Jia Mu, who are trying to forcibly implant the Xianhuang Anamnesis Worm into Jia Xichun. Hong Lu refuses to take the Golden Bough and stands against his grandmother. Jia Mu, using the Golden Bough, Distorts. Hong Lu, with Dante's help, awakens his E.G.O "Land of Illusion" and defeats her, severing the connection with the Anamnesis Worm and leaving the elders trapped in the collapsing temple.

Pec.Name: Finale
Pec.Desc: Jia Xichun becomes Family Hierarch without the Anamnesis Worm. The invading forces retreat. Jia Qiu (the Pinky), Zigong and Zilu leave. Xue Baochai, rejected by Hong Lu, leaves with Jia Yuanchun for Q Corp. Hong Lu leaves home, having made his own decision for the first time. In the final scene, Saude announces the start of a training program for Xichun.

nodes.Name: Jia Xichun
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Hong Lu's younger sister, a candidate for Hierarch of the Jia family, later the Hierarch of Hongyuan.
- **Personality:** Smart and ambitious, but with an inferiority complex from family pressure. Hot-tempered, but devoted to those close to her (especially Wei). After training with the Sinners, she becomes a confident leader.
- **Development:** From a naive girl to a decisive leader ready to change H Corp's system.
- **Abilities:** A fan weapon, combat techniques including "Drunken Immersion, Sleepy Immersion, Spring".

nodes.Name: Jia Mu
nodes.Desc: Hong Lu's grandmother, the current Hierarch; distorted with the help of a Golden Bough.

nodes.Name: Jia Qiu
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Hong Lu's mysterious brother, the last survivor of the annihilated Kong family. A member of the Pinky.
- **Personality:** Calm and philosophical, wearing a mask of indifference. He seeks the path of "true humanity". He helps the Sinners in order to see Hong Lu's true nature.
- **Abilities:** A staff, the "Sin" and "Man" techniques (five rings of light).

nodes.Name: Zigong
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Jia Qiu's student and strategist.
- **Personality:** Perceptive, cautious, devoted. At first skeptical of Hong Lu, but later recognizes his potential.

nodes.Name: Zilu
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A Heishou (adept) serving Jia Qiu.
- **Personality:** Taciturn, devoted. Sacrifices herself, taking Lei Heng's blow for Wei.

nodes.Name: Xue Baochai
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Hong Lu's fiancée from the Xue family.
- **Personality:** Loving, but with a dark side. She adores Hong Lu, but also contributes to the intrigues. In the end she leaves with Jia Yuanchun for Q Corp.

nodes.Name: Lin Daiyu
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Hong Lu's childhood friend, a bodyguard of the Xue clan.
- **Personality:** Melancholic, poetic. She feels betrayed by Hong Lu, but still helps him at the decisive moment.

nodes.Name: Wei
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Jia Xichun's loyal servant and bodyguard, a former Heishou adept.
- **Personality:** Devoted, caring. Ready to do anything for his mistress.

nodes.Name: Lei Heng
nodes.Desc: A Capo of the Thumb, one of the Ten Blades of the East.

nodes.Name: Intervallo VI — Spring Cultivation
nodes.Desc: After Canto VIII. Jia Xichun, having become Hierarch, faces an attempted coup by her older sister **Jia Yuanchun** (returned from Q Corp) and the board of directors. At the council they call a vote of no confidence, accusing Xichun of incompetence. Zigong (Jia Qiu's student) intervenes and proposes settling the dispute through a series of trials over a month — the Sinners are to become Xichun's teachers.

Pec.Name: The Twelve Teachers
Pec.Desc: The Sinners draw up curricula. Zilu and Saude weed out the failed ones (like Outis's "Introduction to Derogatory Linguistics" or Don Quixote's plan with minus three hours of sleep). Sinclair gets carried away preparing a plan, but he himself is assigned as a student alongside Xichun, since he too needs to learn (on Jia Qiu's instructions).

Pec.Name: 30 Days of Lessons
Pec.Desc: Each Sinner's lessons are shown: Yi Sang (self-knowledge through a mirror), Don Quixote (the history of Fixers), Faust (an analysis of H Corp's Singularity), Gregor (the horrors of war), Hong Lu (surviving in Daguanyuan through intuition), Ishmael (a tabletop role-playing game), Meursault (emotional control), Outis (extracting information through "tongue torture"), Ryōshū (communicating with children), Rodion (reading emotions through mahjong), Heathcliff (developing fighting spirit and courage), as well as a lesson from a guest master — **the Night Wanderer** (formerly of the Ten Blades of the East), who teaches "the emptiness of sound, form and mind". Dante holds an anonymous-notes lesson, revealing funny secrets of the bus.

Pec.Name: Exams
Pec.Desc: Every 6 days Xichun takes interim exams, fighting representatives of the families (Shi Huazhen, Shi Xujing, Wang Qingshan, Xue Pan). She not only wins, but also earns their trust, demonstrating her leadership qualities and understanding of their problems.

Pec.Name: The Final Trial and the Ambush
Pec.Desc: On the 30th day, Xue Baochai reveals that the final exam is Jia Yuanchun's trap and that the palanquin is heading into an ambush. The Sinners and Wei rush to help. Xichun fights the Night Wanderer, who turns out to have been hired by Jia Yuanchun, but doesn't betray Xichun — he helps her instead. In the finale she uses the "Drunken Immersion, Sleepy Immersion, Spring" technique to defeat him.

Pec.Name: Finale
Pec.Desc: At the reconvened council, Xichun fights back against Jia Yuanchun. Thanks to the support she has won from council members, the vote of no confidence fails. Jia Yuanchun leaves for Q Corp together with Xue Baochai. Xichun remains the rightful Hierarch. The Sinners say goodbye to her, and Xichun promises to keep their lessons in her heart.

nodes.Name: Jia Yuanchun
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Hong Lu's and Xichun's older sister, who married into Q Corp.
- **Personality:** Manipulative, domineering. She tries to seize control of H Corp using the board of directors. In the end she fails and returns to Q Corp together with Xue Baochai.

nodes.Name: The Drunken Palm Night Wanderer
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A former member of the Ten Blades of the East, hired by Jia Yuanchun as a master for Xichun, later her examiner.
- **Personality:** A carefree drunk, but deeply principled. Disillusioned with the world, he finds hope in Xichun and Sinclair.
- **Abilities:** The technique of "the emptiness of sound, form and mind", which lets him move in absolute silence and unpredictably.

nodes.Name: Canto IX — The Unsevering
nodes.Desc: A central chapter dedicated to **Ryōshū**. After the mission in H Corp, LCB receives a distress signal: Limbus Company's headquarters has been attacked and Charon has been kidnapped. The attackers are the **Nursefathers** of **the Spider's House**, a joint venture of the Five Fingers that raised Ryōshū (Yoshihide) as "a sword that cleaves all".

Pec.Name: Attack on the Convoy
Pec.Desc: Saude, Vergilius and Charon are ambushed. Valencina (the Thumb) cuts off Saude's arm and kidnaps Charon. Vergilius holds Valencina off, while the Sinners enter the captured LCE research center through the Back Door.

Pec.Name: Headquarters in Ruins
Pec.Desc: The Sinners find survivors — Hohenheim, Marton, Alissa, as well as the LCD team (Moses, Ezra, Vespa, Aeng-du). The attack was carried out by the Nursefathers and their students. Their goal — the Golden Boughs and Ryōshū herself.

Pec.Name: Separation
Pec.Desc: A quarantine is activated, splitting up the group. Dante, Ryōshū, Gregor, Yi Sang, Meursault and two new employees (Sora and Ravi, who turn out to be the Index's student and a spy) head for the Golden Bough. The other squads fight the Nursefathers.

Pec.Name: Clashes
Pec.Desc:
- The Sinclair/Faust/Heathcliff/Don Quixote team faces **Callisto** (the Ring) and his student Albina. At the critical moment, **a future version of Sinclair** from an alternate future comes to help, summoned by his Mark. He destroys Albina and Callisto, dropping grim hints about the coming "Second Smoke War".
- The Ishmael/Rodion/Outis/Hong Lu team joins forces with LCD against **Matthias** (the Middle Finger) and his daughter Kira. Matthias sacrifices Kira for an attack without hesitation. Moses uses the "Crimson Dot"; Vespa decapitates Matthias.
- Heathcliff, Rodion, Gregor and Vergilius fight **Valencina** (the Thumb) and her student Lucio. During the battle Gregor, provoked by Valencina's mockery of Smoke War veterans, awakens the form of **the Cockroach Emperor** — G Corp's unfinished fourth weapon. He kills Valencina. Vergilius and the Sinners barely manage to return Gregor to human form.

Pec.Name: Ryōshū's Path
Pec.Desc: Ryōshū pursues the Pinky's Nursefather, **Shiomi Yoru (the Star of Dihuei)**, and **Ryen** (the Index), who have taken the Golden Boughs. Sora (Ryen's student) reveals herself and attacks Dante, but is stopped by Vespa, who arrives in time. Ryōshū fights Shiomi. The past is gradually revealed: Shiomi is Ryōshū's mother, who hated her for becoming her "shackles". In a rage, Ryōshū cut out her tongue and left the Spider's House, but left her daughter **Araya** in a time vault.

Pec.Name: Tragedy on the Roof
Pec.Desc: Pursuing Shiomi, Ryōshū comes out onto the roof. There she learns a shocking truth: Shiomi is **Araya** — her daughter, who grew up in the vault, lived through the temporal entanglement and was turned by the Spider's House into the new Star of Dihuei, forgetting her past. Realizing this, Ryōshū, in despair, plunges her sword into the "Nursefather", killing her own daughter.

Pec.Name: Ryōshū's Downfall
Pec.Desc: Having lost the only thread connecting her to the world, Ryōshū severs the chain of her contract with Dante and sinks into the state of "Not-Self" (Asura), intending to destroy everything. Her sword Arayashiki erases reality. Ryen welcomes this as the completion of the Spider's House project — the birth of "the sword that cleaves all".

Pec.Name: Rescue
Pec.Desc: In Ryōshū's Depths of the Ego, the ghost of little Araya, guided by Dante's broken chain, reaches her. Araya shows that the bond between them is unbreakable — it exists across all times and worlds. Ryōshū accepts her love and her pain. Her sword receives a new sheath woven from red thread — a symbol of their bond. Ryōshū returns and defeats Ryen, who admits defeat.

Pec.Name: Finale
Pec.Desc: The Spider's House is destroyed. Ryōshū loses all her memories of Araya (due to the sword's effect), but the sheath with the red thread remains on her sword. Dante promises that as long as the clock ticks, the bond will not be lost. The Sinners leave the headquarters.

Pec.Name: Epilogue
Pec.Desc: Ryen, mortally wounded, kills the Index's Proxies pursuing him and remembers Ryōshū's childhood. The post-credits scene shows a meeting of the Faust Society — "Naive Faust" is reprimanded for inquiring into the involvement of the company head Dias in the incident, after which she is renamed "Foolish Faust". In N Corp, Hermann and her underlings discuss LCB's successes, the awakening of Sinclair's Mark and Gregor's genetic factor, and prepare for the N Corp board of directors' meeting to approve the roster of the "Malleus Maleficarum".

nodes.Name: Ryen
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Head of the Spider's House, follower of the Prescripts. Raised Ryōshū as a daughter, but also as a weapon.
- **Personality:** Calm and loving, but utterly devoid of a will of his own — he acts solely according to the Prescripts. His mask hides a burn left by Ryōshū.
- **Abilities:** A variety of shape-shifting weapons. Tremendous speed and agility. Zeno's Tortoise Spiral.
- **Fate:** Defeated by Ryōshū in the finale of Canto IX. Later killed by the Index's pursuers.

nodes.Name: Shiomi Yoru / Araya
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** The Pinky's Nursefather. Ryōshū's mother (and at the same time her daughter Araya, due to temporal entanglement).
- **Personality:** Embittered, hating Ryōshū for becoming her "shackles". In truth — an abandoned daughter who grew up and took the place of Nursefather.
- **Fate:** Killed by Ryōshū, who did not recognize her.

nodes.Name: Valencina
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** The Thumb's Nursefather, a veteran of the Smoke War.
- **Personality:** Crude and hard-drinking, but devoted to her "Ticket" — Ryōshū. She calls her "Ticket", believing she will restore her lost status.
- **Abilities:** Rapier, bayonet fighting, use of relics. Has a damaged eye that reacts when Ryōshū is near.
- **Fate:** Killed by the awakened Cockroach Emperor (Gregor).

nodes.Name: Matthias
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** The Middle Finger's Nursefather.
- **Personality:** An eccentric toy collector obsessed with the "family's" justice. Sacrifices his student Kira for an attack without hesitation.
- **Abilities:** A huge sword with a Relic (Moonlight Stones), Retribution tattoos.
- **Fate:** Killed by Vespa (the Yellow Harpoon) and Moses.

nodes.Name: Callisto
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Maestro of the Ring, the Ring's Nursefather.
- **Personality:** Obsessed with art made of human flesh. Considers suffering the highest form of creativity.
- **Fate:** Killed by the future version of Sinclair.

nodes.Name: Sora
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Ryen's student (the Index), a spy in LCE.
- **Personality:** Insecure and clumsy, but devoted to Ryen. Dreamed of becoming his "daughter".
- **Abilities:** E.G.O in the form of shackles.
- **Fate:** Killed in battle.

nodes.Name: Vespa Crabro
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A new Color Fixer, a member of LCD. A former N Corp Taboo Hunter.
- **Personality:** Laconic, efficient. Possesses tremendous physical strength.
- **Abilities:** A harpoon, N Corp methods. Received the title "the Yellow Harpoon" (the name was coined by Ezra).

nodes.Name: Jamila
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Leader of the LCA vanguard team "Udjat".
- **Personality:** A professional soldier. Takes part in the assault on the Spider's House.

nodes.Name: Future Sinclair
nodes.Desc: A Sinclair from an alternate future, summoned by the Mark; a veteran of the coming "Second Smoke War". Destroyed Callisto and Albina.

nodes.Name: How to read this screen
nodes.Desc:
In the center — **Dante** and the 12 Sinners around the clock face (number = hour position). On the left — the company's **departments** and **concepts**; on the right — **the chronicle** from the Prologue to Canto IX: each chapter's sub-blocks hold the key events, and next to it is a frame with its characters.

A chapter tag (for example "Canto VI") works in search.

nodes.Name: Intervallo IV (pt. 1) — Timekilling Time
nodes.Desc:
After Canto VI, **T Corp**'s Nest (District 20), 984.12. Because Dante manipulated time, LCB owes T Corp **10 billion ahn in time tax**. To write off the debt, Dante, Rodion, Ryōshū and Hong Lu work as "detectives" and investigate the **"Time Ripper"** Distortion, which kills people's very lifetime.

They are accompanied by a chatty "auditor" — in fact **Herbert**, T Corp's Executive Director. The killer turns out to be a former member of **the Yurodivy** who lost his brother.

Pec.Name: What matters for the campaign
Pec.Desc:
- Time tax: everyone has their own rate; "time" must be withdrawn from the account in advance (see Dante's notes on T Corp).
- Herbert is interested in Monoliths and dreams of ending suffering by stopping time.
- The Yurodivy are active inside T Corp's Nest as well.

nodes.Name: Herbert
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Executive Director of T Corp (District 20). He accompanied the Sinners disguised as a Grade 5 auditor.
- **Personality:** An eccentric inventor who talks fast and thinks out loud. He laments that humanity cannot defeat time, but believes the City can be made better.
- **Connections:** He warned Dante that turning back time always comes at a steep price (see Dante's notes on T Corp).

nodes.Name: The Time Ripper
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A "serial killer" Distortion of District 20 that takes time away from its victims.
- **Past:** A former member of the Yurodivy whose brother died.

nodes.Name: Intervallo IV (pt. 2) — Murder on the WARP Express
nodes.Desc:
984.12, WARP Train **PW-612**, heading to District 16 (on the way to Canto VII). W Corp hires LCB to eliminate a Distortion that is making passengers disappear. Faust wakes Dante in the middle of the trip — her connection to the "Society" (Gesellschaft) has been cut off.

It turns out the Bloodfiend **Cassetti** is turning passengers into will-less servants to gather a "family" for himself. After an exhausting battle, **Don Quixote reveals herself as a high-ranking Bloodfiend** and destroys Cassetti with ease; afterwards she remembers nothing of it. Vergilius and Faust knew about this in advance. The group leaves through Mephistopheles's Back Doors.

Pec.Name: What matters for the campaign
Pec.Desc:
- A ready-made "murder on the train" scenario inside a WARP Train.
- A foreshadowing of Canto VII: Don Quixote's true nature.
- The MultiCrack Office is mentioned (the Fixer Sasha became Cassetti's servant).

nodes.Name: Cassetti
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A Bloodfiend who turned WARP Train passengers into servants to create a "family".
- **Fate:** Destroyed by Don Quixote, who revealed her Bloodfiend nature.

nodes.Name: Sasha
nodes.Desc: - **Role:** A Fixer (MultiCrack Office) who became Cassetti's kin-servant.

nodes.Name: Intervallo V (pt. 2) — Nocturnal Sweeping
nodes.Desc:
985.01, the Backstreets of **H Corp**'s gigantic construction megastructure (District 8), right before Canto VIII. **Hong Lu** — that is, **Jia Baoyu** of the Jia family — is being hunted. The guide **Qingtao** deliberately leads the group into a trap together with **Shi Yihua**.

The Sinners fight off **the Heishou Pack**, interference from **Ricardo**'s people (the Middle Finger) and endless **Sweepers**. **Jia Qiu** comes to their aid, executing the traitor and the antagonist. The group agrees to work temporarily for **Jia Xichun** before the Family Hierarch Assessment, and LCA demands that Hong Lu take part as a candidate.

Pec.Name: What matters for the campaign
Pec.Desc:
- The Night in H Corp's Backstreets: the Sweepers as a natural disaster.
- The Heishou Pack and the Middle Finger as the families' hired muscle.
- The Tri-axe Office is mentioned.

nodes.Name: Qingtao
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A guide who deliberately led LCB into a trap.
- **Fate:** Executed by Jia Qiu.

nodes.Name: Shi Yihua
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** The organizer of the attempt on Hong Lu's life (the Shi family — one of the four great families of Hongyuan).
- **Fate:** Executed by Jia Qiu.

nodes.Name: Intervallo VII (pt. 1) — Twining Threads
nodes.Desc:
985.02, after Canto IX (released 16.04.2026). After the funeral of the fallen researchers, the Sinners explore the **Corridors** of the destroyed Spider's House — passages to the "rooms" of each Finger. Their guide is the captive **Kira** (Matthias's student).

In the gallery of **the Ring's Fauvists** they are met by Maestro **Émile Benoît** (who taught Ryōshū art in the Spider's House); in the Pinky's Corridor, by her Docent **Rufo**, who wants to obtain **Arayashiki**. It turns out that the sheath of Ryōshū's sword — **"Araya"** — has developed a will of its own: it chooses which memories Ryōshū loses. Ryōshū sacrifices memory so that Arayashiki can cut a way out. In the end the group sets off for **District 14 (N Corp)**.

Pec.Name: The Corridors
Pec.Desc: The passages of the Spider's House leading to the spaces of the Thumb, the Index, the Middle, the Ring and the Pinky. Each holds traces of the Nursefathers and their Children (Valencina and Lucio, Ryen, Sora and Ren…).

Pec.Name: What matters for the campaign
Pec.Desc:
- The Corridors as a "dungeon" with rooms belonging to different Fingers.
- The price of Arayashiki's power is its wielder's memory.

nodes.Name: Émile Benoît
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** Maestro of the Fauvists of **the Ring** (the Ring Finger), a popularizer of Fauvism; in the Spider's House she taught Ryōshū art.
- **Abilities:** Fights with a huge serpentine artwork-weapon and harvests "biomaterials" for her paintings.
- **Fate:** Tried to recruit Ryōshū; survived.

nodes.Name: Rufo
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A Docent of the Ring's Fauvism, a master of "fine compositing from animal hides".
- **Plot:** Attacked in the Pinky's Corridor to take Arayashiki for Émile Benoît. When defeated, she destroyed the Corridor's door, trapping the group in a loop.
- **Fate:** Died of her wounds.

nodes.Name: Intervallo VII (pt. 2) — Mnestic Experience
nodes.Desc:
985.03, **District 14 (N Corp)** (released 11.06.2026). LCB investigates the **"Docugraph"** Distortion — a documentary photographer whose ordinary photos lost out to N Corp's immersive **"Canned Experience"**. The "Place"-type Distortion is built on **Kim in the Bamboo Hat**'s memories of S Corp: he was betrayed by the Right State Councillor whom Kim guarded.

In the distorted images of S Corp, Kim meets **Im Gyeong-eop** — the friend who once saved him — and, with Aeng-du's support, accepts his failures. In the finale **Meursault is arrested**: he had been banished from District 14, and he faces a retrial of his death sentence (the setup for Canto X).

Pec.Name: What matters for the campaign
Pec.Desc:
- "Canned Experience" — an N Corp product that crowds out living creativity.
- Distortion-places assembled from memory.

nodes.Name: Im Gyeong-eop
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A military commissioner of S Corp, a friend of Kim in the Bamboo Hat. He secretly freed Kim after the false accusation and told him to return with allies to root out corruption.
- **In Intervallo VII:** Appears as the core/illusion of the Distortion.

nodes.Name: Docugraph
nodes.Desc: - **Role:** A documentary photographer from District 14 who Distorted when his photos were crowded out by Canned Experience. A "Place"-type Distortion.

nodes.Name: Canto X — The Gaze Bearing (Meursault)
nodes.Desc:
**Meursault**'s chapter, Season 8 "PUNCTUM" (the release was moved from 27.08.2026 to September for full voice acting). **District 14, N Corp**, the virtual department store **Grand Magasin Sisyphe** — a prison and a "farm" where **Canned Experience** is produced.

Meursault is tried for the murder of his mother — one of Sisyphe's **Giants** — and executed by the "Sisyphean punishment"; Faust, through a deal with **the New League of Nine Literati**, gets the Sinners inside. In Sisyphe, the brands **Le Rouge** (which wants to extract the Golden Bough's power) and **Le Noir** (which wants to keep it sealed) are at war; the Giant-architect **Jeanne** is Meursault's former lover.

The story proceeds along **three looping routes**: when Sisyphe can no longer produce experience, a **Liquidation** occurs — a rollback of reality. Only a few remember the loops (Dante, Meursault, the Lady of the Spring, probably Heinrich Kromer).

Pec.Name: Route 1 · Ataraxie
Pec.Desc: The Sinners help stop the birth of Le Rouge's new "god" by forging a "sacred weapon" (the Golden Nail); it all ends in a Liquidation.

Pec.Name: Route 2 · Bon Appétit
Pec.Desc: An alliance with Le Rouge: the Sinners "raise" the newborn god **Pouille**, who awakens as **Buffet** and devours everything — another Liquidation.

Pec.Name: Route 3 · Cogito
Pec.Desc: Dante exposes the Liquidations. It turns out the Warden is an avatar of **the Chaplain**; he is defeated. Meursault's mother had become a Distortion and sought death — Meursault killed her at her wish. Sisyphe collapses, and ~**300 million** distorted prisoners are released; the Chaplain (Maurice) tries to burn them, and a **"Sisyphean rain"** falls over District 14.

Pec.Name: Carmen
Pec.Desc: **Carmen**'s Voice speaks to the Sinners, distorts Jeanne and preaches liberation from society's expectations. At the end she advises Dante to **visit the Library**.

Pec.Name: Post-credits Scene
Pec.Desc: The Kromer(s) persuade N Corp's board of directors to extract Canned Experience directly from brains; **Hermann**'s group obtains materials connected to the **"Protoplast"** — Sisyphe's fall seems to have been staged. The Sisyphean rain of the distorted's ashes threatens confusion between people with prosthetics and Distortions.

Pec.Name: ⚠ Reliability
Pec.Desc: Canto X was released in September 2026. The details were gathered from retellings, not transcripts — double-check them once transcripts appear in the lore folder.

nodes.Name: Jeanne
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A Giant of Sisyphe, the "Voice" of Le Kaki and the architect who gave the department store its current look (7th floor). Meursault's former lover; she protected him after he killed his mother.
- **Plot:** Tries to keep Meursault in her world; under Carmen's influence she Distorts (a "cabaret" battle with its own rules).
- **Fate:** Defeated; before returning from her Distortion, she truly dances a waltz with Meursault for the first time, and he saves her during the collapse.

nodes.Name: The Chaplain (Maurice)
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A Giant of Sisyphe, the "Voice" of Le Noir; outside — an elderly man. His avatar is **the Warden**, who punishes violators and triggers the Liquidations.
- **Plot:** Demands that Meursault repent for his mother's death; rewinds time in battle.
- **Fate:** After Sisyphe's collapse, he tries to burn the prisoners (the "Sisyphean rain") and dies.

nodes.Name: Heinrich Kromer
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** The One Who Holds (N Corp's Inquisition), **the older sister of the Kromer** from Canto III; in Sisyphe — a Giant, the "Voice" of **Nothingness (Les Néants)**, in the guise of "the Hermit".
- **Personality:** Playful and dismissive; doesn't grieve for her sister, hates prosthetics, but is more patient than her.
- **Plot:** Wants to destroy Sisyphe; apparently remembers the loops.
- **Fate:** Alive.

nodes.Name: The Lady of the Spring
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A mysterious woman in blue who lives in Sisyphe's "restroom". Presumably one of **the Lords of the Star** (Demian's organization) — Sinclair notes her resemblance to Demian.
- **Plot:** Protects Dante and the Sinners and understands Dante without a contract; warns of the consequences of exposing the Liquidations. "Keep following the star, and one day…"

nodes.Name: Meursault's Mother
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A Giant of Sisyphe, the "Voice" of Le Rouge.
- **Truth:** She became a Distortion and sought death — Meursault killed her, fulfilling her wish.

nodes.Name: Pouille / Buffet
nodes.Desc:
- **Role:** A newborn "god" raised by Le Rouge; the Sinners named it Pouille, and its true name is **Buffet**.
- **Plot:** Once grown, it devours Sisyphe. After the credits, a limping child hints that Pouille survived.

nodes.Name: Grand Magasin Sisyphe
nodes.Desc:
A non-physical place in **N Corp** (District 14): at once a **punishment** and a **source of experience** for Canned Experience. One gets there through death — the "Sisyphean punishment" (an execution with transfer of consciousness).

A department store of clothing-shop floors; access to the floors depends on how much **currency (human eyes)** a shopper has spent. Its reality is maintained by **the Giants**, who appear to the inhabitants as "Voices", around which cults are built. Meursault was once part of its service team.

By the end of Canto X, Sisyphe collapsed, releasing ~300 million inhabitants.

Pec.Name: Brand-factions
Pec.Desc:
- **Le Rouge** — "revolution"; organic outfits resembling muscles and bones; wants to extract the Golden Bough's power.
- **Le Noir** — "preservation"; black and gold; wants to keep it sealed.
- **Le Kaki** — unaffiliated shoppers, treated with contempt.
- **Nothingness (Les Néants)** — a third force that arose under Carmen's influence; it spawns Distortions and anomalies.

Pec.Name: Giants
Pec.Desc: Jeanne (Le Kaki), Meursault's Mother (Le Rouge, dead), the Chaplain (Le Noir, dead), Heinrich Kromer (Nothingness).

nodes.Name: Canned Experience
nodes.Desc:
An **N Corp** product: "canned" experiences that can be consumed in place of one's own. They are produced by Grand Magasin Sisyphe through the endless cycle of consumption by its prisoners. It crowds out living creativity (see the Docugraph, Intervallo VII).

After Sisyphe's collapse, N Corp intends to extract experience **directly from brains**.

nodes.Name: Liquidation
nodes.Desc:
Sisyphe's mechanism: when the department store can no longer produce experience, reality **rolls back** to a previous state, and the inhabitants' memories are erased. It is triggered by the Chaplain (the Warden). In Canto X, only Dante, Meursault, the Lady of the Spring and, apparently, Heinrich Kromer remember the loops.

**For the GM:** a ready-made "Groundhog Day" mechanic for a story in N Corp.

nodes.Name: BEFORE THE GAMES · order is approximate
THE FOUNDING ERA · 20–30 years before L Corp
The Wing Wars
nodes.Desc: Before the Head established control, the Wings warred with each other. This is how **the Outskirts** came to be — wastelands to which the City's "filth" was later banished.

nodes.Name: The Head's Authority
nodes.Desc: The Head (A, B, C) sets the Taboos, patents and taxes; Arbiters and Claws punish violators.

nodes.Name: La Manchaland
nodes.Desc: More than 200 years ago, the Progenitor Bloodfiend **Don Quixote** turns a desperate girl — Sancho — and builds a park for the coexistence of humans and Bloodfiends. The dream collapses because of bloodlust; the Family locks the Father on the Ferris wheel.

nodes.Name: Sancho at Lethe
nodes.Desc: With **Bari**'s help, Sancho reaches the River of Oblivion, erases her memory and takes her Father's name — **Don Quixote**. According to the notes, she lived by the river for about 200 years.

nodes.Name: Something Full of Tears
nodes.Desc: K Corp's founder **Stefanette** brings back from the Outskirts a creature created by the Star and begins producing ampules from its tears. After her death, the tears are wrung out with brutal videos.

nodes.Name: The Smoke War
nodes.Desc: The war in which **the old L Corp** and **the old G Corp** fell. G Corp's bug soldiers (Gregor), the veterans Outis and Valencina. Future Sinclair mentions a coming "Second Smoke War".

nodes.Name: The League of Nine
nodes.Desc: Idealist scientists gather in T Corp's District: Yeonji, Yi Sang, Dongrang, Dongbaek, Gubo and others. Yi Sang creates **the Mirror** based on Yeonji's glass window.

nodes.Name: The League's Collapse
nodes.Desc: Dongrang sells the group out to T Corp for the sake of his healing technology; the Wings tear the League apart. Gubo takes Yi Sang away to N Corp.

nodes.Name: Kalv
nodes.Desc: N Corp's Inquisition destroys the prosthetics town of Kalv (K Corp). Sinclair survives because Kromer deemed him a "hero".

nodes.Name: Enoch's Death
nodes.Desc: Enoch, who wished to find meaning in life, volunteered for an experiment with "Cogito" — a substance that materializes consciousness. After long hesitation, Carmen agreed. The experiment failed: Enoch died. **Lisa**, in tears, flung at Carmen: *"You should have been the one to die!"* Carmen took these words as confirmation of her guilt. Ayin noted that Enoch *"had seen and experienced so much despair... his eyes no longer looked like a child's"*.

nodes.Name: Carmen's Suicide
nodes.Desc: Crushed by guilt over Enoch's death and by the realization that her dream brought only pain, Carmen slit her wrists in the bathtub. Ayin found her. In desperation he placed her body in a cryo-chamber, refusing to believe she was dead.

nodes.Name: Betrayal and the Head's Raid
nodes.Desc: **Michelle**, unable to bear the pressure and fear, gave away the laboratory's location to **the Head**. **The Arbiter Garion** and a squad of **Claws** attacked the laboratory. **Daniel** (Chesed), paralyzed with fear before Garion's overwhelming power, complied with her demand — he opened the Abnormalities' containment units in exchange for a promise to spare lives. The promise was a lie. Almost all the staff died.

nodes.Name: Kali's Last Battle
nodes.Desc: **Kali (the Red Mist)** fought to the last. She lost an eye and an arm, but managed to kill two Claws and gave battle to Garion herself, buying time for Ayin and Benjamin. Garion, impressed by her resilience, left her severed arm with her as a sign of respect, but dealt her a mortal wound. Kali died protecting others.

nodes.Name: Outcome
nodes.Desc: The laboratory is destroyed. Ayin and Benjamin are the only survivors. They take the corpses (or what was left of them) and the brain of the mortally wounded Garion, to extract information on how to evade the Head and create a Wing.

nodes.Name: Creation of the Sephirot
nodes.Desc: Ayin and Benjamin, using technology extracted from Garion's brain, place the consciousnesses of their dead colleagues into mechanical bodies. Thus the Sephirot are born (Malkuth, Yesod, Hod, Netzach, Gebura, Tiphereth, Chesed). They retain the memories and traumas of their past lives, but are deprived of freedom.

nodes.Name: Creation of Angela
nodes.Desc: Ayin uses Carmen's brain to create a perfect AI — **Angela**. But in her cold logic there is no trace of Carmen's warmth and smile. Ayin cannot bring himself to look at her and leaves communication to Benjamin. He creates a "machine", but hates it for not being Carmen.

nodes.Name: The Murder of Benjamin
nodes.Desc: Benjamin tries to stop Ayin's madness, begging him to end the experiments. But Ayin doesn't listen. In an attempt to regain control and hide the truth from future managers, Angela kills Benjamin. His consciousness also becomes a Sephirah — **Hokma**.

nodes.Name: TT2 Protocol (TimeTrack 2)
nodes.Desc: Ayin makes a deal with T Corp. Using their technology, he creates a time loop inside L Corp. He erases his own memory, becoming "X" — a manager who will go through the 50-day cycle again and again. Every time X fails, time is rewound.

nodes.Name: Angela's Role
nodes.Desc: Angela becomes the warden of this hell. She remembers **every cycle**. Over 10,000 years of subjective time she watches X/Ayin endlessly suffer, die, go mad and hang himself, making the same mistakes again and again. She cynically remarks: *"You are a prisoner. You locked yourself in this prison without bars. Yet the key was always in your hands."*

nodes.Name: 50 Days of Purgatory
nodes.Desc: The final cycle of the TT2 Protocol: X (Ayin without his memory) goes through 50 days, and the Sephirot accept their traumas. For Angela — about 10,000 years of cycles.

nodes.Name: The Light
nodes.Desc: The Light of the Sephirot Tree pours out into the world and shines for **3 days**.

nodes.Name: The Theft of the Light
nodes.Desc: Angela steals the Light; L Corp sinks underground, and all its branches are buried. Wing L's seat becomes vacant — **the Fingers' War** for the Nest begins.

nodes.Name: Distortions
nodes.Desc: Human monsters born of unresolved traumas appear. The first high-profile cases are **the Pianist** (District 9, ~300,000 victims) and later **the Crying Child** (Nest V, 80,000).

nodes.Name: The Library
nodes.Desc: The Library appears in the fog over Nest L. Angela sends out Invitations; Roland becomes her servant.

nodes.Name: Threat Ranks
nodes.Desc: The Hana Association raises the Library's rank: Canard → Urban Myth → Legend → Plague → Nightmare → **Star of the City**.

nodes.Name: Roland's Betrayal
nodes.Desc: Roland tries to kill Angela, blaming her for the Pianist and Angelica's death. Argalia and the Ensemble attack the Library.
