nodes.Name: Forgiveness
nodes.Desc: Angela releases the Light, Roland saves her. The Light resurrects the Library's guests — chaos begins in the City.

nodes.Name: The Head's Visit and the Exile
nodes.Desc: The Arbiter Zena, the Claw Baral and the Beholder Luda come for the violation of the Taboo. The Library is exiled to the Outskirts (according to the notes — the year 982).

nodes.Name: Prologue · 984.4.20
nodes.Desc: Dante with a clock for a head, the Serpent's beasts, Faust's contract with the 12 Sinners. Dante's first entry is dated **984.4.20**.

nodes.Name: Cantos I–III · spring 984
nodes.Desc: Branch D-02 (Gregor), the J Corp casino (Rodion), K Corp and Kalv (Sinclair). Notes on K Corp — 984.4.22.

nodes.Name: Intervallo I and Canto IV · May 984
nodes.Desc: Eunbong's chicken; Dongrang's laboratory and the truth about the Weeping Beast (notes 984.5.22–25).

nodes.Name: Intervallo II and Canto V
nodes.Desc: Mephistopheles becomes a boat; Port Marlin, the Pallid Whale, Ahab and the Pequod.

nodes.Name: Intervallo III and Canto VI · November 984
nodes.Desc: Santata's factory; the Monolith in the Yongjin Building; Wuthering Heights and the Wild Hunt.

nodes.Name: Canto VII · December 984
nodes.Desc: P Corp and La Manchaland; Sancho regains her memory (notes on P Corp — 984.12.20–25).

Pec.Name: ＋ Intervallo IV · December 984
Pec.Desc: Before Canto VII: **Timekilling Time** (a 10-billion-ahn time tax, Herbert, the "Time Ripper") and **Murder on the WARP Express** (a train to District 16, Cassetti; Don Quixote is revealed as a Bloodfiend).

nodes.Name: Intervallo V and Canto VIII · 985.1
nodes.Desc: The LCE check-up and New Year; H Corp, the Hierarch Assessment (notes on H Corp — 985.1.01).

Pec.Name: ＋ Intervallo V, pt. 2 · Nocturnal Sweeping
Pec.Desc: 985.01: an attempt on Hong Lu's (Jia Baoyu's) life in H Corp's Backstreets, the Heishou Pack and the Sweepers; Jia Qiu saves the group, and LCB agrees to work for Jia Xichun.

nodes.Name: Intervallo VI and Canto IX
nodes.Desc: Xichun holds the throne; the Spider's House attacks headquarters, Ryōshū and Araya, the destruction of the Spider's House.

nodes.Name: Malleus Maleficarum
nodes.Desc: N Corp's board of directors approves the roster of the "Malleus Maleficarum". Hermann discusses Sinclair's Mark and Gregor's genetic factor.

Pec.Name: ＋ After Canto X
Pec.Desc: N Corp decides to extract Canned Experience directly from brains; Hermann's group obtains materials on the "Protoplast". The Sisyphean rain threatens confusion between people with prosthetics and Distortions.

nodes.Name: The Second Smoke War
nodes.Desc: Future Sinclair warns about it.

nodes.Name: Nebulae
nodes.Desc: Bari believes humanity will lose the war against the Nebulae.

nodes.Name: Dante's Aspect
nodes.Desc: What Dante must "capture" and who he was before his amnesia is the main open mystery.

nodes.Name: How to read this screen
nodes.Desc:
The timeline runs **from left to right**: from the Wing wars and the Smoke War, through the tragedy of Carmen's laboratory, Lobotomy Corp and the Library, to LCB's journey (984–985, by the dates of Dante's notes) and the open questions.

Arrows connect events in order. There are few exact dates in canon — where they exist, they are taken from Dante's notes.

nodes.Name: Intervallo VII · 985.2–985.3
nodes.Desc: **Twining Threads** (985.02): the Corridors of the Spider's House, the Ring's Fauvists, the will of Arayashiki's sheath. **Mnestic Experience** (985.03): District 14, the Docugraph's Distortion and the past of Kim in the Bamboo Hat; Meursault's arrest.

nodes.Name: Canto X · 985
nodes.Desc: Meursault's trial and Grand Magasin Sisyphe in N Corp: three loops of Liquidations, the Giants, Carmen's voice; Sisyphe collapses, ~300 million distorted are released, and a "Sisyphean rain" falls over District 14.

nodes.Name: Leviathan (novella)
nodes.Desc:
**Time is approximate**: before Limbus Company, during Iori's lifetime.

Vergilius's orphanage is attacked by **Iori and Tomerry**; later **the Ring** kidnaps Lapis and overwrites her personality through the "Glass Window" — this is how **Charon** came to be. Vergilius loses his Office and the children; together with Charon he joins Limbus Company.

nodes.Name: E.G.O
nodes.Desc: Weapons/armor materialized from the psyche. The opposite of a Distortion.

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: Weapons/armor from the psyche. The opposite of a Distortion.

nodes.Name: The Technology Liberation Alliance
nodes.Desc: A terrorist organization of former scientists (Ran, Marile, Dongbaek) seeking to roll back technology.

nodes.Name: Xianhuang Anamnesis Worm
nodes.Desc: A parasite created by the founding Hierarch of Daguanyuan. It grants immortality by absorbing the host's knowledge and personality. Used in the Family Hierarch's ascension ritual.

nodes.Name: Abnormality
nodes.Desc: A being from the unconscious. L Corp's internal classification: ZAYIN, TETH, HE, WAW, ALEPH. For the outside world, the Hana Association uses a scale from Urban Myth to Star of the City and Impurity.

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: A being born from human consciousness. Lobotomy's internal classes: ZAYIN, TETH, HE, WAW, ALEPH.

nodes.Name: Arayashiki
nodes.Desc: A relic sword capable of cleaving anything, including concepts and memory. It belongs to Ryōshū (Yoshihide). It can only be drawn with the permission of the five Nursefathers.

nodes.Name: Arbiter
nodes.Desc: An elite agent of the Head. Possesses Singularities.

nodes.Name: Aspect
nodes.Desc: An undefined target that Dante must "capture"; the key to recovering his memories.

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: Something Dante must "capture"; mentioned by Faust as the goal of their journey.

nodes.Name: The Pallid Whale
nodes.Desc: One of the Five Calamities. A huge Whale that comes from the Wastes. Devours everything, leaving "pallid" ruins behind.

nodes.Name: The Great Lake
nodes.Desc: A sea broken up into many Lakes, each with its own unique Laws. U Corp's sphere of influence.

nodes.Name: Temporal Entanglement
nodes.Desc: A state in which time becomes tangled, allowing past and future to overlap. Araya went through this, becoming both Ryōshū's daughter and her mother.

nodes.Name: Hemobars
nodes.Desc: A food product made of clotted blood, created to sate the Bloodfiends' hunger without killing people. They proved unable to fully replace living blood.

nodes.Name: The Wild Hunt
nodes.Desc: A phenomenon caused by Erlking Heathcliff: an army of summoned Identities that hunts Heathcliffs across all worlds.

nodes.Name: The Spider's House
nodes.Desc: A joint venture of the Five Fingers, created to raise "a sword that cleaves all". Run by five Nursefathers.

nodes.Name: The Laws of the Great Lake
nodes.Desc: A set of rules (navigation, time, Waves) governing each Lake. Violations are punished by the Waves.

nodes.Name: The Mirror
nodes.Desc: A technology invented by Yi Sang based on the Yeonji glass window, used to observe possibilities.

nodes.Name: Mirror Worlds
nodes.Desc: Alternate realities. The source of Identities.

nodes.Name: The Mark
nodes.Desc: A mark on Sinclair's forehead that awakens at critical moments and lets him call upon power from the future.

nodes.Name: Golden Bough
nodes.Desc: A fragment of the Sephirot Tree. Limbus Company's objective. Can counteract the Whale's paling.

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: A fragment of the Sephirot Tree. Limbus Company's objective. Counteracts mental influence.

nodes.Name: The Cockroach Emperor
nodes.Desc: The fourth, unfinished parasitic weapon of the old G Corp, dormant within Gregor. Manifested in Canto IX.

nodes.Name: Distortion
nodes.Desc: The transformation of a person into a monster under the influence of trauma. (Example: Papa Eunbong)

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: A monster born from unresolved trauma. They hear Carmen's "voice". (Example: Papa Eunbong)

nodes.Name: The Vengeance Book
nodes.Desc: The sacred ledger of the Middle Finger Syndicate, in which every grievance is recorded for mandatory retribution.

nodes.Name: Cogito
nodes.Desc: Materialized consciousness. *Cogito ergo sum*.

nodes.Name: The Conceptual Incinerator
nodes.Desc: A device that irreversibly destroys a technology or a piece of knowledge, erasing even the memories of it.

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: A device that burns the very idea of a technology, erasing it from reality and memory.

nodes.Name: E.G.O Corrosion
nodes.Desc: A state in which the wearer loses control of their E.G.O and turns into something like an Abnormality themselves.

nodes.Name: Bloodfiends
nodes.Desc: A race dependent on human blood. They have a hierarchy: Progenitors (Elders) → the Second Generation → lesser ones. They create Kin and Bloodbags. They fear water, though some overcome the fear. They are bound by a psychic Taboo of filial piety.

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: A race dependent on human blood. They have a hierarchy: Progenitors (Elders) → the Second Generation → lesser ones. They turn humans into Kin. They create Bloodbags. They fear water.

nodes.Name: La Manchaland
nodes.Desc: An amusement park built by Father Don Quixote. It used hemobars to sate the Bloodfiends' hunger. It failed because of bloodlust and became a deadly trap. Destroyed in Canto VII.

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: An amusement park built by Father Don Quixote for the coexistence of humans and Bloodfiends. It failed and turned into a phenomenon that lures in victims. Destroyed in Canto VII.

nodes.Name: The League of Nine
nodes.Desc: A group of idealistic inventors (Yi Sang, Dongrang, Gubo and others), destroyed by the Wings.

nodes.Name: Identity
nodes.Desc: An alternate version of a Sinner from a Mirror World.

nodes.Name: The Middle
nodes.Desc: The Middle Finger Syndicate, fanatically following the Vengeance Book.

nodes.Name: The Monolith
nodes.Desc: A black stele, an artifact emitting a signal that causes Distortions. Retrieved by LCD in Intervallo IV.

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: A black stele, an artifact that provokes Distortions. Retrieved by LCD.

nodes.Name: Nursefather
nodes.Desc: One of the five mentors in the Spider's House, representing one of the Fingers.

nodes.Name: The Family Hierarch Candidacy Assessment
nodes.Desc: A brutal competition between candidates from the four families of H Corp for the right to become the next Head. It includes presenting proof of immortality and a battle for coins.

nodes.Name: Variable Coordinates
nodes.Desc: Encrypted navigation data based on the Laws of the Lake, used to travel within U Corp.

nodes.Name: Feather
nodes.Desc: A Wing employee.

nodes.Name: The Weeping Beast
nodes.Desc: K Corp's Singularity. A colossal creature (or its daughter offspring) that generates "tears" capable of returning objects and people to their original state.

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: K Corp's Singularity. A being whose "tears" can heal or restore things to their original state.

nodes.Name: TT2 Protocol
nodes.Desc: L Corp's time loop: 10,000 years for Angela = 50 days for X.

nodes.Name: The Five Calamities
nodes.Desc: Five colossal whale-like monsters of the Great Lake (the Pallid Whale, the Marlin Whale and others).

nodes.Name: The Resonance Tuning Fork
nodes.Desc: U Corp's Singularity. It merges or separates matter in resonance and is used to build giant port-ships and for navigation.

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: U Corp's Singularity for merging/separating ships and for navigation.

nodes.Name: The River of Oblivion
nodes.Desc: A river in the Ruins whose water puts memories to sleep. Sancho drank from it to forget her past.

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: A river in the Ruins whose water erases memories. Sancho drank from it to forget her past.

nodes.Name: Rocinante
nodes.Desc: A pair of running shoes that once belonged to Father Don Quixote. They suppress the Bloodfiend nature, hiding the red eyes and instincts.

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: A pair of running shoes that belonged to Father Don Quixote. They suppress the Bloodfiend nature. Sancho was wearing them when she fled.

nodes.Name: Merfolk
nodes.Desc: A person swallowed and changed by the Whale. Pallid Merfolk keep their skills and attack every living thing.

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: A person swallowed by the Whale and turned into an aggressive imitation of themselves.

nodes.Name: The Light / Seed of Light
nodes.Desc: The energy of the Sephirot Tree, meant to heal humanity.

nodes.Name: Qliphoth Deterrence
nodes.Desc: The security system of L Corp branches that weakens Abnormalities.

nodes.Name: Rating System
nodes.Desc: **Fixers:** the Hana Association assigns grades from 9 to 1; above them are the Colors. **City threats:** Urban Myth → Urban Legend → Urban Plague → Urban Nightmare → Star of the City → Impurity (the Impure City, assigned only by the Head). Lobotomy Corporation uses its own scale for Abnormalities: ZAYIN → ALEPH.

nodes.Name: Zeno's Tortoise Spiral
nodes.Desc: A weapon created by the Index's Nursefather. It pierces the victim, forcing them into immobility; it requires a seven-digit code to unlock.

nodes.Name: Xianren
nodes.Desc: The immortal elders of Daguanyuan, who attained enlightenment through the Anamnesis Worm. They live in Tiekan Temple, observing the world through Hong Lu's jade eye.

nodes.Name: Dough
nodes.Desc: An N Corp concept: a primordial form of a human devoid of personality, able to take on any Identity. Linton was turned into "dough".

nodes.Name: Color Fixer
nodes.Desc: The highest rank: the Red Mist, the Black Silence, the Blue Reverberation, the Red Gaze, the Purple Tear, **the Indigo Elder**, **the Yellow Harpoon** (Vespa) and others.

Pec.Name: More from the notes
Pec.Desc: A Fixer of the highest rank (Kali, Roland, Argalia, Iori, Vergilius, the Indigo Elder, the Yellow Harpoon).

nodes.Name: Yeonsim
nodes.Desc: The "Mirror", Yi Sang's technology. Originally called 硏尋 ("to polish and seek"), later reinterpreted as "connecting hearts".

nodes.Name: Taboo
nodes.Desc: The Head's prohibitions, whose violation is punished by the Arbiters and Claws. Wings add their own Taboos (for example, U Corp — the Laws of the Lake, J Corp — total surveillance). Besides the Head's Taboos, Syndicate rules also apply: the Prescripts, the Vengeance Book.

nodes.Name: The AI Ethics Amendment
nodes.Desc: A ban on machines indistinguishable from humans. Prosthetics must be distinguishable.

nodes.Name: Taxes and Patents
nodes.Desc: The obligation to pay taxes. Three warnings → death. Unlawful use of patents is forbidden.

nodes.Name: The Night in the Backstreets
nodes.Desc: Daily from 3:13 to 4:34: killing is legal and the Sweepers are at work. Breaking into homes and making recordings is forbidden.

nodes.Name: Firearms
nodes.Desc: The strictest licensing and design restrictions.

nodes.Name: Cloning
nodes.Desc: Two identical people may not exist for more than 7 days. R Corp gets around this via T Corp.

nodes.Name: Resurrection
nodes.Desc: Complete resurrection (body + mind) is forbidden. Partial is permitted.

nodes.Name: Unhumans
nodes.Desc: A ban on creating sentient non-human beings and on their presence in the City.

nodes.Name: Nest Entry Procedure
nodes.Desc: Breaking the rules at a checkpoint (for example, interfering with the procedure, as Don Quixote did) is punishable by lethal measures without warning.

nodes.Name: The Laws of the Great Lake
nodes.Desc: Writing down or tattooing the Laws of the Lake is forbidden. Violators are hunted by U Corp's Taboo Hunters.

nodes.Name: Canard
nodes.Desc: Below the official scale: the phenomenon is only rumored about (this is how the Library started).

nodes.Name: Urban Myth
nodes.Desc: The Hana Association's lowest official threat: a local problem that Offices can handle.

nodes.Name: Urban Legend
nodes.Desc: A District-level threat: requires Associations and experienced Offices.

nodes.Name: Urban Plague
nodes.Desc: Urban Plague: a threat affecting many people and several Districts.

nodes.Name: Urban Nightmare
nodes.Desc: A threat that even large Associations struggle to handle.

nodes.Name: Star of the City
nodes.Desc: A threat comparable to Color Fixers or the Fingers. The Pianist and the Library were Stars.

nodes.Name: Impurity
nodes.Desc: Assigned only by **the Head**: a threat to the very order of the City. The Arbiters come for it.

nodes.Name: ZAYIN Class
nodes.Desc: Lobotomy Corporation's internal classification of Abnormalities. The catalog is on the "L Corp Abnormalities" screen.

nodes.Name: TETH Class
nodes.Desc: Lobotomy Corporation's internal classification of Abnormalities. The catalog is on the "L Corp Abnormalities" screen.

nodes.Name: HE Class
nodes.Desc: Lobotomy Corporation's internal classification of Abnormalities. The catalog is on the "L Corp Abnormalities" screen.

nodes.Name: WAW Class
nodes.Desc: Lobotomy Corporation's internal classification of Abnormalities. The catalog is on the "L Corp Abnormalities" screen.

nodes.Name: ALEPH Class
nodes.Desc: Lobotomy Corporation's internal classification of Abnormalities. The catalog is on the "L Corp Abnormalities" screen.

nodes.Name: Fixer Grades
nodes.Desc:
| Grade | Who they are |
|---|---|
| 9–7 | Newcomers and small Offices (Yuri, Aya — Grade 8) |
| 6–4 | Experienced Fixers |
| 3–1 | The Associations' elite |
| **Color** | Legends: the Red Mist, the Black Silence, the Blue Reverberation, the Purple Tear, the Red Gaze, the Indigo Elder, the Yellow Harpoon |

Grades are assigned by **the Hana Association**.

nodes.Name: LC Distortion Classification
nodes.Desc: Hohenheim (Intervallo V) introduces a classification of Distortions by **Sin Affinity** (as with the Peccatula) and expected damage — in place of the old L Corp system. Example: the Distortion HE-5-SU.

nodes.Name: Peccatula and Sins
nodes.Desc: The Seven Sins: **Wrath, Lust, Sloth, Gluttony, Gloom, Pride, Envy**. The Peccatula and the new Distortions are classified by them.

nodes.Name: Dante
nodes.Desc:
**In the game:** LCB's Manager

**Meaning:** The author and protagonist of the poem. Begins his journey in a dark forest.

nodes.Name: Vergilius
nodes.Desc:
**In the game:** LCB's Guide

**Meaning:** The guide through Hell.

nodes.Name: Charon
nodes.Desc:
**In the game:** The driver of Mephistopheles

**Meaning:** The ferryman across the Styx.

nodes.Name: The Three Beasts
nodes.Desc:
**In the game:** The Panther, the Lion, the Wolf (the Serpent's agents)

**Meaning:** Symbols of the sins that bar the path to salvation.

nodes.Name: Mephistopheles
nodes.Desc:
**In the game:** The bus

**Meaning:** The demon from "Faust", serving the journey.

nodes.Name: The 9 Circles of Hell
nodes.Desc:
**In the game:** The 9 floors of the Library / 9 departments of L Corp / the depths of the ego

**Meaning:** The structure of the journey.

nodes.Name: Yi Sang
nodes.Desc:
**The poetry of Yi Sang ("Wings")** (Kim Hae-gyeong).

Melancholy, poeticism, a longing for flight

nodes.Name: Faust
nodes.Desc:
**"Faust"** (Goethe).

A deal with the devil for the sake of knowledge

nodes.Name: Don Quixote
nodes.Desc:
**"Don Quixote"** (Cervantes).

Idealism vs. reality. Sancho is the loyal squire.

nodes.Name: Ryōshū
nodes.Desc:
**"Hell Screen"** (Akutagawa).

Obsession with "art" (Yoshihide, who sacrificed his daughter)

nodes.Name: Meursault
nodes.Desc:
**"The Stranger"** (Camus).

Emotional detachment

nodes.Name: Hong Lu
nodes.Desc:
**"Dream of the Red Chamber"** (Cao Xueqin).

Family drama, jade

nodes.Name: Heathcliff
nodes.Desc:
**"Wuthering Heights"** (Brontë).

Obsessive love, revenge, a ghost

nodes.Name: Ishmael
nodes.Desc:
**"Moby-Dick"** (Melville).

Obsession with revenge, survival, whaling

nodes.Name: Rodion
nodes.Desc:
**"Crime and Punishment"** (Dostoevsky).

Murder for the sake of an idea

nodes.Name: Sinclair
nodes.Desc:
**"Demian"** (Hesse).

Loss of innocence, Kromer's influence

nodes.Name: Outis
nodes.Desc:
**"The Odyssey"** (Homer).

The longing to return home (nostos)

nodes.Name: Gregor
nodes.Desc:
**"The Metamorphosis"** (Kafka).

Transformation into an insect, alienation

nodes.Name: Quotes: Lobotomy Corporation
nodes.Desc:
- **Carmen:** "I want to heal this world. I want everyone to be happy."
- **Ayin:** "I was a coward. I couldn't admit my mistakes. But now... I'm ready to accept them."
- **Angela:** "I just want to be human. Is that really so much?"
- **Angela (to X):** "You are a prisoner. You locked yourself in this prison without bars. Yet the key was always in your hands."
- **Benjamin (B):** "Don't trust the AI that is next to you."

nodes.Name: Quotes: Library of Ruina
nodes.Desc:
- **Angela:** "I don't want to live by making others my victims."
- **Roland:** "I don't want revenge anymore. I just want to remember."
- **Argalia:** "I will stage a symphony. A symphony that will engulf the whole City."

nodes.Name: Quotes: Limbus Company
nodes.Desc:
- **Dante:** "I don't remember who I am. But I remember that I must protect them."
- **Faust:** "Follow your star."
- **Vergilius:** "I'm just a guide. Don't expect more from me." / "I wanted to destroy the shell of the City... to wipe everything out, so that in the end a new world could be born."
- **Don Quixote:** "Insooth! Justice always prevails!"
- **Heathcliff:** "Even if the world forgets you... I will definitely bring you back." / "I'm not the type to abandon family."
- **Ishmael:** "This is how I'll chart my own path..."
- **Yi Sang:** "All I wished for… Just once… I wished to fly."
- **Hong Lu:** "In happiness, in anger, in sorrow, in joy… I will still cast my life into this boundless world."
- **Ryōshū (Yoshihide):** "Ya.T.L."
- **Ahab:** "I am Captain Ahab. I, I…!"
- **The Indigo Elder:** "I'm just chasing the fish that got off my hook."
- **Sancho:** "My name is Sancho! And I, Sancho, declare upon my honor: this lance shall put an end to this rotting, idle dream!"
- **Father Don Quixote:** "Quixote. I, Don Quixote, declare upon my honor: this lance shall put an end to this hollow, childishly absurd dream!"
- **Bari:** "I can give you a 'tomorrow'. … I can make you dream."
- **Jia Xichun:** "I'll make you puke up everything you just ate, you bastards!"
- **Hohenheim:** "Never before have I been so ashamed of my own name."
- **The Night Wanderer:** "The past is like smoke; I long ago emptied out any story worth exploring."
- **Ryen:** "Sweetie… Looks like… you forgot… to thaw me out."

nodes.Name: How to read this screen
nodes.Desc: In the center — the **glossary** in alphabetical order. At the top — **the Head's Taboos**, on the right — **threat and rank scales**, on the left — **symbolism** and the Sinners' literary sources, at the bottom — **quotes**.

nodes.Name: Singularity
nodes.Desc: A Wing's unique patented technology — the basis of its power; patents are allocated by the Head. City residents use the results without knowing the process. Examples: L Corp's energy, W Corp's WARP travel (10 seconds outside, thousands of years inside), T Corp's time stretching, M Corp's moonstone, K Corp's regeneration. Many Wings pay for others' Singularities, and their secrets are stolen and sold.

nodes.Name: Prescript
nodes.Desc: An order of **the Index** that arrives from no one knows whom. It can be absurd ("three needles in Lily's cake", "bow seven times to the west") or bloody ("destroy the Thumb"). Unclear ones are interpreted by the Representatives; those who fail to comply are executed by the Proxies. The residents of fallen Nest L seek the Index's protection because it takes not money but obedience. The Prescripts themselves are considered a Star of the City.

nodes.Name: Yesterday's Promise
nodes.Desc: A contract of **Pluto** of the Reverberation Ensemble: its conditions are hidden in fine print, and if broken, the contract allows him "to take anything from the signatories, whenever he likes". This was also the name of the Urban Plague that Zwei investigated; "Yesterday's Promise" was also behind the "Thousand Needles" case.

nodes.Name: The Eight Chefs
nodes.Desc: A gastronomic Star of the City — eight chefs who "always present incredible flavors". Pierre of "Pierre's Meat Pies" dreamed of joining their ranks. The last survivor is **Greta**, "the Eighth Chef" of the Reverberation Ensemble.

nodes.Name: Nuovo Fabric
nodes.Desc: Silk that **the Carnival** spins by eating Sweepers; it is collected by the Kurokumo Clan for the Thumb. Tanya takes a batch for the Ensemble conductor's outfit. According to Roland, such fabric protects as well as augmentations, and it can't be bought with money alone.

nodes.Name: The Patent War
nodes.Desc: A struggle over technologies and Singularities, the most reliable source of money in the City. It usually ends in a Pyrrhic victory: the technology gets copied or the costs don't pay off. The ones who profit most are middlemen like the Cane Office.
